<file path="backend/generate_vapid2.py">
import json
import base64
from py_vapid import Vapid

v = Vapid()
v.generate_keys()

# Export as base64url for VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY and VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
priv_raw = v.private_key.private_numbers().private_value.to_bytes(32, 'big')
pub_raw = v.public_key.public_numbers().encode_point()

priv_b64 = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(priv_raw).decode('utf-8').rstrip('=')
pub_b64 = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(pub_raw).decode('utf-8').rstrip('=')

with open('.env', 'a') as f:
    f.write(f"\nVAPID_PRIVATE_KEY={priv_b64}\n")
    f.write(f"VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY={pub_b64}\n")

with open('../frontend/.env', 'a') as f:
    f.write(f"\nVITE_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY={pub_b64}\n")

print("Keys generated successfully!")

  <script>
    // Self-healing function to recover from Service Worker routing deadlocks when online
    async function handleReload() {
      if (navigator.onLine) {
        try {
          if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
            const registrations = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations();
            for (const registration of registrations) {
              await registration.unregister();
            }
            console.log('Service workers unregistered successfully to resolve deadlock.');
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('Failed to unregister service worker:', e);
        }
      }
      window.location.reload();
    }

    // Auto-heal on page load if the user is actually online
    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
      if (navigator.onLine) {
        // To avoid infinite redirect loops in edge cases, check if we reloaded recently
        const lastAutoReload = sessionStorage.getItem('last_auto_reload');
        const now = Date.now();
        if (!lastAutoReload || (now - parseInt(lastAutoReload, 10) > 10000)) {
          sessionStorage.setItem('last_auto_reload', now.toString());
          handleReload();
        }
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>

<file path="frontend/src/api/limits.ts">
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

// Лимит токенов ИИ для бесплатного аккаунта (в день)
export const FREE_DAILY_LIMIT = 100;

export interface AIUsage {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  date: string;
  requests_count: number; // логически теперь это `used_tokens`
}

/**
 * Проверяет, может ли пользователь потратить указанное количество токенов ИИ.
 * Возвращает { allowed: true/false, isPro: boolean, count: number }
 */
export async function checkAILimit(userId: string, cost: number = 1): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; isPro: boolean; count: number }> {
  try {
    // 1. Проверяем статус PRO
    const { data: profile } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('is_pro')
      .eq('id', userId)
      .single();

    const isPro = profile?.is_pro || false;

    // Если PRO, лимиты не проверяем (счетчик не важен, но возвращаем 0)
    if (isPro) {
      return { allowed: true, isPro: true, count: 0 };
    }

    // 2. Иначе проверяем кол-во потраченных токенов сегодня
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const { data: usage } = await supabase
      .from('ai_usage')
      .select('requests_count')
      .eq('user_id', userId)
      .eq('date', today)
      .maybeSingle();

    const count = usage?.requests_count || 0;

    return {
      allowed: (count + cost) <= FREE_DAILY_LIMIT,
      isPro: false,
      count
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Ошибка при проверке лимитов:', err);
    // В случае технической ошибки разрешаем, чтобы не блокировать приложение
    return { allowed: true, isPro: false, count: 0 };
  }
}

/**
 * Списывает токены ИИ за сегодня.
 * Если записи нет, создает её.
 */
export async function incrementAIUsage(userId: string, cost: number = 1): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    
    // Пытаемся получить текущую запись
    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from('ai_usage')
      .select('id, requests_count')
      .eq('user_id', userId)
      .eq('date', today)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (existing) {
      // Обновляем (прибавляем стоимость)
      await supabase
        .from('ai_usage')
        .update({ requests_count: existing.requests_count + cost })
        .eq('id', existing.id);
    } else {
      // Создаем новую с начальной стоимостью
      await supabase
        .from('ai_usage')
        .insert({
          user_id: userId,
          date: today,
          requests_count: cost
        });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Ошибка при обновлении счетчика ИИ:', err);
  }
}

<file path="frontend/src/api/materials.ts">
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

export async function getMaterials(userId: string) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('materials')
    .select('id, title, subject, created_at, flashcards_json, quiz_json, original_text, summary_json, missions_json')
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
  if (error) throw error;
  return data || [];
}

export async function getMaterialById(id: string) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('materials')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', id)
    .single();
  if (error) throw error;
  return data;
}

export async function deleteMaterial(id: string) {
  const { error } = await supabase.from('materials').delete().eq('id', id);
  if (error) throw error;
}

export async function updateMaterialSubject(id: string, subject: string) {
  const { error } = await supabase.from('materials').update({ subject }).eq('id', id);
  if (error) console.error('updateMaterialSubject error:', error);
}

export async function updateMaterialTitle(id: string, title: string) {
  const { error } = await supabase.from('materials').update({ title }).eq('id', id);
  if (error) console.error('updateMaterialTitle error:', error);
}

export async function updateMaterialVisibility(id: string, is_public: boolean) {
  const { error } = await supabase.from('materials').update({ is_public }).eq('id', id);
  if (error) console.error('updateMaterialVisibility error:', error);
}

export async function updateMaterialMissions(id: string, missions: any[]) {
  const { error } = await supabase
    .from('materials')
    .update({ missions_json: { missions } })
    .eq('id', id);
  if (error) console.error('updateMaterialMissions error:', error);
}

<file path="frontend/src/api/quests.ts">
import { ExamResult, StudySession } from '../types';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

export type QuestType = 'daily' | 'weekly';
export type TargetType = 'analyze' | 'quiz' | 'chat' | 'mood' | 'exam' | 'review' | 'podcast' | 'grade';

// ── XP / Уровни ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const LEVEL_THRESHOLDS = [
  0,    // Lv 1  — Новичок
  100,  // Lv 2  — Стажёр
  250,  // Lv 3  — Знаток
  500,  // Lv 4  — Эксперт
  900,  // Lv 5  — Профессор
  1400, // Lv 6  — Мастер
  2000, // Lv 7  — Академик
  3000, // Lv 8  — Легенда
];

export const LEVEL_NAMES = [
  'Новичок', 'Стажёр', 'Знаток', 'Эксперт',
  'Профессор', 'Мастер', 'Академик', 'Легенда',
];

export function calcLevel(xp: number): { level: number; name: string; currentXP: number; nextXP: number; progress: number } {
  let level = 0;
  for (let i = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (xp >= LEVEL_THRESHOLDS[i]) { level = i + 1; break; }
  }
  const capped = Math.min(level, LEVEL_NAMES.length);
  const currentThresh = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS[capped - 1] ?? 0;
  const nextThresh = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS[capped] ?? LEVEL_THRESHOLDS[LEVEL_THRESHOLDS.length - 1] + 1000;
  const progress = Math.min(100, Math.round(((xp - currentThresh) / (nextThresh - currentThresh)) * 100));
  return { level: capped, name: LEVEL_NAMES[capped - 1] ?? 'Легенда', currentXP: xp - currentThresh, nextXP: nextThresh - currentThresh, progress };
}

// ── Получение XP пользователя ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function getUserXP(userId: string): Promise<number> {
  const { data } = await supabase
    .from('user_xp')
    .select('total_xp')
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .maybeSingle();
  return data?.total_xp ?? 0;
}

export async function addXP(userId: string, amount: number): Promise<number> {
  const current = await getUserXP(userId);
  const newXP = current + amount;
  await supabase.from('user_xp').upsert({ user_id: userId, total_xp: newXP }, { onConflict: 'user_id' });
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('xp_updated'));
  }
  return newXP;
}

export async function recordStudyActivity(userId: string, cardsReviewed: number = 0, materialsAdded: number = 0) {
  const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  
  try {
    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from('study_sessions')
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', userId)
      .eq('date', today)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (existing) {
      await supabase
        .from('study_sessions')
        .update({
          cards_reviewed: (existing.cards_reviewed || 0) + cardsReviewed,
          materials_added: (existing.materials_added || 0) + materialsAdded
        })
        .eq('id', existing.id);
    } else {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('study_sessions')
        .insert({
          user_id: userId,
          date: today,
          cards_reviewed: cardsReviewed,
          materials_added: materialsAdded
        });
      
      // Обрабатываем возможную гонку уникальности (Unique violation)
      if (error && error.code === '23505') {
        const { data: retryExisting } = await supabase
          .from('study_sessions')
          .select('*')
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .eq('date', today)
          .maybeSingle();
        if (retryExisting) {
          await supabase
            .from('study_sessions')
            .update({
              cards_reviewed: (retryExisting.cards_reviewed || 0) + cardsReviewed,
              materials_added: (retryExisting.materials_added || 0) + materialsAdded
            })
            .eq('id', retryExisting.id);
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Error recording study activity:", e);
  }
}


// ── Достижения ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface AchievementDef {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  icon: string;
  xp: number;
  check: (stats: UserStats) => boolean;
}

interface UserStats {
  totalExams: number;
  totalReviews: number;
  totalAnalyze: number;
  streak: number;
  exam5Count: number;
  totalMistakesResolved: number;
  totalXP: number;
}

export const ACHIEVEMENTS: AchievementDef[] = [
  { id: 'first_exam',       title: 'Первая сессия',        description: 'Сдали первый AI-экзамен',          icon: 'award',  xp: 50,  check: s => s.totalExams >= 1 },
  { id: 'exam_perfectionist', title: 'Перфекционист',      description: 'Получили пятёрку на AI-экзамене',  icon: 'star',   xp: 75,  check: s => s.exam5Count >= 1 },
  { id: 'three_exams',      title: 'Опытный экзаменуемый', description: 'Сдали 3 экзамена',                 icon: 'trophy', xp: 100, check: s => s.totalExams >= 3 },
  { id: 'streak_3',         title: 'На волне',              description: '3 дня учёбы подряд',              icon: 'flame',  xp: 60,  check: s => s.streak >= 3 },
  { id: 'streak_7',         title: 'Недельный марафон',    description: '7 дней учёбы подряд',              icon: 'flame',  xp: 150, check: s => s.streak >= 7 },
  { id: 'first_analyze',    title: 'Лаборант знаний',       description: 'Загрузили первую лекцию',          icon: 'zap',    xp: 30,  check: s => s.totalAnalyze >= 1 },
  { id: 'five_analyze',     title: 'Архивариус',            description: 'Загрузили 5 лекций',              icon: 'book',   xp: 100, check: s => s.totalAnalyze >= 5 },
  { id: 'review_50',        title: 'Мастер карточек',       description: 'Повторили 50 карточек',            icon: 'brain',  xp: 120, check: s => s.totalReviews >= 50 },
  { id: 'mistakes_resolved', title: 'Работа над ошибками', description: 'Исправили 5 ошибок из дневника',   icon: 'check',  xp: 80,  check: s => s.totalMistakesResolved >= 5 },
  { id: 'xp_500',           title: 'Пятисотник',            description: 'Набрали 500 XP',                  icon: 'award',  xp: 50,  check: s => s.totalXP >= 500 },
  { id: 'xp_1000',          title: 'Тысячник',              description: 'Набрали 1000 XP',                 icon: 'award',  xp: 100, check: s => s.totalXP >= 1000 },
];

export async function checkAndAwardAchievements(userId: string): Promise<AchievementDef[]> {
  // Получаем уже полученные достижения
  const { data: existing } = await supabase
    .from('user_achievements')
    .select('achievement_id')
    .eq('user_id', userId);
  const earnedIds = new Set((existing ?? []).map(e => e.achievement_id));

  // Собираем статистику
  const [examsRes, sessRes, matsRes, mistakesRes, xp] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('exam_sessions').select('score').eq('user_id', userId).eq('status', 'completed'),
    supabase.from('study_sessions').select('date, cards_reviewed').eq('user_id', userId).order('date', { ascending: false }),
    supabase.from('materials').select('id').eq('user_id', userId),
    supabase.from('mistake_diary').select('is_resolved').eq('user_id', userId).eq('is_resolved', true),
    getUserXP(userId),
  ]);

  const exams = examsRes.data ?? [];
  const sessions = sessRes.data ?? [];
  const materials = matsRes.data ?? [];

  // Считаем стрик
  const dates = new Set(sessions.map((s: StudySession) => s.date));
  let streak = 0;
  let d = new Date();
  while (dates.has(d.toISOString().split('T')[0])) {
    streak++;
    d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1);
  }

  const stats: UserStats = {
    totalExams: exams.length,
    totalReviews: sessions.reduce((a: number, s: StudySession) => a + (s.cards_reviewed || 0), 0),
    totalAnalyze: materials.length,
    streak,
    exam5Count: exams.filter((e: any) => e.score >= 85).length,
    totalMistakesResolved: (mistakesRes.data ?? []).length,
    totalXP: xp,
  };

  // Находим новые достижения
  const newAchievements: AchievementDef[] = [];
  for (const ach of ACHIEVEMENTS) {
    if (!earnedIds.has(ach.id) && ach.check(stats)) {
      newAchievements.push(ach);
      await supabase.from('user_achievements').insert({ user_id: userId, achievement_id: ach.id });
      await addXP(userId, ach.xp);
    }
  }

  return newAchievements;
}

// ── Квесты ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function getQuestsWithProgress(userId: string) {
  const { data: quests, error: qErr } = await supabase.from('quests').select('*');
  if (qErr || !quests) return [];

  const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  const now = new Date();
  const day = now.getDay();
  const diff = now.getDate() - day + (day === 0 ? -6 : 1);
  const monday = new Date(now.setDate(diff)).toISOString().split('T')[0];

  const { data: progress, error: pErr } = await supabase
    .from('user_quest_progress')
    .select('*')
    .eq('user_id', userId);

  if (pErr) return quests.map(q => ({ ...q, progress: 0, is_completed: false }));

  return quests.map(q => {
    const resetDate = q.type === 'daily' ? today : monday;
    const prog = progress?.find(p => p.quest_id === q.id && p.reset_at === resetDate);
    return { ...q, current_count: prog?.current_count || 0, is_completed: prog?.is_completed || false, reset_at: resetDate };
  });
}

export async function updateQuestProgress(userId: string, targetType: TargetType, increment: number = 1): Promise<boolean> {
  const { data: targetQuests } = await supabase.from('quests').select('*').eq('target_type', targetType);
  if (!targetQuests || targetQuests.length === 0) return false;

  const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  const now = new Date();
  const day = now.getDay();
  const diff = now.getDate() - day + (day === 0 ? -6 : 1);
  const monday = new Date(now.setDate(diff)).toISOString().split('T')[0];

  let anyCompleted = false;

  for (const quest of targetQuests) {
    const resetAt = quest.type === 'daily' ? today : monday;
    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from('user_quest_progress')
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', userId)
      .eq('quest_id', quest.id)
      .eq('reset_at', resetAt)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (existing) {
      if (existing.is_completed) continue;
      const newCount = existing.current_count + increment;
      const isCompleted = newCount >= quest.target_count;
      if (isCompleted) anyCompleted = true;
      await supabase
        .from('user_quest_progress')
        .update({ current_count: newCount, is_completed: isCompleted, completed_at: isCompleted ? new Date().toISOString() : null, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
        .eq('id', existing.id);
      if (isCompleted) await addXP(userId, quest.xp_reward ?? 20);
    } else {
      const isCompleted = increment >= quest.target_count;
      if (isCompleted) anyCompleted = true;
      await supabase.from('user_quest_progress').insert({
        user_id: userId, quest_id: quest.id, current_count: increment,
        is_completed: isCompleted, completed_at: isCompleted ? new Date().toISOString() : null, reset_at: resetAt,
      });
      if (isCompleted) await addXP(userId, quest.xp_reward ?? 20);
    }
  }

  return anyCompleted;
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Trophy, Star, Flame, Zap, BookOpen, Award, Brain, CheckCircle2, X } from 'lucide-react';

export interface Achievement {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  icon: string;
  xp: number;
}

interface Props {
  achievement: Achievement | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const ICON_MAP: Record<string, React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>> = {
  trophy: Trophy,
  star: Star,
  flame: Flame,
  zap: Zap,
  book: BookOpen,
  award: Award,
  brain: Brain,
  check: CheckCircle2,
};

export default function AchievementToast({ achievement, onClose }: Props) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!achievement) return;
    setVisible(true);
    const t = setTimeout(() => { setVisible(false); setTimeout(onClose, 400); }, 4500);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [achievement]);

  if (!achievement) return null;

  const Icon = ICON_MAP[achievement.icon] ?? Trophy;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {visible && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 80, scale: 0.9 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0, scale: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 80, scale: 0.9 }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 25 }}

        >
          {/* Иконка достижения */}
          <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-400 to-amber-600 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-lg">
            <Icon className="w-6 h-6 text-white" />
          </div>

          {/* Текст */}
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">

              <Trophy className="w-3 h-3" /> Достижение разблокировано!
            </p>
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white truncate">{achievement.title}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 truncate">{achievement.description}</p>
            <div className="mt-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-indigo-500/20 border border-indigo-500/30 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5">

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

function UnifiedProgressBar({ value }: { value: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl mx-auto">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
        <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Общий прогресс анализа</span>
        <span className="text-sm font-black text-indigo-600 tabular-nums">{value}%</span>
      </div>
      <div className="h-3 w-full bg-slate-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden p-[2px] border border-slate-200 shadow-inner">
        <motion.div
          className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 via-violet-500 to-emerald-500 rounded-full shadow-sm"
          initial={{ width: '0%' }}
          animate={{ width: `${value}%` }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: 'easeOut' }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AgentTimer({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const startRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const frameRef = useRef<number>(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (status === 'running') {
      startRef.current = Date.now();
      const tick = () => {
        if (startRef.current) setElapsed((Date.now() - startRef.current) / 1000);
        frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      };
      frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
    } else {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
    }
  }, [status]);

  if (status === 'idle') return null;
  return status === 'done'
    ? <span className="text-xs text-emerald-600 font-bold tabular-nums">{elapsed.toFixed(1)}с</span>
    : <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold tabular-nums">{elapsed.toFixed(1)}с</span>;
}

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';

interface Props {
  trigger: boolean;
  type?: 'quest' | 'exam5' | 'achievement' | 'level';
}

export default function ConfettiCelebration({ trigger, type = 'quest' }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!trigger) return;

    const defaults = { startVelocity: 30, spread: 360, ticks: 60, zIndex: 9999 };

    if (type === 'level') {
      // Мощный залп для повышения уровня
      const duration = 3000;
      const end = Date.now() + duration;
      const frame = () => {
        confetti({ ...defaults, particleCount: 7, origin: { x: Math.random(), y: Math.random() * 0.6 } });
        if (Date.now() < end) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      };
      frame();
    } else if (type === 'exam5') {
      // Двойной залп по бокам для пятёрки
      confetti({ particleCount: 100, angle: 60, spread: 55, origin: { x: 0, y: 1 }, colors: ['#4f46e5', '#7c3aed', '#06b6d4'], zIndex: 9999 });
      confetti({ particleCount: 100, angle: 120, spread: 55, origin: { x: 1, y: 1 }, colors: ['#4f46e5', '#7c3aed', '#06b6d4'], zIndex: 9999 });
    } else if (type === 'achievement') {
      confetti({ particleCount: 80, spread: 80, origin: { y: 0.6 }, colors: ['#f59e0b', '#fbbf24', '#fcd34d'], zIndex: 9999 });
    } else {
      // Обычный квест — лёгкий залп с двух сторон
      confetti({ particleCount: 50, angle: 60, spread: 55, origin: { x: 0, y: 1 }, colors: ['#4f46e5', '#10b981', '#f59e0b'], zIndex: 9999 });
      confetti({ particleCount: 50, angle: 120, spread: 55, origin: { x: 1, y: 1 }, colors: ['#4f46e5', '#10b981', '#f59e0b'], zIndex: 9999 });
    }
  }, [trigger, type]);

  return null;
}

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';

export interface SelectOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}

interface CustomSelectProps {
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  options: SelectOption[];
  placeholder?: string;
  className?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}

export function CustomSelect({
  value,
  onChange,
  options,
  placeholder = 'Выберите...',
  className = '',
  icon
}: CustomSelectProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const selectedOption = options.find((opt) => opt.value === value);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [isOpen]);

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full" ref={dropdownRef}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        className={`flex items-center justify-between w-full outline-none transition-all ${className} ${
          isOpen ? (
            className.includes('ring-rose-500') || className.includes('focus:ring-rose-500') ? 'ring-2 ring-rose-500 border-rose-500' :
            className.includes('ring-emerald-500') || className.includes('focus:ring-emerald-500') ? 'ring-2 ring-emerald-500 border-emerald-500' :
            className.includes('ring-amber-500') || className.includes('focus:ring-amber-500') ? 'ring-2 ring-amber-500 border-amber-500' :
            'ring-2 ring-indigo-500 border-indigo-500'
          ) : ''
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
          {icon && <span className="shrink-0 text-slate-400">{icon}</span>}
          <span className="truncate">
            {selectedOption ? selectedOption.label : <span className="text-slate-400">{placeholder}</span>}
          </span>
        </div>
        <ChevronDown
          className={`w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 ${
            isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''
          }`}
        />
      </button>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {isOpen && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.1, ease: 'easeOut' }}
            className="absolute z-50 w-full mt-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl shadow-xl dark:shadow-slate-950/50 overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="max-h-60 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar py-1">
              {options.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-500 text-center">Нет вариантов</div>
              ) : (
                options.map((option) => {
                  const isSelected = option.value === value;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={option.value}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        onChange(option.value);
                        setIsOpen(false);
                      }}
                      className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2.5 text-sm transition-colors ${
                        isSelected
                          ? className.includes('ring-rose-500') || className.includes('focus:ring-rose-500')
                            ? 'bg-rose-50/50 dark:bg-rose-900/20 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 font-semibold'
                            : className.includes('ring-emerald-500') || className.includes('focus:ring-emerald-500')
                            ? 'bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-900/20 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-semibold'
                            : className.includes('ring-amber-500') || className.includes('focus:ring-amber-500')
                            ? 'bg-amber-50/50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 font-semibold'
                            : 'bg-indigo-50/50 dark:bg-indigo-900/20 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 font-semibold'
                          : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/80'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                        {option.icon && <span className="shrink-0 opacity-70">{option.icon}</span>}
                        <span className="truncate">{option.label}</span>
                      </div>
                      {isSelected && (
                        <Check className={`w-4 h-4 shrink-0 ${
                          className.includes('ring-rose-500') || className.includes('focus:ring-rose-500')
                            ? 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400'
                            : className.includes('ring-emerald-500') || className.includes('focus:ring-emerald-500')
                            ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
                            : className.includes('ring-amber-500') || className.includes('focus:ring-amber-500')
                            ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'
                            : 'text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400'
                        }`} />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { Component, ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode;
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error?: Error;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  public state: State = {
    hasError: false
  };

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    console.error('Uncaught error:', error, errorInfo);
  }

  public render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12 text-center h-full">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-rose-100 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-6">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-rose-600" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-2">Что-то пошло не так</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 max-w-md mx-auto mb-6">
            Произошла непредвиденная ошибка при отображении этой страницы. 
            Пожалуйста, обновите страницу или вернитесь на главную.
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={() => window.location.href = '/'}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 transition"
          >
            Вернуться на главную
          </button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

<file path="frontend/src/components/GroupChat.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Send, MessageSquare } from 'lucide-react';
import { getGroupMessages, sendGroupMessage, subscribeToGroupChat, GroupChatMessage } from '../api/chat';
import { GroupMember } from '../api/groups';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import { ru } from 'date-fns/locale';

interface GroupChatProps {
  groupId: string;
  currentUserId: string;
  members: GroupMember[];
  onUserClick: (userId: string) => void;
}

export function GroupChat({ groupId, currentUserId, members, onUserClick }: GroupChatProps) {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<GroupChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [newMessage, setNewMessage] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let unsubscribe: () => void;
    
    setLoading(true);
    getGroupMessages(groupId).then(data => {
      setMessages(data);
      setLoading(false);
      scrollToBottom();
      
      unsubscribe = subscribeToGroupChat(groupId, (msg) => {
        setMessages(prev => {
          if (prev.some(m => m.id === msg.id)) return prev;
          return [...prev, msg];
        });
        setTimeout(scrollToBottom, 100);
      });
    });

    return () => {
      if (unsubscribe) unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [groupId]);

  const scrollToBottom = () => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  const handleSend = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newMessage.trim()) return;
    
    const content = newMessage.trim();
    setNewMessage('');
    
    await sendGroupMessage(groupId, currentUserId, content);
  };

  const getMemberInfo = (userId: string) => {
    return members.find(m => m.student_id === userId);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-10 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-indigo-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mb-4" />
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Загрузка чата...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-[600px] max-h-[70vh] bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/40">
        <MessageSquare className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500" />
        <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm">Чат класса</h3>
      </div>
      
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 custom-scrollbar bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/20">
        {messages.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
            <MessageSquare className="w-12 h-12 mb-2 opacity-50" />
            <p>Здесь пока нет сообщений</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          messages.map((msg, idx) => {
            const isMe = msg.sender_id === currentUserId;
            const sender = getMemberInfo(msg.sender_id);
            const showAvatar = idx === 0 || messages[idx - 1].sender_id !== msg.sender_id;

            return (
              <div key={msg.id} className={`flex gap-3 ${isMe ? 'flex-row-reverse' : ''}`}>
                <div className={`shrink-0 w-8 flex flex-col items-center ${isMe ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'}`}>
                  {showAvatar && (
                    <button onClick={() => onUserClick(msg.sender_id)} className="transition transform hover:scale-110 active:scale-95">
                      {sender?.student_avatar ? (
                        <img src={sender.student_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700" />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-900/40 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold flex items-center justify-center text-xs">
                          {sender?.student_name?.[0] || '?'}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className={`flex flex-col max-w-[75%] ${isMe ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'}`}>
                  {showAvatar && !isMe && (
                    <span 
                      onClick={() => onUserClick(msg.sender_id)}
                      className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1 ml-1 cursor-pointer hover:underline"
                    >
                      {sender?.student_name || 'Студент'}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <div 
                    className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words shadow-sm
                      ${isMe 
                        ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-tr-sm' 
                        : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-tl-sm'
                      }`}
                  >
                    {msg.content}
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1 mx-1">
                    {format(new Date(msg.created_at), 'HH:mm', { locale: ru })}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
        <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleSend} className="p-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 flex gap-2">
        <input
          value={newMessage}
          onChange={(e) => setNewMessage(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Написать сообщение..."
          className="flex-1 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100"
        />
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={!newMessage.trim()}
          className="p-2.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
        >
          <Send className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { GraduationCap, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export default function Header({ onReset }: { onReset: () => void }) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'ok' | 'error' | 'checking'>('checking');

  useEffect(() => {
    const check = () => {
      fetch('/api/health')
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(d => setStatus(d.status === 'ok' ? 'ok' : 'error'))
        .catch(() => setStatus('error'));
    };
    check();
    const id = setInterval(check, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);

  const dotClass = status === 'ok'
    ? 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400'
    : status === 'error'
    ? 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-400 animate-pulse'
    : 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-600 animate-pulse';
  const dotTitle = status === 'ok' ? 'Бэкенд работает' : status === 'error' ? 'Бэкенд недоступен' : 'Проверка...';

  return (
    <header className="border-b border-slate-200 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-sm sticky top-0 z-50">
      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-6 h-14 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-brand-600 flex items-center justify-center">
            <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
          </div>
          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-[15px]">Meldy</span>
          <span className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 text-xs font-medium">
            Статус системы
            <span className={dotClass} title={dotTitle} />

import React, { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import Cropper from 'react-easy-crop';
import { X, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import getCroppedImg from '../utils/cropImage';

interface ImageCropperProps {
  imageSrc: string;
  onCropComplete: (croppedFile: File) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function ImageCropper({ imageSrc, onCropComplete, onClose }: ImageCropperProps) {
  const [crop, setCrop] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [croppedAreaPixels, setCroppedAreaPixels] = useState(null);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);

  const handleCropComplete = useCallback((_croppedArea: any, croppedAreaPixels: any) => {
    setCroppedAreaPixels(croppedAreaPixels);
  }, []);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!croppedAreaPixels) return;
    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      const croppedFile = await getCroppedImg(imageSrc, croppedAreaPixels);
      if (croppedFile) {
        onCropComplete(croppedFile);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
          onClick={onClose}
          className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm"
        />
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
          className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-slate-800 flex flex-col"
        >
          <div className="p-4 flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">Обрезка фото</h3>
            <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-white rounded-full transition">
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
          
          <div className="relative w-full h-[400px] bg-black">
            <Cropper
              image={imageSrc}
              crop={crop}
              zoom={zoom}
              aspect={1}
              cropShape="round"
              showGrid={false}
              onCropChange={setCrop}
              onCropComplete={handleCropComplete}
              onZoomChange={setZoom}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="p-6 bg-slate-900">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-6">
              <span className="text-sm text-slate-400">Масштаб</span>
              <input
                type="range"
                value={zoom}
                min={1}
                max={3}
                step={0.1}
                aria-labelledby="Zoom"
                onChange={(e) => setZoom(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="flex-1 h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-indigo-500"
              />
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleSave}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className="w-full py-3 px-4 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition"
            >
              {isProcessing ? (
                <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Check className="w-5 h-5" />
                  Применить
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Award, BookOpen, Star, X, UserPlus, UserCheck, Clock } from 'lucide-react';
import { GroupMember } from '../api/groups';
import { getFriends, sendFriendRequest, Friendship } from '../api/chat';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface MiniprofileModalProps {
  member: GroupMember;
  currentUserId: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function MiniprofileModal({ member, currentUserId, onClose }: MiniprofileModalProps) {
  const [friendship, setFriendship] = useState<Friendship | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (member.student_id === currentUserId) {
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    
    getFriends(currentUserId).then(friends => {
      const existing = friends.find(f => f.friend_id === member.student_id);
      if (existing) {
        setFriendship(existing);
      }
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, [currentUserId, member.student_id]);

  const handleAddFriend = async () => {
    if (loading || friendship || member.student_id === currentUserId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    const ok = await sendFriendRequest(currentUserId, member.student_id);
    if (ok) {
      toast.success('Заявка отправлена!');
      setFriendship({
        id: 'new',
        requester_id: currentUserId,
        addressee_id: member.student_id,
        status: 'pending',
        created_at: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    } else {
      toast.error('Ошибка при отправке заявки');
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[120] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}>
      <div 
        className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl p-6 w-full max-w-sm shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 relative"
        onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <button 
          onClick={onClose}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 rounded-full transition"
        >
          <X className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>

        <div className="flex flex-col items-center mt-4">
          <div className="relative mb-4">
            {member.student_avatar ? (
              <img src={member.student_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-24 h-24 rounded-full border-4 border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900 shadow-md" />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-24 h-24 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-900/40 border-4 border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-800 flex items-center justify-center text-indigo-500 font-bold text-3xl shadow-md">
                {member.student_name?.[0] || '?'}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="absolute -bottom-2 -right-2 bg-amber-400 text-amber-950 p-1.5 rounded-full shadow-lg border-2 border-white dark:border-slate-900">
              <Star className="w-5 h-5 fill-amber-300" />
            </div>
          </div>

          <h3 className="font-extrabold text-2xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-1 text-center">
            {member.student_name}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm font-medium mb-6">
            Студент класса
          </p>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 w-full">
            <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
              <Award className="w-6 h-6 text-indigo-500 mb-2" />
              <span className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{member.total_xp || 0}</span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mt-1">Опыт (XP)</span>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
              <BookOpen className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-500 mb-2" />
              <span className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{member.total_reviews || 0}</span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mt-1">Повторений</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {member.student_id !== currentUserId && (
            <div className="w-full mt-4">
              {!friendship ? (
                <button 
                  onClick={handleAddFriend}
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="w-full py-3 bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-700 transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <UserPlus className="w-5 h-5" /> Добавить в друзья
                </button>
              ) : friendship.status === 'pending' ? (
                <button 
                  disabled
                  className="w-full py-3 bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                >
                  <Clock className="w-5 h-5" /> Заявка отправлена
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button 
                  disabled
                  className="w-full py-3 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                >
                  <UserCheck className="w-5 h-5" /> Уже друзья
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function OnboardingManager() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [steps, setSteps] = useState<Step[]>([]);
  const [run, setRun] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(checkTours, 1200);
    
    const handleProfileUpdate = () => {
      checkTours();
    };
    window.addEventListener('profile_updated', handleProfileUpdate);
    
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      window.removeEventListener('profile_updated', handleProfileUpdate);
    };
  }, [user?.id, location.pathname]);

  const checkTours = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    const profile = await getProfile(user.id);
    if (!profile) return;
    const status = profile.onboarding_status || {};
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 768;

    if (location.pathname !== '/dashboard') return;

    if (!status['dashboard_tour']) {
      const tourSteps = isMobile ? MOBILE_STEPS : DESKTOP_STEPS;
      // Verify the second target exists in DOM before starting
      const secondTarget = tourSteps[1]?.target as string;
      if (secondTarget === 'body' || document.querySelector(secondTarget)) {
        setRun(false);
        setSteps(tourSteps);
        markOnboardingTourSeen(user.id, 'dashboard_tour');
        setTimeout(() => setRun(true), 100);
      }
    } else if (
      status['dashboard_tour'] &&
      !status['exam_tour'] &&
      profile.total_materials > 0
    ) {
      const tourSteps = isMobile ? EXAM_STEPS_MOBILE : EXAM_STEPS_DESKTOP;
      const secondTarget = tourSteps[1]?.target as string;
      const targetExists = !secondTarget || secondTarget === 'body' || document.querySelector(secondTarget);
      if (targetExists) {
        setSteps(tourSteps);
        markOnboardingTourSeen(user.id, 'exam_tour');
        setTimeout(() => setRun(true), 100);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleJoyrideCallback = (data: CallBackProps) => {
    const { status, type, step } = data;

    if (type === 'step:before' && step.target !== 'body') {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const el = document.querySelector(step.target as string);
        if (el) {
          const isInSidebar = el.closest('aside') !== null;
          if (isInSidebar) {
            el.closest('aside')?.scrollTo({ top: (el as HTMLElement).offsetTop - 80, behavior: 'smooth' });
          } else {
            el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
          }
        }
      }, 50);
    }

    if (status === STATUS.SKIPPED) {
      setRun(false);
      if (user) {
        getProfile(user.id).then(p => {
          if (!p) return;
          const next = { ...(p.onboarding_status || {}), dashboard_tour: true, exam_tour: true, skipped_all: true };
          supabase.from('profiles').update({ onboarding_status: next }).eq('id', user.id);
        });
      }
    } else if (status === STATUS.FINISHED) {
      setRun(false);
    }
  };

  const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768;

  return (
    <Joyride
      callback={handleJoyrideCallback}
      continuous
      disableScrolling={false}
      scrollToFirstStep
      scrollOffset={100}
      hideCloseButton
      run={run}
      showProgress
      showSkipButton
      steps={steps}
      disableOverlayClose={false}
      spotlightPadding={6}
      styles={{
        options: {
          zIndex: 10000,
          primaryColor: '#4f46e5',
          textColor: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#f1f5f9' : '#0f172a',
          backgroundColor: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#ffffff',
          overlayColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)',
        },
        tooltip: {
          borderRadius: '20px',
          padding: isMobile ? '16px' : '20px',
          boxShadow: '0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)',
          border: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '1px solid #334155' : '1px solid #f1f5f9',
          maxWidth: isMobile ? 'min(300px, calc(100vw - 32px))' : '360px',
        },
        tooltipContainer: {
          textAlign: 'left',
        },
        buttonNext: {
          backgroundColor: '#4f46e5',
          borderRadius: '10px',
          fontWeight: 'bold',
          fontSize: '13px',
          padding: '7px 14px',
          outline: 'none',
          border: 'none',
        },
        buttonBack: {
          marginRight: 8,
          color: '#64748b',
          fontWeight: 'bold',
          fontSize: '13px',
          outline: 'none',
          border: 'none',
        },
        buttonSkip: {
          color: '#94a3b8',
          fontWeight: 'bold',
          fontSize: '12px',
          outline: 'none',
          border: 'none',
        },
      }}
      locale={{
        back: 'Назад',
        close: 'Закрыть',
        last: 'Понятно! 🎉',
        next: 'Далее →',
        skip: 'Пропустить',
      }}
    />
  );
}

  "ПГУ им. Евфросинии Полоцкой (Полоцкий государственный университет)"
];

interface UniversitySelectProps {
  value: string;
  onChange: (val: string) => void;
}

export default function UniversitySelect({ value, onChange }: UniversitySelectProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState(value);
  const wrapperRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSearch(value);
  }, [value]);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
      if (wrapperRef.current && !wrapperRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
        // On blur, update the parent value to whatever was typed
        onChange(search);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, [search, onChange]);

  const filtered = BELARUS_UNIVERSITIES.filter(u => u.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full" ref={wrapperRef}>
      <div className="relative flex items-center">
        <Building2 className="absolute left-3 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
        <input
          type="text"
          value={search}
          onClick={() => setIsOpen(true)}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setSearch(e.target.value);
            onChange(e.target.value);
            setIsOpen(true);
          }}
          placeholder="ВУЗ или Школа (например, БГУ)"
          className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none transition shadow-sm placeholder:text-slate-400"
        />
      </div>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute z-[60] w-full mt-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl shadow-xl max-h-60 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
          {filtered.length > 0 ? (
            filtered.map((uni, idx) => (
              <div
                key={idx}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSearch(uni);
                  onChange(uni);
                  setIsOpen(false);
                }}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 cursor-pointer text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 transition border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 last:border-0 flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 text-indigo-400" />
                <span className="truncate">{uni}</span>
              </div>
            ))
          ) : (
            <div className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Нажмите Enter или кликните вне поля, чтобы сохранить "{search}"
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx">
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { User, Session } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

interface AuthContextType {
  user: User | null;
  session: Session | null;
  loading: boolean;
  signOut: () => Promise<void>;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType>({
  user: null, session: null, loading: true,
  signOut: async () => {}
});

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [session, setSession] = useState<Session | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    supabase.auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session } }) => {
      setSession(session);
      setUser(session?.user ?? null);
      setLoading(false);
    });

    const { data: { subscription } } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
      setSession(session);
      setUser(session?.user ?? null);
      setLoading(false);
    });

    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  const signOut = async () => { await supabase.auth.signOut(); };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, session, loading, signOut }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthContext);

<file path="frontend/src/contexts/ConfirmContext.tsx">
import { createContext, useContext, useState, useRef, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { AlertTriangle, Check, X } from 'lucide-react';

interface ConfirmOptions {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  confirmText?: string;
  cancelText?: string;
  type?: 'danger' | 'warning' | 'info';
  icon?: React.ElementType;
  checkboxLabel?: string;
  onCheckboxChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
}

interface ConfirmContextType {
  confirm: (options: ConfirmOptions) => Promise<boolean>;
  alert: (options: Omit<ConfirmOptions, 'cancelText'>) => Promise<void>;
}

const ConfirmContext = createContext<ConfirmContextType | null>(null);

export function ConfirmProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isAlert, setIsAlert] = useState(false);
  const [isChecked, setIsChecked] = useState(false);
  const [options, setOptions] = useState<ConfirmOptions | null>(null);
  const resolvePromiseRef = useRef<((value: boolean) => void) | null>(null);

  const confirm = (opts: ConfirmOptions) => {
    setOptions(opts);
    setIsAlert(false);
    setIsChecked(false);
    setIsOpen(true);
    return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
      resolvePromiseRef.current = resolve;
    });
  };

  const alert = (opts: Omit<ConfirmOptions, 'cancelText'>) => {
    setOptions(opts);
    setIsAlert(true);
    setIsOpen(true);
    return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      resolvePromiseRef.current = resolve as any;
    });
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    setIsOpen(false);
    if (options?.onCheckboxChange) {
      options.onCheckboxChange(isChecked);
    }
    if (resolvePromiseRef.current) {
      resolvePromiseRef.current(true);
      resolvePromiseRef.current = null;
    }
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    setIsOpen(false);
    if (resolvePromiseRef.current) {
      resolvePromiseRef.current(false);
      resolvePromiseRef.current = null;
    }
  };

  return (
    <ConfirmContext.Provider value={{ confirm, alert }}>
      {children}
      
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isOpen && options && (
          <div key="confirm-modal-container" className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
              onClick={handleCancel}
              className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm"
            />
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 10 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 10 }}
              className="relative w-[calc(100%-32px)] md:w-full max-w-md bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800"
            >
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
                <div className={`w-16 h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4 ${
                  options.type === 'danger' ? 'bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-450' :
                  options.type === 'info' ? 'bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400' :
                  'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'
                }`}>
                  {options.icon ? <options.icon className="w-8 h-8" /> : <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8" />}
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2">{options.title}</h3>
                <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm mb-6 leading-relaxed">
                  {options.message}
                </p>
                {options.checkboxLabel && !isAlert && (
                  <label className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full text-left bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 p-3 rounded-xl cursor-pointer mb-6 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition">
                    <input 
                      type="checkbox" 
                      className="w-5 h-5 rounded text-indigo-600 bg-white border-slate-300 focus:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:border-slate-700" 
                      checked={isChecked}
                      onChange={(e) => setIsChecked(e.target.checked)}
                    />
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 select-none">
                      {options.checkboxLabel}
                    </span>
                  </label>
                )}
                <div className="flex w-full gap-3">
                  {!isAlert && (
                    <button
                      onClick={handleCancel}
                      className="flex-1 py-3 px-4 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                    >
                      <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                      {options.cancelText || 'Отмена'}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <button
                    onClick={handleConfirm}
                    className={`flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-white shadow-lg ${
                      options.type === 'danger' ? 'bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 shadow-rose-200 dark:shadow-none' :
                      options.type === 'info' ? 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 shadow-indigo-200 dark:shadow-none' :
                      'bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 shadow-amber-200 dark:shadow-none'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
                    {options.confirmText || 'ОК'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </ConfirmContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useConfirm() {
  const context = useContext(ConfirmContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error('useConfirm must be used within ConfirmProvider');
  return context;
}

<file path="frontend/src/contexts/ThemeProvider.tsx">
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

type Theme = 'dark' | 'light' | 'system';

type ThemeProviderProps = {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  defaultTheme?: Theme;
  storageKey?: string;
};

type ThemeProviderState = {
  theme: Theme;
  setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void;
};

const initialState: ThemeProviderState = {
  theme: 'system',
  setTheme: () => null,
};

const ThemeProviderContext = createContext<ThemeProviderState>(initialState);

export function ThemeProvider({
  children,
  defaultTheme = 'system',
  storageKey = 'vite-ui-theme',
  ...props
}: ThemeProviderProps) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<Theme>(
    () => (localStorage.getItem(storageKey) as Theme) || defaultTheme
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = window.document.documentElement;

    root.classList.remove('light', 'dark');

    if (theme === 'system') {
      const systemTheme = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
        .matches
        ? 'dark'
        : 'light';

      root.classList.add(systemTheme);
      return;
    }

    root.classList.add(theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const value = {
    theme,
    setTheme: (theme: Theme) => {
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, theme);
      setTheme(theme);
    },
  };

  return (
    <ThemeProviderContext.Provider {...props} value={value}>
      {children}
    </ThemeProviderContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useTheme = () => {
  const context = useContext(ThemeProviderContext);

  if (context === undefined)
    throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');

  return context;
};

<file path="frontend/src/hooks/useEnergyConfirm.ts">
import { useConfirm } from '../contexts/ConfirmContext';
import { checkAILimit, FREE_DAILY_LIMIT } from '../api/limits';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Zap } from 'lucide-react';

export function useEnergyConfirm() {
  const { confirm } = useConfirm();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const verifyEnergy = async (userId: string, cost: number, actionName: string = 'Это действие'): Promise<boolean> => {
    try {
      const { allowed, isPro, count } = await checkAILimit(userId, cost);

      if (isPro) {
        return true; // PRO users do not need to confirm or care about limits
      }

      const remaining = Math.max(0, FREE_DAILY_LIMIT - count);

      if (!allowed) {
        const wantsPro = await confirm({
          title: 'Энергия ИИ исчерпана',
          message: `${actionName} требует ${cost} ⚡, но у вас осталось только ${remaining} ⚡. Перейдите на тариф PRO для безлимитного использования ИИ!`,
          type: 'danger',
          icon: Zap,
          confirmText: 'Подключить PRO',
          cancelText: 'Позже'
        });
        
        if (wantsPro) {
          navigate('/pricing');
        }
        return false;
      }

      // Check if user disabled confirmations globally
      const hideConfirm = localStorage.getItem('studyforge_hide_energy_confirm') === 'true';
      if (hideConfirm) {
        return true;
      }

      // Show confirmation modal
      const confirmed = await confirm({
        title: 'Запуск ИИ',
        message: `${actionName} спишет ${cost} ⚡ энергии ИИ. У вас останется ${remaining - cost} ⚡ до конца дня. Продолжить?`,
        type: 'warning',
        icon: Zap,
        confirmText: 'Запустить',
        cancelText: 'Отмена',
        checkboxLabel: 'Больше не спрашивать',
        onCheckboxChange: (checked) => {
          if (checked) {
            localStorage.setItem('studyforge_hide_energy_confirm', 'true');
          }
        }
      });

      return confirmed;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Ошибка проверки энергии:', err);
      return true; // fail-safe open
    }
  };

  return { verifyEnergy };
}

<file path="frontend/src/hooks/useHistory.ts">
import { useState } from 'react';
import { HistoryItem } from '../types';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'studyforge_history';
const MAX_ITEMS = 10;

export function useHistory() {
  const load = (): HistoryItem[] => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || '[]'); }
    catch { return []; }
  };

  const [items, setItems] = useState<HistoryItem[]>(load);

  const add = (item: HistoryItem) => {
    setItems(prev => {
      const next = [item, ...prev].slice(0, MAX_ITEMS);
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
      return next;
    });
  };

  const remove = (id: string) => {
    setItems(prev => {
      const next = prev.filter(i => i.id !== id);
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
      return next;
    });
  };

  const clear = () => {
    setItems([]);
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  };

  return { items, add, remove, clear };
}

<file path="frontend/src/hooks/useInstallPWA.ts">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export function useInstallPWA() {
  const [deferredPrompt, setDeferredPrompt] = useState<any>(null);
  const [isIOS, setIsIOS] = useState(false);
  const [isStandalone, setIsStandalone] = useState(false);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || (window.navigator as any).standalone) {
      setIsStandalone(true);
      return;
    }

    const ua = window.navigator.userAgent;
    setIsMobile(/Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(ua));

    const webkit = !!ua.match(/WebKit/i);
    const isIOSDetect = !!ua.match(/iPad/i) || !!ua.match(/iPhone/i);
    const isSafari = isIOSDetect && webkit && !ua.match(/CriOS/i);
    setIsIOS(isSafari);

    const handleBeforeInstallPrompt = (e: any) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setDeferredPrompt(e);
    };

    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handleBeforeInstallPrompt);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handleBeforeInstallPrompt);
  }, []);

  const handleInstallClick = async () => {
    if (deferredPrompt) {
      deferredPrompt.prompt();
      const { outcome } = await deferredPrompt.userChoice;
      if (outcome === 'accepted') {
        setDeferredPrompt(null);
      }
    } else if (isIOS) {
      toast('Чтобы установить: нажмите иконку "Поделиться" внизу экрана (квадрат со стрелочкой) и выберите "На экран Домой"', {
        id: 'pwa-install-toast-ios',
        icon: '📱',
        duration: 8000,
      });
    } else {
      toast('Чтобы установить: откройте меню браузера (три точки / линии) и найдите пункт «Добавить на главный экран» или «Установить приложение»', {
        id: 'pwa-install-toast',
        icon: '💡',
        duration: 8000,
      });
    }
  };

  return { handleInstallClick, isStandalone, isMobile, showInstall: isMobile && !isStandalone };
}

<file path="frontend/src/hooks/useSound.ts">
import { useCallback, useRef } from 'react';

export const useSound = () => {
  const audioCtxRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);

  const initAudio = () => {
    if (!audioCtxRef.current) {
      audioCtxRef.current = new (window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext)();
    }
    if (audioCtxRef.current.state === 'suspended') {
      audioCtxRef.current.resume();
    }
  };

  // 1. Звук получения XP (Мягкий "стеклянный" аккорд)
  const playXpSound = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      initAudio();
      const ctx = audioCtxRef.current!;
      
      const playNote = (freq: number, startTime: number) => {
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = 'sine';
        osc.frequency.value = freq;
        
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, startTime);
        gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.15, startTime + 0.02);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, startTime + 0.6);
        
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start(startTime);
        osc.stop(startTime + 0.6);
      };

      const now = ctx.currentTime;
      playNote(523.25, now);       // C5
      playNote(659.25, now + 0.05); // E5
      playNote(783.99, now + 0.1);  // G5
      playNote(1046.50, now + 0.15); // C6
    } catch (e) {}
  }, []);

  // 2. Звук переворота карточки (Современный UI Pop)
  const playFlipSound = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      initAudio();
      const ctx = audioCtxRef.current!;
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(200, ctx.currentTime + 0.1); // Быстрый спад частоты (Pop)
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
      
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
    } catch (e) {}
  }, []);

  // 3. Звук успеха (Радостный перелив)
  const playSuccessSound = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      initAudio();
      const ctx = audioCtxRef.current!;
      const now = ctx.currentTime;
      
      const playChime = (freq: number, time: number) => {
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = 'triangle';
        osc.frequency.value = freq;
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, time);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, time + 0.4);
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start(time);
        osc.stop(time + 0.4);
      };

      playChime(440, now);        // A4
      playChime(554.37, now + 0.1); // C#5
      playChime(659.25, now + 0.2); // E5
      playChime(880, now + 0.35);   // A5
    } catch (e) {}
  }, []);

  // 4. Звук ошибки (Мягкий глухой стук, не раздражающий)
  const playErrorSound = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      initAudio();
      const ctx = audioCtxRef.current!;
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(50, ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
      
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
    } catch (e) {}
  }, []);

  // 5. Легкий клик
  const playClickSound = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      initAudio();
      const ctx = audioCtxRef.current!;
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1200, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.05);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.05);
    } catch(e) {}
  }, []);

  return {
    playXpSound,
    playFlipSound,
    playSuccessSound,
    playErrorSound,
    playClickSound,
  };
};

<file path="frontend/src/lib/imageCompression.ts">
export async function compressImage(file: File, maxWidth = 1600, quality = 0.7): Promise<File> {
  if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) return file;
  
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.src = event.target?.result as string;
      img.onload = () => {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        let width = img.width;
        let height = img.height;
        
        if (width > maxWidth) {
          height = Math.round((height * maxWidth) / width);
          width = maxWidth;
        }
        
        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;
        
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) {
          resolve(file);
          return;
        }
        
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
        
        canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
          if (!blob) {
            resolve(file);
            return;
          }
          
          const compressedFile = new File([blob], file.name, {
            type: 'image/jpeg',
            lastModified: Date.now(),
          });
          
          resolve(compressedFile);
        }, 'image/jpeg', quality);
      };
      img.onerror = (err) => reject(err);
    };
    reader.onerror = (err) => reject(err);
  });
}
