<file path="frontend/src/pages/AssignmentView.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ArrowLeft, CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertCircle, Play, BookOpen } from 'lucide-react';
import { getAssignmentById, getStudentAttempts, recordAssignmentAttempt, toggleAssignmentCompletion } from '../api/groups';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import QuizView from '../components/QuizView';
import SummaryView from '../components/SummaryView';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function AssignmentView() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  
  const [assignment, setAssignment] = useState<any>(null);
  const [attempts, setAttempts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'study' | 'quiz'>('study');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id || !user) return;
    
    Promise.all([
      getAssignmentById(id),
      getStudentAttempts(id, user.id)
    ])
      .then(([assn, atts]) => {
        if (!assn) {
          toast.error('Задание не найдено');
          navigate('/dashboard');
          return;
        }
        setAssignment(assn);
        setAttempts(atts);
      })
      .catch(console.error)
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [id, user, navigate]);

  const handleQuizComplete = async (scorePct: number) => {
    if (!user || !assignment) return;
    
    const passingScore = assignment.passing_score || 80;
    const passed = scorePct >= passingScore;
    
    // Записываем попытку
    const ok = await recordAssignmentAttempt(assignment.id, user.id, scorePct, passed);
    if (!ok) {
      toast.error('Не удалось сохранить результат. Возможно, задание было удалено преподавателем.');
      return;
    }
    
    // Обновляем локально
    const newAttempt = { score: scorePct, passed, created_at: new Date().toISOString() };
    setAttempts(prev => [newAttempt, ...prev]);
    
    // Если прошли, отмечаем как выполнено
    if (passed) {
      await toggleAssignmentCompletion(assignment.id, user.id, true);
      toast.success('Задание успешно выполнено!');
    } else {
      toast.error(`Тест не сдан. Ваш балл: ${scorePct}%, необходимо: ${passingScore}%`);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return (
    <div className="p-6 flex items-center justify-center min-h-[50vh]">
      <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
    </div>
  );

  if (!assignment) return null;

  const passingScore = assignment.passing_score || 80;
  const maxAttempts = assignment.max_attempts;
  const attemptsCount = attempts.length;
  const hasPassed = attempts.some(a => a.passed);
  
  const isOverdue = assignment.deadline && new Date(assignment.deadline) < new Date();
  
  const canAttempt = !hasPassed && (!maxAttempts || attemptsCount < maxAttempts) && !isOverdue;

  return (
    <div className="p-4 md:p-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto pb-24">
      {/* Back button */}
      <button
        onClick={() => navigate(-1)}
        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200 text-sm mb-4 transition"
      >
        <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
        Назад в класс
      </button>

      {/* Header */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 mb-6 shadow-sm">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2">
          {assignment.material?.title || 'Удаленный материал'}
        </h1>
        
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-sm mt-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-900/30 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-medium">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            Проходной балл: {passingScore}%
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-medium">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
            Попытки: {attemptsCount} {maxAttempts ? `/ ${maxAttempts}` : '(не ограничено)'}
          </div>
        </div>

        {hasPassed && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-900/20 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-6 h-6 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <p className="font-bold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">Задание выполнено!</p>
              <p className="text-sm">Вы уже набрали проходной балл. Отличная работа!</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {!hasPassed && !canAttempt && attemptsCount > 0 && !isOverdue && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-900/20 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400">
            <XCircle className="w-6 h-6 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <p className="font-bold text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300">Попытки исчерпаны</p>
              <p className="text-sm">К сожалению, вы не набрали нужный балл и больше не можете пересдавать этот тест.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {isOverdue && !hasPassed && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
            <AlertCircle className="w-6 h-6 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <p className="font-bold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">Дедлайн прошёл</p>
              <p className="text-sm">Время на выполнение этого задания истекло. Тест больше недоступен для прохождения.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 mb-6">
        <button
          onClick={() => setPhase('study')}
          className={`flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition border ${
            phase === 'study' 
              ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-600 shadow-md' 
              : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700'
          }`}
        >
          <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5" /> Изучить материал
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setPhase('quiz')}
          className={`flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition border ${
            phase === 'quiz' 
              ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-600 shadow-md' 
              : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700'
          }`}
        >
          <Play className="w-5 h-5" /> Пройти тест
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      {phase === 'study' ? (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 md:p-6 shadow-sm">
          <SummaryView data={assignment.material?.summary_json} />
          
          <div className="mt-8 flex justify-end pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
            <button
              onClick={() => setPhase('quiz')}
              className="px-6 py-3 bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-md hover:bg-indigo-700 transition flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              Перейти к тесту <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 rotate-180" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 md:p-6 shadow-sm">
          {!canAttempt && !hasPassed ? (
            <div className="text-center py-10">
              <XCircle className="w-16 h-16 text-rose-500 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
              <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">Тест недоступен</h3>
              <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-2">
                {isOverdue ? 'Дедлайн прошел.' : 'Вы исчерпали все попытки.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {attemptsCount > 0 && !hasPassed && (
                <div className="mb-6 p-4 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-xl">
                  <p className="text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 font-medium">Предыдущая попытка: {attempts[0].score}%</p>
                  <p className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 text-sm mt-1">Попробуйте еще раз! Нужно набрать {passingScore}%.</p>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="mb-4 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 justify-center bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 p-2 rounded-lg">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4" /> Внимание: Не обновляйте страницу во время теста, иначе прогресс будет сброшен!
              </div>
              <QuizView 
                data={assignment.material?.quiz_json} 
                onComplete={handleQuizComplete} 
              />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { MessageSquare, Send, Trash2, Maximize2, Minimize2 } from 'lucide-react';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkMath from 'remark-math';
import rehypeKatex from 'rehype-katex';
import 'katex/dist/katex.min.css';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { CustomSelect } from '../components/CustomSelect';
import { useConfirm } from '../contexts/ConfirmContext';
import { getMaterials } from '../api/materials';
import { updateQuestProgress } from '../api/quests';
import { incrementAIUsage } from '../api/limits';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { useEnergyConfirm } from '../hooks/useEnergyConfirm';

export default function Chat() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { confirm } = useConfirm();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { verifyEnergy } = useEnergyConfirm();
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState('');
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<{ role: string; content: string }[]>([]);
  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [fetchingHistory, setFetchingHistory] = useState(false);
  const [isFullScreen, setIsFullScreen] = useState(false);
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const prevMsgCount = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    getMaterials(user.id).then(setMaterials).catch(console.error);
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [user?.id]);

  // Загрузка истории при выборе материала
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedId || !user) {
      setMessages([]);
      return;
    }

    const loadHistory = async () => {
      setFetchingHistory(true);
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('chat_messages')
        .select('role, content')
        .eq('material_id', selectedId)
        .eq('user_id', user.id)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: true });
      
      if (!error && data) {
        setMessages(data);
        prevMsgCount.current = data.length;
      }
      setFetchingHistory(false);
    };

    loadHistory();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [selectedId, user?.id]);

  // Auto-scroll only when a NEW message is added (count increases)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (messages.length > prevMsgCount.current) {
      messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    } else if (messages.length > 0 && prevMsgCount.current === 0) {
      // First load of history — instant scroll
      messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'auto' });
    }
    prevMsgCount.current = messages.length;
  }, [messages]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isFullScreen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      return () => { document.body.style.overflow = ''; };
    }
  }, [isFullScreen]);

  const selectedMaterial = materials.find(m => m.id === selectedId);
  
  // Контекст: берем либо оригинал, либо конспект (что есть)
  const getContext = () => {
    if (!selectedMaterial) return '';
    const original = selectedMaterial.original_text || '';
    const summary = typeof selectedMaterial.summary_json === 'string' 
      ? selectedMaterial.summary_json 
      : (selectedMaterial.summary_json?.content || '');
    
    // Если есть оригинал — берем его (он полнее), иначе конспект
    return (original.length > 50 ? original : summary).slice(0, 30000);
  };

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (!input.trim() || !selectedId || !user || loading) return;
    
    setLoading(true);

    // Проверка лимитов (1 токен за сообщение)
    const ok = await verifyEnergy(user.id, 1, 'Отправка сообщения');
    if (!ok) {
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const currentInput = input;
    setInput('');

    try {
      await incrementAIUsage(user.id, 1);
      
      const userMsg = { role: 'user', content: currentInput };
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, userMsg]);
      // 1. Сохраняем сообщение пользователя в БД
      await supabase.from('chat_messages').insert({
        user_id: user.id,
        material_id: selectedId,
        role: 'user',
        content: userMsg.content
      });

      await updateQuestProgress(user.id, 'chat', 1);

      // Получаем актуальное настроение пользователя
      const { data: moodData } = await supabase
        .from('mood_log')
        .select('mood, energy_level, notes')
        .eq('user_id', user.id)
        .order('logged_at', { ascending: false })
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle();

      // 2. Запрос к AI
      const res = await fetch('/api/chat', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ 
          message: userMsg.content, 
          context: getContext(), 
          history: messages.slice(-10), // Отправляем последние сообщения для памяти
          extra_params: moodData ? { mood: moodData } : {}
        }),
      });
      
      const data = await res.json();
      const assistantMsg = { role: 'assistant', content: data.reply };
      
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, assistantMsg]);

      // 3. Сохраняем ответ AI в БД
      await supabase.from('chat_messages').insert({
        user_id: user.id,
        material_id: selectedId,
        role: 'assistant',
        content: assistantMsg.content
      });

    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: 'assistant', content: 'Ошибка при обращении к AI. Попробуйте снова.' }]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClearHistory = async () => {
    if (!selectedId || !user) return;
    const ok = await confirm({ title: 'Очистить историю', message: 'Вы уверены, что хотите очистить историю чата?', type: 'danger' });
    if (!ok) return;
    await supabase.from('chat_messages').delete().eq('material_id', selectedId).eq('user_id', user.id);
    setMessages([]);
  };

  const chatContent = (
    <div className={`flex flex-col transition-all duration-300 ${
      isFullScreen 
        ? 'fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-4 md:p-8 h-screen w-screen' 
        : 'h-full p-4 md:p-6 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-transparent'
    }`}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className={`flex items-center justify-between mb-4 ${isFullScreen ? 'max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full' : ''}`}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
            <MessageSquare className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 truncate">AI-чат</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">Задавайте вопросы по вашим материалам</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          <button 
            onClick={() => setIsFullScreen(!isFullScreen)}
            className="p-2 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 transition rounded-lg hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/30"
            title={isFullScreen ? "Уменьшить" : "На весь экран"}
          >
            {isFullScreen ? <Minimize2 className="w-5 h-5" /> : <Maximize2 className="w-5 h-5" />}
          </button>
          
          {messages.length > 0 && (
            <button onClick={handleClearHistory} className="p-2 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:text-rose-500 dark:hover:text-rose-400 transition rounded-lg hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/30" title="Очистить чат">
              <Trash2 className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Material select */}
      <div className={`mb-4 relative z-20 ${isFullScreen ? 'max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full' : ''}`}>
        <CustomSelect
          value={selectedId}
          onChange={val => setSelectedId(val)}
          options={[
            { value: '', label: 'Выберите материал...' },
            ...materials.map(m => ({ value: m.id, label: m.title }))
          ]}
          className="md:w-72 px-4 py-2.5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 shadow-sm text-sm"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Chat area */}
      <div className={`flex-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm overflow-hidden flex flex-col relative ${isFullScreen ? 'max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full h-full' : ''}`}>
        {!selectedId ? (
          <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-8">
            <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
              <MessageSquare className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-semibold mb-1">Чат не выбран</h3>
            <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm max-w-xs">Выберите лекцию из списка выше, чтобы начать обсуждение с AI</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 custom-scrollbar">
              {fetchingHistory ? (
                <div className="flex justify-center py-8">
                  <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                </div>
              ) : messages.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-center py-12">
                  <div className="inline-block px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-full text-xs font-medium mb-3">
                    Конспект загружен в память
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-sm">
                    Спросите что-нибудь о «{selectedMaterial?.title}»
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                messages.map((msg, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className={`flex ${msg.role === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}>
                    <div
                      className={`max-w-[85%] md:max-w-[75%] lg:max-w-[65%] p-3.5 text-sm rounded-2xl shadow-sm ${
                        msg.role === 'user'
                          ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-tr-none'
                          : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-tl-none'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className={`markdown-content ${msg.role === 'user' ? 'white-text' : ''}`}>
                        <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>{msg.content}</ReactMarkdown>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
              {loading && (
                <div className="flex justify-start">
                  <div className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none p-4 flex gap-1.5 shadow-sm">
                    <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: '0ms' }} />
                    <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: '150ms' }} />
                    <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: '300ms' }} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
            </div>

            {/* Input */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  value={input}
                  onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); handleSend(); } }}
                  placeholder="Напишите вопрос по материалу..."
                  className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 transition shadow-sm bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 dark:placeholder-slate-500"
                  disabled={loading}
                />
                <button
                  onClick={handleSend}
                  disabled={loading || !input.trim()}
                  className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white p-3 rounded-xl transition disabled:opacity-50 shadow-md shadow-indigo-200 flex-shrink-0"
                >
                  <Send className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return isFullScreen ? createPortal(chatContent, document.body) : chatContent;
}

<file path="frontend/src/pages/CoStudy.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ArrowLeft, BookOpen, Send, Users, Play, Square, MessageSquare, Clock, Heart, Volume2, ShieldAlert, Share2, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { getProfile } from '../api/social';
import SummaryView from '../components/SummaryView';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import { CustomSelect } from '../components/CustomSelect';
import { getFriends, Friendship, sendMessage } from '../api/chat';

interface Message {
  id: string;
  sender_name: string;
  sender_avatar?: string;
  sender_id: string;
  content: string;
  created_at: string;
}

interface PresenceUser {
  user_id: string;
  name: string;
  avatar?: string;
  status: string;
}

export default function CoStudy() {
  const { id: materialId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  
  const [material, setMaterial] = useState<any>(null);
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<any>(null);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([]);
  const [messageInput, setMessageInput] = useState('');
  
  // Presence (кто в комнате)
  const [onlineUsers, setOnlineUsers] = useState<PresenceUser[]>([]);
  const [myStatus, setMyStatus] = useState('Изучает конспект');
  const [roomProfiles, setRoomProfiles] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
  const [hoveredUser, setHoveredUser] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hoverPosition, setHoverPosition] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  // Pomodoro таймер
  const [timerSeconds, setTimerSeconds] = useState(25 * 60);
  const [timerActive, setTimerActive] = useState(false);
  const [timerDuration, setTimerDuration] = useState(25 * 60);
  
  // Загрузки
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  
  // Приглашения
  const [friends, setFriends] = useState<Friendship[]>([]);
  const [showInviteModal, setShowInviteModal] = useState(false);
  const [inviteLoading, setInviteLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const chatEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const audioContextRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const coChannelRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const timerEndTimeRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // 1. Загрузка материала и профиля
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!materialId || !user) return;
    
    setLoading(true);
    Promise.all([
      supabase.from('materials').select('*').eq('id', materialId).single(),
      getProfile(user.id),
      // Загрузка сообщений чата из базы
      supabase
        .from('co_study_messages')
        .select('*')
        .eq('material_id', materialId)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
        .limit(50),
      getFriends(user.id)
    ]).then(([matRes, profRes, msgRes, friendsRes]) => {
      if (matRes.data) setMaterial(matRes.data);
      if (profRes) setProfile(profRes);
      if (msgRes.data) setMessages(msgRes.data);
      if (friendsRes) setFriends(friendsRes.filter(f => f.status === 'accepted'));
      setLoading(false);
    }).catch(err => {
      console.error(err);
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, [materialId, user?.id]);

  // Скролл чата
  useEffect(() => {
    chatEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages]);

  // Звуковой сигнал по окончании таймера
  const playAlarmSound = () => {
    try {
      if (!audioContextRef.current) {
        audioContextRef.current = new (window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext)();
      }
      const ctx = audioContextRef.current;
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, ctx.currentTime); // нота Ля
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, ctx.currentTime);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 1.2);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Audio Context failed:', e);
    }
  };

  // 2. Локальное восстановление таймера из localStorage
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!materialId) return;
    const savedEnd = localStorage.getItem(`co_timer_end_${materialId}`);
    const savedDur = localStorage.getItem(`co_timer_dur_${materialId}`);
    if (savedEnd && savedDur) {
      const endTime = parseInt(savedEnd, 10);
      const duration = parseInt(savedDur, 10);
      if (endTime > Date.now()) {
        timerEndTimeRef.current = endTime;
        setTimerDuration(duration);
        setTimerSeconds(Math.max(0, Math.floor((endTime - Date.now()) / 1000)));
        setTimerActive(true);
      }
    }
  }, [materialId]);

  // Загрузка профилей для мини-карточек
  useEffect(() => {
    const missing = onlineUsers.filter(u => !roomProfiles[u.user_id]);
    if (missing.length > 0) {
      missing.forEach(async u => {
        const p = await getProfile(u.user_id);
        if (p) {
          setRoomProfiles(prev => ({ ...prev, [u.user_id]: p }));
        }
      });
    }
  }, [onlineUsers, roomProfiles]);

  // 3. Реализация Supabase Realtime (Presence + Broadcast + DB Changes)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!materialId || !user || !profile) return;

    // A) Канал для Presence и Broadcast (Таймер Pomodoro и т.д.)
    const coChannel = supabase.channel(`co_room_${materialId}`, {
      config: { presence: { key: user.id } }
    });

    coChannelRef.current = coChannel;

    coChannel
      .on('presence', { event: 'sync' }, () => {
        const state = coChannel.presenceState();
        const users: PresenceUser[] = [];
        Object.keys(state).forEach(key => {
          const presenceList = state[key] as any;
          if (presenceList && presenceList.length > 0) {
            users.push({
              user_id: key,
              name: presenceList[0].name || 'Студент',
              avatar: presenceList[0].avatar,
              status: presenceList[0].status || 'Учится'
            });
          }
        });
        setOnlineUsers(users);
      })
      // Прослушивание синхронизации таймера
      .on('broadcast', { event: 'timer' }, ({ payload }) => {
        if (payload.action === 'start') {
          const remaining = payload.remaining || payload.duration;
          const endTime = Date.now() + remaining * 1000;
          timerEndTimeRef.current = endTime;
          setTimerDuration(payload.duration);
          setTimerActive(true);
          // Сохраняем локально на случай перезагрузки
          localStorage.setItem(`co_timer_end_${materialId}`, endTime.toString());
          localStorage.setItem(`co_timer_dur_${materialId}`, payload.duration.toString());
        } else if (payload.action === 'stop') {
          setTimerActive(false);
          timerEndTimeRef.current = null;
          localStorage.removeItem(`co_timer_end_${materialId}`);
        } else if (payload.action === 'reset') {
          setTimerActive(false);
          timerEndTimeRef.current = null;
          localStorage.removeItem(`co_timer_end_${materialId}`);
          setTimerSeconds(payload.duration);
        } else if (payload.action === 'sync_request') {
          // Если у нас запущен таймер, отправляем его данные новому участнику
          if (timerEndTimeRef.current && timerEndTimeRef.current > Date.now()) {
            const remaining = Math.floor((timerEndTimeRef.current - Date.now()) / 1000);
            coChannel.send({
              type: 'broadcast',
              event: 'timer',
              payload: {
                action: 'sync_response',
                duration: timerDuration,
                remaining
              }
            });
          }
        } else if (payload.action === 'sync_response') {
          const remaining = payload.remaining;
          if (remaining && remaining > 0) {
            const endTime = Date.now() + remaining * 1000;
            timerEndTimeRef.current = endTime;
            setTimerDuration(payload.duration);
            setTimerActive(true);
            localStorage.setItem(`co_timer_end_${materialId}`, endTime.toString());
            localStorage.setItem(`co_timer_dur_${materialId}`, payload.duration.toString());
          }
        }
      })
      .subscribe(async (status) => {
        if (status === 'SUBSCRIBED') {
          // Запрашиваем состояние таймера у присутствующих
          coChannel.send({
            type: 'broadcast',
            event: 'timer',
            payload: { action: 'sync_request' }
          });

          await coChannel.track({
            user_id: user.id,
            name: profile.full_name || 'Студент',
            avatar: profile.avatar_url,
            status: myStatus
          });
        }
      });

    // B) Канал для прослушивания новых сообщений чата (Insert в таблицу)
    const msgChannel = supabase
      .channel(`db_messages_${materialId}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { 
        event: 'INSERT', 
        schema: 'public', 
        table: 'co_study_messages', 
        filter: `material_id=eq.${materialId}` 
      }, (payload) => {
        const newMsg = payload.new as Message;
        setMessages(prev => {
          if (prev.some(m => m.id === newMsg.id)) return prev;
          return [...prev, newMsg];
        });
      })
      .subscribe();

    // Слушатель для alt+tab и восстановления фокуса (для обновления присутствия)
    const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && coChannelRef.current) {
        coChannelRef.current.track({
          user_id: user.id,
          name: profile.full_name || 'Студент',
          avatar: profile.avatar_url,
          status: myStatusRef.current
        });
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
      coChannel.untrack();
      supabase.removeChannel(coChannel);
      supabase.removeChannel(msgChannel);
    };
  }, [materialId, user?.id, profile]);

  const myStatusRef = useRef(myStatus);
  useEffect(() => {
    myStatusRef.current = myStatus;
  }, [myStatus]);

  // Обновление статуса Presence локально и на сервере
  const handleUpdateStatus = async (status: string) => {
    setMyStatus(status);
    setOnlineUsers(prev => prev.map(u => u.user_id === user?.id ? { ...u, status } : u));
    
    if (coChannelRef.current && user && profile) {
      await coChannelRef.current.track({
        user_id: user.id,
        name: profile.full_name || 'Студент',
        avatar: profile.avatar_url,
        status: status
      });
    }
  };

  // 4. Работа с Pomodoro-таймером локально (вычисление по endTime для борьбы с дрейфом в фоне)
  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: any = null;
    if (timerActive && timerEndTimeRef.current) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.floor((timerEndTimeRef.current! - Date.now()) / 1000));
        setTimerSeconds(remaining);
        if (remaining <= 0) {
          setTimerActive(false);
          timerEndTimeRef.current = null;
          localStorage.removeItem(`co_timer_end_${materialId}`);
          playAlarmSound();
          clearInterval(interval);
        }
      }, 500);
    }
    return () => {
      if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [timerActive, materialId]);

  const handleStartTimer = (durationMins: number) => {
    const duration = durationMins * 60;
    const endTime = Date.now() + duration * 1000;
    
    if (coChannelRef.current) {
      coChannelRef.current.send({
        type: 'broadcast',
        event: 'timer',
        payload: { action: 'start', duration, remaining: duration }
      });
    }

    timerEndTimeRef.current = endTime;
    setTimerDuration(duration);
    setTimerSeconds(duration);
    setTimerActive(true);
    localStorage.setItem(`co_timer_end_${materialId}`, endTime.toString());
    localStorage.setItem(`co_timer_dur_${materialId}`, duration.toString());
  };

  const handleStopTimer = () => {
    if (coChannelRef.current) {
      coChannelRef.current.send({
        type: 'broadcast',
        event: 'timer',
        payload: { action: 'stop' }
      });
    }
    setTimerActive(false);
    timerEndTimeRef.current = null;
    localStorage.removeItem(`co_timer_end_${materialId}`);
  };

  const handleResetTimer = () => {
    const duration = 25 * 60;
    if (coChannelRef.current) {
      coChannelRef.current.send({
        type: 'broadcast',
        event: 'timer',
        payload: { action: 'reset', duration }
      });
    }
    setTimerActive(false);
    timerEndTimeRef.current = null;
    localStorage.removeItem(`co_timer_end_${materialId}`);
    setTimerSeconds(duration);
  };


  // 4. Отправка сообщений чата в базу данных
  const handleSendMessage = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!messageInput.trim() || !user || !profile || !materialId) return;

    const text = messageInput.trim();
    setMessageInput('');

    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('co_study_messages')
        .insert({
          material_id: materialId,
          sender_id: user.id,
          sender_name: profile.full_name || 'Студент',
          sender_avatar: profile.avatar_url,
          content: text
        })
        .select()
        .single();
        
      if (error) throw error;
      
      // Добавляем к себе локально (на случай если триггер realtime сработает медленнее)
      const newMsg = data as Message;
      setMessages(prev => {
        if (prev.some(m => m.id === newMsg.id)) return prev;
        return [...prev, newMsg];
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to send message:', err);
    }
  };

  // Форматирование времени таймера
  const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  // Отправка приглашения в личку
  const handleSendInvite = async (friendId: string) => {
    if (!user || !materialId || !material) return;
    setInviteLoading(friendId);
    
    const inviteLink = `${window.location.origin}/co-study/${materialId}`;
    const text = `👋 Привет! Присоединяйся ко мне в совместную комнату для изучения материала «${material.title}»: ${inviteLink}`;
    
    const msg = await sendMessage(user.id, friendId, text);
    if (msg) {
      toast.success('Приглашение отправлено!');
    } else {
      toast.error('Ошибка при отправке приглашения');
    }
    setInviteLoading(null);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[80vh]">
        <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-indigo-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mb-4" />
        <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">Подключение к учебной комнате...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!material) {
    return (
      <div className="p-8 text-center">
        <ShieldAlert className="w-12 h-12 text-rose-500 mx-auto mb-3" />
        <p className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold mb-4">Материал не найден</p>
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/library')} className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl">← В библиотеку</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-4 md:p-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto min-h-screen relative">
      {/* МИНИ ПРОФИЛЬ ПРИ НАВЕДЕНИИ */}
      {hoveredUser && roomProfiles[hoveredUser] && (
        <div 
          className="fixed z-50 w-64 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-4 pointer-events-none transform -translate-y-1/2"
          style={{ left: hoverPosition.x, top: hoverPosition.y }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
            {roomProfiles[hoveredUser].avatar_url ? (
              <img src={roomProfiles[hoveredUser].avatar_url} alt="avatar" className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover shadow-sm" />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-slate-500">
                {roomProfiles[hoveredUser].full_name?.[0]}
              </div>
            )}
            <div>
              <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 line-clamp-1">{roomProfiles[hoveredUser].full_name}</div>
              {roomProfiles[hoveredUser].public_id && (
                <div className="text-xs font-mono text-indigo-500 font-bold">#{roomProfiles[hoveredUser].public_id}</div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          {roomProfiles[hoveredUser].university && (
            <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 p-2 rounded-lg">
              🎓 {roomProfiles[hoveredUser].university}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* HEADER */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate(`/library/${materialId}`)}
            className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl transition"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-lg uppercase tracking-wider">
                Совместная комната
              </span>
              <span className="flex h-2 w-2 relative">
                <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-emerald-400 opacity-75"></span>
                <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-emerald-500"></span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 tracking-tight mt-1">
              {material.title}
            </h1>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowInviteModal(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-900/30 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900/50 transition shrink-0"
          >
            <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Пригласить друга</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showInviteModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl p-6 w-full max-w-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-2xl">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-4">Пригласить друга</h3>
            
            <div className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar space-y-2 mb-6">
              {friends.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-center py-4">У вас пока нет друзей. Добавьте их в Social Hub!</p>
              ) : (
                friends.map(f => (
                  <div key={f.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      {f.friend_avatar ? (
                        <img src={f.friend_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover" />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                          <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold">{f.friend_name?.[0]}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">{f.friend_name}</span>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleSendInvite(f.friend_id!)}
                      disabled={inviteLoading === f.friend_id}
                      className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50 transition"
                    >
                      {inviteLoading === f.friend_id ? 'Отправка...' : 'Отправить'}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center gap-2">
              <button 
                onClick={() => {
                  navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);
                  toast.success('Ссылка скопирована!');
                }}
                className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-200 px-4 py-2"
              >
                Копировать ссылку
              </button>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setShowInviteModal(false)}
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold rounded-xl transition"
              >
                Закрыть
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 items-start">
        {/* LEFT COLUMN: MATERIAL STUDY + POMODORO */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Pomodoro Timer widget */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-6 relative overflow-hidden">
            <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 bottom-0 w-2 bg-indigo-500" />
            
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center shadow-inner">
                <Clock className="w-6 h-6" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-base">Совместный Pomodoro</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 max-w-xs mt-0.5">
                  Синхронный таймер фокусировки для совместного заучивания карточек или конспекта.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col items-center sm:items-end gap-3 shrink-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 font-mono tracking-wider">
                  {formatTime(timerSeconds)}
                </span>
                
                {timerActive ? (
                  <button
                    onClick={handleStopTimer}
                    className="p-2 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/60 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 rounded-xl transition"
                    title="Приостановить таймер"
                  >
                    <Square className="w-4 h-4 fill-rose-600 dark:fill-rose-400" />
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleStartTimer(25)}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition shadow-sm shadow-indigo-100"
                    >
                      <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-white" />
                      25 мин
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleStartTimer(15)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition"
                    >
                      15 мин
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
                
                <button
                  onClick={handleResetTimer}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition"
                >
                  Сбросить
                </button>
              </div>
              
              {timerActive && (
                <div className="w-full sm:w-44 h-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                  <div 
                    className="h-full bg-indigo-500 transition-all duration-1000"
                    style={{ width: `${(timerSeconds / timerDuration) * 100}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Material summary document */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
              <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500" />
              <h2 className="font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-lg">Совместное изучение конспекта</h2>
            </div>
            
            <div className="overflow-y-auto max-h-[60vh] pr-2 custom-scrollbar">
              {material.summary_json ? (
                <SummaryView data={material.summary_json} />
              ) : (
                <p className="text-slate-400 italic">Конспект пуст или не найден.</p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* RIGHT COLUMN: PRESENCE & CHAT MESSAGE PANEL */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          
          {/* Online Users Presence */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
                <h3 className="font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm">В комнате ({onlineUsers.length})</h3>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[180px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
              {onlineUsers.map(u => (
                <div key={u.user_id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
                  <div 
                    className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0 cursor-pointer group"
                    onMouseEnter={(e) => { 
                      setHoveredUser(u.user_id);
                      const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
                      setHoverPosition({ x: rect.left - 270, y: rect.top + rect.height / 2 });
                    }} 
                    onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredUser(null)}
                    onClick={() => navigate(`/profile/${u.user_id}`)}
                  >
                    <div className="relative">
                      {u.avatar ? (
                        <img src={u.avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full object-cover border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700 group-hover:ring-2 ring-indigo-500 transition-all" />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 group-hover:ring-2 ring-indigo-500 transition-all">
                          {u.name?.[0] || '?'}
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-emerald-500 border-2 border-white dark:border-slate-900 rounded-full" />
                    </div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 truncate group-hover:text-indigo-500 transition-colors">{u.name}</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                    {u.status}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
              {myStatus !== 'Изучил конспект ✅' ? (
                <button 
                  onClick={() => handleUpdateStatus('Изучил конспект ✅')} 
                  className="w-full py-2 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold text-xs rounded-xl hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/50 transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Отметить как прочитанное
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button 
                  onClick={() => handleUpdateStatus('Изучает конспект')} 
                  className="w-full py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold text-xs rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition"
                >
                  Вернуться к изучению
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Realtime Chat */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-sm h-[400px] flex flex-col">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 mb-3 shrink-0">
              <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" />
              <h3 className="font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm">Обсуждение</h3>
            </div>

            {/* Message feed */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 pr-1 mb-4 custom-scrollbar text-xs">
              {messages.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic">
                  Нет сообщений. Напишите что-нибудь первым!
                </div>
              ) : (
                messages.map(m => {
                  const isMe = m.sender_id === user?.id;
                  return (
                    <div key={m.id} className={`flex items-start gap-2 max-w-[85%] ${isMe ? 'ml-auto flex-row-reverse' : ''}`}>
                      {!isMe && (
                        m.sender_avatar ? (
                          <img src={m.sender_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full object-cover shrink-0" />
                        ) : (
                          <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 shrink-0">
                            {m.sender_name?.[0]}
                          </div>
                        )
                      )}
                      
                      <div>
                        {!isMe && (
                          <span className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mb-0.5 pl-1">
                            {m.sender_name}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-2xl ${
                          isMe 
                            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-tr-none' 
                            : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-tl-none'
                        }`}>
                          <p className="leading-relaxed break-words">{m.content}</p>
                        </div>
                        <span className="block text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-0.5 text-right pl-1">
                          {format(new Date(m.created_at), 'HH:mm')}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
              <div ref={chatEndRef} />
            </div>

            {/* Message Input */}
            <form onSubmit={handleSendMessage} className="flex gap-2 shrink-0 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pt-3">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={messageInput}
                onChange={e => setMessageInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Задать вопрос или написать сообщение..."
                className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder-slate-400"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!messageInput.trim()}
                className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl transition disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </form>

          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/pages/Messages.tsx">
import { Material } from '../types';
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { getChats, ChatContact, getMessages, sendMessage, subscribeToMessages, DirectMessage, sendFriendRequest, getFriends, Friendship, respondFriendRequest, searchUsers, subscribeToFriendships, getUnreadDMsGrouped, markNotificationsAsReadForSender } from '../api/chat';
import { Send, UserCircle2, MessageSquare, Loader2, BookOpen, Link2, ChevronLeft, UserPlus, Users, Check, X, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { getMaterials, updateMaterialVisibility } from '../api/materials';
import { getProfile } from '../api/social';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function Messages() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { id: urlId } = useParams();
  
  const [viewTab, setViewTab] = useState<'chats' | 'friends'>('chats');
  
  const [friends, setFriends] = useState<ChatContact[]>([]);
  const [friendships, setFriendships] = useState<Friendship[]>([]);
  
  const [activeFriend, setActiveFriend] = useState<ChatContact | null>(null);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<DirectMessage[]>([]);
  const [newMessage, setNewMessage] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showInvite, setShowInvite] = useState(false);
  const [myMaterials, setMyMaterials] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [friendRequestSent, setFriendRequestSent] = useState(false);
  
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
  const [unreadCounts, setUnreadCounts] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});

  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => { setFriendRequestSent(false); }, [activeFriend]);

  // Self-chat prevention
  useEffect(() => {
    if (user && urlId && urlId === user.id) {
      toast.error('Вы не можете общаться с самим собой!');
      navigate('/messages');
    }
  }, [user, urlId, navigate]);

  const loadData = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    if (urlId === user.id) return;
    
    const chats = await getChats(user.id);
    const fs = await getFriends(user.id);
    const counts = await getUnreadDMsGrouped(user.id);
    
    setFriends(chats);
    setFriendships(fs);
    setUnreadCounts(counts);
    
    if (urlId && !chats.some(c => c.friend_id === urlId)) {
      const p = await getProfile(urlId);
      if (p) {
        chats.unshift({ id: p.id, friend_id: p.id, friend_name: p.full_name, friend_avatar: p.avatar_url });
        setFriends([...chats]);
      }
    }
    
    if (urlId) {
      setActiveFriend(chats.find(c => c.friend_id === urlId) || null);
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
    if (user) {
      getMaterials(user.id).then(setMyMaterials);
    }
  }, [user?.id, urlId]);

  // Subscribe to ALL friendships updates in real time to auto-reload friends lists and requests
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    const unsubscribe = subscribeToFriendships(user.id, () => {
      loadData();
    });
    return () => { unsubscribe(); };
  }, [user?.id]);

  // Subscribe to ALL incoming messages globally on Messages page
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;

    const unsubscribe = subscribeToMessages(user.id, (msg) => {
      // Reload chats list so new conversations show up immediately
      getChats(user.id).then(setFriends);
      getUnreadDMsGrouped(user.id).then(setUnreadCounts);

      // If the message belongs to the currently active friend thread, append it
      setActiveFriend(current => {
        if (current && (msg.sender_id === current.friend_id || msg.receiver_id === current.friend_id)) {
          setMessages(prev => prev.find(m => m.id === msg.id) ? prev : [...prev, msg]);
          
          // Mark as read immediately if the active friend sent it
          if (msg.sender_id === current.friend_id) {
            markNotificationsAsReadForSender(user.id, current.friend_id).then(() => {
              getUnreadDMsGrouped(user.id).then(setUnreadCounts);
              window.dispatchEvent(new Event('notification_read'));
            });
          }
        }
        return current;
      });
    });

    return () => { unsubscribe(); };
  }, [user?.id]);

  // Mark active friend messages as read when opened
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user || !activeFriend) return;
    markNotificationsAsReadForSender(user.id, activeFriend.friend_id).then(() => {
      getUnreadDMsGrouped(user.id).then(setUnreadCounts);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('notification_read'));
    });
  }, [user?.id, activeFriend?.friend_id]);

  // Load message history when active friend changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user || !activeFriend) {
      setMessages([]);
      return;
    }
    getMessages(user.id, activeFriend.friend_id!).then(setMessages);
  }, [user?.id, activeFriend?.friend_id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user || !searchQuery.trim()) {
      setSearchResults([]);
      return;
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      setIsSearching(true);
      const res = await searchUsers(searchQuery, user.id);
      setSearchResults(res);
      setIsSearching(false);
    }, 500);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchQuery, user?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages]);

  const handleSend = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!user || !activeFriend || !newMessage.trim()) return;
    const content = newMessage.trim();
    setNewMessage('');
    const msg = await sendMessage(user.id, activeFriend.friend_id!, content);
    if (msg) {
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, msg]);
    } else {
      toast.error('Не удалось отправить сообщение. Возможно, вы заблокированы.');
    }
  };

  const handleSendInvite = async (material: Material) => {
    if (!user || !activeFriend) return;
    
    // Сделаем материал публичным, чтобы получатель мог его открыть
    if (!material.is_public) {
      await updateMaterialVisibility(material.id, true);
    }
    
    const inviteText = `[MATERIAL_INVITE:${material.id}] 📚 Приглашаю изучить материал: «${material.title}» (${material.subject || 'Без предмета'})`;
    setShowInvite(false);
    const msg = await sendMessage(user.id, activeFriend.friend_id!, inviteText);
    if (msg) {
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, msg]);
      toast.success('Материал отправлен!', { duration: 3000 });
    } else {
      toast.error('Не удалось отправить материал.');
    }
  };

  const handleRespondRequest = async (friendshipId: string, status: 'accepted' | 'declined') => {
    const success = await respondFriendRequest(friendshipId, status);
    if (success) {
      toast.success(status === 'accepted' ? 'Заявка принята!' : 'Заявка отклонена');
      loadData();
    } else {
      toast.error('Произошла ошибка при обработке заявки.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="flex h-[calc(100vh-48px)] items-center justify-center"><Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 text-indigo-500 animate-spin" /></div>;
  }

  const incomingRequests = friendships.filter(f => f.addressee_id === user?.id && f.status === 'pending');
  const acceptedFriends = friendships.filter(f => f.status === 'accepted');

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full md:h-[calc(100vh-48px)] bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 md:rounded-2xl rounded-none shadow-sm border-0 md:border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden md:m-6 m-0 relative">

      {/* Левая панель */}
      <div className={`w-full md:w-80 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/40 shrink-0 ${activeFriend ? 'hidden md:flex md:flex-col' : 'flex flex-col'}`}>
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 space-y-4">
          <h2 className="font-bold text-lg text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500" />
            Друзья и Диалоги
          </h2>
          <div className="flex bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 p-1 rounded-xl">
            <button
              onClick={() => setViewTab('chats')}
              className={`flex-1 text-xs font-bold py-2 px-3 rounded-lg transition-all ${viewTab === 'chats' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-300'}`}
            >
              Диалоги
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setViewTab('friends')}
              className={`flex-1 flex justify-center items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold py-2 px-3 rounded-lg transition-all ${viewTab === 'friends' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-300'}`}
            >
              Друзья
              {incomingRequests.length > 0 && (
                <span className="bg-rose-500 text-white text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">{incomingRequests.length}</span>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
          {viewTab === 'chats' ? (
            friends.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-6 text-center">
                <MessageSquare className="w-10 h-10 text-slate-200 dark:text-slate-800 mx-auto mb-3" />
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">У вас пока нет диалогов.</p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setViewTab('friends')}
                  className="mt-3 text-sm text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold hover:text-indigo-700 dark:hover:text-indigo-300"
                >
                  Перейти к друзьям →
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              friends.map(f => (
                <button
                  key={f.id}
                  onClick={() => setActiveFriend(f)}
                  className={`w-full p-4 flex items-center gap-3 text-left transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/40 relative ${
                    activeFriend?.id === f.id ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40' : 'hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-slate-800/30'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="relative shrink-0">
                    {f.friend_avatar ? (
                      <img src={f.friend_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover" />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center">
                        <UserCircle2 className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-500" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {unreadCounts[f.friend_id] > 0 && (
                      <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 min-w-[16px] h-4 bg-rose-500 text-white text-[9px] font-black rounded-full flex items-center justify-center px-1 border border-white dark:border-slate-900 animate-pulse z-10">
                        {unreadCounts[f.friend_id]}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-sm truncate">{f.friend_name}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">Нажмите, чтобы открыть чат</div>
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))
            )
          ) : (
            <div className="p-4 space-y-6">
              {/* Поиск пользователей */}
              <div>
                <div className="relative mb-4">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={searchQuery}
                    onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Поиск по имени или ID..."
                    className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 transition dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400"
                  />
                  <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3" />
                  {isSearching && (
                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500 animate-spin absolute right-3.5 top-3" />
                  )}
                </div>

                {searchQuery.trim() && (
                  <div className="mb-6 space-y-2">
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Результаты поиска</h3>
                    {searchResults.length === 0 && !isSearching ? (
                      <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-center py-2">Ничего не найдено</p>
                    ) : (
                      searchResults.map(u => {
                        const isAlreadyFriend = friendships.some(f => (f.requester_id === u.id || f.addressee_id === u.id) && f.status === 'accepted');
                        return (
                          <div key={u.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                              {u.avatar_url ? (
                                <img src={u.avatar_url} alt="avatar" className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover shrink-0" />
                              ) : (
                                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                                  <UserCircle2 className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-400" />
                                </div>
                              )}
                              <div className="min-w-0 text-left">
                                <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-sm truncate">{u.full_name || 'Без имени'}</div>
                                <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">#{u.public_id}</div>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <button
                              onClick={() => {
                                const contact: ChatContact = {
                                  id: u.id,
                                  friend_id: u.id,
                                  friend_name: u.full_name || 'Неизвестный',
                                  friend_avatar: u.avatar_url
                                };
                                setActiveFriend(contact);
                              }}
                              className="p-2 text-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:hover:bg-indigo-500/20 rounded-lg transition shrink-0 ml-2"
                              title="Написать"
                            >
                              <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {!searchQuery.trim() && incomingRequests.length > 0 && (
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">Заявки в друзья</h3>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {incomingRequests.map(r => (
                      <div key={r.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                          {r.friend_avatar ? (
                            <img src={r.friend_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full object-cover shrink-0" />
                          ) : (
                            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                              <UserCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
                            </div>
                          )}
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-sm truncate">{r.friend_name}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleRespondRequest(r.id, 'accepted')}
                            className="p-1.5 text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500/20 rounded-lg transition"
                          >
                            <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleRespondRequest(r.id, 'declined')}
                            className="p-1.5 text-rose-600 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:hover:bg-rose-500/20 rounded-lg transition"
                          >
                            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {!searchQuery.trim() && (
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                    Мои друзья
                    <span className="bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px]">{acceptedFriends.length}</span>
                  </h3>
                {acceptedFriends.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-center py-6">
                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-2">У вас пока нет друзей.</p>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => navigate('/network')}
                      className="text-sm text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold hover:underline"
                    >
                      Найти в Study Network
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {acceptedFriends.map(f => (
                      <button
                        key={f.id}
                        onClick={() => {
                          const contact: ChatContact = {
                            id: f.friend_id!,
                            friend_id: f.friend_id!,
                            friend_name: f.friend_name!,
                            friend_avatar: f.friend_avatar
                          };
                          setActiveFriend(contact);
                        }}
                        className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/50 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 transition"
                      >
                        {f.friend_avatar ? (
                          <img src={f.friend_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover shrink-0" />
                        ) : (
                          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                            <UserCircle2 className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-400" />
                          </div>
                        )}
                        <div className="text-left min-w-0">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-sm truncate">{f.friend_name}</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 truncate">Написать сообщение</div>
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Правая панель — чат */}
      <div className={`w-full md:flex-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 relative min-w-0 ${!activeFriend ? 'hidden md:flex md:flex-col' : 'flex flex-col'}`}>
        {activeFriend ? (
          <>
            {/* Хедер */}
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-sm z-10">
              <button onClick={() => setActiveFriend(null)} className="md:hidden p-2 -ml-2 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-slate-200 transition">
                <ChevronLeft className="w-6 h-6" />
              </button>
              <div 
                onClick={() => navigate(`/profile/${activeFriend.friend_id}`)}
                className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition min-w-0 flex-1"
                title="Открыть профиль"
              >
                {activeFriend.friend_avatar ? (
                  <img src={activeFriend.friend_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover shrink-0" />
                ) : (
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <UserCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate">{activeFriend.friend_name}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
              {/* Кнопки */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 relative">
                {!friendRequestSent && !friendships.some(f => f.friend_id === activeFriend.friend_id && (f.status === 'accepted' || f.status === 'pending')) && (
                  <button
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (!user || !activeFriend) return;
