                      await sendFriendRequest(user.id, activeFriend.friend_id!);
                      setFriendRequestSent(true);
                      toast.success('Заявка в друзья отправлена!');
                      loadData();
                    }}
                    className="flex items-center justify-center w-8 h-8 md:w-auto md:px-3 md:py-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/80 rounded-lg transition border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/60"
                    title="Добавить в друзья"
                  >
                    <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span className="hidden md:inline md:ml-2">Добавить</span>
                  </button>
                )}

                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowInvite(v => !v)}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center w-8 h-8 md:w-auto md:px-3 md:py-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900/50 transition rounded-lg"
                  title="Поделиться материалом"
                >
                  <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span className="hidden md:inline md:ml-2">Поделиться</span>
                </button>

                {showInvite && (
                  <div className="absolute right-0 top-10 w-72 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 z-20 overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="p-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700">
                      <p className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">Отправить материал в чат</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="max-h-56 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-slate-50 dark:divide-slate-700">
                      {myMaterials.length === 0 ? (
                        <p className="p-4 text-sm text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-center">У вас нет материалов</p>
                      ) : myMaterials.map(m => (
                        <button
                          key={m.id}
                          onClick={() => handleSendInvite(m)}
                          className="w-full p-3 text-left hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/50 transition"
                        >
                          <div className="font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-sm truncate">{m.title}</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">{m.subject || 'Без предмета'}</div>
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Сообщения */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 space-y-3 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/20" onClick={() => setShowInvite(false)}>
              {messages.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-sm">
                  Напишите первое сообщение!
                </div>
              ) : (
                messages.map(msg => {
                  const isMe = msg.sender_id === user?.id;
                  const isLegacyInvite = msg.content.startsWith('📚');
                  const isNewInvite = msg.content.startsWith('[MATERIAL_INVITE:');
                  const isInvite = isNewInvite || isLegacyInvite;
                  return (
                    <motion.div
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 5 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                      key={msg.id}
                      className={`flex ${isMe ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}
                    >
                      <div className={`max-w-[72%] px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl text-sm ${
                        isMe
                          ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-tr-sm dark:bg-indigo-600'
                          : isInvite
                            ? 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/50 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 rounded-tl-sm shadow-sm'
                            : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-tl-sm shadow-sm'
                      }`}>
                        {(() => {
                          if (isNewInvite) {
                            const match = msg.content.match(/^\[MATERIAL_INVITE:([a-zA-Z0-9-]+)\]\s*(.*)$/);
                            if (match) {
                              const materialId = match[1];
                              const text = match[2];
                              return (
                                <div>
                                  {(!isMe || true) && (
                                    <div className={`flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-xs mb-1.5 ${isMe ? 'text-indigo-200' : 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'}`}>
                                      <Link2 className="w-3 h-3" /> Приглашение к материалу
                                    </div>
                                  )}
                                  <div className="mb-2">{text}</div>
                                  <button
                                    onClick={() => navigate(`/shared/${materialId}`)}
                                    className={`block w-full text-center px-4 py-2 mt-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm transition ${
                                      isMe 
                                        ? 'bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-white' 
                                        : 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white shadow-sm'
                                    }`}
                                  >
                                    Открыть материал
                                  </button>
                                </div>
                              );
                            }
                          }
                          return (
                            <>
                              {isLegacyInvite && !isMe && (
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold text-xs mb-1">
                                  <Link2 className="w-3 h-3" /> Приглашение к материалу
                                </div>
                              )}
                              {msg.content}
                            </>
                          );
                        })()}
                        <div className={`text-[10px] mt-1 text-right ${isMe ? 'text-indigo-200 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500'}`}>
                          {new Date(msg.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </motion.div>
                  );
                })
              )}
              <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
            </div>

            {/* Ввод сообщения */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              <form onSubmit={handleSend} className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newMessage}
                  onChange={e => setNewMessage(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Напишите сообщение..."
                  className="flex-1 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 text-sm dark:text-white"
                />
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={!newMessage.trim()}
                  className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white p-2.5 rounded-xl transition disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                >
                  <Send className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 p-6 hidden md:flex">
            <MessageSquare className="w-16 h-16 text-slate-200 dark:text-slate-800 mb-4" />
            <p className="text-lg font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">Выберите друга или диалог слева</p>
            <p className="text-sm mt-1">чтобы начать общение</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/pages/Missions.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Gamepad2, BookOpen, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, ChevronRight, ChevronDown, HelpCircle, Trophy, Sparkles, X, ArrowRight, Lock, Unlock, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkMath from 'remark-math';
import rehypeKatex from 'rehype-katex';
import 'katex/dist/katex.min.css';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { useConfirm } from '../contexts/ConfirmContext';
import { CustomSelect } from '../components/CustomSelect';
import { getMaterials, updateMaterialMissions } from '../api/materials';
import { updateQuestProgress, checkAndAwardAchievements, recordStudyActivity } from '../api/quests';
import ConfettiCelebration from '../components/ConfettiCelebration';
import AchievementToast from '../components/AchievementToast';
import type { Achievement } from '../components/AchievementToast';
import { incrementAIUsage } from '../api/limits';
import { useEnergyConfirm } from '../hooks/useEnergyConfirm';

interface Mission {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  explanation: string;
  question: string;
  options: string[];
  correct: string;
  hint: string;
}

export default function Missions() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { confirm, alert } = useConfirm();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { verifyEnergy } = useEnergyConfirm();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const queryMaterialId = searchParams.get('materialId');

  // Восстановление состояния из sessionStorage
  const savedStateStr = sessionStorage.getItem('studyforge_missions_state');
  const savedState = savedStateStr ? JSON.parse(savedStateStr) : null;

  // Состояние материалов
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [selectedMaterialId, setSelectedMaterialId] = useState<string>(queryMaterialId || savedState?.selectedMaterialId || '');
  
  // Состояние игры
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'select' | 'loading' | 'game' | 'completed'>(
    queryMaterialId
      ? 'loading'
      : (savedState?.phase === 'loading' ? 'select' : (savedState?.phase || 'select'))
  );
  const [missions, setMissions] = useState<Mission[]>(savedState?.missions || []);
  const [activeStep, setActiveStep] = useState<number>(savedState?.activeStep !== undefined ? savedState.activeStep : 0); // индекс текущей миссии (0, 1, 2)
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<string | null>(savedState?.selectedOption || null);
  const [isCorrect, setIsCorrect] = useState<boolean | null>(savedState?.isCorrect !== undefined ? savedState.isCorrect : null);
  const [showHint, setShowHint] = useState<boolean>(savedState?.showHint || false);
  const [shake, setShake] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showConfetti, setShowConfetti] = useState(false);
  const [achievement, setAchievement] = useState<Achievement | null>(null);
  const [isDropdownOpen, setIsDropdownOpen] = useState(false);

  // Сохранение состояния в sessionStorage
  useEffect(() => {
    sessionStorage.setItem('studyforge_missions_state', JSON.stringify({
      selectedMaterialId,
      phase,
      missions,
      activeStep,
      selectedOption,
      isCorrect,
      showHint
    }));
  }, [selectedMaterialId, phase, missions, activeStep, selectedOption, isCorrect, showHint]);

  // Загрузка материалов
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    getMaterials(user.id)
      .then((data) => {
        setMaterials(data);
        
        // Если передан queryMaterialId и мы еще не начали играть, автоматически запускаем
        if (queryMaterialId && (phase === 'select' || phase === 'loading')) {
          const found = data.find(m => m.id === queryMaterialId);
          if (found) {
            (async () => {
              setPhase('loading');
              setSelectedOption(null);
              setIsCorrect(null);
              setShowHint(false);
              setActiveStep(0);

              // 1. Проверяем, есть ли уже сгенерированные миссии в БД
              const foundAny = found as any;
              if (foundAny.missions_json && foundAny.missions_json.missions && foundAny.missions_json.missions.length > 0) {
                setMissions(foundAny.missions_json.missions);
                setPhase('game');
                return;
              }

              // 2. Если нет (старый материал), генерируем на лету
              const summary = typeof found.summary_json === 'string'
                ? found.summary_json
                : (found.summary_json?.content || '');
              const context = (found.original_text || summary || '').slice(0, 15000);

              if (user?.id) {
                const ok = await verifyEnergy(user.id, 2, 'Генерация игры');
                if (!ok) {
                  setPhase('select');
                  return;
                }
                await incrementAIUsage(user.id, 2);
              }

              try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/missions/generate', {
                  method: 'POST',
                  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                  body: JSON.stringify({ context })
                });

                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Ошибка генерации игры');
                const gData = await res.json();
                
                if (gData.missions && gData.missions.length > 0) {
                  setMissions(gData.missions);
                  setPhase('game');
                  updateMaterialMissions(found.id, gData.missions);
                } else {
                  throw new Error('Пустой список миссий');
                }
              } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                setPhase('select');
              }
            })();
          }
        }
      })
      .catch(console.error);
  }, [user?.id, queryMaterialId]);

  const selectedMaterial = materials.find(m => m.id === selectedMaterialId);

  // Старт игры: запрос генерации квестов
  const startGame = async () => {
    if (!selectedMaterial) return;
    setPhase('loading');
    setSelectedOption(null);
    setIsCorrect(null);
    setShowHint(false);
    setActiveStep(0);

    // 1. Проверяем, есть ли уже сгенерированные миссии в БД
    if (selectedMaterial.missions_json && selectedMaterial.missions_json.missions && selectedMaterial.missions_json.missions.length > 0) {
      setMissions(selectedMaterial.missions_json.missions);
      setPhase('game');
      return;
    }

    // 2. Если нет (старый материал), генерируем на лету
    const summary = typeof selectedMaterial.summary_json === 'string'
      ? selectedMaterial.summary_json
      : (selectedMaterial.summary_json?.content || '');
    const context = (selectedMaterial.original_text || summary || '').slice(0, 15000);

    if (user?.id) {
      const ok = await verifyEnergy(user.id, 2, 'Генерация игры');
      if (!ok) {
        setPhase('select');
        return;
      }
      await incrementAIUsage(user.id, 2);
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/missions/generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ context })
      });

      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Ошибка генерации игры');
      const data = await res.json();
      
      if (data.missions && data.missions.length > 0) {
        setMissions(data.missions);
        setPhase('game');
        updateMaterialMissions(selectedMaterial.id, data.missions);
      } else {
        throw new Error('Пустой список миссий');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      await alert({ title: 'Ошибка', message: 'Не удалось сформировать игру по материалу. Попробуйте еще раз.', type: 'danger' });
      setPhase('select');
    }
  };

  // Проверка ответа студента
  const handleOptionClick = (option: string) => {
    if (isCorrect) return; // уже ответил верно

    setSelectedOption(option);
    const correctLetter = missions[activeStep].correct; // 'A', 'B' или 'C'
    const isCorrectAnswer = option.startsWith(correctLetter);

    if (isCorrectAnswer) {
      setIsCorrect(true);
      setShowHint(false);
    } else {
      setIsCorrect(false);
      setShowHint(true);
      setShake(true);
      setTimeout(() => setShake(false), 500); // анимация тряски
    }
  };

  // Переход к следующей миссии
  const handleNextMission = async () => {
    setSelectedOption(null);
    setIsCorrect(null);
    setShowHint(false);

    if (activeStep + 1 >= missions.length) {
      // Все миссии пройдены!
      setShowConfetti(true);
      setPhase('completed');
      setTimeout(() => setShowConfetti(false), 100);
      
      // Запись сессии в Supabase для начисления XP и активности
      if (user) {
        await updateQuestProgress(user.id, 'quiz', 1);
        await recordStudyActivity(user.id, 3, 0);
        // Проверяем достижения
        const newAchs = await checkAndAwardAchievements(user.id);
        if (newAchs.length > 0) {
          setAchievement({ id: newAchs[0].id, title: newAchs[0].title, description: newAchs[0].description, icon: newAchs[0].icon, xp: newAchs[0].xp });
        }
      }
    } else {
      setActiveStep(prev => prev + 1);
    }
  };

  const currentMission = missions[activeStep];

  return (
    <div className="p-3 md:p-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto min-h-[80vh] flex flex-col justify-center">
      <ConfettiCelebration trigger={showConfetti} type="quest" />
      <AchievementToast achievement={achievement} onClose={() => setAchievement(null)} />
      {/* Шапка */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-6 justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center">
            <Gamepad2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">Интерактивные миссии</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Геймификация сложных лекций в порции квестов</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        {phase !== 'select' && (
          <button
            onClick={async () => {
              if (await confirm({ title: 'Выход', message: 'Вы уверены, что хотите выйти из игры? Весь прогресс будет потерян.', type: 'warning' })) {
                setPhase('select');
                setMissions([]);
                setActiveStep(0);
                setSelectedOption(null);
                setIsCorrect(null);
                setShowHint(false);
              }
            }}
            className="text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/30 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:text-rose-400 rounded-lg text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 transition"
          >
            <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Выйти из игры
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        {/* ФАЗА 1: Выбор материала */}
        {phase === 'select' && (
          <motion.div
            key="select"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 15 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -15 }}
            className="card p-4 md:p-8 text-center relative z-20"
          >
            <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
              <Gamepad2 className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-500" />
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2">Микро-квесты по лекциям</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 max-w-md mx-auto mb-6">
              AI-Методист разобьет сложную тему на 3 простые миссии. Изучите порции теории на простом языке и разблокируйте все уровни игры!
            </p>

            <div className="max-w-md mx-auto space-y-4">
              <div className="text-left relative">
                <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider block mb-2">Выберите лекцию из библиотеки:</label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <CustomSelect
                    value={selectedMaterialId}
                    onChange={val => setSelectedMaterialId(val)}
                    options={[
                      { value: '', label: 'Выберите лекцию для игры' },
                      ...materials.map(m => ({ value: m.id, label: m.title }))
                    ]}
                    className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 shadow-sm"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                disabled={!selectedMaterialId}
                onClick={startGame}
                className="w-full py-3.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-100"
              >
                <Zap className="w-5 h-5" /> Начать игру
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {/* ФАЗА ЗАГРУЗКИ / ГЕНЕРАЦИИ ИГРЫ */}
        {phase === 'loading' && (
          <motion.div
            key="loading"
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-center"
          >
            <div className="relative mb-6">
              <div className="w-16 h-16 border-4 border-emerald-100 dark:border-emerald-950/50 border-t-emerald-600 rounded-full animate-spin" />
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Gamepad2 className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-base mb-1">ИИ-Методист готовит сценарий квестов...</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 max-w-xs leading-relaxed">
              Сложная научная лекция переводится на игровой язык с метафорами и аналогиями
            </p>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {/* ФАЗА 2: Игровой процесс */}
        {phase === 'game' && currentMission && (
          <motion.div
            key="game"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.98 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="space-y-6"
          >
            {/* Визуальная шкала миссий */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60 p-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 gap-1">
              {missions.map((m, idx) => {
                const isActive = activeStep === idx;
                const isPassed = activeStep > idx;
                const isLocked = activeStep < idx;

                return (
                  <div key={m.id} className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 relative">
                    <div className={`flex items-center gap-1 md:gap-1.5 px-2 md:px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition shadow-sm ${
                      isActive 
                        ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' 
                        : isPassed 
                        ? 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400' 
                        : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500'
                    }`}>
                      {isPassed ? <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : isLocked ? <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Unlock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                      <span className="hidden sm:inline">Миссия {idx + 1}</span>
                      <span className="sm:hidden">{idx + 1}</span>
                    </div>
                    {idx < missions.length - 1 && (
                      <div className="hidden sm:block absolute right-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/2 z-10">
                        <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Игровой блок теории (простым языком) */}
            <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-900 to-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl p-4 md:p-6 shadow-xl relative border border-emerald-900/50 overflow-hidden">
              <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-emerald-500/10 rounded-full blur-2xl pointer-events-none" />
              
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
                <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black tracking-wider uppercase">Квест {activeStep + 1}: {currentMission.title}</span>
              </div>
              
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-base font-extrabold text-white leading-snug">
                  📖 Теория на пальцах
                </h3>
                <div className="text-slate-300 text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line markdown-content white-text">
                  <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>{currentMission.explanation}</ReactMarkdown>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Проверочный вопрос */}
            <motion.div 
              animate={shake ? { x: [-10, 10, -10, 10, 0] } : {}}
              transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
              className="card p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                <HelpCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm uppercase tracking-wider">Испытание для разблокировки следующего уровня:</h4>
              </div>

              <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 leading-relaxed mb-4 markdown-content">
                <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>{currentMission.question}</ReactMarkdown>
              </div>

              {/* Кнопки ответов */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3">
                {currentMission.options.map((opt) => {
                  const isThisSelected = selectedOption === opt;
                  const isCorrectAnswer = opt.startsWith(currentMission.correct);

                  let btnStyle = "bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800";
                  if (selectedOption) {
                    if (isThisSelected) {
                      btnStyle = isCorrectAnswer 
                        ? "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/20 font-bold" 
                        : "bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 ring-2 ring-rose-500/20 font-bold";
                    } else if (isCorrectAnswer && !isCorrect) {
                      btnStyle = "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 opacity-60";
                    } else {
                      btnStyle = "bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border-transparent text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 opacity-40 cursor-default";
                    }
                  }

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={opt}
                      onClick={() => handleOptionClick(opt)}
                      disabled={isCorrect === true}
                      className={`w-full p-3 md:p-4 rounded-xl border text-left text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-200 flex justify-between items-center ${btnStyle}`}
                    >
                      <span>{opt}</span>
                      {selectedOption && isThisSelected && (
                        isCorrectAnswer 
                          ? <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" /> 
                          : <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-500 shrink-0" />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Вывод подсказки при ошибке */}
              <AnimatePresence>
                {showHint && currentMission.hint && (
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                    style={{ overflow: 'hidden' }}
                    className="bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/50 rounded-xl"
                  >
                    <div className="p-3.5 flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">
                      <AlertCircle className="w-4.5 h-4.5 shrink-0 text-amber-500 mt-0.5" />
                      <div>
                        <span className="font-bold block mb-0.5">💡 Подсказка AI-Методиста:</span>
                        <div className="mb-2">{currentMission.hint}</div>
                        <div className="inline-flex font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/60 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md animate-pulse">
                          👉 Попробуйте выбрать другой вариант
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </motion.div>
                )}
              </AnimatePresence>

              {/* Кнопка далее */}
              {isCorrect && (
                <motion.div
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  className="pt-2"
                >
                  <button
                    onClick={handleNextMission}
                    className="w-full py-3.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-100 dark:shadow-emerald-950/20"
                  >
                    {activeStep + 1 >= missions.length ? 'Завершить обучение 🎉' : 'Пройти к миссии ' + (activeStep + 2) + ' →'}
                  </button>
                </motion.div>
              )}
            </motion.div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {/* ФАЗА 3: Завершение и награда */}
        {phase === 'completed' && (
          <motion.div
            key="completed"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="card p-5 md:p-10 text-center bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-50 to-teal-50 dark:from-emerald-950/20 dark:to-teal-950/20 border-emerald-100 dark:border-emerald-900/30 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-64 h-64 bg-emerald-500/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
            <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-64 h-64 bg-teal-500/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-emerald-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6 text-white shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden">
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/10 rounded-full scale-90 border border-dashed border-white/50 animate-spin-slow" />
              <Trophy className="w-10 h-10 animate-pulse" />
            </div>

            <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 mb-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
              Тема полностью освоена!
              <Sparkles className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-500 animate-bounce" />
            </h2>
            <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm max-w-md mx-auto mb-8">
              Вы успешно прошли все 3 микро-миссии по лекции «{selectedMaterial?.title}»! Вы поняли суть темы без лишней академической шелухи.
            </p>

            {/* Бейдж награды XP */}
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-emerald-600 text-white font-extrabold px-6 py-3 rounded-2xl shadow-md mb-8 ring-4 ring-emerald-600/10">
              <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-300" />
              <span>НАГРАДА: +50 XP</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 justify-center max-w-md mx-auto">
              <button
                onClick={() => setPhase('select')}
                className="flex-1 py-3 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-100 dark:shadow-emerald-950/20"
              >
                Выбрать другую лекцию
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => navigate('/dashboard')}
                className="px-6 py-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl font-bold hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition"
              >
                Вернуться на дашборд
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

  { id: 'mistake-2', question: 'Вопрос 2', correct_answer: 'Ответ 2', student_answer: 'Ошибка 2', topic: 'Тема 2', is_resolved: false, created_at: '2026-09-24T08:00:00Z', material_id: null },
  { id: 'mistake-3', question: 'Вопрос 3', correct_answer: 'Ответ 3', student_answer: 'Ошибка 3', topic: 'Тема 3', is_resolved: false, created_at: '2026-09-24T08:00:00Z', material_id: null },
];

const practice = mistakes.map((mistake, index) => ({
  id: index + 1,
  mistake_id: mistake.id,
  question: `Проверочный вопрос ${index + 1}`,
  options: ['A) Верный ответ', 'B) Неверный ответ', 'C) Другой ответ', 'D) Ещё ответ'],
  correct: 'A',
  explanation: 'Краткое объяснение ответа.',
}));

function createQuery() {
  const query: any = {};
  query.select = vi.fn(() => query);
  query.eq = vi.fn(() => query);
  query.order = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ data: mistakes, error: null });
  query.update = vi.fn(() => query);
  query.in = vi.fn().mockImplementation(async () => ({ error: api.updateError }));
  return query;
}

async function beginPractice(user: ReturnType<typeof userEvent.setup>) {
  await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Дневник ошибок' });
  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Запустить AI-работу над ошибками/ }));

  beforeEach(() => {
    api.updateError = null;
    const query = createQuery();
    api.from.mockReturnValue(query);
    api.verifyEnergy.mockResolvedValue(true);
    api.incrementAIUsage.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    api.addXP.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    api.confirm.mockResolvedValue(true);
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      ok: true,
      json: async () => ({ practice }),
    }));
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    cleanup();
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it('resolves only the mistakes whose linked questions were answered correctly', async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<MemoryRouter><MistakeDiary /></MemoryRouter>);
    await beginPractice(user);

    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'A) Верный ответ' }));
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Следующий вопрос' }));
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'B) Неверный ответ' }));
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Следующий вопрос' }));
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'A) Верный ответ' }));
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Завершить практику' }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      const updateQuery = api.from.mock.results[api.from.mock.results.length - 1]?.value;
      expect(updateQuery.in).toHaveBeenCalledWith('id', ['mistake-1', 'mistake-3']);
    });
    expect(api.addXP).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user-1', 50);
  });

  it('does not treat an unlinked fallback question as a valid practice test', async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      ok: true,
      json: async () => ({
        practice: [{
          id: 1,
          mistake_id: '',
          question: 'Какое ключевое правило нужно соблюдать?',
          options: ['A) Внимательно разбирать ошибки', 'B) Заучивать ответы', 'C) Не смотреть дневник', 'D) Избегать сложных тем'],
          correct: 'A',
          explanation: 'Общее пояснение.',
        }],
      }),
    }));
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<MemoryRouter><MistakeDiary /></MemoryRouter>);

    await beginPractice(user);

    expect(api.alert).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Какое ключевое правило нужно соблюдать?')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Дневник ошибок' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(api.addXP).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('does not claim progress or award XP when saving resolved mistakes fails', async () => {
    api.updateError = { message: 'offline' };
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<MemoryRouter><MistakeDiary /></MemoryRouter>);
    await beginPractice(user);

    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'A) Верный ответ' }));
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Следующий вопрос' }));
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'B) Неверный ответ' }));
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Следующий вопрос' }));
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'A) Верный ответ' }));
    await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Завершить практику' }));

    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Не удалось сохранить прогресс' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(api.addXP).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/Ошибки исправлены/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

<file path="frontend/src/pages/MistakeDiary.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { BookMarked, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, RefreshCw, Trash2, Filter, ChevronDown, Zap, CircleDot } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { useConfirm } from '../contexts/ConfirmContext';
import { useSound } from '../hooks/useSound';
import { addXP } from '../api/quests';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import { incrementAIUsage } from '../api/limits';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useEnergyConfirm } from '../hooks/useEnergyConfirm';

interface Mistake {
  id: string;
  question: string;
  correct_answer: string;
  student_answer: string;
  topic: string;
  is_resolved: boolean;
  created_at: string;
  material_id: string | null;
}

interface MistakePracticeQuestion {
  id: number | string;
  mistake_id: string;
  question: string;
  options: string[];
  correct: 'A' | 'B' | 'C' | 'D';
  explanation: string;
}

export default function MistakeDiary() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { confirm, alert } = useConfirm();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { verifyEnergy } = useEnergyConfirm();
  const [mistakes, setMistakes] = useState<Mistake[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'all' | 'open' | 'resolved'>('all');
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const { playFlipSound, playSuccessSound, playErrorSound, playXpSound } = useSound();

  // Состояния для AI-Работы над ошибками
  const [isPracticing, setIsPracticing] = useState(false);
  const [practiceLoading, setPracticeLoading] = useState(false);
  const [practiceQuestions, setPracticeQuestions] = useState<MistakePracticeQuestion[]>([]);
  const [currentQIndex, setCurrentQIndex] = useState(0);
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showExplanation, setShowExplanation] = useState(false);
  const [correctCount, setCorrectCount] = useState(0);
  const [finalCorrectCount, setFinalCorrectCount] = useState(0);
  const [correctQuestionIndexes, setCorrectQuestionIndexes] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [practiceFinished, setPracticeFinished] = useState(false);
  const [finishingPractice, setFinishingPractice] = useState(false);
  const [practiceSaveError, setPracticeSaveError] = useState(false);
  const [practiceXpError, setPracticeXpError] = useState(false);
  const [practiceResolvedCount, setPracticeResolvedCount] = useState(0);
  const [practiceMistakeCount, setPracticeMistakeCount] = useState(0);
  const [practiceXpAwarded, setPracticeXpAwarded] = useState(false);

  const startPractice = async () => {
    const openMistakes = mistakes.filter(m => !m.is_resolved);
    if (openMistakes.length === 0) return;
    
    // Берём до 5 неисправленных ошибок
    const toPractice = openMistakes.slice(0, 5);
    
    if (user?.id) {
      const ok = await verifyEnergy(user.id, 2, 'Работа над ошибками');
      if (!ok) return;
      await incrementAIUsage(user.id, 2);
    }

    setPracticeLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/mistakes/practice', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ mistakes: toPractice }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
      const data = await res.json();
      const allowedMistakeIds = new Set(toPractice.map(mistake => mistake.id));
      const questions = data?.practice;
      const isValidPractice = Array.isArray(questions) && questions.length > 0 && questions.every((question: Partial<MistakePracticeQuestion>) =>
        typeof question.id === 'number' || typeof question.id === 'string'
      ) && questions.every((question: Partial<MistakePracticeQuestion>) =>
        typeof question.mistake_id === 'string' &&
        allowedMistakeIds.has(question.mistake_id) &&
        typeof question.question === 'string' && question.question.trim().length > 0 &&
        Array.isArray(question.options) && question.options.length === 4 &&
        question.options.every(option => typeof option === 'string' && option.trim().length > 0) &&
        ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'].includes(question.correct ?? '') &&
        question.options.some(option => option.startsWith(question.correct ?? '\0')) &&
        typeof question.explanation === 'string' && question.explanation.trim().length > 0
      );

      if (!isValidPractice) throw new Error('Invalid practice response');

      setPracticeQuestions(questions);
      setIsPracticing(true);
      setCurrentQIndex(0);
      setSelectedOption(null);
      setShowExplanation(false);
      setCorrectCount(0);
      setFinalCorrectCount(0);
      setCorrectQuestionIndexes([]);
      setPracticeFinished(false);
      setFinishingPractice(false);
      setPracticeSaveError(false);
      setPracticeXpError(false);
      setPracticeResolvedCount(0);
      setPracticeMistakeCount(toPractice.length);
      setPracticeXpAwarded(false);
    } catch (e) {
      await alert({ title: 'Ошибка', message: 'Не удалось запустить работу над ошибками. Попробуйте еще раз.', type: 'danger' });
    } finally {
      setPracticeLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const checkAnswer = (opt: string) => {
    if (selectedOption) return; // Запрещаем повторный выбор
    setSelectedOption(opt);
    setShowExplanation(true);
    const q = practiceQuestions[currentQIndex];
    if (opt.startsWith(q.correct)) {
      playFlipSound(); // Pleasant sound for correct
      setCorrectCount(prev => prev + 1);
      setCorrectQuestionIndexes(prev => prev.includes(currentQIndex) ? prev : [...prev, currentQIndex]);
    } else {
      playErrorSound();
    }
  };

  const nextQuestion = async () => {
    if (currentQIndex + 1 < practiceQuestions.length) {
      setCurrentQIndex(prev => prev + 1);
      setSelectedOption(null);
      setShowExplanation(false);
    } else {
      setFinishingPractice(true);

      const correctIndexes = new Set(correctQuestionIndexes);
      if (selectedOption?.startsWith(practiceQuestions[currentQIndex]?.correct)) {
        correctIndexes.add(currentQIndex);
      }
      const finalCorrect = correctIndexes.size;
      const finalRate = finalCorrect / practiceQuestions.length;
      setFinalCorrectCount(finalCorrect);

      const questionIndexesByMistake = new Map<string, number[]>();
      practiceQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
        const indexes = questionIndexesByMistake.get(question.mistake_id) ?? [];
        indexes.push(index);
        questionIndexesByMistake.set(question.mistake_id, indexes);
      });
      const resolvedIds = [...questionIndexesByMistake]
        .filter(([, indexes]) => indexes.every(index => correctIndexes.has(index)))
        .map(([mistakeId]) => mistakeId);

      if (resolvedIds.length > 0) {
        try {
          const { error } = await supabase
            .from('mistake_diary')
            .update({ is_resolved: true, resolved_at: new Date().toISOString() })
            .in('id', resolvedIds);
          if (error) throw error;
        } catch {
          setPracticeSaveError(true);
          setPracticeFinished(true);
          setFinishingPractice(false);
          return;
        }

        setMistakes(prev => prev.map(mistake => resolvedIds.includes(mistake.id)
          ? { ...mistake, is_resolved: true }
          : mistake));
        setPracticeResolvedCount(resolvedIds.length);
        playSuccessSound();
      }

      if (user && resolvedIds.length > 0 && finalRate >= 0.6) {
        try {
          await addXP(user.id, 50);
          setPracticeXpAwarded(true);
          setTimeout(() => playXpSound(), 800);
          confetti({ particleCount: 120, spread: 70, origin: { y: 0.6 } });
        } catch {
          setPracticeXpError(true);
        }
      }

      setPracticeFinished(true);
      setFinishingPractice(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchMistakes = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    setLoading(true);
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('mistake_diary')
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    if (!error && data) setMistakes(data);
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchMistakes();
  }, [user?.id]);

  const markResolved = async (id: string) => {
    await supabase
      .from('mistake_diary')
      .update({ is_resolved: true, resolved_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('id', id);
    setMistakes(prev => prev.map(m => m.id === id ? { ...m, is_resolved: true } : m));
  };

  const deleteMistake = async (id: string) => {
    await supabase.from('mistake_diary').delete().eq('id', id);
    setMistakes(prev => prev.filter(m => m.id !== id));
  };

  const filtered = mistakes.filter(m => {
    if (filter === 'open') return !m.is_resolved;
    if (filter === 'resolved') return m.is_resolved;
    return true;
  });

  const openCount = mistakes.filter(m => !m.is_resolved).length;
  const resolvedCount = mistakes.filter(m => m.is_resolved).length;

  return (
    <div className="p-3 md:p-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto">
      {/* ═══ РЕЖИМ ПРАКТИКИ ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {isPracticing ? (
        <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto py-8">
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
            {!practiceFinished ? (
              <motion.div
                key={`q-${currentQIndex}`}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                className="space-y-6"
              >
                {/* Хедер прогресса */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg">
                      Вопрос {currentQIndex + 1} из {practiceQuestions.length}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                      Верных ответов: {correctCount}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (await confirm({ title: 'Прервать', message: 'Вы уверены, что хотите прервать работу над ошибками? Прогресс не сохранится.', type: 'warning' })) {
                        setIsPracticing(false);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 transition"
                  >
                    Прервать
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Карточка вопроса */}
                <div className="card p-4 md:p-8 space-y-4 md:space-y-6">
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 leading-relaxed">
                    {practiceQuestions[currentQIndex]?.question}
                  </h3>

                  {/* Опции */}
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    {practiceQuestions[currentQIndex]?.options.map((opt: string) => {
                      const isSelected = selectedOption === opt;
                      const isCorrect = opt.startsWith(practiceQuestions[currentQIndex]?.correct);
                      const hasAnswered = selectedOption !== null;

                      let btnStyle = 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200';
                      if (hasAnswered) {
                        if (isCorrect) {
                          btnStyle = 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300';
                        } else if (isSelected) {
                          btnStyle = 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300';
                        } else {
                          btnStyle = 'border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 opacity-60';
                        }
                      }

                      return (
                        <button
                          key={opt}
                          disabled={hasAnswered}
                          onClick={() => checkAnswer(opt)}
                          className={`w-full p-3 md:p-4 text-left text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl border-2 transition-all duration-200 ${btnStyle} flex justify-between items-center`}
                        >
                          <span>{opt}</span>
                          {hasAnswered && isCorrect && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold bg-emerald-600 text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md shrink-0">Верно</span>
                          )}
                          {hasAnswered && isSelected && !isCorrect && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold bg-rose-600 text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md shrink-0">Ошибка</span>
                          )}
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>

                  {/* Объяснение */}
                  {showExplanation && (
                    <motion.div
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                      style={{ overflow: 'hidden' }}
                      className="p-4 bg-amber-50/50 dark:bg-amber-950/20 border border-amber-100 dark:border-amber-900/50 rounded-xl space-y-1"
                    >
                      <h4 className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">Разбор и пояснение</h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                        {practiceQuestions[currentQIndex]?.explanation}
                      </p>
                    </motion.div>
                  )}

                  {/* Кнопка далее */}
                      {selectedOption && (
                    <motion.button
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 5 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                      onClick={nextQuestion}
                      disabled={finishingPractice}
                      className="w-full py-3.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-sm font-bold rounded-xl transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-100"
                    >
                      {finishingPractice
                        ? 'Сохраняем результат…'
                        : currentQIndex + 1 < practiceQuestions.length ? 'Следующий вопрос' : 'Завершить практику'}
                    </motion.button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            ) : (
              <motion.div
                key="finished"
                initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                className="card p-8 md:p-10 text-center space-y-6"
              >
                {/* Иконка */}
                <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-100 to-rose-100">
                  <Zap className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-500 animate-bounce" />
                </div>

                {/* Результат показываем только после сохранения */}
                {practiceSaveError ? (
                  <div role="alert" className="space-y-2">
                    <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">Не удалось сохранить прогресс</h2>
                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
                      Изменения не сохранены. Ошибки остались открытыми, опыт не начислен.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">Работа завершена</h2>
                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
                      Правильных ответов: {finalCorrectCount} из {practiceQuestions.length}.
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                      Исправлено ошибок: {practiceResolvedCount} из {practiceMistakeCount}. Остальные остаются открытыми.
                    </p>
                    {practiceXpAwarded && (
                      <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 text-xs font-bold rounded-full px-4 py-2 mt-2">
                        <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                        Получено +50 XP
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {practiceXpError && (
                      <p role="status" className="text-sm text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300">
                        Ошибки сохранены, но XP начислить не удалось.
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Кнопка выхода */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setIsPracticing(false);
                    setPracticeFinished(false);
                    fetchMistakes();
                  }}
                  className="px-8 py-3 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl transition"
                >
                  Вернуться в дневник
                </button>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* ═══ ОБЫЧНЫЙ РЕЖИМ ДНЕВНИКА ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
        <>
          {/* Заголовок */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-amber-100 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center">
              <BookMarked className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">Дневник ошибок</h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Все слабые места после AI-Экзаменатора</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Кнопка работы над ошибками */}
          {openCount > 0 && (
            <button
              onClick={startPractice}
              disabled={practiceLoading}
              className="w-full mb-6 py-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-rose-500 hover:from-amber-600 hover:to-rose-600 text-white rounded-2xl font-black text-sm transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-rose-100"
            >
              {practiceLoading ? (
                <>
                  <div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                  AI анализирует ошибки и готовит тест...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  ⚡ Запустить AI-работу над ошибками
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          )}

          {/* Статистика */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 md:gap-4 mb-6">
            <div className="card p-2 md:p-4 text-center">
              <p className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">{mistakes.length}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] md:text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">Всего ошибок</p>
            </div>
            <div className="card p-2 md:p-4 text-center border-l-4 border-l-rose-400">
              <p className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black text-rose-600">{openCount}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] md:text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">Внимания</p>
            </div>
            <div className="card p-2 md:p-4 text-center border-l-4 border-l-emerald-400">
              <p className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600">{resolvedCount}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] md:text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">Исправлено</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Фильтры */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
            <Filter className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
            {(['all', 'open', 'resolved'] as const).map(f => (
              <button
                key={f}
                onClick={() => setFilter(f)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition ${
                  filter === f
                    ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                    : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  {f === 'all' && 'Все'}
                  {f === 'open' && <><CircleDot className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${filter === 'open' ? 'text-rose-300' : 'text-rose-500'}`} /> Открытые</>}
                  {f === 'resolved' && <><CheckCircle2 className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${filter === 'resolved' ? 'text-emerald-300' : 'text-emerald-500'}`} /> Исправленные</>}
                </span>
              </button>
            ))}
            <button
              onClick={fetchMistakes}
              className="ml-auto p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 transition"
              title="Обновить"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Список ошибок */}
          {loading ? (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
            </div>
          ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="card p-10 text-center">
              <div className="w-14 h-14 bg-emerald-50 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-7 h-7 text-emerald-500" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                {filter === 'open' ? 'Отличная работа!' : 'Пока пусто'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">
                {filter === 'open'
                  ? 'Все ошибки исправлены. Продолжайте в том же духе!'
                  : 'Пройдите AI-Экзамен, и ваши ошибки появятся здесь.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <AnimatePresence>
                {filtered.map(mistake => (
                  <motion.div
                    key={mistake.id}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0, margin: 0 }}
                    className={`card overflow-hidden ${
                      mistake.is_resolved ? 'opacity-60' : ''
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Заголовок карточки */}
                    <div
                      className="p-4 cursor-pointer flex items-start gap-3"
                      onClick={() => setExpandedId(expandedId === mistake.id ? null : mistake.id)}
                    >
                      <div className={`mt-0.5 shrink-0 w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center ${
                        mistake.is_resolved ? 'bg-emerald-100' : 'bg-rose-100'
                      }`}>
                        {mistake.is_resolved
                          ? <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                          : <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600" />
                        }
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 leading-snug line-clamp-2">
                          {mistake.correct_answer}
                        </p>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                          {mistake.topic && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium">
                              {mistake.topic}
                            </span>
                          )}
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                            {new Date(mistake.created_at).toLocaleDateString('ru-RU')}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 shrink-0 transition-transform ${
                        expandedId === mistake.id ? 'rotate-180' : ''
                      }`} />
                    </div>

                    {/* Раскрытое содержимое */}
                    <AnimatePresence>
                      {expandedId === mistake.id && (
                        <motion.div
                          initial={{ height: 0 }}
                          animate={{ height: 'auto' }}
                          exit={{ height: 0 }}
                          className="overflow-hidden"
                        >
                          <div className="px-4 pb-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pt-3 space-y-3">
                            {/* Контекст (Вопрос) */}
                            <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 rounded-xl">
                              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                                Контекст / Вопрос
                              </p>
                              <p className="text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed italic">
                                "{mistake.question}"
                              </p>
                            </div>

                            {/* Ответ студента */}
                            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 border border-rose-100 dark:border-rose-900/50 rounded-xl">
                              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                                Мой ответ
                              </p>
                              <p className="text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                                {mistake.student_answer || '— (пусто)'}
                              </p>
                            </div>

                            {/* Суть ошибки / Правильный ответ */}
                            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 border border-emerald-100 dark:border-emerald-900/50 rounded-xl">
                              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                                Суть ошибки / Что нужно было сказать
                              </p>
                              <p className="text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                                {mistake.correct_answer}
                              </p>
                            </div>

                            {/* Действия */}
                            <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
                              {!mistake.is_resolved && (
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => markResolved(mistake.id)}
                                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition"
                                >
                                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  Отметить как исправленную
                                </button>
                              )}
                              <button
                                onClick={() => deleteMistake(mistake.id)}
                                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/30 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:text-rose-400 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition"
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                Удалить
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </motion.div>
                      )}
                    </AnimatePresence>
                  </motion.div>
                ))}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/pages/MoodTracker.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Heart, Zap, Brain, Coffee, Frown, Smile, Meh, SmilePlus, CheckCircle2, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { updateQuestProgress } from '../api/quests';

type MoodType = 'great' | 'good' | 'okay' | 'tired' | 'stressed';

interface MoodEntry {
  id: string;
  mood: MoodType;
  energy_level: number;
  notes: string;
  recommended_mode: string;
  logged_at: string;
}

interface MoodConfig {
  label: string;
  emoji: string;
  color: string;
  bg: string;
  border: string;
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
}

const MOODS: Record<MoodType, MoodConfig> = {
  great: { label: 'Отлично!', emoji: '🚀', color: 'text-emerald-700', bg: 'bg-emerald-50', border: 'border-emerald-300', icon: SmilePlus },
  good: { label: 'Хорошо', emoji: '😊', color: 'text-indigo-700', bg: 'bg-indigo-50', border: 'border-indigo-300', icon: Smile },
  okay: { label: 'Нормально', emoji: '😐', color: 'text-amber-700', bg: 'bg-amber-50', border: 'border-amber-300', icon: Meh },
  tired: { label: 'Устал(а)', emoji: '😴', color: 'text-slate-700', bg: 'bg-slate-100', border: 'border-slate-300', icon: Coffee },
  stressed: { label: 'Стресс', emoji: '😰', color: 'text-rose-700', bg: 'bg-rose-50', border: 'border-rose-300', icon: Frown },
};

const ENERGY_LABELS: Record<number, string> = {
  1: 'Совсем нет сил',
  2: 'Слабая энергия',
  3: 'Средняя',
  4: 'Бодрый(ая)',
  5: 'Полон(на) сил!'
};

function getRecommendation(mood: MoodType, energy: number): string {
  if (mood === 'great' && energy >= 4) {
    return '🔥 Режим «Глубокое погружение» — идеальный день для изучения сложных тем и AI-Экзаменатора!';
  }
  if ((mood === 'good' || mood === 'great') && energy >= 3) {
    return '📚 Режим «Активное обучение» — хорошо зайдёт изучение новых материалов и интерактивные миссии.';
  }
  if (mood === 'okay' || energy === 3) {
    return '🔄 Режим «Повторение» — самое время для спейсд-репетишн и флэш-карточек. Никаких подвигов!';
  }
  if (mood === 'tired' || energy <= 2) {
    return '🌙 Режим «Лёгкий просмотр» — просто перечитай конспект или послушай AI-чат. Мозг сегодня заслужил отдых.';
  }
  if (mood === 'stressed') {
    return '🧘 Режим «Анти-стресс» — начни с планировщика, разбей задачи на мелкие шаги и сделай только одно дело.';
  }
  return '📖 Выбери любой режим учёбы, который кажется тебе комфортным сегодня.';
}

export default function MoodTracker() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'check' | 'form' | 'done'>('check');
  const [todayEntry, setTodayEntry] = useState<MoodEntry | null>(null);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<MoodEntry[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Form state
  const [selectedMood, setSelectedMood] = useState<MoodType | null>(null);
  const [energy, setEnergy] = useState(3);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    loadData();
  }, [user?.id]);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('mood_log')
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', user!.id)
      .order('logged_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(14);

    if (data) {
      const todayLog = data.find(d => d.logged_at === today);
      if (todayLog) {
        setTodayEntry(todayLog);
        setPhase('done');
      } else {
        setPhase('form');
      }
      setHistory(data.filter(d => d.logged_at !== today));
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const saveMood = async () => {
    if (!selectedMood || !user) return;
    setSaving(true);

    const rec = getRecommendation(selectedMood, energy);

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('mood_log')
      .insert({
        user_id: user.id,
        mood: selectedMood,
        energy_level: energy,
        notes: notes.trim(),
        recommended_mode: rec,
        logged_at: today,
      })
      .select()
      .single();

    if (!error && data) {
      setTodayEntry(data);
      setPhase('done');
      await updateQuestProgress(user.id, 'mood', 1);
    }
    setSaving(false);
  };

  const moodToEmoji = (m: MoodType) => MOODS[m]?.emoji ?? '•';
  const energyToBar = (e: number) => Math.round((e / 5) * 100);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-4 md:p-6 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
      {/* Заголовок */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
        <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-pink-100 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center">
          <Heart className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-600" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">Трекер состояния</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Как ты себя чувствуешь? ИИ подберёт режим учёбы</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        {/* ФОРМА ВВОДА НАСТРОЕНИЯ */}
        {phase === 'form' && (
          <motion.div
            key="form"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 15 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -15 }}
            className="space-y-5"
          >
            <div className="card p-6">
              <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-1">Как ты сегодня?</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mb-5">Выбери своё состояние прямо сейчас</p>

              <div className="flex sm:grid sm:grid-cols-5 gap-3 mb-8 overflow-x-auto pb-2 snap-x snap-mandatory [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden [-ms-overflow-style:none] [scrollbar-width:none]">
                {(Object.entries(MOODS) as [MoodType, MoodConfig][]).map(([key, cfg]) => {
                  const Icon = cfg.icon;
                  const isSelected = selectedMood === key;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={key}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedMood(key)}
                      className={`flex-none w-[100px] sm:w-auto flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 transition-all snap-center ${
                        isSelected
                          ? `${cfg.bg} ${cfg.border} scale-[1.02] shadow-sm`
                          : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/60 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-600 bg-white/50 dark:bg-slate-800/50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="text-3xl mb-1 filter drop-shadow-sm">{cfg.emoji}</span>
                      <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wide ${isSelected ? cfg.color : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400'}`}>
                        {cfg.label}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Уровень энергии */}
              <div className="mb-8 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                  <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest">
                    Уровень энергии
                  </label>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-900/30 px-2 py-1 rounded-md">
                    {ENERGY_LABELS[energy]}
                  </span>
                </div>
                
                <div className="relative pt-2 pb-6">
                  <div className="absolute top-4 left-0 w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                    <div 
                      className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-400 to-indigo-600 transition-all duration-300"
                      style={{ width: `${((energy - 1) / 4) * 100}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min={1}
                    max={5}
                    value={energy}
                    onChange={e => setEnergy(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="absolute top-2 left-0 w-full h-6 opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10"
                  />
                  <div className="flex justify-between relative z-0 mt-6 px-1">
                    {[1,2,3,4,5].map(n => (
                      <div key={n} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 -ml-3" style={{ width: '24px' }}>
                        <div className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full border-2 transition-all duration-300 ${energy >= n ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-600 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(79,70,229,0.4)]' : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 border-white dark:border-slate-800'}`} />
                        <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold ${energy === n ? 'text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400' : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500'}`}>{n}</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Заметка */}
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider block mb-2">
                  Заметка (необязательно)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  value={notes}
                  onChange={e => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Что беспокоит? Есть дедлайн? Хочется конкретного?"
                  className="w-full h-20 px-4 py-3 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-sm outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 transition resize-none bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder-slate-400"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Превью рекомендации */}
              {selectedMood && (
                <motion.div
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                  style={{ overflow: 'hidden' }}
