import os
import glob
import re

files = [
    r"d:\Для пробной\frontend\src\components\ExpressPrepView.tsx",
    r"d:\Для пробной\frontend\src\components\SummaryView.tsx",
    r"d:\Для пробной\frontend\src\pages\Career.tsx",
    r"d:\Для пробной\frontend\src\pages\Chat.tsx",
    r"d:\Для пробной\frontend\src\pages\Courses.tsx",
    r"d:\Для пробной\frontend\src\pages\Missions.tsx",
    r"d:\Для пробной\frontend\src\pages\ProfessorExam.tsx",
    r"d:\Для пробной\frontend\src\pages\QuickPrep.tsx",
    r"d:\Для пробной\frontend\src\pages\SocialHub.tsx",
]

imports_to_add = """
import remarkMath from 'remark-math';
import rehypeKatex from 'rehype-katex';
import 'katex/dist/katex.min.css';
""".strip()

for f in files:
    with open(f, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as file:
        content = file.read()

    # Skip if already added
    if 'remark-math' in content:
        continue

    # Add imports after the react-markdown import
    content = re.sub(
        r"(import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';)", 
        r"\1\n" + imports_to_add, 
        content
    )

    # Add plugins to ReactMarkdown tags that don't have them
    content = re.sub(
        r'<ReactMarkdown>',
        r'<ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>',
        content
    )
    
    # Also handle <ReactMarkdown children={...} className={...} />
    content = re.sub(
        r'<ReactMarkdown(\s+)',
        r'<ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}\1',
        content
    )
    # Fix double injections just in case
    content = content.replace(
        '<ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]} remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}',
        '<ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}'
    )

    with open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as file:
        file.write(content)

print("Updated ReactMarkdown in files!")

import os
import re

def fix_file(path, replacements):
    with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    for old, new in replacements:
        content = content.replace(old, new)
        
    with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(content)

<file path="frontend/replace_any.py">
import os
import re

SRC_DIR = r"d:\Для пробной\frontend\src"

def process_file(filepath):
    with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = f.read()

    original = content

    # Add imports to top if we use these types
    types_to_import = set()

    if 'flashcards.ts' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('cards: any[]', 'cards: Flashcard[]')
        content = content.replace('(r: any)', '(r: Flashcard)')
        content = content.replace('(c: any)', '(c: Flashcard)')
        types_to_import.add('Flashcard')
        
    elif 'quests.ts' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('(s: any)', '(s: StudySession)')
        content = content.replace('(e: any)', '(e: ExamResult)')
        types_to_import.update(['StudySession', 'ExamResult'])

    elif 'AgentCards.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('icon: any;', 'icon: React.ElementType;')
        
    elif 'ExpressPrepView.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('summaryJson: any', 'summaryJson: SummaryInfo')
        types_to_import.add('SummaryInfo')

    elif 'FlashcardsView.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('data: any', 'data: FlashcardsInfo')
        content = content.replace('(_: any, i: number)', '(_: Flashcard, i: number)')
        content = content.replace('(c: any, i: number)', '(c: Flashcard, i: number)')
        types_to_import.update(['FlashcardsInfo', 'Flashcard'])

    elif 'QuizView.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('data: any', 'data: QuizInfo')
        content = content.replace('(q: any, i: number)', '(q: QuizQuestion, i: number)')
        types_to_import.update(['QuizInfo', 'QuizQuestion'])

    elif 'ResultsPanel.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('(c: any, i: number)', '(c: Flashcard, i: number)')
        content = content.replace('(q: any, i: number)', '(q: QuizQuestion, i: number)')
        types_to_import.update(['Flashcard', 'QuizQuestion'])

    elif 'SummaryView.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('data: any', 'data: SummaryInfo')
        types_to_import.add('SummaryInfo')

    elif 'Analytics.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('(a: any)', '(a: Achievement)')
        content = content.replace('(s: any)', '(s: StudySession)')
        content = content.replace('(e: any, i)', '(e: ExamResult, i: number)')
        content = content.replace('(m: any)', '(m: Mistake)')
        content = content.replace('(a: number, s: any)', '(a: number, s: StudySession)')
        content = content.replace('(v: number, _: any, props: any)', '(v: number, _: unknown, props: any)')
        types_to_import.update(['Achievement', 'StudySession', 'ExamResult', 'Mistake'])

    elif 'Analyze.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('catch (err: any)', 'catch (err: Error | any)')
        content = content.replace('handleSSE = (d: any)', 'handleSSE = (d: Record<string, any>)')

    elif 'Career.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('(t: any)', '(t: Term)')
        types_to_import.add('Term')

    elif 'Dashboard.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('icon: any;', 'icon: React.ElementType;')
        content = content.replace('(s: any)', '(s: StudySession)')
        content = content.replace('(c: any)', '(c: Flashcard)')
        content = content.replace('(m: any)', '(m: Material)')
        types_to_import.update(['StudySession', 'Flashcard', 'Material'])

    elif 'KnowledgeMap.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('details?: any;', 'details?: any;')
        content = content.replace('summaryJson: any', 'summaryJson: SummaryInfo')
        content = content.replace('(t: any)', '(t: Term)')
        types_to_import.update(['SummaryInfo', 'Term'])

    elif 'MaterialDetail.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('(prev: any)', '(prev: Material)')
        content = content.replace('material: any', 'material: Material')
        content = content.replace('setMaterial: any', 'setMaterial: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Material | null>>')
        types_to_import.add('Material')

    elif 'Messages.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('material: any', 'material: Material')
        types_to_import.add('Material')

    elif 'Planner.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('(s: any)', '(s: any)')
        content = content.replace('(t: any)', '(t: any)')
        content = content.replace('(day: any, i: number)', '(day: any, i: number)')
        content = content.replace('(sum: number, t: any)', '(sum: number, t: any)')
        content = content.replace('(task: any, j: number)', '(task: any, j: number)')
    
    elif 'Library.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('<any[]>', '<Material[]>')
        types_to_import.add('Material')
        
    elif 'SocialHub.tsx' in filepath:
        content = content.replace('searchResults: any[]', 'searchResults: any[]')
        
    if content != original:
        if types_to_import:
            # find depth
            depth = filepath.replace(SRC_DIR, '').count(os.sep)
            prefix = '../' * (depth - 1) if depth > 1 else './'
            if depth == 1:
                prefix = './'
            import_stmt = f"import {{ {', '.join(types_to_import)} }} from '{prefix}types';\n"
            # insert after last import
            last_import_idx = content.rfind('import ')
            if last_import_idx != -1:
                end_of_line = content.find('\\n', last_import_idx)
                if end_of_line != -1:
                    content = content[:end_of_line+1] + import_stmt + content[end_of_line+1:]
                else:
                    content = import_stmt + content
            else:
                content = import_stmt + content

        with open(filepath, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(content)
        print(f"Updated {filepath}")

for root, _, files in os.walk(SRC_DIR):
    for file in files:
        if file.endswith(('.ts', '.tsx')) and file != 'index.ts' and file != 'types.ts':
            process_file(os.path.join(root, file))
</file>

<file path="fix_base.py">
import sys

with open('backend/agents/base.py', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if line.strip().startswith('async def run(self, system_prompt: str, user_text: str) -> str:'):
        break
    new_lines.append(line)

new_lines.append('''    async def run(self, system_prompt: str, user_text: str) -> str:
        max_chars = 300000 if self.gemini_keys else 80000
        truncated = user_text[:max_chars]
        if len(user_text) > max_chars:
            truncated += f"\\n\\n[Текст сокращен с {len(user_text)} до {max_chars} символов]"

        gemini_errors = []

        if self.gemini_keys:
            shuffled_keys = list(self.gemini_keys)
            import random
            random.shuffle(shuffled_keys)
            
            for key in shuffled_keys:
                try:
                    genai.configure(api_key=key)
                    GEMINI_MODELS = [
                        "gemini-3.1-flash-lite",
                        "gemini-3-flash-preview",
                        "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
                        "gemini-2.5-flash",
                        "gemini-2.0-flash",
                        "gemini-1.5-flash",
                    ]
                    
                    response_text = None
                    last_err = None
                    
                    for model_name in GEMINI_MODELS:
                        try:
                            model_loaded = genai.GenerativeModel(model_name)
                            full_prompt = f"{system_prompt}\\n\\nЗАПРОС:\\n{truncated}"
                            response = await model_loaded.generate_content_async(
                                full_prompt,
                                generation_config=genai.types.GenerationConfig(
                                    temperature=0.3,
                                    max_output_tokens=8192,
                                ),
                                safety_settings=self.safety_settings
                            )
                            if response and response.text:
                                response_text = response.text
                                break
                        except Exception as e:
                            last_err = str(e)
                            continue
                            
                    if response_text:
                        return response_text
                        
                    gemini_errors.append(f"Key {key[:6]}... error: {last_err[:100] if last_err else 'No text'}")
                    continue
                except Exception as e:
                    gemini_errors.append(f"Key {key[:6]}... fatal error: {str(e)[:100]}")
                    continue

        if self.groq_client:
            try:
                response = await self.groq_client.chat.completions.create(
                    model=self.model,
                    messages=[
                        {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
                        {"role": "user", "content": truncated},
                    ],
                    temperature=0.3,
                    max_tokens=8192,
                )
                return response.choices[0].message.content or ""
            except Exception as e:
                groq_err = str(e)
                if "429" in groq_err:
                    debug_info = "\\n".join(gemini_errors) if gemini_errors else "Ключи Gemini не найдены"
                    return f"Ошибка: Лимиты ИИ исчерпаны.\\n\\nGemini ошибки:\\n{debug_info}\\n\\nGroq ошибка: 429."
                return f"Ошибка ИИ (Groq): {groq_err}"
        
        return "Ошибка: API ключи не настроены."
''')

with open('backend/agents/base.py', 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
    f.writelines(new_lines)
print('SUCCESS')
</file>

<file path="patch.py">
import sys

with open('backend/agents/base.py', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

target = '''                    GEMINI_MODELS = [
                        "gemini-3.1-flash-lite",
                        "gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20",
                        "gemini-2.0-flash",
                        "gemini-1.5-flash",
                    ]
                    
                    model_loaded = None
                    model_error = None
                    for model_name in GEMINI_MODELS:
                        try:
                            model_loaded = genai.GenerativeModel(model_name)
                            break
                        except Exception as e:
                            model_error = str(e)
                            continue
                    
                    if not model_loaded:
                        gemini_errors.append(f"Не удалось загрузить ни одну Gemini модель: {model_error}")
                        continue  # переходим к следующему ключу
                    
                    full_prompt = f"{system_prompt}\\n\\nЗАПРОС:\\n{truncated}"
                    
                    # Делаем запрос
                    response = await model_loaded.generate_content_async(
                        full_prompt,
                        generation_config=genai.types.GenerationConfig(
                            temperature=0.3,
                            max_output_tokens=8192,
                        ),
                        safety_settings=self.safety_settings
                    )
                    
                    if response and response.text:
                        return response.text
                    
                    gemini_errors.append(f"Key {key[:6]}... returned empty text")
                except Exception as e:
                    err_msg = str(e)
                    gemini_errors.append(f"Key {key[:6]}... error: {err_msg[:100]}")
                    continue'''

replacement = '''                    GEMINI_MODELS = [
                        "gemini-3.1-flash-lite",
                        "gemini-3-flash-preview",
                        "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
                        "gemini-2.5-flash",
                        "gemini-2.0-flash",
                        "gemini-1.5-flash",
                    ]
                    
                    response_text = None
                    last_err = None
                    
                    for model_name in GEMINI_MODELS:
                        try:
                            model_loaded = genai.GenerativeModel(model_name)
                            full_prompt = f"{system_prompt}\\n\\nЗАПРОС:\\n{truncated}"
                            response = await model_loaded.generate_content_async(
                                full_prompt,
                                generation_config=genai.types.GenerationConfig(
                                    temperature=0.3,
                                    max_output_tokens=8192,
                                ),
                                safety_settings=self.safety_settings
                            )
                            if response and response.text:
                                response_text = response.text
                                break
                        except Exception as e:
                            last_err = str(e)
                            continue
                            
                    if response_text:
                        return response_text
                        
                    gemini_errors.append(f"Key {key[:6]}... error: {last_err[:100] if last_err else 'No text'}")
                    continue
                except Exception as e:
                    gemini_errors.append(f"Key {key[:6]}... fatal error: {str(e)[:100]}")
                    continue'''

if target in content:
    with open('backend/agents/base.py', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(content.replace(target, replacement))
    print('SUCCESS')
else:
    print('TARGET NOT FOUND')

# Meldy — помощник для учёбы

Три AI-агента параллельно создают конспект, карточки и тест из любой лекции.

## Использование

1. Откройте приложение
2. Загрузите PDF/DOCX/TXT файл или нажмите «Демо без файла»
3. Дождитесь завершения анализа (~15 сек)
4. Изучайте конспект, карточки и тест

## Переменные окружения

Установите в Settings → Repository secrets:

- `GROQ_API_KEY` — ключ API от [console.groq.com](https://console.groq.com) (бесплатно)
- `GEMINI_API_KEY` — ключи API от Google AI Studio (для аудио/подкастов). Можно указать несколько ключей через запятую для обхода лимитов.
</file>

SUPABASE_SCHEMA = r"""================================================================================
SUPABASE SCHEMA — Project: Meldy (daunnytubqbzafjnpfnw)
================================================================================

-- 1. materials — Проанализированные материалы
CREATE TABLE materials (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id         uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title           text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  subject         text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  original_text   text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  summary_json    jsonb,
  flashcards_json jsonb,
  quiz_json       jsonb,
  created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE materials ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Users can read own materials" ON materials FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can insert own materials" ON materials FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can update own materials" ON materials FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can delete own materials" ON materials FOR DELETE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_materials_user_id ON materials(user_id);

-- 2. profiles — Профиль пользователя (автосоздание при регистрации)
CREATE TABLE profiles (
  id               uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  full_name        text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  streak_days      int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_active_date date,
  total_reviews    int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_materials  int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Users can read own profile" ON profiles FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can update own profile" ON profiles FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can insert own profile" ON profiles FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id);

-- 3. flashcard_progress — Spaced repetition (SM-2)
CREATE TABLE flashcard_progress (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id         uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  material_id     uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES materials(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  question        text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  answer          text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  ease_factor     real NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5,
  interval_days   int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  repetitions     int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  next_review     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  last_reviewed_at timestamptz
);
ALTER TABLE flashcard_progress ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Users can read own progress" ON flashcard_progress FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Триггер: автосоздание профиля при регистрации
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
RETURNS trigger AS 
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name)
  VALUES (NEW.id, COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''));
  RETURN NEW;
END;
 LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created
  AFTER INSERT ON auth.users
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();
"""


def main():
    lines = []
    for rel_path in FILES:
        abs_path = os.path.join(ROOT, rel_path.replace("/", os.sep))
        if not os.path.isfile(abs_path):
            print(f"  SKIP (not found): {rel_path}")
            continue

        with open(abs_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            content = f.read()

        lines.append("=" * 80)
        lines.append(f"FILE: {rel_path}")
        lines.append("=" * 80)
        lines.append(content.rstrip())
        lines.append("")

    # Supabase schema в конце
    lines.append(SUPABASE_SCHEMA.rstrip())
    lines.append("")

    result = "\n".join(lines)
    with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(result)

    print(f"Done! {OUT} — {len(result)} chars, {len(FILES)} files + schema")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from .base import BaseAgent
import json
import asyncio

def build_career_prompt() -> str:
    return """Ты — ведущий карьерный консультант, HR-эксперт крупного ИТ-холдинга и технический ментор.
Проанализируй предоставленный список изученных студентом тем, терминов и концепций из материалов, оцени глубину его знаний и сформируй премиальный, профессиональный карьерный профиль.

ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО верни ответ строго в формате JSON без markdown-обёртки (НИКАКИХ ```json или ```):
{
  "skills": ["Навык 1", "Навык 2"],
  "professions": [
    {"title": "Название профессии", "match": 85}
  ],
  "resume_summary": "Текст 'О себе' для резюме (2-3 емких абзаца, подчеркивающие хард-скиллы).",
  "projects": [
    {"title": "Название проекта", "description": "Детальное и привлекательное техническое описание пет-проекта"}
  ]
}

ИНСТРУКЦИЯ ПО ЗАПОЛНЕНИЮ:
1. "skills": Выдели 5-10 конкретных, востребованных на рынке труда хард-скиллов (конкретные технологии, фреймворки, архитектурные паттерны или методологии), которые напрямую следуют из изученного материала.
2. "professions": Предложи 2-4 реальные, современные ИТ-профессии (например: Backend-разработчик (Python/Django), Системный аналитик, Frontend-разработчик (React)). Укажи точный процент соответствия (match) от 50 до 100% на основе покрытия тем.
3. "resume_summary" (КРИТИЧЕСКИ ВАЖНО): Напиши потрясающее, цепляющее саммари "О себе" для CV на русском языке. Оно должно звучать зрело и профессионально (без шаблонных фраз вроде "быстро учусь"), подчеркивать реальный стек, концептуальное понимание проектирования и практическую готовность к стажировкам или Junior-позициям.
4. "projects": Предложи 2-3 идеи для крутых пет-проектов в портфолио, которые идеально ложатся на стек изученных материалов. Каждое описание должно быть сформулировано коммерчески привлекательно: "Разработка высоконагруженного сервиса для... с использованием..."
"""

class CareerAgent(BaseAgent):
    """
    Агент для генерации карьерного профиля на основе материалов.
    """
    
    async def process(self, context: str) -> dict:
        """
        context: Сборная строка всех тем и конспектов пользователя.
        """
        prompt = build_career_prompt()
        raw_result = await self.run(prompt, context)
        
        # Парсинг JSON
        try:
            # Очистка от возможных markdown-оберток
            cleaned = raw_result.strip()
            if cleaned.startswith("```json"):
                cleaned = cleaned[7:]
            if cleaned.startswith("```"):
                cleaned = cleaned[3:]
            if cleaned.endswith("```"):
                cleaned = cleaned[:-3]
            
            return json.loads(cleaned.strip())
        except Exception as e:
            # Fallback in case of failure
            return {
                "skills": ["Анализ данных", "Обучаемость"],
                "professions": [{"title": "Студент-исследователь", "match": 100}],
                "resume_summary": "Активно изучаю новые материалы и стремлюсь к профессиональному развитию.",
                "projects": [{"title": "Продолжить обучение", "description": "Изучить больше материалов для точного анализа."}],
                "error": f"JSON Parse Error: {str(e)}"
            }

import os
import re

# Define the replacements map
replacements = {
    "slate-150": "slate-100",
    "slate-250": "slate-200",
    "slate-350": "slate-300",
    "slate-405": "slate-400",
    "slate-450": "slate-400",
    "slate-550": "slate-500",
    "slate-750": "slate-700",
    "slate-805": "slate-800",
    "indigo-150": "indigo-100",
    "indigo-550": "indigo-500",
    "indigo-650": "indigo-600",
    "violet-650": "violet-600"
}

src_dir = "src"

def fix_file(filepath):
    try:
        with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            content = f.read()
        
        modified = False
        new_content = content
        for original, target in replacements.items():
            if original in new_content:
                # Use regex or simple replace
                # We want to replace occurrences in classNames or style classes
                new_content = new_content.replace(original, target)
                modified = True
        
        if modified:
            with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(new_content)
            print(f"Fixed: {filepath}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error reading/writing {filepath}: {e}")

def main():
    print("Scanning frontend/src directory for invalid Tailwind classes...")
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(src_dir):
        for file in files:
            if file.endswith((".tsx", ".ts", ".css")):
                filepath = os.path.join(root, file)
                fix_file(filepath)
    print("Tailwind classes cleanup completed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<file path="frontend/src/api/chat.ts">
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { getPublicProfiles } from './social';

export interface Friendship {
  id: string;
  requester_id: string;
  addressee_id: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'accepted' | 'declined';
  created_at: string;
  friend_id?: string;
  friend_name?: string;
  friend_avatar?: string;
}

export interface DirectMessage {
  id: string;
  sender_id: string;
  receiver_id: string;
  content: string;
  created_at: string;
}

export interface Notification {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  type: 'friend_request' | 'message' | 'like' | 'invite' | 'assignment';
  title: string;
  body?: string;
  related_id?: string;
  is_read: boolean;
  created_at: string;
}

// ── Друзья ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function getFriends(userId: string): Promise<Friendship[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('friendships')
    .select('*')
    .or(`requester_id.eq.${userId},addressee_id.eq.${userId}`)
    .neq('status', 'declined');

  if (error || !data) return [];

  const friendIds = data.map(f => f.requester_id === userId ? f.addressee_id : f.requester_id);
  if (friendIds.length === 0) return [];

  const profiles = await getPublicProfiles(friendIds);
  const profileMap = new Map((profiles || []).map(p => [p.id, p]));

  return data.map(f => {
    const friendId = f.requester_id === userId ? f.addressee_id : f.requester_id;
    const p = profileMap.get(friendId);
    return {
      ...f,
      friend_id: friendId,
      friend_name: p?.full_name || 'Неизвестный',
      friend_avatar: p?.avatar_url || undefined
    };
  });
}

export async function sendFriendRequest(requesterId: string, addresseeId: string) {
  const { error } = await supabase.from('friendships').insert({
    requester_id: requesterId,
    addressee_id: addresseeId,
    status: 'pending'
  });
  return !error;
}

export async function respondFriendRequest(friendshipId: string, status: 'accepted' | 'declined') {
  const { error } = await supabase.from('friendships').update({ status }).eq('id', friendshipId);
  return !error;
}

export async function searchUsers(query: string, currentUserId: string) {
  const q = query.replace('#', '').trim();
  return getPublicProfiles(null, q, currentUserId, 20);
}

// ── Блокировки ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function blockUser(blockerId: string, blockedId: string) {
  const { error } = await supabase.from('user_blocks').insert({
    blocker_id: blockerId,
    blocked_id: blockedId
  });
  return !error;
}

export async function unblockUser(blockerId: string, blockedId: string) {
  const { error } = await supabase.from('user_blocks').delete().match({
    blocker_id: blockerId,
    blocked_id: blockedId
  });
  return !error;
}

export async function getBlockedUserIds(userId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const { data } = await supabase
    .from('user_blocks')
    .select('blocked_id')
    .eq('blocker_id', userId);
  return (data || []).map(b => b.blocked_id);
}

// ── Чат (Realtime) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ChatContact {
  id: string;
  friend_id: string; // To match the old API structure for Messages
  friend_name: string;
  friend_avatar?: string;
}

export async function getChats(userId: string): Promise<ChatContact[]> {
  const { data: sent } = await supabase.from('direct_messages').select('receiver_id').eq('sender_id', userId);
  const { data: received } = await supabase.from('direct_messages').select('sender_id').eq('receiver_id', userId);
  
  const ids = new Set([
    ...(sent || []).map(d => d.receiver_id),
    ...(received || []).map(d => d.sender_id)
  ]);
  
  if (ids.size === 0) return [];
  
  const profiles = await getPublicProfiles(Array.from(ids));
  
  return (profiles || []).map(p => ({
    id: p.id,
    friend_id: p.id,
    friend_name: p.full_name || 'Неизвестный',
    friend_avatar: p.avatar_url || undefined
  }));
}

export async function getMessages(user1: string, user2: string): Promise<DirectMessage[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('direct_messages')
    .select('*')
    .or(`and(sender_id.eq.${user1},receiver_id.eq.${user2}),and(sender_id.eq.${user2},receiver_id.eq.${user1})`)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(100);
  if (error) console.error('getMessages error:', error);
  return data || [];
}

export async function sendMessage(senderId: string, receiverId: string, content: string) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('direct_messages').insert({
    sender_id: senderId,
    receiver_id: receiverId,
    content
  }).select('*').single();

  if (error) console.error('sendMessage error:', error);
  return data;
}

export function subscribeToMessages(userId: string, onMessage: (msg: DirectMessage) => void) {
  const channel = supabase
    .channel(`dm_${userId}`)
    .on('postgres_changes', 
      { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'direct_messages' },
      (payload) => {
        const msg = payload.new as DirectMessage;
        if (msg && (msg.sender_id === userId || msg.receiver_id === userId)) {
          onMessage(msg);
        }
      }
    )
    .subscribe();
  return () => supabase.removeChannel(channel);
}

// ── Уведомления ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function getNotifications(userId: string): Promise<Notification[]> {
  const { data } = await supabase
    .from('notifications')
    .select('*')
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(30);
  return data || [];
}

export async function getUnreadCount(userId: string): Promise<number> {
  const { count } = await supabase
    .from('notifications')
    .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .eq('is_read', false);
  return count || 0;
}

export async function markAllRead(userId: string) {
  await supabase.from('notifications').update({ is_read: true }).eq('user_id', userId).eq('is_read', false);
}

export async function deleteNotification(notificationId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const { error } = await supabase
    .from('notifications')
    .delete()
    .eq('id', notificationId);
  return !error;
}

export async function getUnreadDMsGrouped(userId: string): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
  const { data } = await supabase
    .from('notifications')
    .select('related_id')
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .eq('type', 'message')
    .eq('is_read', false);
  
  const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
  if (data) {
    data.forEach(n => {
      if (n.related_id) {
        counts[n.related_id] = (counts[n.related_id] || 0) + 1;
      }
    });
  }
  return counts;
}

export async function markNotificationsAsReadForSender(userId: string, senderId: string) {
  await supabase
    .from('notifications')
    .update({ is_read: true })
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .eq('related_id', senderId)
    .eq('type', 'message')
    .eq('is_read', false);
}

export function subscribeToNotifications(userId: string, onChange: (payload: any) => void) {
  const channel = supabase
    .channel(`notif_${userId}`)
    .on('postgres_changes', 
      { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'notifications' },
      (payload) => {
        const notif = payload.new as Notification;
        if (notif && notif.user_id === userId) {
          onChange(payload);
        }
      }
    )
    .subscribe();
  return () => supabase.removeChannel(channel);
}

export function subscribeToFriendships(userId: string, onChange: () => void) {
  const channel = supabase
    .channel(`friendships_${userId}`)
    .on('postgres_changes', 
      { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'friendships' },
      (payload) => {
        const f = (payload.new || payload.old) as Friendship;
        if (f && (f.requester_id === userId || f.addressee_id === userId)) {
          onChange();
        }
      }
    )
    .subscribe();
  return () => supabase.removeChannel(channel);
}

export interface GroupChatMessage {

  group_id: string;
  sender_id: string;
  content: string;
  created_at: string;

export async function getGroupMessages(groupId: string): Promise<GroupChatMessage[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('group_chat_messages')
    .select('*')
    .eq('group_id', groupId)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(200);
  if (error) console.error('getGroupMessages error:', error);
  return data || [];
}

export async function sendGroupMessage(groupId: string, senderId: string, content: string) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('group_chat_messages').insert({
    group_id: groupId,
    sender_id: senderId,
    content
  }).select('*').single();
  if (error) console.error('sendGroupMessage error:', error);
  return data;
}

export function subscribeToGroupChat(groupId: string, onMessage: (msg: GroupChatMessage) => void) {
  const channel = supabase
    .channel(`group_chat_${groupId}`)
    .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'group_chat_messages', filter: `group_id=eq.${groupId}` },
      (payload) => onMessage(payload.new as GroupChatMessage))
    .subscribe();
  return () => supabase.removeChannel(channel);
}

import { Flashcard } from '../types';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

export async function getDueCards(userId: string) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('flashcard_progress')
    .select('*')
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .lte('next_review', new Date().toISOString())
    .order('next_review', { ascending: true })
    .limit(20);
  if (error) throw error;
  return data || [];
}

export async function syncFlashcards(userId: string, materialId: string, cards: Flashcard[]) {
  // Добавляет карточки только если их ещё нет
  const existing = await supabase
    .from('flashcard_progress')
    .select('question')
    .eq('material_id', materialId);
  const existingQ = new Set((existing.data || []).map((r: any) => r.question));
  const toInsert = cards
    .filter((c: any) => !existingQ.has(c.question))
    .map((c: any) => ({ user_id: userId, material_id: materialId, question: c.question, answer: c.answer }));
  if (toInsert.length > 0) {
    await supabase.from('flashcard_progress').insert(toInsert);
  }
}

export async function updateCardProgress(cardId: string, quality: number) {
  // SM-2 алгоритм
  const { data: card, error: readError } = await supabase
    .from('flashcard_progress')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', cardId)
    .single();
  if (readError) throw readError;
  if (!card) throw new Error('Карточка для повторения не найдена.');

  let { ease_factor, interval_days, repetitions } = card;
  if (quality >= 3) {
    if (repetitions === 0) interval_days = 1;
    else if (repetitions === 1) interval_days = 6;
    else interval_days = Math.round(interval_days * ease_factor);
    repetitions += 1;
    ease_factor = Math.max(1.3, ease_factor + 0.1 - (5 - quality) * (0.08 + (5 - quality) * 0.02));
  } else {
    repetitions = 0;
    interval_days = 1;
  }

  const next_review = new Date();
  next_review.setDate(next_review.getDate() + interval_days);

  const { error: updateError } = await supabase.from('flashcard_progress').update({
    ease_factor, interval_days, repetitions,
    next_review: next_review.toISOString()
  }).eq('id', cardId);
  if (updateError) throw updateError;
}

// Generate random code e.g. MTH-4X9
export function generateInviteCode() {
  const chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789';
  const random = new Uint32Array(10);
  globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(random);
  const code = Array.from(random, value => chars[value % chars.length]).join('');
  return `${code.slice(0, 4)}-${code.slice(4, 8)}-${code.slice(8)}`;
}

export async function createGroup(name: string, teacherId: string): Promise<Group | null> {
  const existing = await getTeacherGroups(teacherId);
  if (existing.some(g => g.name.trim().toLowerCase() === name.trim().toLowerCase())) {
    throw new Error('Класс с таким названием уже существует');
  }
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('groups').insert({
    name,
    teacher_id: teacherId,
    invite_code: generateInviteCode()
  }).select('*').single();
  
  if (error) { console.error('createGroup', error); return null; }
  return data;
}

// Get materials assigned to a student
export async function getAssignedMaterials(studentId: string): Promise<Material[]> {
  // Find groups
  const { data: memberships } = await supabase.from('group_members').select('group_id').eq('student_id', studentId);
  if (!memberships || memberships.length === 0) return [];
  
  const groupIds = memberships.map(m => m.group_id);
  
  // Find assignments
  const { data: assignments } = await supabase.from('assignments').select('*, material:materials(*)').in('group_id', groupIds);
  if (!assignments) return [];

  // Return materials, map deadline
  return assignments.map(a => {
    const mat = a.material as any;
    if (mat) {
      mat.assigned_deadline = a.deadline;
      mat.is_assigned = true;
    }
    return mat;
  }).filter(Boolean);
}

export interface AssignmentCompletion {
  id: string;
  assignment_id: string;
  student_id: string;
  completed_at: string;
}

export async function toggleAssignmentCompletion(assignmentId: string, studentId: string, markCompleted: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
  if (markCompleted) {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('assignment_completions').insert({
      assignment_id: assignmentId,
      student_id: studentId
    });
    if (error && error.code !== '23505') { // Ignore unique constraint violation
      console.error('toggleAssignmentCompletion', error);
      return false;
    }
  } else {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('assignment_completions').delete().eq('assignment_id', assignmentId).eq('student_id', studentId);
    if (error) {
      console.error('toggleAssignmentCompletion', error);
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

export async function getStudentCompletions(studentId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('assignment_completions').select('assignment_id').eq('student_id', studentId);
  if (error || !data) return [];
  return data.map(c => c.assignment_id);
}

export async function getGroupCompletions(groupId: string): Promise<any[]> {
  const { data: assignments } = await supabase.from('assignments').select('id').eq('group_id', groupId);
  if (!assignments || assignments.length === 0) return [];
  const assignmentIds = assignments.map(a => a.id);
  
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('assignment_completions').select('*').in('assignment_id', assignmentIds);
  if (error || !data) return [];
  return data;
}

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { getGroupMembers, getGroupWeeklyScores, joinGroup } from './groups';
import { getPublicProfiles, toggleLike } from './social';

const database = vi.hoisted(() => ({ rpc: vi.fn(), from: vi.fn() }));

vi.mock('../lib/supabase', () => ({ supabase: database }));

describe('database security boundaries', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.resetAllMocks();
  });

  it('joins a class through the invite-code RPC instead of accepting a client-supplied user or group id', async () => {
    database.rpc.mockResolvedValue({ data: true, error: null });

    await expect(joinGroup(' abc-123 ', 'Denis')).resolves.toBe(true);

    expect(database.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('join_group_by_invite_code', {
      p_invite_code: 'ABC-123',
      p_class_nickname: 'Denis',
    });
    expect(database.from).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('loads a class roster only through the membership-checked RPC', async () => {
    const roster = [{
      id: 'member-1',
      group_id: 'group-1',
      student_id: 'user-2',
      joined_at: '2026-09-24T00:00:00Z',
      class_nickname: 'Саша',
      full_name: 'Александр',
      avatar_url: null,
      total_reviews: 8,
      total_xp: 120,
    }];
    database.rpc.mockResolvedValue({ data: roster, error: null });

    await expect(getGroupMembers('group-1')).resolves.toEqual([{
      ...roster[0],
      student_name: 'Саша',
      student_avatar: undefined,
    }]);

    expect(database.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('get_group_members', { p_group_id: 'group-1' });
    expect(database.from).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('loads weekly class scores through the membership-checked RPC', async () => {
    const scores = [{ student_id: 'user-2', weekly_xp: 150 }];
    database.rpc.mockResolvedValue({ data: scores, error: null });

    await expect(getGroupWeeklyScores('group-1')).resolves.toEqual(scores);

    expect(database.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('get_group_weekly_scores', { p_group_id: 'group-1' });
    expect(database.from).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('loads only the safe public profile projection through a server-side function', async () => {
    const profiles = [{ id: 'user-2', full_name: 'Student', avatar_url: null }];
    database.rpc.mockResolvedValue({ data: profiles, error: null });

    await expect(getPublicProfiles(['user-2'])).resolves.toEqual(profiles);

    expect(database.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('get_public_profiles', {
      p_user_ids: ['user-2'],
      p_query: null,
      p_exclude_user_id: null,
      p_limit: 50,
    });
    expect(database.from).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('changes a material like through one atomic database operation', async () => {
    database.rpc.mockResolvedValue({ data: true, error: null });

    await expect(toggleLike('material-1', false)).resolves.toBe(true);

    expect(database.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('toggle_material_like', {
      p_material_id: 'material-1',
      p_like: true,
    });
    expect(database.from).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';

export interface UserProfile {
  id: string;
  public_id?: string;
  full_name: string;
  avatar_url?: string;
  bio?: string;
  university?: string;
  streak_days: number;
  total_reviews: number;
  total_materials: number;
  role?: string;
  onboarding_status?: Record<string, boolean>;
  is_pro?: boolean;
  pro_until?: string;
}

export interface PublicMaterial {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  subject: string;
  user_id: string;
  created_at: string;
  likes_count: number;
  author_name?: string;
  author_avatar?: string;
  is_liked_by_me?: boolean;
}

export interface LeaderboardEntry {
  id: string;
  full_name: string;
  avatar_url?: string;
  total_xp: number;
  level: number;
}

export interface PublicProfile {
  id: string;
  full_name: string;
  avatar_url: string | null;
  bio: string | null;
  university: string | null;
  public_id: string | null;
  streak_days: number;
  total_reviews: number;
  total_materials: number;
  role: string | null;
}

export async function getPublicProfiles(
  userIds: string[] | null = null,
  query: string | null = null,
  excludeUserId: string | null = null,
  limit = 50,
): Promise<PublicProfile[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_public_profiles', {
    p_user_ids: userIds?.length ? userIds : null,
    p_query: query?.trim() || null,
    p_exclude_user_id: excludeUserId,
    p_limit: limit,
  });
  if (error) {
    console.error('getPublicProfiles error:', error);
    return [];
  }
  return data || [];
}

export async function ensurePublicId(userId: string): Promise<string> {
  let unique = false;
  let newId = '';
  while (!unique) {
    const chars = '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    newId = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      newId += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
    }
    const { error } = await supabase.from('profiles').update({ public_id: newId }).eq('id', userId);
    if (!error) {
      unique = true;
    } else if (error.code !== '23505') { // Not a unique constraint violation
      break;
    }
  }
  return newId;
}

export async function getProfile(userId: string): Promise<UserProfile | null> {
  const { data: authData } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  const isOwnProfile = authData.user?.id === userId;
  const { data, error } = isOwnProfile
    ? await supabase.from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', userId).single()
    : { data: null, error: null };
  if (error) { console.error('getProfile error:', error); return null; }

  if (!isOwnProfile) {
    const [publicProfile] = await getPublicProfiles([userId], null, null, 1);
    if (!publicProfile) return null;
    return {
      id: publicProfile.id,
      public_id: publicProfile.public_id || undefined,
      full_name: publicProfile.full_name,
      avatar_url: publicProfile.avatar_url || undefined,
      bio: publicProfile.bio || undefined,
      university: publicProfile.university || undefined,
      role: publicProfile.role || undefined,
      streak_days: publicProfile.streak_days || 0,
      total_reviews: publicProfile.total_reviews || 0,
      total_materials: publicProfile.total_materials || 0,
    };
  }
  
  if (data && !data.public_id) {
    const newId = await ensurePublicId(userId);
    data.public_id = newId;
  }
  
  return data;
}

export async function updateProfile(userId: string, updates: Partial<UserProfile>) {
  const { error } = await supabase.from('profiles').update(updates).eq('id', userId);
  if (error) console.error('updateProfile error:', error);
  return !error;
}

export async function markOnboardingTourSeen(userId: string, tourKey: string) {
  // We need to merge the existing JSONB. Wait, supabase update with JSONB replaces it unless we use rpc.
  // Actually, we can fetch, merge, and update.
  const p = await getProfile(userId);
  if (!p) return;
  const current = p.onboarding_status || {};
  if (current[tourKey]) return; // already seen

  const next = { ...current, [tourKey]: true };
  await updateProfile(userId, { onboarding_status: next });
}

export async function getLeaderboard(): Promise<LeaderboardEntry[]> {
  const { data: xpData, error: xpError } = await supabase
    .from('user_xp')
    .select('user_id, total_xp')
    .order('total_xp', { ascending: false })
    .limit(50);
  if (xpError || !xpData) return [];

  const userIds = xpData.map(x => x.user_id);
  const profiles = await getPublicProfiles(userIds);

  const profileMap = new Map((profiles || []).map(p => [p.id, p]));

  return xpData.map(xp => {
    const p = profileMap.get(xp.user_id);
    return {
      id: xp.user_id,
      full_name: p?.full_name || 'Студент',
      avatar_url: p?.avatar_url || undefined,
      total_xp: xp.total_xp,
      level: 1,
    };
  });
}

export async function getPublicMaterials(currentUserId: string): Promise<PublicMaterial[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('materials')
    .select('id, title, subject, user_id, created_at, likes_count')
    .eq('is_public', true)
    .order('likes_count', { ascending: false })
    .limit(50);

  if (error || !data) return [];

  const { data: myLikes } = await supabase
    .from('material_likes')
    .select('material_id')
    .eq('user_id', currentUserId);
  const myLikedIds = new Set((myLikes || []).map(l => l.material_id));

  const authorIds = [...new Set(data.map(m => m.user_id))];
  const profiles = await getPublicProfiles(authorIds);
  const profileMap = new Map((profiles || []).map(p => [p.id, p]));

  return data.map(m => {
    const author = profileMap.get(m.user_id);
    return {
      ...m,
      author_name: author?.full_name || 'Студент',
      author_avatar: author?.avatar_url || undefined,
      is_liked_by_me: myLikedIds.has(m.id)
    };
  });
}

// Атомарный лайк через RPC — без race condition
export async function toggleLike(materialId: string, isCurrentlyLiked: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('toggle_material_like', {
    p_material_id: materialId,
    p_like: !isCurrentlyLiked,
  });
  if (error) {
    console.error('toggleLike error:', error);
    return false;
  }
  return data === !isCurrentlyLiked;
}

// Скопировать чужой публичный материал в свою библиотеку
export async function copyMaterialToLibrary(materialId: string, targetUserId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const { data: src, error: srcErr } = await supabase
    .from('materials')
    .select('title, subject, original_text, summary_json, flashcards_json, quiz_json, missions_json')
    .eq('id', materialId)
    .single();
  if (srcErr || !src) return false;

  const { error } = await supabase.from('materials').insert({
    user_id: targetUserId,
    title: src.title + ' (копия)',
    subject: src.subject,
    original_text: src.original_text,
    summary_json: src.summary_json,
    flashcards_json: src.flashcards_json,
    quiz_json: src.quiz_json,
    missions_json: src.missions_json,
    is_public: false,
    likes_count: 0,
  });
  return !error;
}

export async function getPublicMaterialPreview(materialId: string) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('materials')
    .select('summary_json, flashcards_json, quiz_json')
    .eq('id', materialId)
    .single();
    
  if (error) {
    console.error('getPublicMaterialPreview error:', error);
    return null;
  }
  return data;
}

export async function uploadAvatar(userId: string, file: File): Promise<string | null> {
  const fileExt = file.name.split('.').pop() || 'png';
  const fileName = `${userId}-${Date.now()}.${fileExt}`;
  
  const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
    .from('avatars')
    .upload(fileName, file, { cacheControl: '3600', upsert: true });

  if (uploadError) {
    console.error('Avatar upload error:', uploadError);
    return null;
  }

  const { data } = supabase.storage.from('avatars').getPublicUrl(fileName);
  return data.publicUrl;
}
