<file path="frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { getProfile, updateProfile, uploadAvatar, UserProfile } from '../api/social';
import { getFriends, sendFriendRequest, respondFriendRequest, Friendship, blockUser, unblockUser, getBlockedUserIds } from '../api/chat';
import { UserCircle2, GraduationCap, Trophy, BookOpen, Loader2, UserPlus, Check, Edit3, X, UserCheck, UserX, Bell, BellOff, Camera, Star, MessageSquare, Ban } from 'lucide-react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { subscribeUserToPush, checkPushSubscription, requestNotificationPermission } from '../utils/push';
import UniversitySelect from '../components/UniversitySelect';
import { getUserXP, calcLevel } from '../api/quests';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import ImageCropper from '../components/ImageCropper';
import { CustomSelect } from '../components/CustomSelect';

export default function Profile() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { id: profileId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const targetId = profileId || user?.id;
  
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<UserProfile | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  
  const [friendStatus, setFriendStatus] = useState<'none' | 'pending' | 'accepted'>('none');
  const [incomingRequests, setIncomingRequests] = useState<Friendship[]>([]);
  
  const [isBlocked, setIsBlocked] = useState(false);
  const [blockLoading, setBlockLoading] = useState(false);

  const isMyProfile = user?.id === targetId;

  // Edit State
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState({ full_name: '', university: '', bio: '', avatar_url: '', role: 'student' });

  // Push notifications state
  const [pushEnabled, setPushEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [pushLoading, setPushLoading] = useState(true);

  // Avatar Upload state
  const [uploadingAvatar, setUploadingAvatar] = useState(false);
  const [cropImageSrc, setCropImageSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // XP / Level state
  const [xp, setXp] = useState(0);
  const [levelInfo, setLevelInfo] = useState({ level: 1, name: 'Новичок', currentXP: 0, nextXP: 100, progress: 0 });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!targetId) return;
    
    getProfile(targetId).then(p => {
      setProfile(p);
      if (p) {
        setEditForm({
          full_name: p.full_name || '',
          university: p.university || '',
          bio: p.bio || '',
          avatar_url: p.avatar_url || '',
          role: p.role || 'student'
        });
      }
      setLoading(false);
    });

    getUserXP(targetId).then(v => {
      setXp(v);
      setLevelInfo(calcLevel(v));
    });

    if (user) {
      getFriends(user.id).then(friends => {
        if (!isMyProfile) {
          const friendship = friends.find(f => f.requester_id === targetId || f.addressee_id === targetId);
          if (friendship) setFriendStatus(friendship.status as 'pending' | 'accepted');
        } else {
          // Входящие заявки мне
          const incoming = friends.filter(f => f.addressee_id === user.id && f.status === 'pending');
          setIncomingRequests(incoming);
        }
      });
      
      if (!isMyProfile && targetId) {
        getBlockedUserIds(user.id).then(blockedIds => {
          setIsBlocked(blockedIds.includes(targetId));
        });
      }
    }

    checkPushSubscription().then(enabled => {
      setPushEnabled(enabled);
      setPushLoading(false);
    });
  }, [targetId, user?.id, isMyProfile]);

  const handleAddFriend = async () => {
    if (!user || !targetId) return;
    const ok = await sendFriendRequest(user.id, targetId);
    if (ok) setFriendStatus('pending');
  };

  const handleRespondRequest = async (id: string, status: 'accepted' | 'declined') => {
    await respondFriendRequest(id, status);
    setIncomingRequests(prev => prev.filter(req => req.id !== id));
  };

  const handleToggleBlock = async () => {
    if (!user || !targetId) return;
    setBlockLoading(true);
    if (isBlocked) {
      await unblockUser(user.id, targetId);
      setIsBlocked(false);
      toast.success('Пользователь разблокирован');
    } else {
      await blockUser(user.id, targetId);
      setIsBlocked(true);
      toast.success('Пользователь заблокирован');
    }
    setBlockLoading(false);
  };

  const handleSaveProfile = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    const ok = await updateProfile(user.id, editForm);
    if (ok) {
      setProfile(prev => prev ? { ...prev, ...editForm } : null);
      setIsEditing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTogglePush = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    setPushLoading(true);
    try {
      if (!pushEnabled) {
        const granted = await requestNotificationPermission();
        if (!granted) {
          toast.error('Доступ к уведомлениям запрещён в браузере.');
          setPushLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        await subscribeUserToPush(user.id);
        setPushEnabled(true);
      } else {
        toast('Отключить уведомления можно в настройках браузера.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Ошибка настройки уведомлений: ' + (err as Error).message);
    }
    setPushLoading(false);
  };

  const handleFileChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    // Считываем файл как URL, чтобы передать в кроппер
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.addEventListener('load', () => {
      setCropImageSrc(reader.result?.toString() || null);
    });
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    e.target.value = ''; // Сбросить инпут
  };

  const handleCropComplete = async (croppedFile: File) => {
    setCropImageSrc(null);
    setUploadingAvatar(true);
    const url = await uploadAvatar(user!.id, croppedFile);
    setUploadingAvatar(false);

    if (url) {
      setEditForm({ ...editForm, avatar_url: url });
      // Если не в режиме редактирования, сохраним сразу
      if (!isEditing) {
        await updateProfile(user!.id, { avatar_url: url });
        setProfile(prev => prev ? { ...prev, avatar_url: url } : null);
      }
      toast.success('Фото обновлено');
    } else {
      toast.error('Не удалось загрузить фото');
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="flex min-h-[85vh] items-center justify-center"><Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 text-cyan-400 animate-spin" /></div>;
  if (!profile) return <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500">Профиль не найден.</div>;

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto min-h-[85vh] max-w-5xl px-4 py-8 md:px-8 md:py-12">
      <motion.div 
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        className="mb-8 border-y border-slate-200 py-7 dark:border-slate-800"
      >
        <div className="hidden" />
        
        <div className="relative flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center md:items-start gap-8 mb-8">
          <div className="relative group shrink-0 mb-4 md:mb-0 z-10">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" className="hidden">
              <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="48" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="4" fill="transparent" className="text-slate-200/50 dark:text-slate-800/50" />
              <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="48" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="4" fill="transparent" strokeDasharray={`${levelInfo.progress * 3.01} 301`} strokeLinecap="round" className="text-cyan-500" />
            </svg>

            <div className="relative z-10 h-28 w-28 overflow-hidden rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 md:h-32 md:w-32">
              {profile.avatar_url ? (
                <img src={profile.avatar_url} alt="Фото профиля" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
              ) : (
                <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center">
                  <UserCircle2 className="w-16 h-16 md:w-20 md:h-20 text-slate-400" />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {isMyProfile && (
              <label className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 z-20 flex h-10 w-10 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-white bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 transition hover:bg-cyan-300 dark:border-slate-950">
                {uploadingAvatar ? <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : <Camera className="w-5 h-5 md:w-6 md:h-6" />}
                <input type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={handleFileChange} disabled={uploadingAvatar} />
              </label>
            )}

            <div className="absolute -bottom-2 left-1/2 z-30 -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300">
              Уровень {levelInfo.level}
            </div>
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex-1 text-center md:text-left pt-2">
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center md:justify-start gap-3 mb-2">
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950 dark:text-white md:text-4xl">{profile.full_name || 'Студент'}</h1>
              {profile.is_pro && (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center md:items-start">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-amber-400/30 bg-amber-400/10 px-2 py-1 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300">
                    <Star className="w-4 h-4 fill-current" />
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold">PRO</span>
                  </div>
                  {profile.pro_until && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1 uppercase tracking-widest font-bold">
                      до {new Date(profile.pro_until).toLocaleDateString('ru-RU')}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center md:justify-start gap-2 mb-4">
              <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono text-sm font-bold rounded-lg cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition" onClick={() => {
                if (profile.public_id) {
                  navigator.clipboard.writeText(profile.public_id);
                  toast.success('ID скопирован!');
                }
              }} title="Нажмите, чтобы скопировать ID">
                ID: #{profile.public_id || 'загрузка...'}
              </span>
            </div>

            {profile.university && (
              <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 md:justify-start">
                <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5" />
                {profile.university}
              </div>
            )}
            {profile.role === 'teacher' && (
              <div className="inline-flex mb-4 items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border border-amber-500/20">
                Преподаватель
              </div>
            )}

            {!isMyProfile ? (
              <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap justify-center md:justify-start gap-3">
                {friendStatus === 'none' && (
                  <button onClick={handleAddFriend} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-cyan-400 px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold text-slate-950 transition hover:bg-cyan-300">
                    <UserPlus className="w-5 h-5" /> Добавить в друзья
                  </button>
                )}
                {friendStatus === 'pending' && (
                  <button disabled className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-white/50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 cursor-not-allowed border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                    <Check className="w-5 h-5" /> Заявка отправлена
                  </button>
                )}
                {friendStatus === 'accepted' && (
                  <button className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 border border-emerald-500/20">
                    <Check className="w-5 h-5" /> В друзьях
                  </button>
                )}
                
                <button 
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/messages/${targetId}`)}
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-sky-50 dark:bg-sky-900/30 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400 border border-sky-200 dark:border-sky-800 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 hover:bg-sky-100 dark:hover:bg-sky-900/50 transition"
                >
                  <MessageSquare className="w-5 h-5" /> Написать
                </button>

                <button 
                  onClick={handleToggleBlock}
                  disabled={blockLoading}
                  className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 transition border ${
                    isBlocked 
                      ? 'bg-slate-800 text-white border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-700' 
                      : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-900/20 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/40'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Ban className="w-5 h-5" /> {isBlocked ? 'Разблокировать' : 'Заблокировать'}
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-4 flex justify-center md:justify-start">
                <button onClick={() => setIsEditing(!isEditing)} className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold transition ${isEditing ? 'border-rose-500/30 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:border-cyan-400 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200'}`}>
                  {isEditing ? <X className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  {isEditing ? 'Отменить редактирование' : 'Редактировать профиль'}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Форма редактирования (плавная) */}
        {isEditing && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="relative z-20 mb-8 border-y border-slate-200 py-6 dark:border-slate-800">
            <h3 className="mb-4 font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Редактирование профиля</h3>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Имя и Фамилия</label>
                  <input type="text" value={editForm.full_name} onChange={e => setEditForm({...editForm, full_name: e.target.value})} className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-transparent px-4 py-3 text-slate-900 outline-none transition focus:border-cyan-400 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-100" placeholder="Иван Иванов" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Университет / Школа</label>
                  <UniversitySelect value={editForm.university} onChange={(val) => setEditForm({...editForm, university: val})} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">О себе</label>
                <textarea value={editForm.bio} onChange={e => setEditForm({...editForm, bio: e.target.value})} className="min-h-[100px] w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-transparent px-4 py-3 text-slate-900 outline-none transition focus:border-cyan-400 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-100" rows={3} placeholder="Факультет, направление и учебные интересы" />
              </div>
              <div className="w-full md:w-1/2 relative z-20">
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Роль в системе</label>
                <CustomSelect 
                  value={editForm.role} 
                  onChange={val => setEditForm({...editForm, role: val})} 
                  className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-transparent px-4 py-3 text-slate-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-400 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-100"
                  options={[
                    { value: 'student', label: 'Студент' },
                    { value: 'teacher', label: 'Преподаватель' }
                  ]}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end pt-4">
                <button onClick={handleSaveProfile} className="rounded-lg bg-cyan-400 px-6 py-2.5 font-semibold text-slate-950 transition hover:bg-cyan-300">Сохранить</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {!isEditing && profile.bio && (
          <div className="mb-8 border-y border-slate-200 py-5 text-slate-700 dark:border-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">
            <div className="max-w-3xl leading-7">{profile.bio}</div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 border-y border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 md:grid-cols-4">
          {[
            { label: 'Опыт', value: `${xp} XP`, icon: Star },
            { label: 'Дней подряд', value: profile.streak_days || 0, icon: Trophy },
            { label: 'Материалов', value: profile.total_materials || 0, icon: BookOpen },
            { label: 'Повторений', value: profile.total_reviews || 0, icon: GraduationCap },
          ].map(({ label, value, icon: Icon }, index) => (
            <div key={label} className={`py-5 ${index % 2 ? 'pl-5' : 'pr-5'} ${index > 1 ? 'border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800' : ''} md:border-l md:border-t-0 md:px-5 md:first:border-l-0 md:first:pl-0`}>
              <Icon className="mb-3 h-4 w-4 text-cyan-500" />
              <div className="text-2xl font-semibold text-slate-950 dark:text-white">{value}</div>
              <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{label}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <p className="py-4 text-sm text-slate-500">
          Уровень {levelInfo.level}: {levelInfo.name}. До следующего уровня — {Math.max(0, levelInfo.nextXP - levelInfo.currentXP)} XP.
        </p>

        {isMyProfile && (
          <div className="mt-8 pt-8 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4">Уведомления</h3>
            <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 border-y border-slate-200 py-4 dark:border-slate-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
              <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-3">
                {pushEnabled ? <Bell className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-500" /> : <BellOff className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-500" />}
                <div className="text-left">
                  <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200 text-sm">Напоминания о повторении</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-tight mt-0.5">Meldy сообщит, когда карточки будут готовы к повторению.</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={handleTogglePush}
                disabled={pushLoading || pushEnabled}
                className={`w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold transition ${
                  pushLoading ? 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600 cursor-not-allowed' :
                  pushEnabled ? 'text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-300 cursor-default border border-cyan-400/30' :
                  'bg-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-300 text-slate-950'
                }`}
              >
                {pushLoading ? 'Загрузка...' : pushEnabled ? 'Включено' : 'Включить'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </motion.div>

      {isMyProfile && incomingRequests.length > 0 && (
        <section className="border-y border-slate-200 py-6 dark:border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="mb-4 text-xl font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">Заявки в друзья · {incomingRequests.length}</h2>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {incomingRequests.map(req => (
              <div key={req.id} className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 py-4 last:border-b-0 dark:border-slate-800">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  {req.friend_avatar ? (
                    <img src={req.friend_avatar} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover" alt="avatar" />
                  ) : (
                    <UserCircle2 className="w-10 h-10 text-slate-400" />
                  )}
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{req.friend_name}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button onClick={() => handleRespondRequest(req.id, 'accepted')} className="p-2 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-200 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/50 rounded-lg transition" title="Принять">
                    <UserCheck className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={() => handleRespondRequest(req.id, 'declined')} className="p-2 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-200 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/50 rounded-lg transition" title="Отклонить">
                    <UserX className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {cropImageSrc && (
        <ImageCropper 
          imageSrc={cropImageSrc} 
          onCropComplete={handleCropComplete} 
          onClose={() => setCropImageSrc(null)} 
        />
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { cleanup, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import Review from './Review';

const api = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  getDueCards: vi.fn(),
  updateCardProgress: vi.fn(),
  updateQuestProgress: vi.fn(),
  recordStudyActivity: vi.fn(),
  playFlipSound: vi.fn(),
  playSuccessSound: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../api/flashcards', () => ({
  getDueCards: api.getDueCards,
  updateCardProgress: api.updateCardProgress,
}));

vi.mock('../api/quests', () => ({
  updateQuestProgress: api.updateQuestProgress,
  recordStudyActivity: api.recordStudyActivity,
}));

vi.mock('../hooks/useAuth', () => ({
  useAuth: () => ({ user: { id: 'user-1' } }),
}));

vi.mock('../hooks/useSound', () => ({
  useSound: () => ({
    playFlipSound: api.playFlipSound,
    playSuccessSound: api.playSuccessSound,
  }),
}));

function deferred<T>() {
  let resolve!: (value: T) => void;
  let reject!: (reason?: unknown) => void;
  const promise = new Promise<T>((resolvePromise, rejectPromise) => {
    resolve = resolvePromise;
    reject = rejectPromise;
  });
  return { promise, resolve, reject };
}

async function revealAndChooseKnownCard() {
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  render(<MemoryRouter><Review /></MemoryRouter>);
  await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Показать ответ' }));
  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Знаю' }));
  return user;
}

describe('Review answer persistence', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    api.getDueCards.mockResolvedValue([{
      id: 'card-1',
      question: 'Что такое интервальное повторение?',
      answer: 'Повторение с увеличивающимися интервалами.',
    }]);
    api.updateCardProgress.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    api.updateQuestProgress.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    api.recordStudyActivity.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
  });

  afterEach(cleanup);

  it('does not complete the session before the answer is saved', async () => {
    const save = deferred<void>();
    api.updateCardProgress.mockReturnValue(save.promise);

    await revealAndChooseKnownCard();

    expect(api.updateCardProgress).toHaveBeenCalledWith('card-1', 5);
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Знаю' })).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { name: 'Сессия завершена' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toHaveTextContent('Сохраняем ответ…');

    save.resolve();
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'Сессия завершена' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('keeps the current card available and reports a failed save', async () => {
    vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
    api.updateCardProgress.mockRejectedValue(new Error('offline'));

    await revealAndChooseKnownCard();

    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('Ответ не сохранён');
    expect(screen.getByText('Что такое интервальное повторение?')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Знаю' })).toBeEnabled();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('heading', { name: 'Сессия завершена' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(api.updateQuestProgress).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(api.recordStudyActivity).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('does not show the empty state when loading the queue fails', async () => {
    vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
    api.getDueCards.mockRejectedValue(new Error('offline'));

    render(<MemoryRouter><Review /></MemoryRouter>);

    expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('Не удалось загрузить карточки');
    expect(screen.queryByText('На сегодня всё')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Повторить загрузку' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

<file path="frontend/src/pages/SharedMaterial.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { Bot, Sparkles, BookOpen, Headphones } from 'lucide-react';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkMath from 'remark-math';
import rehypeKatex from 'rehype-katex';
import 'katex/dist/katex.min.css';

export default function SharedMaterial() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [material, setMaterial] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadMaterial() {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('materials')
          .select('*')
          .eq('id', id)
          .eq('is_public', true)
          .maybeSingle();

        if (error) throw error;
        setMaterial(data);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
    if (id) loadMaterial();
  }, [id]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-cyan-400 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!material) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center">
        <Bot className="w-16 h-16 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 mb-4" />
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 mb-2">Материал не найден</h2>
        <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-8">Возможно, ссылка устарела или автор закрыл к нему доступ.</p>
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/')} className="px-6 py-3 bg-cyan-300 text-slate-950 font-semibold rounded-lg hover:bg-cyan-200 transition-colors">На главную</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const cheatsheet = material.summary_json?.cheatsheet;

  const extractCleanContent = (data: any): string => {
    if (!data) return '';
    let raw = data.content || data.raw || '';
    if (typeof raw === 'string' && raw.trim().startsWith('{')) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (parsed.content) raw = parsed.content;
      } catch (e) {
        const match = raw.match(/"content"\s*:\s*"([\s\S]*?)(?:"\s*[,}])/);
        if (match) raw = match[1];
      }
    }
    return raw;
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 flex flex-col">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 sm:p-6 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-50">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-cyan-300 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
            <Bot className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-950" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-lg">Meldy</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium tracking-wide uppercase">Общий материал</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/register')} className="px-4 py-2 bg-cyan-50 dark:bg-cyan-950/30 text-cyan-800 dark:text-cyan-300 font-semibold rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-cyan-100 dark:hover:bg-cyan-950/50 transition-colors">
          Создать свой
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 max-w-3xl mx-auto w-full p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
          <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-2">{material.title}</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
            Сгенерировано ИИ на основе лекции
          </p>
        </div>

        {cheatsheet ? (
          <div className="bg-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-800/80 text-white rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-xl border border-slate-200/10 dark:border-slate-800 relative overflow-hidden">
            <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-48 h-48 bg-white/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
            <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              Краткий конспект
            </p>
            <div className="prose prose-invert max-w-none text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-300 leading-relaxed cheatsheet-style">
              <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>{cheatsheet}</ReactMarkdown>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
             <div className="prose dark:prose-invert max-w-none text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
              <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>
                {extractCleanContent(material.summary_json) || material.original_text || ''}
              </ReactMarkdown>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* CTA */}
        <div className="bg-[#091522] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-6 sm:p-8 text-center text-white relative overflow-hidden mt-8">
           <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-64 h-64 bg-white/10 rounded-full blur-3xl -ml-20 -mt-20 pointer-events-none" />
           <h3 className="text-2xl font-semibold mb-3">Подготовьте свой материал</h3>
           <p className="text-slate-300 max-w-md mx-auto mb-6 text-sm">Загрузите лекцию или учебник, чтобы получить конспект, карточки и тест со ссылками на источник.</p>
           <button onClick={() => navigate('/register')} className="px-8 py-3 bg-cyan-300 text-slate-950 font-semibold rounded-lg hover:bg-cyan-200 transition-colors">
             Создать материал
           </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="frontend/src/pages/SocialHub.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Globe, Trophy, Heart, Download, UserCircle2, Loader2, Search, X, CheckCircle2, Eye, FileText, Layers } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { getLeaderboard, getPublicMaterials, toggleLike, copyMaterialToLibrary, getPublicMaterialPreview, LeaderboardEntry, PublicMaterial } from '../api/social';
import { getMaterials } from '../api/materials';
import { searchUsers } from '../api/chat';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkMath from 'remark-math';
import rehypeKatex from 'rehype-katex';
import 'katex/dist/katex.min.css';

export default function SocialHub() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'feed' | 'leaderboard' | 'search'>('feed');

  const [feed, setFeed] = useState<PublicMaterial[]>([]);
  const [leaderboard, setLeaderboard] = useState<LeaderboardEntry[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [myMaterials, setMyMaterials] = useState<any[]>([]);

  // Поиск пользователей
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [searching, setSearching] = useState(false);

  // Уведомления о копировании
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Предпросмотр
  const [previewMaterial, setPreviewMaterial] = useState<PublicMaterial | null>(null);
  const [previewData, setPreviewData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [previewLoading, setPreviewLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    setLoading(true);
    getMaterials(user.id).then(setMyMaterials);
    if (activeTab === 'feed') {
      getPublicMaterials(user.id).then(data => { setFeed(data); setLoading(false); });
    } else if (activeTab === 'leaderboard') {
      getLeaderboard().then(data => { setLeaderboard(data); setLoading(false); });
    } else {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [user?.id, activeTab]);

  // Поиск с дебаунсом
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user || activeTab !== 'search') return;
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) { setSearchResults([]); return; }
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      setSearching(true);
      const results = await searchUsers(searchQuery, user.id);
      setSearchResults(results);
      setSearching(false);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchQuery, user?.id, activeTab]);

  const handleLike = async (m: PublicMaterial) => {
    if (!user) return;
    const isLiked = m.is_liked_by_me;
    setFeed(prev => prev.map(item =>
      item.id === m.id ? { ...item, is_liked_by_me: !isLiked, likes_count: item.likes_count + (isLiked ? -1 : 1) } : item
    ));
    const saved = await toggleLike(m.id, !!isLiked);
    if (!saved) {
      setFeed(prev => prev.map(item => item.id === m.id ? {
        ...item,
        is_liked_by_me: !!isLiked,
        likes_count: Math.max(0, item.likes_count + (isLiked ? 1 : -1)),
      } : item));
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = async (m: PublicMaterial) => {
    if (!user) return;
    const ok = await copyMaterialToLibrary(m.id, user.id);
    if (ok) {
      setCopiedId(m.id);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 3000);
    }
  };

  const handlePreview = async (m: PublicMaterial) => {
    setPreviewMaterial(m);
    setPreviewData(null);
    setPreviewLoading(true);
    const data = await getPublicMaterialPreview(m.id);
    setPreviewData(data);
    setPreviewLoading(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 md:p-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto min-h-[85vh]">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-8">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 tracking-tight flex items-center gap-3">
            <Globe className="w-8 h-8 text-indigo-600" />
            Study Network
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">Глобальное сообщество студентов</p>
        </div>

        {/* Табы */}
        <div className="flex bg-slate-200/60 dark:bg-slate-950 p-1 rounded-2xl border border-slate-300/20 dark:border-slate-800/60 overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0">
          {[
            { key: 'feed', label: 'Маркетплейс' },
            { key: 'leaderboard', label: 'Лидерборд' },
            { key: 'search', label: '🔍 Найти' },
          ].map(tab => {
            const isActive = activeTab === tab.key;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.key}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.key as any)}
                className={`relative flex-1 sm:flex-none text-center px-5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-colors duration-200 whitespace-nowrap select-none ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400'
                    : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
                }`}
              >
                {isActive && (
                  <motion.span
                    layoutId="activeSocialTab"
                    className="absolute inset-0 bg-white dark:bg-slate-850 rounded-xl shadow-md -z-10"
                    transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 380, damping: 30 }}
                  />
                )}
                <span className="relative z-10">{tab.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Поиск пользователей ── */}
      {activeTab === 'search' && (
        <div>
          <div className="relative mb-6">
            <Search className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Найдите студентов по имени или #ID..."
              className="w-full pl-12 pr-4 py-3.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 shadow-sm"
              autoFocus
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')} className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600">
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {searching && <div className="flex justify-center py-10"><Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 text-indigo-500 animate-spin" /></div>}

          {!searching && searchResults.length === 0 && searchQuery && (
            <p className="text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-505 py-10">Никого не найдено по запросу «{searchQuery}»</p>
          )}

          {!searching && searchResults.length === 0 && !searchQuery && (
            <p className="text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-505 py-10">Введите имя студента, чтобы найти его</p>
          )}

          <div className="space-y-3">
            {searchResults.map(u => (
              <motion.div
                key={u.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 5 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-4 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow"
              >
                <button onClick={() => navigate(`/profile/${u.id}`)} className="flex items-center gap-4 flex-1 text-left">
                  {u.avatar_url ? (
                    <img src={u.avatar_url} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover" alt="avatar" />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-850 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                      <UserCircle2 className="w-7 h-7 text-slate-400" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">{u.full_name}</div>
                    {u.public_id && <div className="text-xs font-mono text-indigo-500 font-bold mb-0.5">#{u.public_id}</div>}
                    {u.university && <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{u.university}</div>}
                  </div>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/profile/${u.id}`)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/30 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold text-sm rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900/50 transition"
                >
                  Профиль →
                </button>
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Лента / Лидерборд ── */}
      {activeTab !== 'search' && (
        loading ? (
          <div className="flex justify-center py-20">
            <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 text-indigo-500 animate-spin" />
          </div>
        ) : activeTab === 'feed' ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:gap-6">
            {feed.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="col-span-2 text-center py-20 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                <Globe className="w-12 h-12 text-slate-200 dark:text-slate-700 mx-auto mb-4" />
                Пока никто не опубликовал материалы. Откройте свои в Библиотеке!
              </div>
            ) : (
              feed.map((m, i) => (
                <motion.div
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  transition={{ delay: i * 0.04 }}
                  key={m.id}
                  className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center mb-4">
                    <button onClick={() => navigate(`/profile/${m.user_id}`)} className="flex items-center gap-3 group flex-1">
                      {m.author_avatar ? (
                        <img src={m.author_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover" />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                          <UserCircle2 className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-400" />
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div className="text-left">
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 group-hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors text-sm">{m.author_name}</div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">{new Date(m.created_at).toLocaleDateString('ru')}</div>
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mb-5">
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">{m.subject || 'Без предмета'}</div>
                    <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 line-clamp-2 break-words">{m.title}</h3>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleLike(m)}
                      className={`flex items-center gap-2 font-medium transition-colors text-sm ${
                        m.is_liked_by_me ? 'text-pink-600' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-pink-600'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <Heart className={`w-4 h-4 ${m.is_liked_by_me ? 'fill-pink-600' : ''}`} />
                      {m.likes_count}
                    </button>

                    {String(m.user_id) !== String(user?.id) && (
                      <div className="flex flex-col xl:flex-row gap-2 items-stretch xl:items-center w-full sm:w-auto">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handlePreview(m)}
                          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-bold text-sm transition-colors px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700"
                        >
                          <Eye className="w-4 h-4" /> <span>Предпросмотр</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleCopy(m)}
                          disabled={copiedId === m.id || myMaterials.some(my => my.title === m.title + ' (копия)')}
                          className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-bold text-sm transition-colors px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg ${
                            (copiedId === m.id || myMaterials.some(my => my.title === m.title + ' (копия)'))
                              ? 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400'
                              : 'bg-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-700 text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 dark:hover:bg-indigo-600'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {(copiedId === m.id || myMaterials.some(my => my.title === m.title + ' (копия)')) ? (
                            <><CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" /> Сохранено!</>
                          ) : (
                            <><Download className="w-4 h-4" /> <span>Сохранить</span></>
                          )}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </motion.div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Лидерборд */
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/30">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Trophy className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-500" />
                Топ 50 студентов
              </h2>
            </div>
            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
              {leaderboard.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-10 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Нет данных для рейтинга.</div>
              ) : (
                leaderboard.map((u, i) => (
                  <div key={u.id} className="p-4 sm:px-6 flex items-center gap-4 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition-colors">
                    <div className={`w-8 font-black text-center shrink-0 ${
                      i === 0 ? 'text-amber-500 text-2xl' :
                      i === 1 ? 'text-slate-400 text-xl' :
                      i === 2 ? 'text-amber-700 text-xl' : 'text-slate-300 text-base'
                    }`}>
                      {i < 3 ? ['🥇','🥈','🥉'][i] : `#${i+1}`}
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={() => navigate(`/profile/${u.id}`)} className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 text-left">
                      {u.avatar_url ? (
                        <img src={u.avatar_url} alt="avatar" className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full object-cover shadow-sm" />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-11 h-11 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm">
                          <UserCircle2 className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400" />
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div>
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors">{u.full_name}</div>
                        <div className="text-sm font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md inline-block mt-0.5">
                          {u.total_xp.toLocaleString()} XP
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )
      )}

      {/* Модалка предпросмотра */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {previewMaterial && (

                <div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">
                    {previewMaterial.subject || 'Без предмета'}
                  </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => setPreviewMaterial(null)}
                  className="p-2 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-full transition text-slate-400"
                >
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-2 space-y-6">
                {previewLoading ? (
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 text-indigo-500 animate-spin mb-4" />
                    <p>Загрузка данных для предпросмотра...</p>
                  </div>
                ) : previewData ? (

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">

                        <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/30 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center">
                          <Layers className="w-5 h-5" />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">Карточки</p>
                          <p className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
                            {previewData.flashcards_json?.flashcards?.length || 0} шт.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/30 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center">
                          <FileText className="w-5 h-5" />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">Тесты</p>
                          <p className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
                            {previewData.quiz_json?.quiz?.length || 0} шт.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {previewData.summary_json && (
                      <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5">
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Eye className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500" /> Отрывок конспекта
                        </h4>
                        <div className="text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed markdown-content max-h-64 overflow-y-hidden relative">
                          <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>
                            {typeof previewData.summary_json === 'string' 
                              ? previewData.summary_json.slice(0, 500) + '...'
                              : (previewData.summary_json.content?.slice(0, 500) || '') + '...'}
                          </ReactMarkdown>
                          <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-24 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-50 dark:from-slate-950 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />

                      </div>

                  </>
                ) : (
                  <div className="text-center py-10 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Не удалось загрузить данные
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 flex gap-3">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setPreviewMaterial(null)}
                  className="flex-1 py-3 px-4 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                >
                  Закрыть
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (!(copiedId === previewMaterial.id || myMaterials.some(my => my.title === previewMaterial.title + ' (копия)'))) {
                      handleCopy(previewMaterial);
                      setPreviewMaterial(null);
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={copiedId === previewMaterial.id || myMaterials.some(my => my.title === previewMaterial.title + ' (копия)')}
                  className={`flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 ${
                    (copiedId === previewMaterial.id || myMaterials.some(my => my.title === previewMaterial.title + ' (копия)'))
                      ? 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400'
                      : 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {(copiedId === previewMaterial.id || myMaterials.some(my => my.title === previewMaterial.title + ' (копия)')) ? (
                    <><CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5" /> Сохранено!</>
                  ) : (
                    <><Download className="w-5 h-5" /> Сохранить себе</>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

function deferred<T>() {
  let resolve!: (value: T) => void;
  let reject!: (reason?: unknown) => void;
  const promise = new Promise<T>((resolvePromise, rejectPromise) => {
    resolve = resolvePromise;
    reject = rejectPromise;
  });
  return { promise, resolve, reject };
}

const material = {
  id: 'material-1',
  title: 'Интервальное повторение',
  flashcards_json: [],
  missions_json: { missions: [] },
};

async function renderCardSession() {
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  localStorage.setItem(`study_session_user-1`, JSON.stringify({
    phase: 'cards',
    cardIdx: 0,
    cardStats: { correct: 0, wrong: 0 },
    chatMessages: [],
    quizIdx: 0,
    quizScore: 0,
    activeMaterial: material,
    sessionCards: [{
      id: 'card-1',
      question: 'Что такое интервальное повторение?',
      answer: 'Повторение с увеличивающимися интервалами.',
    }],
    testQuestions: [],
    xpGained: 0,
    selectedOption: null,
    isCorrect: null,
    showHint: false,
  }));

  render(<MemoryRouter><StudySession /></MemoryRouter>);
  await screen.findByText('Шаг 1 из 3 · Повторение карточек');
  await user.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Показать ответ' }));
  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /Знал/ }));
  return user;
}

    expect(api.recordStudyActivity).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

<file path="frontend/src/utils/codeSandbox.ts">
export interface SandboxCase {
  input: unknown;
  expected: unknown;
}

export interface SandboxResult {
  results: Array<{ actual: unknown; passed: boolean }>;
}

/**
 * Runs practice code in a short-lived Worker. The Worker has no DOM,
 * localStorage, cookies or access to the app's authenticated page context.
 */
export function runCodeSandbox(
  source: string,
  cases: SandboxCase[],
  timeoutMs = 1500,
): Promise<SandboxResult> {
  const workerSource = `
    self.fetch = undefined;
    self.XMLHttpRequest = undefined;
    self.WebSocket = undefined;
    self.EventSource = undefined;
    self.importScripts = undefined;
    self.onmessage = (event) => {
      try {
        const factory = new Function('"use strict"; return (' + event.data.source + ')');
        const candidate = factory();
        if (typeof candidate !== 'function') throw new Error('Решение должно возвращать функцию');
        const results = event.data.cases.map((testCase) => {
          const args = Array.isArray(testCase.input) ? testCase.input : [testCase.input];
          const actual = candidate(...args);
          return { actual, passed: JSON.stringify(actual) === JSON.stringify(testCase.expected) };
        });
        self.postMessage({ ok: true, results });
      } catch (error) {
        self.postMessage({ ok: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) });
      }
    };
  `;

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([workerSource], { type: 'text/javascript' }));
    const worker = new Worker(blobUrl);
    const cleanup = () => {
      worker.terminate();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
    };
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      cleanup();
      reject(new Error('Проверка заняла слишком много времени и была остановлена'));
    }, timeoutMs);

    worker.onmessage = (event) => {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      cleanup();
      if (!event.data?.ok) {
        reject(new Error(event.data?.error || 'Не удалось выполнить код'));
        return;
      }
      resolve({ results: event.data.results });
    };
    worker.onerror = () => {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      cleanup();
      reject(new Error('Не удалось запустить изолированную проверку'));
    };
    worker.postMessage({ source, cases });
  });
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/utils/resultPresentation.ts">
import type { AnalysisResults } from '../types';

const GENERIC_TITLES = new Set([
  'без названия',
  'введение',
  'введение в тему',
  'конспект',
  'лекция',
  'материал',
  'новый материал',
  'результат анализа',
  'учебный материал',
  'unknown',
]);

export function stripFileExtension(value = ''): string {
  return value.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '').trim();
}

export function cleanTitleCandidate(value?: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return '';

  return value
    .replace(/^[#*_`\s«»"'–—-]+/, '')
    .replace(/[#*_`\s«»"'–—-]+$/, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

export function isGenericMaterialTitle(value?: string | null): boolean {
  const title = cleanTitleCandidate(stripFileExtension(value || ''));
  if (!title) return true;

  const lower = title.toLocaleLowerCase('ru-RU');
  return (
    GENERIC_TITLES.has(lower) ||
    /^\d+(?:[_\s-]\d+)*$/.test(lower) ||
    /^(img|image|screenshot|whatsapp|photo|video|audio|file|doc|document|scan|temp)[_\s-]/.test(lower) ||
    lower.includes('снимок экрана') ||
    lower.includes('безымянн') ||
    /^https?:\/\//.test(lower)
  );
}

function titleFromSummaryContent(content?: string): string {
  if (!content) return '';

  const headings = content
    .split('\n')
    .map(line => line.match(/^#{1,3}\s+(.+)$/)?.[1])
    .filter((line): line is string => Boolean(line))
    .map(cleanTitleCandidate);

  return headings.find(title => title.length <= 80 && !isGenericMaterialTitle(title)) || '';
}

export function getResultDisplayTitle(results: AnalysisResults, sourceFileName?: string): string {
  const generatedTitle = cleanTitleCandidate(results.summarizer?.title);
  if (generatedTitle && generatedTitle.length <= 90 && !isGenericMaterialTitle(generatedTitle)) {
    return generatedTitle;
  }

  const fileTitle = cleanTitleCandidate(stripFileExtension(sourceFileName || ''));
  if (fileTitle && fileTitle.length <= 90 && !isGenericMaterialTitle(fileTitle)) {
    return fileTitle;
  }

  const contentTitle = titleFromSummaryContent(
    results.summarizer?.content || (results.summarizer as { raw?: string })?.raw,
  );
  if (contentTitle) return contentTitle;

  const subject = cleanTitleCandidate(results.summarizer?.subject);
  if (subject && !isGenericMaterialTitle(subject)) return subject;

  return 'Учебный материал';
}
</file>

import asyncio
import httpx
import re

async def fetch_hh_vacancies(profession: str, location: str = "") -> str:
    url = "https://api.hh.ru/vacancies"
    headers = {
        "User-Agent": "StudyForgeSuperAppDynamicLudosiel/1.0 (denislabyncev935@gmail.com)"
    }
    query_text = f"{profession} {location}".strip()
    params = {
        "text": query_text,
        "per_page": 12,
        "only_with_salary": "true"
    }
    
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        response = await client.get(url, headers=headers, params=params, timeout=8.0)
        print(f"HH status: {response.status_code}")
        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise Exception(f"HH API returned status {response.status_code}, text: {response.text[:200]}")
        data = response.json()
        items = data.get("items", [])
        print(f"HH items count: {len(items)}")
        if not items:
            raise Exception("No vacancies found on HH")
        return "HH OK"

async def fetch_trudvsem_vacancies(profession: str, location: str = "") -> str:
    url = "https://opendata.trudvsem.ru/api/v1/vacancies"
    query_text = f"{profession} {location}".strip()
    params = {
        "text": query_text,
        "limit": 10
    }
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        response = await client.get(url, params=params, timeout=8.0)
        print(f"TrudVsem status: {response.status_code}")
        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise Exception(f"TrudVsem API returned status {response.status_code}")
        data = response.json()
        results = data.get("results", {})
        vacancies = results.get("vacancies", [])
        print(f"TrudVsem vacancies count: {len(vacancies)}")
        if not vacancies:
            raise Exception("No vacancies found on TrudVsem")
        return "TrudVsem OK"

async def main():
    try:
        print("Testing HH with 'Frontend-разработчик' in 'Москва'")
        res = await fetch_hh_vacancies("Frontend-разработчик", "Москва")
        print(res)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"HH failed: {e}")
        
    try:
        print("\nTesting TrudVsem with 'Frontend-разработчик' in 'Москва'")
        res = await fetch_trudvsem_vacancies("Frontend-разработчик", "Москва")
        print(res)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"TrudVsem failed: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
