<file path="backend/media_parser.py">
import os
import re
import tempfile
import asyncio
from youtube_transcript_api import YouTubeTranscriptApi
import yt_dlp
from google import genai
from google.genai import types
import random


async def _transcribe_audio_with_groq(file_path: str, mime_type: str | None) -> str:
    api_key = os.getenv("GROQ_API_KEY", "").strip()
    if not api_key:
        return ""

    from groq import AsyncGroq

    client = AsyncGroq(api_key=api_key)
    with open(file_path, "rb") as audio_file:
        response = await client.audio.transcriptions.create(
            model=os.getenv("GROQ_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL", "whisper-large-v3-turbo"),
            file=(os.path.basename(file_path), audio_file, mime_type or "audio/mpeg"),
            response_format="text",
            temperature=0,
        )
    if isinstance(response, str):
        return response.strip()
    return str(getattr(response, "text", "") or "").strip()

def get_gemini_keys():
    raw_keys = os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY", "")
    keys = [k.strip() for k in raw_keys.split(",") if k.strip()]
    if not keys:
        raise ValueError("GEMINI_API_KEY не настроен для расшифровки аудио.")
    return keys

def extract_youtube_id(url: str) -> str:
    pattern = r"(?:v=|\/)([0-9A-Za-z_-]{11}).*"
    match = re.search(pattern, url)
    if match:
        return match.group(1)
    return ""

async def extract_youtube_transcript(youtube_url: str) -> str:
    video_id = extract_youtube_id(youtube_url)
    if not video_id:
        raise ValueError("Не удалось распознать ссылку на YouTube.")
        
    try:
        from youtube_transcript_api import YouTubeTranscriptApi
        
        # Поддержка разных версий библиотеки
        try:
            api = YouTubeTranscriptApi()
            transcript_list = api.list(video_id)
        except Exception:
            transcript_list = YouTubeTranscriptApi.list_transcripts(video_id)
            
        try:
            transcript = transcript_list.find_transcript(['ru', 'en', 'uk'])
        except Exception:
            # Если нет нужных языков, берём первую попавшуюся транскрипцию
            transcript = next(iter(transcript_list))
            
        # Пытаемся перевести на русский, если язык другой
        if not transcript.language_code.startswith('ru'):
            try:
                transcript = transcript.translate('ru')
            except Exception:
                pass
                
        data = transcript.fetch()
        text_parts = []
        for t in data:
            if isinstance(t, dict) and 'text' in t:
                text_parts.append(t['text'])
            elif hasattr(t, 'text'):
                text_parts.append(t.text)
                
        text = " ".join(text_parts)
        if text.strip():
            return text
            
        raise ValueError("Транскрипция оказалась пустой")
    except Exception as e:
        # Если субтитров нет вообще ни на одном языке
        return await _download_and_transcribe_youtube(youtube_url)

async def _download_and_transcribe_youtube(youtube_url: str) -> str:
    temp_path = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp4", delete=False) as temp_vid:
            temp_path = temp_vid.name

        ydl_opts = {
            'format': 'worst[ext=mp4]', # Скачиваем в плохом качестве, чтобы сэкономить трафик
            'outtmpl': temp_path,
            'quiet': True,
            'no_warnings': True,
            'extractor_args': {'youtube': ['player_client=android,web']},
        }

        loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
        def download():
            with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(ydl_opts) as ydl:
                ydl.download([youtube_url])
                
        await loop.run_in_executor(None, download)

        return await transcribe_media_file(temp_path, "video/mp4")
    except Exception as e:
        error_msg = str(e)
        if "bot" in error_msg.lower() or "sign in" in error_msg.lower():
            raise ValueError(
                "YouTube заблокировал скачивание с серверов платформы (защита от ботов). "
                "Пожалуйста, скачайте это видео самостоятельно в формате MP3/MP4 (например, через любой YouTube Downloader) "
                "и загрузите файл напрямую во вкладку 'Видео / Аудио'."
            )
        raise ValueError(f"Ошибка транскрибации YouTube: {error_msg}")
    finally:
        if temp_path and os.path.exists(temp_path):
            os.remove(temp_path)

async def transcribe_media_file(file_path: str, mime_type: str = None) -> str:
    if mime_type and mime_type.startswith("audio/"):
        try:
            groq_text = await _transcribe_audio_with_groq(file_path, mime_type)
            if groq_text:
                return groq_text
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"Groq audio transcription failed; trying Gemini: {exc}")

    keys = get_gemini_keys()
    shuffled_keys = list(keys)
    random.shuffle(shuffled_keys)
    
    loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
    last_error = None
    
    gemini_models = [
        model.strip() for model in os.getenv(
            "GEMINI_MODELS", "gemini-2.5-flash-lite,gemini-2.5-flash,gemini-2.0-flash"
        ).split(",") if model.strip()
    ]
    
    for key in shuffled_keys:
        try:
            client = genai.Client(api_key=key)
            
            # Загружаем файл в Gemini
            myfile = await loop.run_in_executor(
                None,
                lambda: client.files.upload(
                    file=file_path,
                    config=types.UploadFileConfig(mime_type=mime_type) if mime_type else None,
                ),
            )
            
            try:
                # Ожидаем завершения процессинга на стороне Google
                while myfile.state.name == "PROCESSING":
                    await asyncio.sleep(2)
                    myfile = await loop.run_in_executor(None, lambda: client.files.get(name=myfile.name))
                    
                if myfile.state.name == "FAILED":
                    raise ValueError("Ошибка обработки медиа-файла серверами Google.")
                    
                response = None
                for model_name in gemini_models:
                    try:
                        is_image = mime_type and mime_type.startswith('image/')
                        if is_image:
                            prompt = "Внимательно изучи это изображение. Это фотография конспекта, школьной доски или страницы учебника. Извлеки АБСОЛЮТНО ВЕСЬ текст, который ты видишь. Сохрани структуру: заголовки, списки, абзацы. Если видишь математические формулы, запиши их в формате LaTeX (KaTeX). Если часть текста неразборчива, напиши [неразборчиво], но постарайся восстановить по контексту. Твоя единственная цель - сделать идеальный текстовый слепок изображения без лишних комментариев."
                        else:
                            prompt = "Сделай максимально полную и точную текстовую расшифровку всего, что сказано в этом аудио/видео. Передай речь дословно на языке оригинала."
                        
                        response = await client.aio.models.generate_content(
                            model=model_name,
                            contents=[myfile, prompt],
                        )
                        if response and getattr(response, "text", None):
                            break
                    except Exception as model_err:
                        continue
                        
                if not response or not getattr(response, "text", None):
                    raise ValueError("Модели Gemini не справились с задачей.")

                return response.text
                
            finally:
                try:
                    await loop.run_in_executor(None, lambda: client.files.delete(name=myfile.name))
                except:
                    pass
        except Exception as e:
            last_error = str(e)
            continue
            
    raise ValueError(f"Не удалось расшифровать медиа. Убедитесь, что ключи активны. Последняя ошибка: {last_error}")
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/components/DiagnosticTestModal.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { X, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Loader2, Trophy, Sparkles, BookOpen } from 'lucide-react';
import { getDiagnosticTest, DiagnosticQuestion } from '../api/career';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface DiagnosticTestModalProps {
  moduleTitle: string;
  moduleTheory: string;
  profession: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onComplete: (canSkip: boolean, xpGained: number) => void;
}

export default function DiagnosticTestModal({
  moduleTitle,
  moduleTheory,
  profession,
  onClose,
  onComplete,
}: DiagnosticTestModalProps) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<DiagnosticQuestion[]>([]);
  const [currentIdx, setCurrentIdx] = useState(0);
  const [selectedOpt, setSelectedOpt] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [answered, setAnswered] = useState(false);
  const [scores, setScores] = useState<boolean[]>([]);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [finalScore, setFinalScore] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadTest();
  }, []);

  const loadTest = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await getDiagnosticTest(moduleTitle, moduleTheory, profession);
      setQuestions(data.questions || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      toast.error('Не удалось загрузить диагностический тест. Пожалуйста, попробуйте позже.');
      onClose();
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSelect = (opt: string) => {
    if (answered) return;
    setSelectedOpt(opt);
    setAnswered(true);
    
    const q = questions[currentIdx];
    const letter = opt.split(')')[0].trim();
    const isCorrect = letter === q.correct;
    
    setScores(prev => [...prev, isCorrect]);
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (currentIdx < questions.length - 1) {
      setCurrentIdx(prev => prev + 1);
      setSelectedOpt(null);
      setAnswered(false);
    } else {
      // Finished
      const correct = scores.filter(Boolean).length;
      const pct = Math.round((correct / questions.length) * 100);
      setFinalScore(pct);
      setDone(true);
    }
  };

  const handleFinish = () => {
    const passed = finalScore >= 80;
    const xpGained = passed ? 40 : 0;
    onComplete(passed, xpGained);
  };

  const q = questions[currentIdx];

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94 }}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-lg overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-[90vh] sm:h-auto"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/20 shrink-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-600/20 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/30">
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-widest block">Входное ИИ-тестирование</span>
                <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 truncate pr-4">{moduleTitle}</h3>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-full transition text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-650 dark:hover:text-slate-200">
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Body */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 flex flex-col justify-center min-h-0">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 gap-3">
                <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">ИИ составляет индивидуальные вопросы для вас...</p>
              </div>
            ) : done ? (
              /* Done Screen */
              <motion.div
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                className="flex flex-col items-center gap-5 py-4 text-center"
              >
                <div className={`w-20 h-20 rounded-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center font-black text-2xl border-4
                  ${finalScore >= 80 
                    ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/40 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.1)]' 
                    : 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/30 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border-indigo-500/40'}`}>
                  {finalScore}%
                </div>
                
                <div>
                  <h4 className="text-base font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                    {finalScore >= 80 ? '🔥 Теория пройдена экстерном!' : '📚 Рекомендуем изучить теорию'}
                  </h4>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 max-w-sm leading-relaxed">
                    {finalScore >= 80 
                      ? 'Поздравляем! Вы правильно ответили на 4+ вопроса. Вы получили бонусные +40 XP и можете сразу приступить к Expert-заданию в песочнице!'
                      : 'Вам немного не хватило до проходного балла (80%). Не переживайте! Изучите теорию модуля — это займет всего 15 минут.'}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleFinish}
                  className="w-full mt-4 py-3 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold transition shadow-md shadow-indigo-100 dark:shadow-none"
                >
                  {finalScore >= 80 ? 'Получить +40 XP и начать Практику' : 'Перейти к теории модуля'}
                </button>
              </motion.div>
            ) : (
              /* Quiz View */
              <div className="space-y-5">
                {/* Progress dot indicators */}
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase">
                  <span>Вопрос {currentIdx + 1} из {questions.length}</span>
                  <div className="flex gap-1">
                    {questions.map((_, i) => (
                      <div
                        key={i}
                        className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all ${
                          i < currentIdx
                            ? (scores[i] ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-rose-500')
                            : i === currentIdx ? 'bg-indigo-500 w-6' : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800'
                        } w-3`}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Question title */}
                <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/20 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl">
                  <p className="text-xs font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 leading-relaxed">
                    {q?.question}
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Options List */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {q?.options.map((opt, oi) => {
                    const letter = opt.split(')')[0].trim();
                    const isCorrect = q.correct === letter;
                    const isSelected = selectedOpt === opt;
                    
                    let btnStyle = 'bg-slate-50/50 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-indigo-600 dark:hover:border-indigo-500 hover:bg-indigo-50/10 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/20 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200';
                    
                    if (answered) {
                      if (isCorrect) {
                        btnStyle = 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-500 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-extrabold';
                      } else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) {
                        btnStyle = 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-500 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-450 font-extrabold';
                      } else {
                        btnStyle = 'bg-slate-100/40 dark:bg-slate-800/20 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 opacity-40 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500';
                      }
                    }

                    return (
                      <button
                        key={oi}
                        disabled={answered}
                        onClick={() => handleSelect(opt)}
                        className={`w-full text-left p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold transition-all flex items-center justify-between ${btnStyle}`}
                      >
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate pr-4">
                          {answered && isCorrect && <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />}
                          {answered && isSelected && !isCorrect && <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-500 shrink-0" />}
                          <span className="truncate">{opt}</span>
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                {/* Explanation text */}
                {answered && (
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 5 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    className="p-3 bg-indigo-50/50 dark:bg-indigo-950/10 border border-indigo-100/50 dark:border-indigo-900/20 rounded-xl text-[10px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed italic"
                  >
                    <span className="font-extrabold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 not-italic block mb-0.5">Разбор ответа:</span>
                    {q?.explanation}
                  </motion.div>
                )}

                {/* Action button */}
                {answered && (
                  <button
                    onClick={handleNext}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold transition shadow-sm"
                  >
                    {currentIdx < questions.length - 1 ? 'Следующий вопрос →' : 'Посмотреть результаты'}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/components/SourceReferences.tsx">
import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, CircleAlert, Link2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface SourceReferencesProps {
  ids?: string[];
  sources?: { id: string; text: string }[];
  compact?: boolean;
}

export default function SourceReferences({ ids, sources = [], compact = false }: SourceReferencesProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const contentId = useId();

  if (!ids?.length) {
    if (!sources.length) return null;
    return (
      <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 ${compact ? 'mt-2' : ''}`} title="Для этого результата не найден точный фрагмент исходника">
        <CircleAlert className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />Без ссылки на исходник
      </span>
    );
  }

  const sourceMap = new Map(sources.map(source => [source.id, source.text]));

  return (
    <div className={compact ? 'mt-2' : ''}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen(value => !value)}
        className="inline-flex min-h-7 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 transition hover:text-teal-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-500 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-teal-300"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={contentId}
      >
        <Link2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400" />
        {compact ? ids.join(', ') : `Источники: ${ids.join(', ')}`}
        <ChevronDown className={`w-3 h-3 transition-transform ${open ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div id={contentId} className="mt-2 space-y-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-100/70 p-3 dark:bg-slate-900/70">
          {ids.map(id => (
            <p key={id} className="text-xs leading-5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
              <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-teal-700 dark:text-teal-300">{id}</span>{' '}
              {sourceMap.get(id) || 'Фрагмент исходника недоступен'}
            </p>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="frontend/src/components/SummaryView.tsx">
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkMath from 'remark-math';
import rehypeKatex from 'rehype-katex';
import 'katex/dist/katex.min.css';
import { SummaryInfo } from '../types';
import SourceReferences from './SourceReferences';

/** Извлекает чистый текст конспекта, защищаясь от сырого JSON в content */
function extractCleanContent(data: any): string {
  // Нормальный случай: объект с полем content
  let raw = data?.content || (data as any)?.raw || '';

  // Если content сам является строкой с JSON — пробуем распарсить
  if (typeof raw === 'string' && raw.trimStart().startsWith('{')) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (parsed?.content) raw = parsed.content;
    } catch {
      // Попробуем вырезать content из raw вручную
      const match = raw.match(/"content"\s*:\s*"([\s\S]*?)(?:"\s*[,}])/);
      if (match) raw = match[1].replace(/\\n/g, '\n').replace(/\\"/g, '"');
    }
  }

  // Если data сам — строка (старые записи)
  if (!raw && typeof data === 'string') {
    raw = data;
    if (raw.trimStart().startsWith('{')) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (parsed?.content) raw = parsed.content;
      } catch {}
    }
  }

  // Обрезаем JSON-хвост с terms/терминами, если он приклеился к концу
  const jsonTailIdx = raw.search(/\s*[,"]?\s*"terms"\s*:/);
  if (jsonTailIdx > 0) raw = raw.slice(0, jsonTailIdx);

  return raw.trim();
}

function extractTerms(data: any): { term: string; definition: string }[] {
  return data?.terms || data?.summary_json?.terms || [];
}

function SectionBlock({ index, title, children }: { index: number; title: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="grid gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 py-6 first:pt-0 last:border-b-0 dark:border-slate-800 sm:grid-cols-[2.5rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-4">
      <span className="pt-1 font-mono text-[11px] font-medium tabular-nums tracking-wider text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500" aria-hidden="true">
        {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
      </span>
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <h2 className="mb-3 text-lg font-semibold leading-snug tracking-[-0.01em] text-slate-950 dark:text-slate-50 md:text-xl">{title}</h2>
        <div className="text-[15px] leading-7 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 md:text-base">
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default function SummaryView({ data, sources = [] }: { data: SummaryInfo; sources?: { id: string; text: string }[] }) {
  const content = extractCleanContent(data);
  const terms = extractTerms(data);

  if (!content && terms.length === 0) {
    return <p className="text-slate-400">Нет данных для отображения</p>;
  }

  // Разбиваем по заголовкам уровня 2 (## Название)
  const sections = content ? content.split(/(?=^## )/gm).filter(Boolean) : [];

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="mb-6">
        <SourceReferences ids={data?.source_ids} sources={sources} />
      </div>
      {sections.map((sec: string, i: number) => {
        const match = sec.match(/^## (.+)/);
        if (!match) {
          // Первый блок без заголовка — обычный абзац
          return (
            <div key={i} className="markdown-content mb-6 max-w-[70ch] text-[15px] leading-7 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 md:text-base">
              <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>{sec.trim()}</ReactMarkdown>
            </div>
          );
        }
        const title = match[1].trim();
        const body = sec.replace(/^## .+\n?/, '').trim();
        const cleanTitle = title.replace(/[📌🔑📖📚💡🏁🗂️]/g, '').trim();
        const headingIndex = sections
          .slice(0, i + 1)
          .filter(section => /^## /m.test(section)).length - 1;

        return (
          <SectionBlock key={i} index={headingIndex} title={cleanTitle}>
            <div className="markdown-content">
              <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>{body}</ReactMarkdown>
            </div>
          </SectionBlock>
        );
      })}

      {/* Словарь терминов */}
      {terms.length > 0 && (
        <section className="mt-8 border-t border-slate-300 pt-7 dark:border-slate-700">
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-baseline justify-between gap-4">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950 dark:text-slate-50">Термины</h2>
            <span className="text-xs tabular-nums text-slate-400">{terms.length}</span>
          </div>
          <dl className="divide-y divide-slate-200 border-y border-slate-200 dark:divide-slate-800 dark:border-slate-800">
            {terms.map((t: any, i: number) => (
              <div key={i} className="grid gap-1 py-4 sm:grid-cols-[12rem_minmax(0,1fr)] sm:gap-6">
                <dt className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">{t.term}</dt>
                <dd className="text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                  {t.definition}
                  <SourceReferences ids={t.source_ids} sources={sources} compact />
                </dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import Gradebook from '../components/Gradebook';

import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { getUserXP, calcLevel, ACHIEVEMENTS } from '../api/quests';
import { useTheme } from '../contexts/ThemeProvider';

export default function Analytics() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme === 'dark' || (theme === 'system' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);
  const activeTab = searchParams.get('tab') === 'gradebook' ? 'gradebook' : 'platform';
  const setActiveTab = (tab: string) => setSearchParams({ tab });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [xp, setXp] = useState(0);
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [exams, setExams] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [mistakes, setMistakes] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [earnedAchievements, setEarnedAchievements] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [cardProgress, setCardProgress] = useState<any[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    Promise.all([
      getUserXP(user.id),
      supabase.from('study_sessions').select('*').eq('user_id', user.id).order('date', { ascending: false }).limit(60),
      supabase.from('exam_sessions').select('*').eq('user_id', user.id).eq('status', 'completed').order('completed_at', { ascending: false }).limit(30),
      supabase.from('mistake_diary').select('*').eq('user_id', user.id),
      supabase.from('user_achievements').select('achievement_id').eq('user_id', user.id),
      supabase.from('materials').select('id, title, subject, created_at').eq('user_id', user.id),
      supabase.from('flashcard_progress').select('material_id, repetitions').eq('user_id', user.id),
    ]).then(([xpVal, sessRes, examsRes, mistakesRes, achRes, matsRes, cardsRes]) => {
      setXp(xpVal);
      setSessions(sessRes.data ?? []);
      setExams(examsRes.data ?? []);
      setMistakes(mistakesRes.data ?? []);
      setEarnedAchievements((achRes.data ?? []).map((a: Achievement) => a.achievement_id));
      setMaterials(matsRes.data ?? []);
      setCardProgress(cardsRes.data ?? []);
    }).catch(console.error).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [user?.id]);

  const levelInfo = calcLevel(xp);

  // Расчет владения темами
  const knowledgeHeatmap = (() => {
    const cardsByMaterial: Record<string, { total: number; mastered: number }> = {};
    cardProgress.forEach(c => {
      if (!c.material_id) return;
      if (!cardsByMaterial[c.material_id]) {
        cardsByMaterial[c.material_id] = { total: 0, mastered: 0 };
      }
      cardsByMaterial[c.material_id].total += 1;
      if (c.repetitions >= 3) {
        cardsByMaterial[c.material_id].mastered += 1;
      }
    });

    const examsByMaterial: Record<string, { totalScore: number; count: number }> = {};
    exams.forEach(e => {
      if (!e.material_id) return;
      if (!examsByMaterial[e.material_id]) {
        examsByMaterial[e.material_id] = { totalScore: 0, count: 0 };
      }
      examsByMaterial[e.material_id].totalScore += e.score || 0;
      examsByMaterial[e.material_id].count += 1;
    });

    return materials.map(m => {
      const cards = cardsByMaterial[m.id];
      const exam = examsByMaterial[m.id];
      
      let cardScore = -1;
      let examScore = -1;

      if (cards && cards.total > 0) {
        cardScore = (cards.mastered / cards.total) * 100;
      }
      if (exam && exam.count > 0) {
        examScore = exam.totalScore / exam.count;
      }

      let score = 0;
      let status: 'not_started' | 'started' | 'mastering' | 'mastered' = 'not_started';

      if (cardScore !== -1 && examScore !== -1) {
        score = Math.round(0.6 * cardScore + 0.4 * examScore);
        status = score >= 80 ? 'mastered' : score >= 40 ? 'mastering' : 'started';
      } else if (cardScore !== -1) {
        score = Math.round(cardScore);
        status = score >= 80 ? 'mastered' : score >= 40 ? 'mastering' : 'started';
      } else if (examScore !== -1) {
        score = Math.round(examScore);
        status = score >= 80 ? 'mastered' : score >= 40 ? 'mastering' : 'started';
      }

      return {
        id: m.id,
        title: m.title,
        subject: m.subject || 'Другое',
        score,
        status,
        cardScore: cardScore !== -1 ? Math.round(cardScore) : null,
        examScore: examScore !== -1 ? Math.round(examScore) : null,
      };
    }).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  })();

  const getProficiencyColor = (score: number, status: string) => {
    if (status === 'not_started') return 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500';
    if (score < 40) return 'bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/50 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400';
    if (score < 70) return 'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/50 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400';
    if (score < 85) return 'bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-900/50 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400';
    return 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400';
  };

  // Активность за 30 дней
  const activityData = (() => {
    const map: Record<string, number> = {};
    sessions.forEach((s: StudySession) => { map[s.date] = (map[s.date] ?? 0) + (s.cards_reviewed ?? 0); });
    return Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => {
      const d = subDays(new Date(), 29 - i);
      const key = format(d, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
      return { day: format(d, 'dd.MM'), value: map[key] ?? 0, full: key };
    });
  })();

  // Оценки на экзаменах
  const examScoreData = exams.slice(0, 10).reverse().map((e: ExamResult, i: number) => ({
    name: `#${i + 1}`,
    score: e.score ?? 0,
    subject: (e as any).subject ?? '',
  }));

  // Топ тем с ошибками
  const mistakeTopics = (() => {
    const map: Record<string, number> = {};
    mistakes.forEach((m: Mistake) => { if (m.topic) map[m.topic] = (map[m.topic] ?? 0) + 1; });
    return Object.entries(map).sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a).slice(0, 5);
  })();

  // Streak
  const streak = (() => {
    const dates = new Set(sessions.map((s: StudySession) => s.date));
    let count = 0;
    let d = new Date();
    while (dates.has(format(d, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) { count++; d = subDays(d, 1); }
    return count;
  })();

  // Radar-данные для профиля навыков
  const totalCards = sessions.reduce((a: number, s: StudySession) => a + (s.cards_reviewed ?? 0), 0);
  const avgExamScore = exams.length > 0 ? Math.round(exams.reduce((a, e) => a + (e.score ?? 0), 0) / exams.length) : 0;
  const resolvedMistakes = mistakes.filter(m => m.is_resolved).length;
  const radarData = [
    { subject: 'Экзамены', A: Math.min(100, (exams.length / 10) * 100) },
    { subject: 'Карточки', A: Math.min(100, (totalCards / 100) * 100) },
    { subject: 'Точность', A: avgExamScore },
    { subject: 'Активность', A: Math.min(100, (streak / 7) * 100) },
    { subject: 'Ошибки→Знания', A: mistakes.length > 0 ? Math.round((resolvedMistakes / mistakes.length) * 100) : 0 },
    { subject: 'Материалы', A: Math.min(100, (materials.length / 10) * 100) },
  ];

  // Тепловая карта (последние 12 недель)
  const heatmapData = (() => {
    const map: Record<string, number> = {};
    sessions.forEach((s: StudySession) => { map[s.date] = (map[s.date] ?? 0) + (s.cards_reviewed ?? 0); });
    const weeks: { date: string; value: number }[][] = [];
    let week: { date: string; value: number }[] = [];
    for (let i = 83; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = subDays(new Date(), i);
      const key = format(d, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
      week.push({ date: key, value: map[key] ?? 0 });
      if (week.length === 7) { weeks.push(week); week = []; }
    }
    if (week.length) weeks.push(week);
    return weeks;
  })();

  const heatColor = (v: number) => {
    if (v === 0) return 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800';
    if (v < 3) return 'bg-cyan-200 dark:bg-cyan-900';
    if (v < 7) return 'bg-cyan-400 dark:bg-cyan-700';
    if (v < 15) return 'bg-cyan-600 dark:bg-cyan-500';
    return 'bg-cyan-800 dark:bg-cyan-300';
  };

  if (loading) return (
    <div className="p-6 flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]">
      <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-cyan-300 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-7 px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 md:py-10">
      {/* Заголовок и табы */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 border-b border-slate-200 pb-7 dark:border-slate-800 md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between">
        <div>
          <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--sf-accent)]">Результаты</p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950 dark:text-slate-50 md:text-4xl">Прогресс</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Повторения, экзамены и активность по дням.</p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-1 rounded-lg w-full md:w-auto select-none">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('platform')}
            className={`relative flex-1 md:px-5 py-2.5 rounded-md text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold transition-colors duration-200 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 select-none ${
              activeTab === 'platform' 
                ? 'text-white'
                : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-300'
            }`}
          >
            {activeTab === 'platform' && (
              <motion.span
                layoutId="activeAnalyticsTab"
                className="absolute inset-0 bg-[var(--sf-accent)] rounded-md -z-10"
                transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 380, damping: 30 }}
              />
            )}
            <span className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-2">
              <BarChart2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>Обучение</span>
            </span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('gradebook')}
            className={`relative flex-1 md:px-5 py-2.5 rounded-md text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold transition-colors duration-200 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 select-none ${
              activeTab === 'gradebook' 
                ? 'text-white'
                : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-300'
            }`}
          >
            {activeTab === 'gradebook' && (
              <motion.span
                layoutId="activeAnalyticsTab"
                className="absolute inset-0 bg-[var(--sf-accent)] rounded-md -z-10"
                transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 380, damping: 30 }}
              />
            )}
            <span className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-2">
              <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>Оценки</span>
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {activeTab === 'gradebook' ? (
        <Gradebook />
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-6 md:space-y-8">
          {/* XP и уровень */}
          <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        className="hidden"
      >
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-0 w-64 h-64 bg-white/5 rounded-full -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/4" />
        <div className="relative">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div>
              <p className="text-indigo-200 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">Уровень {levelInfo.level}</p>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black">{levelInfo.name}</h2>
            </div>
            <div className="text-right">
              <p className="text-3xl font-black">{xp}</p>
              <p className="text-indigo-200 text-xs">всего XP</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex-1 h-2 bg-white/20 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <motion.div
                className="h-full bg-white rounded-full"
                initial={{ width: 0 }}
                animate={{ width: `${levelInfo.progress}%` }}
                transition={{ duration: 1, ease: 'easeOut' }}
              />
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-200 shrink-0">
              {levelInfo.currentXP}/{levelInfo.nextXP} XP
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-indigo-200 text-xs mt-2">до уровня {levelInfo.level + 1}</p>
        </div>
      </motion.div>

      {/* Ключевые метрики */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 md:gap-4">
        {[
          { icon: Flame, label: 'Стрик', value: `${streak} дн.`, colorBg: 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40', colorIcon: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400', sub: 'дней подряд' },
          { icon: Trophy, label: 'Экзаменов', value: exams.length, colorBg: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40', colorIcon: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', sub: 'сдано' },
          { icon: Brain, label: 'Карточек', value: totalCards, colorBg: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40', colorIcon: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', sub: 'повторено' },
          { icon: Target, label: 'Средний балл', value: `${avgExamScore}%`, colorBg: 'bg-cyan-50 dark:bg-cyan-950/40', colorIcon: 'text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300', sub: 'на экзаменах' },
        ].map(({ icon: Icon, label, value, colorBg, colorIcon, sub }) => (
          <motion.div
            key={label}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            className="border-y border-slate-200 p-3 dark:border-slate-800 md:p-4"
          >
            <div className={`w-9 h-9 ${colorBg} rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center mb-3`}>
              <Icon className={`w-5 h-5 ${colorIcon}`} />
            </div>
            <p className="text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">{value}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">{sub}</p>
          </motion.div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Два столбца: график активности + radar */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:gap-6">
        {/* График активности */}
        <div className="border-y border-slate-200 p-4 dark:border-slate-800 md:p-5 overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-300" />
            Активность за 30 дней
          </h3>
          <div style={{ height: 180, minWidth: 280 }}>
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <AreaChart data={activityData}>
                <defs>
                  <linearGradient id="actGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                    <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#22d3ee" stopOpacity={0.35} />
                    <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#22d3ee" stopOpacity={0} />
                  </linearGradient>
                </defs>
                <XAxis dataKey="day" tick={{ fontSize: 10, fill: isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b' }} stroke={isDark ? '#334155' : '#e2e8f0'} interval={4} />
                <YAxis allowDecimals={false} tick={{ fontSize: 10, fill: isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b' }} stroke={isDark ? '#334155' : '#e2e8f0'} />
                <Tooltip
                  contentStyle={{ borderRadius: 8, border: isDark ? '1px solid #334155' : '1px solid #e2e8f0', fontSize: 12, backgroundColor: isDark ? '#1e293b' : '#ffffff', color: isDark ? '#f1f5f9' : '#0f172a' }}
                  formatter={(v: number) => [v, 'Карточек']}
                />
                <Area type="monotone" dataKey="value" stroke="#22d3ee" strokeWidth={2} fill="url(#actGrad)" />
              </AreaChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Профиль навыков */}
        <div className="border-y border-slate-200 p-4 dark:border-slate-800 md:p-5">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Star className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
            Профиль навыков
          </h3>
          <div style={{ height: 180, minWidth: 200 }}>
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <RadarChart data={radarData}>
                <PolarGrid stroke={isDark ? '#334155' : '#e2e8f0'} />
                <PolarAngleAxis dataKey="subject" tick={{ fontSize: 10, fill: isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b' }} />
                <Radar name="Навыки" dataKey="A" stroke="#22d3ee" fill="#22d3ee" fillOpacity={0.16} strokeWidth={2} />
              </RadarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Оценки на экзаменах */}
      <div className="border-y border-slate-200 p-4 dark:border-slate-800 md:p-5 overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar">
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Award className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-500" />
          Динамика оценок на устном экзамене
        </h3>
        {examScoreData.length < 3 ? (
          <div className="h-[160px] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
            <Award className="w-10 h-10 text-slate-200 dark:text-slate-700 mb-2" />
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Недостаточно данных</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">Сдайте еще {3 - examScoreData.length} экзамен(а), чтобы увидеть график</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ height: 160, minWidth: 280 }}>
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <BarChart data={examScoreData}>
                <XAxis dataKey="name" tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b' }} stroke={isDark ? '#334155' : '#e2e8f0'} />
                <YAxis domain={[0, 100]} tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b' }} stroke={isDark ? '#334155' : '#e2e8f0'} />
                <Tooltip
                  cursor={{ fill: isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }}
                  contentStyle={{ borderRadius: 8, border: isDark ? '1px solid #334155' : '1px solid #e2e8f0', fontSize: 12, backgroundColor: isDark ? '#1e293b' : '#ffffff', color: isDark ? '#f1f5f9' : '#0f172a' }}
                  formatter={(v: number, _: unknown, props: unknown) => [
                    `${v}% — ${(props as any).payload.subject || 'Без предмета'}`, 'Балл'
                  ]}
                />
                <Bar
                  dataKey="score"
                  radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]}
                  fill="#22d3ee"
                  label={{ position: 'top', fontSize: 10, fill: isDark ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b', formatter: (v: number) => `${v}%` }}
                />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Тепловая карта */}
      <div className="border-y border-slate-200 p-4 dark:border-slate-800 md:p-5">
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-1 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
          Карта активности (12 недель)
        </h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mb-4">Интенсивность повторения карточек по дням</p>
        <div className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
          {heatmapData.map((week, wi) => (
            <div key={wi} className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              {week.map((day) => (
                <div
                  key={day.date}
                  title={`${day.date}: ${day.value} карточек`}
                  className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-sm ${heatColor(day.value)} transition-all hover:scale-125`}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-3">
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">Меньше</span>
          {[
            'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800',
            'bg-cyan-200 dark:bg-cyan-900',
            'bg-cyan-400 dark:bg-cyan-700',
            'bg-cyan-600 dark:bg-cyan-500',
            'bg-cyan-800 dark:bg-cyan-300'
          ].map(c => (
            <div key={c} className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-sm ${c}`} />
          ))}
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">Больше</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Тепловая карта владения знаниями */}
      <div className="border-y border-slate-200 p-4 dark:border-slate-800 md:p-5">
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-1 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Brain className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-300" />
          Карта владения знаниями по темам
        </h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mb-4">
          Уровень освоения материала на основе устных экзаменов (40%) и повторения карточек (60%)
        </p>

        {knowledgeHeatmap.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-center text-slate-400 text-xs py-8">Темы не найдены. Загрузите материалы в библиотеку.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            {knowledgeHeatmap.map(item => (
              <div
                key={item.id}
                onClick={() => navigate(`/library/${item.id}`)}
                className={`p-3 rounded-xl border cursor-pointer hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col justify-between ${getProficiencyColor(item.score, item.status)}`}
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-2 mb-1">
                    <span className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider opacity-75 truncate max-w-[120px]">
                      {item.subject}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-black shrink-0">
                      {item.status === 'not_started' ? '0%' : `${item.score}%`}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <h4 className="font-bold text-xs line-clamp-2 leading-snug">
                    {item.title}
                  </h4>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] opacity-80 pt-1.5 border-t border-black/5">
                  <span>
                    {item.status === 'not_started' ? 'Не изучалось' : item.score >= 85 ? 'Освоено' : 'В процессе'}
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex gap-2 font-semibold">
                    {item.cardScore !== null && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" /> {item.cardScore}%</span>}
                    {item.examScore !== null && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><GraduationCap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-500" /> {item.examScore}%</span>}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Слабые темы */}
      {mistakeTopics.length > 0 && (
        <div className="card p-4 md:p-5">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <BookMarked className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
            Топ тем с ошибками
          </h3>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {mistakeTopics.map(([topic, count], i) => (
              <div key={topic} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span className="text-xs font-black text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 w-4">{i + 1}</span>
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 truncate">{topic}</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-500 ml-2">{count} ошибок</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-rose-400 rounded-full"
                      style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, (count / (mistakeTopics[0][1])) * 100)}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => navigate('/mistakes')}
                  className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 hover:text-indigo-500 transition"
                >
                  <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Достижения */}
      <div className="card p-4 md:p-5">
        <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Trophy className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
          Достижения ({earnedAchievements.length}/{ACHIEVEMENTS.length})
        </h3>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          {ACHIEVEMENTS.map(ach => {
            const earned = earnedAchievements.includes(ach.id);
            return (
              <div
                key={ach.id}
                className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-center transition-all ${
                  earned
                    ? 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/50 shadow-sm'
                    : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 opacity-40 grayscale'
                }`}
              >
                <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-2 ${
                  earned ? 'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/50' : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800'
                }`}>
                  <Trophy className={`w-5 h-5 ${earned ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600'}`} />
                </div>
                <p className={`text-xs font-bold leading-tight ${earned ? 'text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100' : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400'}`}>
                  {ach.title}
                </p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-0.5 leading-tight">{ach.description}</p>
                {earned && (
                  <span className="mt-1.5 inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold">
                    <Zap className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                    +{ach.xp}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';

import { GraduationCap, Mail, ArrowRight, ShieldCheck, HelpCircle } from 'lucide-react';

export default function ForgotPassword() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleReset = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {
      redirectTo: window.location.origin + '/update-password',
    });
    
    if (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found') || error.message.includes('invalid')) {
        setError('Не удалось найти пользователя с таким email.');
      } else {
        setError('Произошла ошибка при отправке. Попробуйте позже.');
      }

      setSuccess(true);

    <div className="auth-page min-h-screen flex text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
      {/* Left Column: Form */}

          </div>

          {error && (
            <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} className="bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/50 text-rose-600 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium mb-6">
              {error}
            </motion.div>
          )}

          {success ? (
            <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} className="bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900 text-emerald-600 px-4 py-6 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold mb-6 flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-3 shadow-sm shadow-emerald-100 dark:shadow-none">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-1">
                <Mail className="w-6 h-6" />

              <button
                onClick={() => navigate('/login')}
                className="mt-4 w-full py-2.5 px-4 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 rounded-xl text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-100/50 dark:bg-emerald-900/20 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/40 font-bold transition-all"

<file path="frontend/src/pages/HHCallback.tsx">
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { exchangeHHCode } from '../api/career';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export default function HHCallback() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const exchangeCalled = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (exchangeCalled.current) return;
    exchangeCalled.current = true;

    const code = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('code');
    if (!code) {
      toast.error('Код авторизации не найден в URL.');
      navigate('/career', { replace: true });
      return;
    }

    supabase.auth.getSession().then(async ({ data: { session } }) => {
      if (!session) {
        toast.error('Пользователь не авторизован.');
        navigate('/login', { replace: true });
        return;
      }

      let hasCourse = false;
      try {
        const token = session.access_token;
        const res = await exchangeHHCode(code, token);
        if (res.success) {
          toast.success('Аккаунт HeadHunter успешно подключен!');
        } else {
          toast.error(res.message || 'Не удалось связать аккаунт HeadHunter.');
        }
        
        const { data: profileRes } = await supabase
          .from('career_profiles')
          .select('profile_json')
          .eq('user_id', session.user.id)
          .maybeSingle();
          
        if (profileRes?.profile_json?.course) {
          hasCourse = true;
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.error(err);
        toast.error(err.message || 'Ошибка при обмене токенов.');
      } finally {
        if (hasCourse) {
          navigate('/career?tab=jobs', { replace: true });
        } else {
          navigate('/career', { replace: true });
        }
      }
    });
  }, [navigate]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 text-center p-6">
      <div className="relative w-16 h-16 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 border-4 border-indigo-500/20 rounded-full" />
        <div className="absolute inset-0 border-4 border-t-indigo-500 rounded-full animate-spin" />
        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/10 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400 animate-pulse" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1.5 mt-2">
        <h3 className="text-white font-extrabold text-lg">Авторизация HeadHunter</h3>
        <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs max-w-xs leading-relaxed">
          Безопасно сохраняем ваши токены доступа в Meldy. Пожалуйста, не закрывайте вкладку...
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
