<file path="frontend/src/pages/Review.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkMath from 'remark-math';
import rehypeKatex from 'rehype-katex';
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm';
import 'katex/dist/katex.min.css';
import { ArrowLeft, CheckCircle2, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { useSound } from '../hooks/useSound';
import { getDueCards, updateCardProgress } from '../api/flashcards';
import { updateQuestProgress, recordStudyActivity } from '../api/quests';

function CircularProgress({ value, size = 100, strokeWidth = 8, isDark = false }: { value: number; size?: number; strokeWidth?: number; isDark?: boolean }) {
  const radius = (size - strokeWidth) / 2;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const offset = circumference - (value / 100) * circumference;
  const color = value >= 80 ? '#10b981' : value >= 50 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444';
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} className="transform -rotate-90">
      <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius} fill="none" stroke={isDark ? '#334155' : '#e2e8f0'} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} />
      <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius} fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
        strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray={circumference} strokeDashoffset={offset} />
    </svg>
  );
}

export default function Review() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { isDark } = (window as any).__useTheme?.() ?? { isDark: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') };
  const { playFlipSound, playSuccessSound } = useSound();
  const [cards, setCards] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [idx, setIdx] = useState(0);
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(false);
  const [sessionStats, setSessionStats] = useState({ correct: 0, wrong: 0 });
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const processingRef = useRef(false);

  const loadCards = async () => {
    if (!user?.id) {
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setLoadError(null);
    setSaveError(null);
    processingRef.current = false;
    try {
      const data = await getDueCards(user.id);
      setCards(data);
      setIdx(0);
      setRevealed(false);
      setSessionStats({ correct: 0, wrong: 0 });
      setDone(false);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading due cards:', error);
      setCards([]);
      setLoadError('Не удалось загрузить карточки. Проверьте соединение и повторите попытку.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { loadCards(); }, [user?.id]);

  const handleReveal = () => {
    if (!revealed) {
      playFlipSound();
      setRevealed(true);
    }
  };

  const handleAnswer = async (quality: number) => {
    if (!cards[idx] || processingRef.current) return;
    
    const currentCard = cards[idx];
    processingRef.current = true;
    setProcessing(true);
    setSaveError(null);

    try {
      if (!currentCard.id) throw new Error('Review card is missing its database id.');
      await updateCardProgress(currentCard.id, quality);

      if (quality >= 3) {
        setSessionStats(p => ({ ...p, correct: p.correct + 1 }));
      } else {
        setSessionStats(p => ({ ...p, wrong: p.wrong + 1 }));
      }

      if (idx + 1 >= cards.length) {
        playSuccessSound();
        setDone(true);
      } else {
        setIdx(p => p + 1);
        setRevealed(false);
      }

      if (user?.id) {
        updateQuestProgress(user.id, 'review', 1).catch(err => console.error('Error updating quest progress:', err));
        recordStudyActivity(user.id, 1, 0).catch(err => console.error('Error recording study activity:', err));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error saving card progress:', error);
      setSaveError('Ответ не сохранён. Проверьте соединение и попробуйте ещё раз.');
    } finally {
      processingRef.current = false;
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return (
    <div className="p-4 md:p-6 flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]">
      <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-cyan-300 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
    </div>
  );

  if (loadError) return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl px-4 py-16 text-center md:py-24">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-3">Не удалось загрузить карточки</h2>
      <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 mb-6">{loadError}</p>
      <button onClick={loadCards} className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-cyan-300 hover:bg-cyan-200 text-slate-950 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition-colors">
        Повторить загрузку
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  // No cards due
  if (cards.length === 0) return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl px-4 py-16 text-center md:py-24">
      <CheckCircle2 className="w-16 h-16 text-emerald-500 mx-auto mb-4" />
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2">На сегодня всё</h2>
      <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-6">Карточек с наступившим сроком повторения нет.</p>
      <div className="flex justify-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/library')} className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-cyan-300 hover:bg-cyan-200 text-slate-950 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition-colors">
          В библиотеку
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/analyze')} className="px-5 py-2 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition">
          Новый анализ
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  // Session done
  if (done) {
    const total = sessionStats.correct + sessionStats.wrong;
    const pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((sessionStats.correct / total) * 100) : 0;
    const darkMode = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl px-4 py-16 text-center md:py-24">
        <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300">Результат</p>
        <h2 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-6">Сессия завершена</h2>
        <div className="relative inline-block mb-4">
          <CircularProgress value={pct} size={120} strokeWidth={10} isDark={darkMode} />
          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
            <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{pct}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Правильно: <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{sessionStats.correct}</span> из {total}</p>
        <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm mb-8">Ответы сохранены. Если карточки ещё остались, продолжите следующей группой.</p>
        <div className="flex justify-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
          <button onClick={loadCards} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 bg-cyan-300 hover:bg-cyan-200 text-slate-950 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition-colors">
            <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />Продолжить повторение
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => navigate('/dashboard')} className="px-5 py-2 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition">
            На главную
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const card = cards[idx];

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto max-w-3xl px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 md:py-10">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => navigate('/dashboard')} className="mb-7 inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-100">
        <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Сегодня
      </button>
      {/* Progress bar */}
      <div className="mb-6">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-2">
          <span>{idx + 1} / {cards.length} карточек</span>
          <span>{sessionStats.correct} ✓ · {sessionStats.wrong} ✗</span>
        </div>
        <div className="h-1 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 overflow-hidden">
          <div className="h-full bg-cyan-400 transition-all" style={{ width: `${((idx + 1) / cards.length) * 100}%` }} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Card */}
      <motion.div
        key={idx}
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
        className="min-h-[340px] p-6 md:p-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer relative active:scale-[0.995] transition border-y border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white/40 dark:bg-slate-900/20"
        onClick={handleReveal}
      >
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300 tracking-[0.1em] mb-5">Вопрос</span>
        <div className="text-lg sm:text-xl md:text-2xl font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-center leading-snug max-w-xl px-2 mb-6 markdown-content">
          <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath, remarkGfm]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>{card.question}</ReactMarkdown>
        </div>

        {revealed && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: [0.4, 0, 0.2, 1] }}
            style={{ overflow: 'hidden' }}
            className="w-full border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 pt-6 mt-2"
          >
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 tracking-[0.1em] mb-3 block text-center">Ответ</span>
            <div className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-sm sm:text-base md:text-lg text-center leading-relaxed max-w-xl mx-auto px-2 whitespace-pre-line markdown-content">
              <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath, remarkGfm]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>{card.answer}</ReactMarkdown>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {!revealed && (
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-4 animate-pulse font-medium">Нажмите, чтобы открыть ответ</p>
        )}
      </motion.div>

      {/* Actions */}
      <div className="mt-6" aria-busy={processing}>
        {!revealed ? (
          <button
            onClick={handleReveal}
            className="w-full h-14 bg-cyan-300 hover:bg-cyan-200 active:bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-colors text-base"
          >
            Показать ответ
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 md:gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={() => handleAnswer(1)}
              disabled={processing}
              className="h-14 md:h-12 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/60 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/50 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 rounded-xl font-medium transition text-sm disabled:cursor-wait disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              Не помню
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleAnswer(3)}
              disabled={processing}
              className="h-14 md:h-12 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:hover:bg-amber-950/60 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/50 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 rounded-xl font-medium transition text-sm disabled:cursor-wait disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              С трудом
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleAnswer(5)}
              disabled={processing}
              className="h-14 md:h-12 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-xl font-medium transition text-sm disabled:cursor-wait disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              Знаю
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        {processing && <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="mt-3 text-center text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">Сохраняем ответ…</p>}
        {saveError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-center text-sm text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300">{saveError}</p>}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/pages/StudySession.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkMath from 'remark-math';
import rehypeKatex from 'rehype-katex';
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm';
import 'katex/dist/katex.min.css';
import {
  Brain, BookOpen, GraduationCap, Flame, ChevronRight, Zap, Play, Trophy,
  Sparkles, X, Heart, HelpCircle, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, RefreshCw, Send,
  ArrowRight, MessageSquare, Layers, Award
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { useSound } from '../hooks/useSound';
import { getDueCards, updateCardProgress } from '../api/flashcards';
import { getMaterials, updateMaterialMissions } from '../api/materials';
import { addXP, recordStudyActivity, updateQuestProgress, checkAndAwardAchievements } from '../api/quests';
import { incrementAIUsage } from '../api/limits';
import ConfettiCelebration from '../components/ConfettiCelebration';
import AchievementToast from '../components/AchievementToast';
import type { Achievement } from '../components/AchievementToast';

interface Flashcard {
  id?: string;
  question: string;
  answer: string;
  isMock?: boolean;
}

interface TestQuestion {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  explanation: string;
  question: string;
  options: string[];
  correct: string;
  hint: string;
}

interface ChatMessage {
  role: 'user' | 'assistant';
  content: string;
}

export default function StudySession() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { playFlipSound, playSuccessSound, playErrorSound, playXpSound } = useSound();

  const formatMessageContent = (content: string) => {
    // Автоматически форматирует английские ключевые слова в одинарных кавычках (например, 'GROUP BY') в маркдаун-бэктэки для красивого кода
    return content.replace(/'([A-Z0-9_ ]+)'/g, '`$1`');
  };

  // Состояния загрузки
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [activeMaterial, setActiveMaterial] = useState<any | null>(null);
  
  // Текущая фаза: 'setup' | 'cards' | 'read' | 'quiz' | 'completed'
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'setup' | 'cards' | 'read' | 'quiz' | 'completed'>('setup');
  
  // Шаг 1: Карточки
  const [sessionCards, setSessionCards] = useState<Flashcard[]>([]);
  const [cardIdx, setCardIdx] = useState(0);
  const [cardRevealed, setCardRevealed] = useState(false);
  const [cardStats, setCardStats] = useState({ correct: 0, wrong: 0 });
  const [cardProcessing, setCardProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [cardSaveError, setCardSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const cardProcessingRef = useRef(false);

  // Шаг 2: Чтение + Чат
  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);
  const [inputMessage, setInputMessage] = useState('');
  const [chatLoading, setChatLoading] = useState(false);
  const chatEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Шаг 3: Тест
  const [testQuestions, setTestQuestions] = useState<TestQuestion[]>([]);
  const [quizIdx, setQuizIdx] = useState(0);
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isCorrect, setIsCorrect] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [showHint, setShowHint] = useState(false);
  const [shake, setShake] = useState(false);
  const [quizScore, setQuizScore] = useState(0);

  // Награды и финал
  const [showConfetti, setShowConfetti] = useState(false);
  const [achievement, setAchievement] = useState<Achievement | null>(null);
  const [xpGained, setXpGained] = useState(0);

  // Скролл чата
  useEffect(() => {
    chatEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [chatMessages]);

  // Первоначальная загрузка
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    setLoading(true);
    
    Promise.all([
      getMaterials(user.id),
      getDueCards(user.id)
    ]).then(([mats, cards]) => {
      setMaterials(mats);
      
      if (mats.length === 0) {
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      // Проверяем наличие незавершенной сохраненной сессии в localStorage
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`study_session_${user.id}`);
      if (saved) {
        try {
          const data = JSON.parse(saved);
          const matExists = mats.some(m => m.id === data.activeMaterial?.id);
          if (matExists && data.phase !== 'completed') {
            setPhase(data.phase);
            setCardIdx(data.cardIdx);
            setCardStats(data.cardStats);
            setChatMessages(data.chatMessages);
            setQuizIdx(data.quizIdx);
            setQuizScore(data.quizScore);
            setActiveMaterial(data.activeMaterial);
            setSessionCards(data.sessionCards);
            setTestQuestions(data.testQuestions);
            setXpGained(data.xpGained);
            setSelectedOption(data.selectedOption);
            setIsCorrect(data.isCorrect);
            setShowHint(data.showHint);
            setLoading(false);
            return; // Восстанавливаем состояние и прерываем стандартную инициализацию
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Ошибка при восстановлении сессии:", e);
        }
      }

      // Выбираем активный материал
      const mat = mats[0];
      setActiveMaterial(mat);

      // Готовим карточки для сессии (Шаг 1)
      let preparedCards: Flashcard[] = [];
      const relatedDueCards = cards.filter(c => c.material_id === mat.id);
      
      if (relatedDueCards.length > 0) {
        // Берем просроченные карточки именно по этой лекции
        preparedCards = relatedDueCards.slice(0, 10);
      } else if (cards.length > 0) {
        // Если по ней нет, берем любые просроченные
        preparedCards = cards.slice(0, 10);
      } else if (mat.flashcards_json && mat.flashcards_json.length > 0) {
        // Если просроченных карточек 0 вообще, берем из кэша лекции (как тренировку)
        preparedCards = mat.flashcards_json.slice(0, 5).map((c: any) => ({
          question: c.question,
          answer: c.answer,
          isMock: true
        }));
      }

      setSessionCards(preparedCards);
      
      // Инициализируем сообщения чата (Шаг 2)
      setChatMessages([
        {
          role: 'assistant',
          content: `Привет, ${user?.user_metadata?.full_name || 'друг'}! Я Meldy 🤖, твой персональный наставник.

Я подготовил сессию по теме **«${mat.title}»**. 

Мы начнем с тренировки ${preparedCards.length} карточек для укрепления памяти, затем разберем выжимку теории, а в конце проверим знания коротким квестом из 3-х вопросов. 

За прохождение ты получишь **+50 XP** и продвинешь свой стрик дней 🔥. Начнем?`
        }
      ]);

      // Подгружаем квесты/миссии для теста (Шаг 3)
      if (mat.missions_json?.missions && mat.missions_json.missions.length > 0) {
        setTestQuestions(mat.missions_json.missions.slice(0, 3));
      } else {
        // Сгенерируем позже, если кэша нет
      }
    })
    .catch(console.error)
    .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [user?.id]);

  // Автоматическое сохранение состояния сессии в localStorage при изменениях
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.id || loading || phase === 'completed') return;
    
    const sessionData = {
      phase,
      cardIdx,
      cardStats,
      chatMessages,
      quizIdx,
      quizScore,
      activeMaterial,
      sessionCards,
      testQuestions,
      xpGained,
      selectedOption,
      isCorrect,
      showHint
    };
    
    localStorage.setItem(`study_session_${user.id}`, JSON.stringify(sessionData));
  }, [
    user?.id, phase, cardIdx, cardStats, chatMessages, quizIdx, 
    quizScore, activeMaterial, sessionCards, testQuestions, 
    xpGained, selectedOption, isCorrect, showHint, loading
  ]);

  // Генерация миссий на лету (если не кэшировано)
  const ensureQuizLoaded = async (mat: any) => {
    if (testQuestions.length > 0) return true;
    
    try {
      const summary = typeof mat.summary_json === 'string'
        ? mat.summary_json
        : (mat.summary_json?.content || '');
      const context = (mat.original_text || summary || '').slice(0, 15000);

      const res = await fetch('/api/missions/generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ context })
      });

      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Ошибка генерации');
      const data = await res.json();
      
      if (data.missions && data.missions.length > 0) {
        const sliced = data.missions.slice(0, 3);
        setTestQuestions(sliced);
        updateMaterialMissions(mat.id, data.missions);
        if (user?.id) {
          await incrementAIUsage(user.id, 2);
        }
        return true;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Ошибка генерации викторины:', e);
    }
    return false;
  };

  const handleStart = () => {
    if (sessionCards.length > 0) {
      setPhase('cards');
    } else {
      setPhase('read');
    }
  };

  // ── ШАГ 1: КАРТОЧКИ ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const handleRevealCard = () => {
    if (!cardRevealed) {
      playFlipSound();
      setCardRevealed(true);
    }
  };

  const handleCardAnswer = async (quality: number) => {
    if (!sessionCards[cardIdx] || cardProcessingRef.current) return;
    
    const card = sessionCards[cardIdx];
    cardProcessingRef.current = true;
    setCardProcessing(true);
    setCardSaveError(null);

    try {
      if (card.id && !card.isMock) {
        await updateCardProgress(card.id, quality);
      } else if (!card.isMock) {
        throw new Error('Study card is missing its database id.');
      }

      if (quality >= 3) {
        setCardStats(p => ({ ...p, correct: p.correct + 1 }));
      } else {
        setCardStats(p => ({ ...p, wrong: p.wrong + 1 }));
      }

      if (cardIdx + 1 >= sessionCards.length) {
        playSuccessSound();
        setPhase('read');
      } else {
        setCardIdx(p => p + 1);
        setCardRevealed(false);
      }

      if (user?.id) {
        updateQuestProgress(user.id, 'review', 1).catch(err => console.error('Error updating quest progress:', err));
        recordStudyActivity(user.id, 1, 0).catch(err => console.error('Error recording study activity:', err));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error saving card progress:', error);
      setCardSaveError('Ответ не сохранён. Проверьте соединение и попробуйте ещё раз.');
    } finally {
      cardProcessingRef.current = false;
      setCardProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // ── ШАГ 2: ЧАТ С AI ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const handleSendMessage = async (customText?: string) => {
    const textToSend = (customText || inputMessage).trim();
    if (!textToSend || chatLoading || !activeMaterial) return;

    setInputMessage('');
    setChatLoading(true);

    const newUserMessage: ChatMessage = { role: 'user', content: textToSend };
    setChatMessages(prev => [...prev, newUserMessage]);

    const summary = typeof activeMaterial.summary_json === 'string'
      ? activeMaterial.summary_json
      : (activeMaterial.summary_json?.content || '');
    const context = (activeMaterial.original_text || summary || '').slice(0, 15000);

    try {
      if (user?.id) {
        await incrementAIUsage(user.id, 1);
      }

      const res = await fetch('/api/chat', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: textToSend,
          context,
          history: chatMessages.slice(-8).map(m => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content }))
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Ошибка чата');
      const data = await res.json();
      
      setChatMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: 'assistant', content: data.reply }]);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setChatMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: 'assistant', content: 'Ой, что-то пошло не так с сервером ИИ. Давай я подготовлю квест!' }]);
    } finally {
      setChatLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleGoToQuiz = async () => {
    if (!activeMaterial) return;
    setLoading(true);
    const ok = await ensureQuizLoaded(activeMaterial);
    setLoading(false);

    if (ok || testQuestions.length > 0) {
      setPhase('quiz');
      setSelectedOption(null);
      setIsCorrect(null);
      setShowHint(false);
      setQuizIdx(0);
      setQuizScore(0);
    } else {
      // Если генерация теста полностью упала, завершаем сессию
      handleFinishSession();
    }
  };

  // ── ШАГ 3: ВИКТОРИНА ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const handleOptionClick = (option: string) => {
    if (isCorrect) return;

    setSelectedOption(option);
    const currentQ = testQuestions[quizIdx];
    const correctLetter = currentQ.correct;
    const isCorrectAnswer = option.startsWith(correctLetter);

    if (isCorrectAnswer) {
      setIsCorrect(true);
      setShowHint(false);
      setQuizScore(s => s + 1);
    } else {
      setIsCorrect(false);
      setShowHint(true);
      setShake(true);
      playErrorSound();
      setTimeout(() => setShake(false), 500);
    }
  };

  const handleNextQuiz = () => {
    setSelectedOption(null);
    setIsCorrect(null);
    setShowHint(false);

    if (quizIdx + 1 >= testQuestions.length) {
      handleFinishSession();
    } else {
      setQuizIdx(prev => prev + 1);
    }
  };

  // ── ФИНАЛ: ЗАВЕРШЕНИЕ СЕССИИ ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  const handleFinishSession = async () => {
    setPhase('completed');
    setShowConfetti(true);
    playSuccessSound();

    if (user?.id) {
      localStorage.removeItem(`study_session_${user.id}`);
      try {
        // Начисляем XP (+50 за всю сессию + по 10 за каждый верный ответ)
        const earnedXP = 50 + quizScore * 10;
        setXpGained(earnedXP);
        await addXP(user.id, earnedXP);
        playXpSound();

        // Записываем завершение квестов/активности
        await updateQuestProgress(user.id, 'quiz', 1);
        await recordStudyActivity(user.id, sessionCards.length, 0);

        // Проверяем новые достижения
        const newAchs = await checkAndAwardAchievements(user.id);
        if (newAchs.length > 0) {
          setAchievement({
            id: newAchs[0].id,
            title: newAchs[0].title,
            description: newAchs[0].description,
            icon: newAchs[0].icon,
            xp: newAchs[0].xp
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
      }
    }
    setTimeout(() => setShowConfetti(false), 3000);
  };

  if (loading) return (
    <div className="p-6 flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]">
      <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
    </div>
  );

  if (materials.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="p-4 md:p-6 text-center py-20 max-w-md mx-auto space-y-4">
        <AlertCircle className="w-16 h-16 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700 mx-auto" />
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">Библиотека пуста</h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          Загрузи свой первый конспект или лекцию, и Meldy составит план учебной сессии.
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={() => navigate('/analyze')}
          className="w-full py-3 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-sm transition"
        >
          Загрузить первый материал 🚀
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const summaryText = typeof activeMaterial?.summary_json === 'string'
    ? activeMaterial.summary_json
    : (activeMaterial?.summary_json?.content || '');

  return (
    <div className="p-3 md:p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-center relative w-full">
      <ConfettiCelebration trigger={showConfetti} type="quest" />
      <AchievementToast achievement={achievement} onClose={() => setAchievement(null)} />

      {/* ── КНОПКА ЗАКРЫТИЯ ── */}
      {phase !== 'completed' && (
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (confirm('Вы уверены, что хотите выйти из сессии обучения? Прогресс будет утерян.')) {
              localStorage.removeItem(`study_session_${user?.id}`);
              navigate('/dashboard');
            }
          }}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 transition z-40"
        >
          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      )}

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        
        {/* ═══ ФАЗА: SETUP ═══ */}
        {phase === 'setup' && (
          <motion.div
            key="setup"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 15 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -15 }}
            className="card p-6 md:p-10 text-center relative z-20 space-y-8 max-w-2xl mx-auto shadow-xl"
          >
            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-purple-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-lg text-white text-3xl animate-pulse">
              🔮
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <h2 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 tracking-tight leading-tight">Персональная сессия готовит тебя к победам!</h2>
              <p className="text-base md:text-lg text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 max-w-lg mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                Давай закрепим тему <strong className="font-black text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">«{activeMaterial?.title}»</strong> по методу глубокого погружения.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Карточка планов */}
            <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto text-left bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-800/50 rounded-2xl p-7 space-y-6 shadow-inner">
              <h3 className="font-black text-sm md:text-base text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-widest">План урока сегодня:</h3>
              <div className="space-y-5">
                {sessionCards.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-sm md:text-base shrink-0">1</div>
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-base md:text-lg font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">Разминка с карточками ({sessionCards.length} шт)</p>
                      <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">Интервальное повторение по алгоритму SM-2</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-sm md:text-base shrink-0">{sessionCards.length > 0 ? '2' : '1'}</div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-base md:text-lg font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">Изучение выжимки лекции с AI</p>
                    <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">Краткий конспект и свободные вопросы наставнику</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-sm md:text-base shrink-0">{sessionCards.length > 0 ? '3' : '2'}</div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-base md:text-lg font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">Проверочный мини-квест</p>
                    <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">3 вопроса на усвоение с разбором ошибок</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="max-w-md mx-auto pt-2">
              <button
                onClick={handleStart}
                className="w-full py-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-purple-600 hover:from-indigo-500 hover:to-purple-500 text-white rounded-xl font-extrabold hover:shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20 tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition active:scale-[0.99] text-base"
              >
                Поехали! 🚀
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {/* ═══ ФАЗА: КАРТОЧКИ (Шаг 1) ═══ */}
        {phase === 'cards' && sessionCards.length > 0 && (
          <motion.div
            key="cards"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.98 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="space-y-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto w-full"
          >
            {/* Шкала шагов */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold mb-2">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Brain className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500 animate-pulse" /> Шаг 1 из 3 · Повторение карточек</span>
              <span>{cardIdx + 1} / {sessionCards.length}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div className="h-full bg-indigo-500 rounded-full transition-all duration-300" style={{ width: `${(cardIdx / sessionCards.length) * 100}%` }} />
            </div>

            {/* Карточка */}
            <motion.div
              key={cardIdx}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
              className="card min-h-[300px] md:min-h-[360px] p-8 md:p-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer relative active:scale-[0.99] transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md"
              onClick={handleRevealCard}
            >
              {sessionCards[cardIdx].isMock && (
                <span className="absolute top-4 left-4 px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-md text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Разминка
                </span>
              )}
              <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-black uppercase text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400 tracking-wider mb-3">Вопрос</span>
              <div className="text-lg sm:text-xl md:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-center leading-snug max-w-xl px-2 mb-6 markdown-content">
                <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath, remarkGfm]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>{sessionCards[cardIdx].question}</ReactMarkdown>
              </div>

              <AnimatePresence>
                {cardRevealed && (
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: [0.4, 0, 0.2, 1] }}
                    style={{ overflow: 'hidden' }}
                    className="w-full border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 pt-6 mt-2"
                  >
                    <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-black uppercase text-emerald-500 tracking-wider mb-3 block text-center">Ответ</span>
                    <div className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-sm sm:text-base md:text-lg font-semibold text-center leading-relaxed max-w-xl mx-auto px-2 whitespace-pre-line markdown-content">
                      <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath, remarkGfm]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>{sessionCards[cardIdx].answer}</ReactMarkdown>
                    </div>
                  </motion.div>
                )}
              </AnimatePresence>

              {!cardRevealed && (
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-4 animate-pulse font-medium">Нажмите, чтобы открыть ответ</p>
              )}
            </motion.div>

            {/* Управление */}
            <div className="pt-3" aria-busy={cardProcessing}>
              {!cardRevealed ? (
                <button
                  onClick={handleRevealCard}
                  className="w-full h-14 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 active:bg-indigo-800 text-white rounded-xl font-bold transition text-sm md:text-base tracking-wide shadow-md flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-indigo-500/10 active:scale-[0.99]"
                >
                  Показать ответ
                </button>
              ) : (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleCardAnswer(1)}
                    disabled={cardProcessing}
                    className="h-14 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/40 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm active:scale-[0.98] disabled:cursor-wait disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    <span>Не знал 😕</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleCardAnswer(3)}
                    disabled={cardProcessing}
                    className="h-14 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:hover:bg-amber-950/50 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/40 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm active:scale-[0.98] disabled:cursor-wait disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    <span>Затруднялся 🤔</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleCardAnswer(5)}
                    disabled={cardProcessing}
                    className="h-14 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/50 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm active:scale-[0.98] disabled:cursor-wait disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    <span>Знал! 😎</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
              {cardProcessing && <p role="status" aria-live="polite" className="mt-3 text-center text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">Сохраняем ответ…</p>}
              {cardSaveError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-center text-sm text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300">{cardSaveError}</p>}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {/* ═══ ФАЗА: ЧТЕНИЕ И AI ЧАТ (Шаг 2) ═══ */}
        {phase === 'read' && (
          <motion.div
            key="read"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.98 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 w-full"
          >
            {/* Заголовок сверху на всю ширину */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-12 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500" /> Шаг 2 из 3 · Разбор Лекции</span>
                <span>Теория + Консультация</span>
              </div>
              <div className="h-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                <div className="h-full bg-indigo-500 rounded-full transition-all duration-300" style={{ width: '66.6%' }} />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Сам конспект лекции (Левая колонка) */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col space-y-4">
              <div className="card p-6 md:p-8 flex-1 flex flex-col max-h-[60vh] lg:max-h-[530px] overflow-hidden">
                <h3 className="font-black text-lg md:text-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
                  📖 Выжимка теории: {activeMaterial?.title}
                </h3>
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-2 custom-scrollbar text-sm md:text-base text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed space-y-4 markdown-content">
                  {summaryText ? (
                    <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath, remarkGfm]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>{summaryText}</ReactMarkdown>
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm italic">Конспект не содержит краткого содержания. Спроси Meldy ниже!</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Чат с наставником Meldy (правая колонка) */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col space-y-4">
              <div className="card p-6 flex flex-col h-[50vh] lg:h-[470px] overflow-hidden bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-800 shadow-xl">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3 mb-3 shrink-0">
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-lg">🤖</div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-black text-white leading-none">ИИ-наставник Meldy</h4>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                      <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-emerald-400 rounded-full animate-ping shrink-0" />
                      Онлайн в твоем уроке
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Сообщения чата */}
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-1 space-y-3 pr-2 custom-scrollbar text-sm leading-relaxed">
                  {chatMessages.map((msg, index) => (
                    <div
                      key={index}
                      className={`flex ${msg.role === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}
                    >
                      <div
                        className={`max-w-[85%] px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl ${
                          msg.role === 'user'
                            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-tr-none'
                            : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-200 rounded-tl-none border border-slate-700/40'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="whitespace-pre-wrap markdown-content text-sm text-left">
                          <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath, remarkGfm]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>
                            {formatMessageContent(msg.content)}
                          </ReactMarkdown>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  {chatLoading && (
                    <div className="flex justify-start">
                      <div className="bg-slate-800/50 text-slate-400 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl rounded-tl-none border border-slate-700/40 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-slate-400 rounded-full animate-bounce" />
                        <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-slate-400 rounded-full animate-bounce [animation-delay:0.2s]" />
                        <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-slate-400 rounded-full animate-bounce [animation-delay:0.4s]" />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div ref={chatEndRef} />
                </div>

                {/* Быстрые подсказки-таблетки */}
                <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 shrink-0 select-none custom-scrollbar">
                  {[
                    'Объясни на примерах',
                    '3 главных вывода',
                    'Где применить в жизни?'
                  ].map(pill => (
                    <button
                      key={pill}
                      disabled={chatLoading}
                      onClick={() => handleSendMessage(pill)}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs text-indigo-300 font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition disabled:opacity-50 shrink-0 active:scale-[0.98]"
                    >
                      {pill}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>

                {/* Ввод сообщения */}
                <form
                  onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleSendMessage(); }}
                  className="flex gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 shrink-0"
                >
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={inputMessage}
                    onChange={e => setInputMessage(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Задай вопрос по лекции..."
                    disabled={chatLoading}
                    className="flex-1 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 focus:border-indigo-500 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none transition"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={chatLoading || !inputMessage.trim()}
                    className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:opacity-40 text-white flex items-center justify-center transition shrink-0 active:scale-[0.96]"
                  >
                    <Send className="w-4.5 h-4.5" />
                  </button>
                </form>
              </div>

              {/* Кнопка далее */}
              <button
                onClick={handleGoToQuiz}
                className="w-full py-3.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-md"
              >
                Всё понял, к мини-тесту! <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {/* ═══ ФАЗА: ТЕСТ (Шаг 3) ═══ */}
        {phase === 'quiz' && (
          <motion.div
            key="quiz"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.98 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="space-y-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto w-full px-2 md:px-4"
          >
            {/* Шкала викторины */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold mb-1">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><HelpCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" /> Шаг 3 из 3 · Проверочный квест</span>
              <span>{quizIdx + 1} / {testQuestions.length} вопросов</span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div className="h-full bg-indigo-500 rounded-full transition-all duration-300" style={{ width: `${((quizIdx) / testQuestions.length) * 100}%` }} />
            </div>

            {/* Карточка квеста */}
            {testQuestions.length > 0 ? (
              <motion.div
                animate={shake ? { x: [-10, 10, -10, 10, 0] } : {}}
                transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
                className="card p-4 md:p-6 space-y-4 shadow-md"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/20 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Миссия {quizIdx + 1}: {testQuestions[quizIdx].title}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="text-base sm:text-lg md:text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-50 leading-snug markdown-content">
                  <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath, remarkGfm]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>{testQuestions[quizIdx].question}</ReactMarkdown>
                </div>

                {/* Варианты ответов */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 pt-2">
                  {testQuestions[quizIdx].options.map((opt) => {
                    const isThisSelected = selectedOption === opt;
                    const isCorrectAnswer = opt.startsWith(testQuestions[quizIdx].correct);

                    let btnStyle = "bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800";
                    
                    if (selectedOption) {
                      if (isThisSelected) {
                        btnStyle = isCorrectAnswer
                          ? "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/20 font-bold"
                          : "bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 ring-2 ring-rose-500/20 font-bold";
                      } else if (isCorrectAnswer && !isCorrect) {
                        btnStyle = "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 opacity-60";
                      } else {
                        btnStyle = "bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border-transparent text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 opacity-40 cursor-default";
                      }
                    }

                    return (
                      <button
                        key={opt}
                        onClick={() => handleOptionClick(opt)}
                        disabled={isCorrect === true}
                        className={`w-full px-5 py-4 rounded-xl border text-left text-sm sm:text-base font-black transition-all duration-200 flex justify-between items-center ${btnStyle}`}
                      >
                        <span>{opt}</span>
                        {selectedOption && isThisSelected && (
                          isCorrectAnswer
                            ? <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                            : <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-500 shrink-0" />
                        )}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                {/* Подсказки и комментарии */}
                <AnimatePresence>
                  {showHint && testQuestions[quizIdx].hint && (
                    <motion.div
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                      exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                      style={{ overflow: 'hidden' }}
                      className="bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/40 rounded-xl mt-3"
                    >
                      <div className="p-3.5 flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">
                        <AlertCircle className="w-4.5 h-4.5 shrink-0 text-amber-500 mt-0.5" />
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-extrabold block mb-0.5">💡 Подсказка Meldy:</span>
                          <div className="mb-2 markdown-content text-xs md:text-sm">
                            <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath, remarkGfm]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>
                              {testQuestions[quizIdx].hint}
                            </ReactMarkdown>
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider font-extrabold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/60 inline-block animate-pulse">
                            👉 Выберите другой вариант
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </motion.div>
                  )}
                </AnimatePresence>

                {/* Кнопка перехода к следующему */}
                {isCorrect && (
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    className="pt-2"
                  >
                    <button
                      onClick={handleNextQuiz}
                      className="w-full py-3.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-md"
                    >
                      {quizIdx + 1 >= testQuestions.length ? 'Завершить урок 🎉' : 'К следующей миссии →'}
                    </button>
                  </motion.div>
                )}
              </motion.div>
            ) : (
              <div className="card p-8 text-center space-y-4">
                <RefreshCw className="w-10 h-10 text-indigo-500 animate-spin mx-auto" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">Создаем проверочный тест по лекции...</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Meldy превратит сложные термины в короткую викторину</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {/* ═══ ФАЗА: COMPLETED (Урок завершен) ═══ */}
        {phase === 'completed' && (
          <motion.div
            key="completed"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="card p-5 md:p-10 text-center bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 to-teal-50 dark:from-slate-900/30 dark:to-teal-950/20 border-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-64 h-64 bg-indigo-500/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
            <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-64 h-64 bg-teal-500/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

            {/* Кубок */}
            <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-indigo-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6 text-white shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden">
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/10 rounded-full scale-90 border border-dashed border-white/50 animate-spin-slow" />
              <Trophy className="w-10 h-10 animate-bounce" />
            </div>

            <h2 className="text-3xl font-black text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-300 mb-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5">
              Дневная сессия завершена!
              <Sparkles className="w-7 h-7 text-amber-500 animate-pulse" />
            </h2>
            
            <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm md:text-base max-w-lg mx-auto mb-6 leading-relaxed">
              Отличная работа! Ты успешно прошёл интервальное повторение, проработал теорию лекции <strong className="font-extrabold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">«{activeMaterial?.title}»</strong> и ответил на проверочные вопросы. Твой стрик дней под защитой 🔥!
            </p>

            {/* Награды */}
            <div className="flex justify-center gap-4 flex-wrap mb-8">
              <div className="bg-indigo-600 text-white font-extrabold px-6 py-3.5 rounded-2xl shadow-md flex items-center gap-2 border border-indigo-500/40">
                <Sparkles className="w-4.5 h-4.5 text-amber-300 animate-pulse" />
                <span className="text-sm tracking-wider">НАГРАДА: +{xpGained} XP</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-orange-500 text-white font-extrabold px-6 py-3.5 rounded-2xl shadow-md flex items-center gap-2 border border-orange-400/40">
                <Flame className="w-4.5 h-4.5 text-white animate-pulse" />
                <span className="text-sm tracking-wider">СТРИК ПОДТВЕРЖДЕН 🔥</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Управление */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 justify-center max-w-sm mx-auto">
              <button
                onClick={() => navigate('/dashboard')}
                className="flex-1 py-3.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20"
              >
                На дашборд
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  if (user?.id) {
                    localStorage.removeItem(`study_session_${user.id}`);
                  }
                  setPhase('setup');
                  setCardIdx(0);
                  setCardRevealed(false);
                  setCardStats({ correct: 0, wrong: 0 });
                  setQuizIdx(0);
                  setQuizScore(0);
                  setSelectedOption(null);
                  setIsCorrect(null);
                }}
                className="px-6 py-3.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl font-bold hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition"
              >
                Пройти ещё раз ⚡
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/pages/TeacherDashboard.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { getTeacherGroups, getStudentGroups, getGroupMembers, getGroupWeeklyScores, createGroup, getGroupAssignments, createAssignment, Group, GroupMember, Assignment, toggleAssignmentCompletion, getStudentCompletions, getGroupCompletions, deleteGroup, removeStudentFromGroup, updateStudentNickname, deleteAssignment } from '../api/groups';
import { getPublicProfiles } from '../api/social';
import { getMaterials } from '../api/materials';
import { Material } from '../types';
import { Users, Plus, Key, Calendar, BookOpen, AlertCircle, TrendingUp, Award, Trophy, Medal, Crown, ShieldAlert, GraduationCap, Check, Backpack, CheckCircle2, Trash2, Edit2, UserMinus, MessageSquare } from 'lucide-react';

// Функция получения участников группы с подсчетом недельного XP
async function getGroupMembersWithWeeklyXP(groupId: string): Promise<GroupMember[]> {
  const [membersData, weeklyScores] = await Promise.all([
    getGroupMembers(groupId),
    getGroupWeeklyScores(groupId),
  ]);
  if (!membersData.length) return [];
  const weeklyScoreMap = new Map(weeklyScores.map(score => [score.student_id, score.weekly_xp]));

  return membersData.map(m => {
    return {
      ...m,
      total_xp: m.total_xp || 0,
      weekly_xp: weeklyScoreMap.get(m.student_id) || 0
    };
  });
}

export default function TeacherDashboard() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  
  // Роль пользователя
  const [role, setRole] = useState<'student' | 'teacher' | null>(() => {
    if (user) {
      return (localStorage.getItem(`user_role_${user.id}`) as 'student' | 'teacher') || null;
    }
    return null;
  });
  const [teacherName, setTeacherName] = useState('Загрузка...');

  // Группы
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState<Group[]>([]);
  const [selectedGroupId, setSelectedGroupId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<GroupMember[]>([]);
  const [assignments, setAssignments] = useState<Assignment[]>([]);
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState<Material[]>([]);
  const [completedAssignments, setCompletedAssignments] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [groupCompletions, setGroupCompletions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  
  // Создание класса
  const [showCreateGroup, setShowCreateGroup] = useState(false);
  const [newGroupName, setNewGroupName] = useState('');
  
  // Назначение материала
  const [showAssignModal, setShowAssignModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedMaterial, setSelectedMaterial] = useState('');
  const [deadline, setDeadline] = useState('');
  const [passingScore, setPassingScore] = useState<number>(80);
  const [maxAttempts, setMaxAttempts] = useState<number | ''>('');

  // QR код
  const [showQRModal, setShowQRModal] = useState(false);

  // Никнейм
  const [showNicknamePrompt, setShowNicknamePrompt] = useState(false);
  const [nicknameInput, setNicknameInput] = useState('');
  const [selectedUserForProfile, setSelectedUserForProfile] = useState<GroupMember | null>(null);
  
  const [confirmAction, setConfirmAction] = useState<{title: string, message: string, onConfirm: () => void, confirmText?: string} | null>(null);
  const [promptAction, setPromptAction] = useState<{title: string, message: string, onConfirm: (val: string) => void} | null>(null);
  const [promptInput, setPromptInput] = useState('');
  const [leaderboardTab, setLeaderboardTab] = useState<'all-time' | 'weekly'>('all-time');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Вкладки панели класса
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'assignments' | 'members' | 'chat'>('assignments');
  

  // Определение роли и подписка на изменения
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    const fetchRole = () => {
      supabase.from('profiles').select('role').eq('id', user.id).single()
        .then(({ data }) => {
          if (data) {
            const fetchedRole = data.role as 'student' | 'teacher';
            setRole(fetchedRole);
            localStorage.setItem(`user_role_${user.id}`, fetchedRole);
          }
        });
    };
    fetchRole();
    window.addEventListener('profile_updated', fetchRole);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('profile_updated', fetchRole);
    };
  }, [user?.id]);

  const handleToggleRole = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    const newRole = role === 'teacher' ? 'student' : 'teacher';
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .update({ role: newRole })
      .eq('id', user.id);
    if (!error) {
      setRole(newRole);
      localStorage.setItem(`user_role_${user.id}`, newRole);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('profile_updated'));
      // Если переключились на студента, сбрасываем выбранную группу, чтобы загрузилась первая доступная
      setSelectedGroupId(null);
    }
  };

  // Загрузка групп для преподавателя
  const loadTeacherGroups = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    const cacheKey = `teacher_groups_${user.id}`;
    const cached = localStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(cached);
        setGroups(data);
        if (data.length > 0 && !selectedGroupId) setSelectedGroupId(data[0].id);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (e) {}
    } else {
      setLoading(true);
    }
    
    const data = await getTeacherGroups(user.id);
    setGroups(data);
    localStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(data));
    if (data.length > 0) {
      setSelectedGroupId(prev => prev ? (data.some(g => g.id === prev) ? prev : data[0].id) : data[0].id);
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  // Загрузка групп для студента
  const loadStudentGroups = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    const cacheKey = `student_groups_${user.id}`;
    const cached = localStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(cached);
        setGroups(data);
        if (data.length > 0 && !selectedGroupId) setSelectedGroupId(data[0].id);
        setLoading(false);
      } catch (e) {}
    } else {
      setLoading(true);
    }
    
    const groupsData = await getStudentGroups();
      
    setGroups(groupsData || []);
    localStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(groupsData || []));
    if (groupsData && groupsData.length > 0) {
      setSelectedGroupId(prev => prev ? (groupsData.some(g => g.id === prev) ? prev : groupsData[0].id) : groupsData[0].id);
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user || role === null) return;
    if (role === 'teacher') {
      loadTeacherGroups();
    } else {
      loadStudentGroups();
    }
    getMaterials(user.id).then((data: any) => setMaterials(data as Material[]));
  }, [user?.id, role]);

  // Загрузка деталей выбранной группы
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedGroupId && user) {
      const cacheMembers = localStorage.getItem(`group_members_${selectedGroupId}`);
      if (cacheMembers) { try { setMembers(JSON.parse(cacheMembers)); } catch(e) {} }
      getGroupMembersWithWeeklyXP(selectedGroupId).then(data => {
        setMembers(data);
        localStorage.setItem(`group_members_${selectedGroupId}`, JSON.stringify(data));
        
        if (role === 'student') {
          const myMember = data.find(m => m.student_id === user.id);
          if (myMember && !myMember.class_nickname) {
            setShowNicknamePrompt(true);
          }
        }
      });

      const cacheAssignments = localStorage.getItem(`group_assignments_${selectedGroupId}`);
      if (cacheAssignments) { try { setAssignments(JSON.parse(cacheAssignments)); } catch(e) {} }
      getGroupAssignments(selectedGroupId).then(data => {
        setAssignments(data);
        localStorage.setItem(`group_assignments_${selectedGroupId}`, JSON.stringify(data));
      });
      
      if (role === 'student') {
        const cacheCompletions = localStorage.getItem(`student_completions_${user.id}`);
        if (cacheCompletions) { try { setCompletedAssignments(JSON.parse(cacheCompletions)); } catch(e) {} }
        getStudentCompletions(user.id).then(data => {
          setCompletedAssignments(data);
          localStorage.setItem(`student_completions_${user.id}`, JSON.stringify(data));
        });
        
        const group = groups.find(g => g.id === selectedGroupId);
        if (group) {
          getPublicProfiles([group.teacher_id], null, null, 1).then(([profile]) => {
            setTeacherName(profile?.full_name || 'Неизвестный преподаватель');
          });
        }
      } else if (role === 'teacher') {
        const cacheGroupCompletions = localStorage.getItem(`group_completions_${selectedGroupId}`);
        if (cacheGroupCompletions) { try { setGroupCompletions(JSON.parse(cacheGroupCompletions)); } catch(e) {} }
        getGroupCompletions(selectedGroupId).then(data => {
          setGroupCompletions(data);
          localStorage.setItem(`group_completions_${selectedGroupId}`, JSON.stringify(data));
        });
      }

      // Realtime subscription for assignments
      const channel = supabase.channel(`group_updates_${selectedGroupId}`)
        .on(
          'postgres_changes',
          { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'assignments', filter: `group_id=eq.${selectedGroupId}` },
          () => {
            getGroupAssignments(selectedGroupId).then(data => {
              setAssignments(data);
              localStorage.setItem(`group_assignments_${selectedGroupId}`, JSON.stringify(data));
            });
          }
        )
        .subscribe();
        
      return () => {
        supabase.removeChannel(channel);
      };
    }
  }, [selectedGroupId, role, groups, user?.id]);

  const handleCreateGroup = async () => {
    if (!newGroupName.trim() || !user) return;
    try {
      const g = await createGroup(newGroupName, user.id);
      if (g) {
        setGroups([g, ...groups]);
        setSelectedGroupId(g.id);
        setShowCreateGroup(false);
        setNewGroupName('');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || 'Ошибка создания группы');
    }
  };

  const handleAssign = async () => {
    if (!selectedGroupId || !selectedMaterial) return;
    
    if (deadline && new Date(deadline) < new Date()) {
      toast.error('Дедлайн не может быть в прошлом!');
      return;
    }

    const ok = await createAssignment(
      selectedGroupId, 
      selectedMaterial, 
      deadline || undefined, 
      passingScore, 
      maxAttempts === '' ? undefined : maxAttempts
    );
    if (ok) {
      getGroupAssignments(selectedGroupId).then(setAssignments);
      if (role === 'teacher') {
        getGroupCompletions(selectedGroupId).then(setGroupCompletions);
      }
      setShowAssignModal(false);
      setSelectedMaterial('');
      setDeadline('');
      setPassingScore(80);
      setMaxAttempts('');
    }
  };

  const handleToggleCompletion = async (assignmentId: string) => {
    if (!user || !selectedGroupId) return;
    const isCurrentlyCompleted = completedAssignments.includes(assignmentId);
    const ok = await toggleAssignmentCompletion(assignmentId, user.id, !isCurrentlyCompleted);
    if (ok) {
      setCompletedAssignments(prev => 
        isCurrentlyCompleted 
          ? prev.filter(id => id !== assignmentId)
          : [...prev, assignmentId]
      );
      // Перезагружаем сдачи группы, чтобы преподаватель видел обновления в реальном времени
      getGroupCompletions(selectedGroupId).then(setGroupCompletions);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteAssignment = async (assignmentId: string) => {
    setConfirmAction({
      title: 'Удалить задание?',
      message: 'Вы уверены, что хотите удалить это задание?',
      confirmText: 'Удалить',
      onConfirm: async () => {
        const ok = await deleteAssignment(assignmentId);
        if (ok) {
          toast.success('Задание удалено');
          setAssignments(prev => prev.filter(a => a.id !== assignmentId));
        } else {
          toast.error('Ошибка при удалении задания');
        }
      }
    });
  };

  const handleDeleteGroup = async () => {
    if (!selectedGroupId) return;
    setConfirmAction({
      title: 'Удалить класс?',
      message: 'Вы уверены, что хотите безвозвратно удалить этот класс? Все данные о студентах и заданиях будут потеряны.',
      confirmText: 'Удалить класс',
      onConfirm: async () => {
        const ok = await deleteGroup(selectedGroupId);
        if (ok) {
          toast.success('Класс удалён');
          setGroups(prev => prev.filter(g => g.id !== selectedGroupId));
          setSelectedGroupId(null);
        } else {
          toast.error('Ошибка при удалении класса');
        }
      }
    });
  };

  const handleKickStudent = async (studentId: string) => {
    if (!selectedGroupId) return;
    setConfirmAction({
      title: 'Исключить студента?',
      message: 'Вы уверены, что хотите исключить этого студента из класса?',
      confirmText: 'Исключить',
      onConfirm: async () => {
        const ok = await removeStudentFromGroup(selectedGroupId, studentId);
        if (ok) {
          toast.success('Студент исключён');
          setMembers(prev => prev.filter(m => m.student_id !== studentId));
        } else {
          toast.error('Ошибка при удалении студента');
        }
      }
    });
  };

  const handleRenameStudent = async (studentId: string, currentName: string) => {
    if (!selectedGroupId) return;
    setPromptInput(currentName);
    setPromptAction({
      title: 'Переименовать студента',
      message: 'Введите новое Имя и Фамилию для студента:',
      onConfirm: async (newName: string) => {
        if (newName && newName.trim() !== currentName) {
          const ok = await updateStudentNickname(selectedGroupId, studentId, newName.trim());
          if (ok) {
            toast.success('Имя изменено');
            setMembers(prev => prev.map(m => m.student_id === studentId ? { ...m, student_name: newName.trim(), class_nickname: newName.trim() } : m));
          } else {
            toast.error('Ошибка при изменении имени');
          }
        }
      }
    });
  };

  const handleSaveNickname = async () => {
    if (!user || !selectedGroupId || !nicknameInput.trim()) return;
    const ok = await updateStudentNickname(selectedGroupId, user.id, nicknameInput.trim());
    if (ok) {
      toast.success('Имя сохранено!');
      setShowNicknamePrompt(false);
      setMembers(prev => prev.map(m => m.student_id === user.id ? { ...m, student_name: nicknameInput.trim(), class_nickname: nicknameInput.trim() } : m));
    } else {
      toast.error('Ошибка сохранения');
    }
  };

  const selectedGroup = groups.find(g => g.id === selectedGroupId);

  // Сортировка участников для лидерборда
  const sortedMembers = [...members].sort((a, b) => {
    const valA = leaderboardTab === 'all-time' ? (a.total_xp || 0) : ((a as any).weekly_xp || 0);
    const valB = leaderboardTab === 'all-time' ? (b.total_xp || 0) : ((b as any).weekly_xp || 0);
    return valB - valA;
  });

  // Топ-3 для пьедестала
  const podium = [
    sortedMembers[1], // 2 место (слева)
    sortedMembers[0], // 1 место (центр)
    sortedMembers[2], // 3 место (справа)
  ];

  const restRankings = sortedMembers.slice(3);

  if (role === null) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[85vh]">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-indigo-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-4 md:p-8 max-w-6xl mx-auto min-h-[85vh]">
      {/* Role Switcher Widget */}
      <div className="mb-6 p-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 shadow-sm tour-step-role-toggle">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-white shrink-0 shadow-md ${role === 'teacher' ? 'bg-emerald-600' : 'bg-indigo-600'}`}>
            {role === 'teacher' ? <Users className="w-5 h-5" /> : <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5" />}
          </div>
          <div>
            <h4 className="font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-sm">
              {role === 'teacher' ? <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">Режим: Преподаватель <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" /></span> : <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">Режим: Студент <Backpack className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-500" /></span>}
            </h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-xl mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">
              {role === 'teacher' 
                ? 'Вы управляете классами, приглашаете учеников и выдаете им домашние задания. Хотите учиться сами и решать тесты? Переключитесь в режим студента.'
                : 'Вы видите домашние задания и дедлайны от преподавателя, а также соревнуетесь в лидерборде. Хотите сами преподавать и создавать свои группы? Переключитесь в режим преподавателя!'}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={handleToggleRole}
          className={`px-4 py-2 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow-md dark:shadow-none transition shrink-0 ${role === 'teacher' ? 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700' : 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700'}`}
        >
          {role === 'teacher' ? <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 justify-center">В режим Студента <Backpack className="w-4 h-4" /></span> : <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 justify-center">В режим Преподавателя <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4" /></span>}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* HEADER */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between mb-8 gap-4">
        <div>
