            {role === 'teacher' ? 'Мои учебные классы' : 'Мой учебный класс'}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
            {role === 'teacher' 
              ? 'Управляйте группами, создавайте задания и просматривайте статистику учеников.' 
              : 'Ваше учебное пространство, дедлайны от преподавателя и рейтинг одногруппников.'}
          </p>
        </div>
        
        {role === 'teacher' && (
          <button 
            onClick={() => setShowCreateGroup(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl transition shadow-sm dark:shadow-none"
          >
            <Plus className="w-5 h-5" />
            Создать класс
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* CREATE GROUP PANEL */}
      {showCreateGroup && role === 'teacher' && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 mb-8 flex items-end gap-4">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <label className="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-2">Название новой группы</label>
            <input autoFocus value={newGroupName} onChange={e => setNewGroupName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Например: ПИ-22 (Алгебра)" className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-850 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none" />
          </div>
          <button onClick={handleCreateGroup} className="px-6 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl font-bold transition h-[42px]">Создать</button>
          <button onClick={() => setShowCreateGroup(false)} className="px-6 py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold transition h-[42px]">Отмена</button>
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {/* LOADING */}
      {(loading || role === null) && (
        <div className="text-center py-20">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-indigo-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mx-auto mb-4" />
          <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">Загрузка информации о группах...</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* EMPTY GROUPS STATE */}
      {!(loading || role === null) && groups.length === 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="text-center py-16 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 border-dashed">
            <Users className="w-16 h-16 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700 mx-auto mb-4" />
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
              {role === 'teacher' ? 'У вас пока нет групп' : 'Вы пока не вступили в группу'}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-2 max-w-sm mx-auto text-sm leading-relaxed">
              {role === 'teacher' 
                ? 'Создайте свой первый класс, чтобы пригласить студентов по коду приглашения.' 
                : 'Вам нужно вступить в группу вашего преподавателя по пятизначному коду приглашения.'}
            </p>
            {role === 'student' && (
              <button
                onClick={() => navigate('/library')}
                className="mt-6 px-6 py-3 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl transition shadow-md shadow-indigo-200 dark:shadow-none"
              >
                Вступить в класс
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Step by step guide card */}
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm">
            <h3 className="font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-base mb-4">
              Как устроена работа с классами? 🧭
            </h3>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
              {role === 'teacher' ? (
                <>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="w-7 h-7 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">1</span>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm">Создайте класс</h4>
                    <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs leading-relaxed">Нажмите кнопку «Создать класс» в правом верхнем углу этой страницы и введите его название.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="w-7 h-7 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">2</span>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm">Передайте код</h4>
                    <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs leading-relaxed">Скопируйте уникальный пятизначный код класса из карточки группы и отправьте его своим ученикам.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="w-7 h-7 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">3</span>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm">Назначьте лекцию</h4>
                    <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs leading-relaxed">Нажмите «Назначить задание», выберите лекцию из своей библиотеки и укажите дату сдачи (дедлайн).</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="w-7 h-7 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">4</span>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm">Следите за топом</h4>
                    <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs leading-relaxed">В лидерборде вы увидите активность студентов за 7 дней и всё время (XP за карточки и экзамены).</p>
                  </div>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="w-7 h-7 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">1</span>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm">Получите код</h4>
                    <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs leading-relaxed">Попросите у своего преподавателя уникальный 5-значный код для вступления в его группу.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="w-7 h-7 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">2</span>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm">Вступите в класс</h4>
                    <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs leading-relaxed">Перейдите в «Библиотеку» и в правом верхнем углу нажмите кнопку «Ввести код класса».</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="w-7 h-7 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">3</span>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm">Делайте задания</h4>
                    <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs leading-relaxed">Изучайте назначенные преподавателем конспекты, чтобы успешно уложиться в дедлайны.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="w-7 h-7 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">4</span>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm">Участвуйте в рейтинге</h4>
                    <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs leading-relaxed">Решайте тесты и заучивайте карточки, накапливайте еженедельный XP и занимайте топ-3 пьедестала!</p>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MAIN CONTAINER */}
      {!loading && groups.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-8">
          {/* Sidebar */}
          <div className="lg:w-1/4 shrink-0">
            <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden sticky top-4">
              <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/40">
                <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider text-xs">Список классов</h2>
              </div>
              <div className="p-2 space-y-1 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
                {groups.map(g => (
                  <button
                    key={g.id}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedGroupId(g.id)}
                    className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-3 rounded-xl transition ${selectedGroupId === g.id ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold' : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/35 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium'}`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="truncate mr-2">{g.name}</span>
                      <Users className={`w-4 h-4 shrink-0 ${selectedGroupId === g.id ? 'text-indigo-400' : 'text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600'}`} />
                    </div>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Main Panel */}
          {selectedGroup && (
            <div className="lg:w-3/4 flex-1 space-y-6">
              {/* Group Header Card */}
              <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl p-6 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">{selectedGroup.name}</h2>
                  
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 mt-2 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm">
                    {role === 'student' && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500" />
                        <span>Преподаватель: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{teacherName}</span></span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Key className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500" />
                      <span>Код приглашения:</span>
                      <span className="font-mono bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold text-base select-all">
                        {selectedGroup.invite_code}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    
                    {role === 'teacher' && (
                      <button 
                        onClick={() => setShowQRModal(true)}
                        className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-700 dark:hover:text-indigo-355 text-sm font-bold ml-2 underline"
                      >
                        Показать QR-код
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                {role === 'teacher' && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => setShowAssignModal(true)}
                      className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-700 transition shrink-0"
                    >
                      Назначить задание
                    </button>
                    <button 
                      onClick={handleDeleteGroup}
                      className="p-2.5 bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/30 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/50 dark:text-rose-400 rounded-xl transition shrink-0 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800/30"
                      title="Удалить класс"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-5 h-5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* QR CODE MODAL */}
              {showQRModal && role === 'teacher' && (
                <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
                  <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl p-8 max-w-sm w-full text-center shadow-2xl border dark:border-slate-800">
                    <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2">Пригласить в класс</h3>
                    <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm mb-6">Попросите учеников отсканировать этот QR-код или ввести код вручную в Библиотеке.</p>
                    
                    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 inline-block mb-6 shadow-sm">
                      <QRCode 
                        value={`${window.location.origin}/library?join=${selectedGroup.invite_code}`} 
                        size={200}
                      />
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 rounded-xl p-3 mb-6">
                      <span className="text-xs text-indigo-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Код класса</span>
                      <span className="text-2xl font-black font-mono text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 tracking-widest">{selectedGroup.invite_code}</span>
                    </div>
                    
                    <button onClick={() => setShowQRModal(false)} className="w-full py-3 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold rounded-xl transition">
                      Закрыть
                    </button>
                  </motion.div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* ASSIGN MATERIAL MODAL */}
              {showAssignModal && role === 'teacher' && (
                <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl p-6 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-850 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-100/50 dark:shadow-none">
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 mb-4">Назначить материал</h3>
                  <div className="space-y-4 relative z-20">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Выберите материал из вашей библиотеки</label>
                      <CustomSelect 
                        value={selectedMaterial} 
                        onChange={val => setSelectedMaterial(val)} 
                        className="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-850 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 shadow-inner"
                        options={[
                          { value: '', label: '-- Выберите материал --' },
                          ...materials.map(m => ({ 
                            value: m.id, 
                            label: `${m.title} (${format(new Date(m.created_at || new Date()), 'dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm')})` 
                          }))
                        ]}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Дедлайн (опционально)</label>
                      <input 
                        type="datetime-local" 
                        value={deadline} 
                        min={new Date(new Date().getTime() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 16)}
                        onChange={e => setDeadline(e.target.value)} 
                        className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-850 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none" 
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                      <div>
                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Проходной балл (%)</label>
                        <input 
                          type="number" 
                          min={1} max={100}
                          value={passingScore} 
                          onChange={e => setPassingScore(Number(e.target.value))} 
                          className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-850 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none" 
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Попытки (пусто = ∞)</label>
                        <input 
                          type="number" 
                          min={1}
                          value={maxAttempts} 
                          onChange={e => setMaxAttempts(e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : '')} 
                          className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-850 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none" 
                          placeholder="∞"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex gap-2 justify-end pt-2">
                      <button onClick={() => setShowAssignModal(false)} className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700">Отмена</button>
                      <button onClick={handleAssign} disabled={!selectedMaterial} className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50">Назначить</button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </motion.div>
              )}

              {/* TABS NAVIGATION */}
              <div className="flex bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-1 shadow-sm overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar gap-1 mb-6 flex-nowrap">
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('assignments')}
                  className={`shrink-0 flex-1 min-w-[120px] py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition whitespace-nowrap flex items-center justify-center gap-2 ${activeTab === 'assignments' ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'}`}
                >
                  <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4" /> Задания
                </button>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('members')}
                  className={`shrink-0 flex-1 min-w-[120px] py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition whitespace-nowrap flex items-center justify-center gap-2 ${activeTab === 'members' ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'}`}
                >
                  <Users className="w-4 h-4" /> Участники & Топ
                </button>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('chat')}
                  className={`shrink-0 flex-1 min-w-[120px] py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition whitespace-nowrap flex items-center justify-center gap-2 ${activeTab === 'chat' ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'}`}
                >
                  <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" /> Чат класса
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* ACTIVE TAB CONTENT */}
              
              {/* ASSIGNMENTS TAB */}
              {activeTab === 'assignments' && (
                <div className="space-y-6">
                  {/* EMPTY STATE FOR NEW GROUP */}
                  {assignments.length === 0 && members.length === 0 && (
                    <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/40 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 border-dashed rounded-3xl p-10 text-center flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
                      <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                        <Users className="w-8 h-8" />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-lg">Класс готов к работе! 🎉</h3>
                        <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm max-w-md mx-auto mt-2 leading-relaxed">
                          Теперь пригласите учеников. Скопируйте код приглашения <span className="font-mono bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded shadow-sm text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold whitespace-nowrap">{selectedGroup.invite_code}</span> и отправьте им.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      {role === 'teacher' && (
                        <button 
                          onClick={() => setShowAssignModal(true)}
                          className="mt-2 px-6 py-3 bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-700 transition shadow-md shadow-indigo-200 dark:shadow-none flex items-center gap-2"
                        >
                          <Plus className="w-5 h-5" /> Назначить первое задание
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Assignments List */}
                  {assignments.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
                      <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/40">
                        <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500" />
                        <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm">Назначенные задания ({assignments.length})</h3>
                      </div>
                      <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                        {assignments.map(a => {
                          const isDone = completedAssignments.includes(a.id);
                          const isOverdue = a.deadline && new Date(a.deadline) < new Date();
                          const completionsCount = groupCompletions.filter(c => c.assignment_id === a.id).length;
                          const totalStudents = members.length;

                          return (
                            <div key={a.id} className="p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-850/50 transition-colors">
                              <div>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{a.material?.title || 'Удаленный материал'}</span>
                                  {role === 'student' ? (
                                    isDone ? (
                                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-md uppercase tracking-wider">
                                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">Выполнено <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></span>
                                      </span>
                                    ) : isOverdue ? (
                                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-md uppercase tracking-wider">
                                    Просрочено ⏰
                                  </span>
                                ) : (
                                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-sky-100 dark:bg-sky-950/40 text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-md uppercase tracking-wider">
                                    В процессе ⏳
                                  </span>
                                )
                              ) : (
                                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-55 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-md uppercase tracking-wider">
                                  Сдали: {completionsCount} из {totalStudents}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            {a.deadline && (
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-500 mt-1">
                                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                Дедлайн: {format(new Date(a.deadline), 'd MMMM, HH:mm', { locale: ru })}
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-center">
                            {role === 'student' && a.material && (
                              <button
                                onClick={() => navigate(`/assignment/${a.id}`)}
                                className={`px-4 py-1.5 font-bold rounded-lg text-xs transition ${
                                  isDone 
                                    ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/50 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900'
                                    : 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white shadow-md'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {isDone ? 'Результаты' : 'Выполнить'}
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Teacher-only Assignment completions matrix */}
              {role === 'teacher' && assignments.length > 0 && (
                <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-sm p-6 space-y-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <Check className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
                    <h3 className="font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-base">Контроль выполнения заданий 🧭</h3>
                  </div>
                  
                  {members.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs italic">Нет студентов в классе для отображения прогресса.</p>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                      <table className="w-full text-left text-xs min-w-[500px]">
                        <thead>
                          <tr className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/40 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">
                            <th className="p-3 sticky left-0 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 z-10 shadow-[1px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]">Студент</th>
                            {assignments.map(a => (
                              <th key={a.id} className="p-3 font-bold truncate max-w-[120px]" title={a.material?.title}>
                                {a.material?.title || 'Удаленный'}
                              </th>
                            ))}
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                          {members.map(m => (
                            <tr key={m.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-850/30 transition-colors group">
                              <td className="p-3 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 sticky left-0 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 group-hover:bg-slate-50 dark:group-hover:bg-slate-850 z-10 shadow-[1px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)] transition-colors">
                                {m.student_name}
                              </td>
                              {assignments.map(a => {
                                const completion = groupCompletions.find(c => c.assignment_id === a.id && c.student_id === m.student_id);
                                const isOverdue = a.deadline && new Date(a.deadline) < new Date();
                                
                                return (
                                  <td key={a.id} className="p-3">
                                    {completion ? (
                                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                                        <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Выполнено
                                      </span>
                                    ) : isOverdue ? (
                                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400 font-semibold">
                                        ❌ Просрочено
                                      </span>
                                    ) : (
                                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                                        ⏳ В процессе
                                      </span>
                                    )}
                                  </td>
                                );
                              })}
                            </tr>
                          ))}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

              {/* MEMBERS AND LEADERBOARD TAB */}
              {activeTab === 'members' && (
                <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm p-6 space-y-6">
                
                {/* Section header & Toggles */}
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Trophy className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />
                    <h3 className="font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 text-lg">Рейтинг участников класса ({members.length})</h3>
                  </div>
                  
                  {/* Weekly / All-time toggle */}
                  <div className="flex bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 p-1 rounded-xl w-full sm:w-auto">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setLeaderboardTab('all-time')}
                      className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                        leaderboardTab === 'all-time'
                          ? 'bg-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-950 text-white shadow-sm'
                          : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
                      }`}
                    >
                      За все время
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setLeaderboardTab('weekly')}
                      className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                        leaderboardTab === 'weekly'
                          ? 'bg-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-950 text-white shadow-sm'
                          : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
                      }`}
                    >
                      За 7 дней
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {members.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 py-10">
                    Пока никто не присоединился к этой группе.
                  </p>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-8">
                    
                    {/* PODIUM (TOP-3 STUDENTS) */}
                    {sortedMembers.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="flex items-end justify-center gap-2 md:gap-6 pt-12 pb-4 overflow-x-auto min-w-[280px]">
                        
                        {/* 2nd place */}
                        {podium[0] && (
                          <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
                            <div className="relative mb-3 flex flex-col items-center">
                              {podium[0].student_avatar ? (
                                <img src={podium[0].student_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full border-2 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-md cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 transition" onClick={() => setSelectedUserForProfile(podium[0])} />
                              ) : (
                                <div onClick={() => setSelectedUserForProfile(podium[0])} className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 border-2 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 font-bold text-sm shadow-md cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 transition">
                                  {podium[0].student_name?.[0]}
                                </div>
                              )}
                              <span className="absolute -top-3 bg-slate-300 text-slate-800 p-0.5 rounded-full shadow border border-white dark:border-slate-850 text-xs font-black">
                                <Medal className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600" />
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 max-w-[90px] truncate text-center mb-1">{podium[0].student_name}</span>
                            <div className="w-20 md:w-24 bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-slate-850 border-t-2 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-t-xl h-24 flex flex-col items-center justify-center shadow-sm">
                              <span className="font-mono text-xs font-black text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">2 место</span>
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400 mt-1">
                                {leaderboardTab === 'all-time' ? podium[0].total_xp : (podium[0] as any).weekly_xp} XP
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}

                        {/* 1st place */}
                        {podium[1] && (
                          <div className="flex flex-col items-center scale-110 -translate-y-2 z-10">
                            <div className="relative mb-3 flex flex-col items-center">
                              {podium[1].student_avatar ? (
                                <img src={podium[1].student_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full border-4 border-amber-400 shadow-lg cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 transition" onClick={() => setSelectedUserForProfile(podium[1])} />
                              ) : (
                                <div onClick={() => setSelectedUserForProfile(podium[1])} className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-4 border-amber-400 dark:border-amber-700 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-450 font-black text-base shadow-lg cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 transition">
                                  {podium[1].student_name?.[0]}
                                </div>
                              )}
                              <span className="absolute -top-3.5 bg-amber-400 text-amber-950 p-0.5 rounded-full shadow border-2 border-white dark:border-slate-850 animate-bounce">
                                <Crown className="w-4 h-4 fill-amber-300" />
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <span className="text-xs font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 max-w-[100px] truncate text-center mb-1">{podium[1].student_name}</span>
                            <div className="w-24 md:w-28 bg-gradient-to-t from-amber-50 to-amber-100/50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-t-4 border-amber-400 dark:border-amber-600 rounded-t-2xl h-32 flex flex-col items-center justify-center shadow-md">
                              <span className="font-mono text-xs font-black text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400">1 место</span>
                              <span className="text-xs font-black text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 mt-1">
                                {leaderboardTab === 'all-time' ? podium[1].total_xp : (podium[1] as any).weekly_xp} XP
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}

                        {/* 3rd place */}
                        {podium[2] && (
                          <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
                            <div className="relative mb-3 flex flex-col items-center">
                              {podium[2].student_avatar ? (
                                <img src={podium[2].student_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-amber-600 shadow-md cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 transition" onClick={() => setSelectedUserForProfile(podium[2])} />
                              ) : (
                                <div onClick={() => setSelectedUserForProfile(podium[2])} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 border-2 border-amber-600 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold text-xs shadow-md cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 transition">
                                  {podium[2].student_name?.[0]}
                                </div>
                              )}
                              <span className="absolute -top-3 bg-amber-700 text-white p-0.5 rounded-full shadow border border-white text-xs font-black">
                                <Award className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-200" />
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 max-w-[80px] truncate text-center mb-1">{podium[2].student_name}</span>
                            <div className="w-18 md:w-20 bg-amber-50/20 dark:bg-amber-950/20 border-t-2 border-amber-600 rounded-t-xl h-20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center shadow-sm">
                              <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-black text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-500">3 место</span>
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400 mt-1">
                                {leaderboardTab === 'all-time' ? podium[2].total_xp : (podium[2] as any).weekly_xp} XP
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}

                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* REST OF THE RANKINGS LIST */}
                    {restRankings.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl">
                        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs min-w-[400px]">
                          <thead>
                            <tr className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/40 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">
                              <th className="p-4 w-12 text-center">Ранг</th>
                              <th className="p-4">Студент</th>
                              <th className="p-4 text-right">Опыт в этой группе (XP)</th>
                              <th className="p-4 text-right">Повторений</th>
                              {role === 'teacher' && <th className="p-4 text-right">Управление</th>}
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                            {restRankings.map((m, index) => {
                              const rank = index + 4;
                              const score = leaderboardTab === 'all-time' ? m.total_xp : (m as any).weekly_xp;
                              return (
                                <tr key={m.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-850/50 transition-colors">
                                  <td className="p-4 font-mono font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-center">{rank}</td>
                                  <td className="p-4">
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                      {m.student_avatar ? (
                                        <img src={m.student_avatar} alt="avatar" className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full cursor-pointer hover:ring-2 ring-indigo-500 transition" onClick={() => setSelectedUserForProfile(m)} />
                                      ) : (
                                        <div onClick={() => setSelectedUserForProfile(m)} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer hover:ring-2 ring-indigo-500 transition">
                                          {m.student_name?.[0] || '?'}
                                        </div>
                                      )}
                                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-indigo-600 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setSelectedUserForProfile(m)}>{m.student_name}</span>
                                    </div>
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="p-4 text-right font-mono text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold">{score} XP</td>
                                  <td className="p-4 text-right text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">{m.total_reviews || 0}</td>
                                  {role === 'teacher' && (
                                    <td className="p-4 text-right">
                                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                                        <button onClick={() => handleRenameStudent(m.student_id, m.student_name || '')} className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 transition" title="Изменить имя">
                                          <Edit2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                                        </button>
                                        <button onClick={() => handleKickStudent(m.student_id)} className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:text-rose-400 transition" title="Исключить студента">
                                          <UserMinus className="w-4 h-4" />
                                        </button>
                                      </div>
                                    </td>
                                  )}
                                </tr>
                              );
                            })}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              )}

              {/* CHAT TAB */}
              {activeTab === 'chat' && user && (
                <div className="mb-4">
                  <GroupChat 
                    groupId={selectedGroupId!} 
                    currentUserId={user.id} 
                    members={members}
                    onUserClick={(userId) => {
                      const m = members.find(mbr => mbr.student_id === userId);
                      if (m) setSelectedUserForProfile(m);
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Nickname Prompt Modal */}
      {showNicknamePrompt && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-sm shadow-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2">Как вас зовут?</h3>
            <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm mb-4">Преподаватель просит указать настоящие Имя и Фамилию для этого класса.</p>
            <input 
              autoFocus
              value={nicknameInput} 
              onChange={e => setNicknameInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Иван Иванов" 
              className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl mb-4 text-center text-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100" 
            />
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button onClick={() => setShowNicknamePrompt(false)} className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700">Пропустить</button>
              <button onClick={handleSaveNickname} disabled={!nicknameInput.trim()} className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50">Сохранить</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Confirm Modal */}
      {confirmAction && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[200] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl p-6 w-full max-w-sm shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
              <AlertCircle className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="font-bold text-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2">{confirmAction.title}</h3>
            <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm mb-6 leading-relaxed">{confirmAction.message}</p>
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button onClick={() => setConfirmAction(null)} className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition">Отмена</button>
              <button onClick={() => { confirmAction.onConfirm(); setConfirmAction(null); }} className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-rose-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-rose-700 transition shadow-md shadow-rose-200 dark:shadow-none">{confirmAction.confirmText || 'Удалить'}</button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Prompt Modal */}
      {promptAction && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[200] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl p-6 w-full max-w-sm shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2">{promptAction.title}</h3>
            <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm mb-4 leading-relaxed">{promptAction.message}</p>
            <input 
              autoFocus
              value={promptInput} 
              onChange={e => setPromptInput(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl mb-4 text-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100" 
            />
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button onClick={() => setPromptAction(null)} className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition">Отмена</button>
              <button onClick={() => { promptAction.onConfirm(promptInput); setPromptAction(null); }} disabled={!promptInput.trim()} className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl hover:bg-indigo-700 transition shadow-md shadow-indigo-200 dark:shadow-none disabled:opacity-50">Сохранить</button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Miniprofile Modal */}
      {selectedUserForProfile && user && (
        <MiniprofileModal 
          member={selectedUserForProfile} 
          currentUserId={user.id}
          onClose={() => setSelectedUserForProfile(null)} 
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="frontend/src/pages/UpdatePassword.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { GraduationCap, Lock, ArrowRight, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';

export default function UpdatePassword() {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    // Listen for auth state changes to make sure we are handling the password recovery event
    const { data: authListener } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(
      async (event, session) => {
        if (event == 'PASSWORD_RECOVERY') {
          // User is ready to update their password
        }
      }
    );
    return () => {
      authListener.subscription.unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  const handleUpdate = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (password.length < 6) {
      setError('Пароль должен содержать минимум 6 символов');
      return;
    }
    
    if (password !== confirm) {
      setError('Пароли не совпадают');
      return;
    }
    
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({
      password: password
    });
    
    if (error) {
      setError('Произошла ошибка при обновлении пароля.');
    } else {
      setSuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        navigate('/dashboard');
      }, 2000);
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="auth-page min-h-screen flex text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
      {/* Left Column: Form */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center px-6 sm:px-12 lg:px-24 xl:px-32 relative">
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/')} className="absolute top-8 left-6 sm:left-12 flex items-center gap-2 group">
          <div className="app-logo-mark w-8 h-8 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center">
            <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-lg tracking-tight group-hover:text-[var(--sf-accent)] transition-colors">Meldy</span>
        </button>

        <motion.div 
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
          className="w-full max-w-sm mx-auto"
        >
          <div className="mb-8">
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 tracking-tight mb-2">Новый пароль</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Используйте не менее шести символов.</p>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} className="bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/50 text-rose-600 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium mb-6">
              {error}
            </motion.div>
          )}

          {success ? (
            <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} className="bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900 text-emerald-600 px-4 py-6 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold mb-6 flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-3 shadow-sm shadow-emerald-100 dark:shadow-none">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-1">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6" />
              </div>
              <p>Пароль успешно изменён! Перенаправляем...</p>
            </motion.div>
          ) : (
            <form onSubmit={handleUpdate} className="space-y-5">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="new-password" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">Новый пароль</label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                    <Lock className="h-5 w-5 text-slate-400" />
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="new-password"
                    name="new-password"
                    type="password"
                    autoComplete="new-password"
                    value={password}
                    onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                    className="block w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--sf-accent)] focus:border-[var(--sf-accent)] outline-none transition-colors"
                    placeholder="••••••••"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="confirm-new-password" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">Подтвердите пароль</label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                    <Lock className="h-5 w-5 text-slate-400" />
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="confirm-new-password"
                    name="confirm-new-password"
                    type="password"
                    autoComplete="new-password"
                    value={confirm}
                    onChange={e => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
                    className="block w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--sf-accent)] focus:border-[var(--sf-accent)] outline-none transition-colors"
                    placeholder="••••••••"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={loading}
                className="group relative w-full flex justify-center py-3.5 px-4 border border-transparent rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-slate-950 bg-cyan-300 hover:bg-cyan-200 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-cyan-400 transition-colors disabled:opacity-70 mt-4"
              >
                {loading ? (
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">Сохраняем... <div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" /></span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">Сохранить <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" /></span>
                )}
              </button>
            </form>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      </div>

      {/* Right Column: Branded Visual (Hidden on mobile) */}
      <div className="auth-showcase hidden lg:flex flex-1 relative overflow-hidden items-center justify-center p-12 border-l">

        <motion.div 
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9, rotateY: -15 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, rotateY: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.8, type: "spring" }}
          className="relative w-full max-w-md border-y py-8"
          style={{ transformStyle: "preserve-3d", perspective: 1000 }}
        >
          <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-white/20 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mb-6 border border-white/20 shadow-inner">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6 text-white" />
          </div>
          
          <h2 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-white leading-tight mb-4 tracking-tight">
            Один шаг до продолжения
          </h2>
          
          <p className="text-slate-300 leading-relaxed text-sm mb-6">
            После сохранения вы вернётесь в Meldy и продолжите работу с прежними материалами.
          </p>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="backend/tests/test_text_pipeline.py">
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from parser import extract_text
from utils import build_source_chunks, find_source_ids, is_safe_public_url, parse_llm_json


class TextPipelineTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_utf8_bom_is_decoded_without_bom(self):
        self.assertEqual(extract_text("Привет, лекция".encode("utf-8-sig"), "note.txt"), "Привет, лекция")

    def test_utf16_is_not_decoded_as_cp1251(self):
        self.assertEqual(extract_text("Формула и конспект".encode("utf-16"), "note.txt"), "Формула и конспект")

    def test_cp1251_is_supported(self):
        self.assertEqual(extract_text("Беларусь".encode("cp1251"), "note.txt"), "Беларусь")

    def test_cp866_is_not_misread_as_cp1251(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            extract_text("Привет, конспект".encode("cp866"), "note.txt"),
            "Привет, конспект",
        )

    def test_url_analyzer_rejects_private_and_non_http_targets(self):
        rejected = [
            "http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs",
            "http://localhost/admin",
            "http://10.0.0.4/private",
            "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data",
            "file:///etc/passwd",
        ]
        for url in rejected:
            with self.subTest(url=url):
                self.assertFalse(is_safe_public_url(url))

        self.assertTrue(is_safe_public_url("https://example.com/article"))

    def test_llm_json_code_fence_is_parsed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_llm_json('```json\n{"content":"Текст"}\n```'), {"content": "Текст"})

    def test_source_chunks_are_numbered_and_match_generated_items(self):
        text = "Квантовая механика описывает состояние частицы.\n\nСуперпозиция означает сочетание нескольких состояний до измерения."
        chunks = build_source_chunks(text)
        self.assertEqual([chunk["id"] for chunk in chunks], ["S01", "S02"])
        self.assertEqual(find_source_ids("Что такое суперпозиция?", chunks), ["S02"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

<file path="backend/parser.py">
import io
import re
from typing import Optional


def extract_text(contents: bytes, filename: str) -> str:
    ext = filename.lower().rsplit(".", 1)[-1] if "." in filename else "txt"

    if ext == "pdf":
        return _extract_pdf(contents)
    elif ext == "docx":
        return _extract_docx(contents)
    elif ext in ("html", "htm"):
        return _extract_html(contents)
    elif ext in ("txt", "md"):
        return _extract_text(contents)
    else:
        return _extract_text(contents)


def _extract_pdf(contents: bytes) -> str:
    try:
        from PyPDF2 import PdfReader
        reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(contents))
        text_parts = []
        for page in reader.pages:
            page_text = page.extract_text()
            if page_text:
                text_parts.append(page_text)
        return clean_extracted_text("\n\n".join(text_parts))
    except Exception as e:
        raise ValueError(f"Ошибка чтения PDF: {e}")


def _extract_docx(contents: bytes) -> str:
    try:
        from docx import Document
        doc = Document(io.BytesIO(contents))
        text_parts = []
        for para in doc.paragraphs:
            if para.text.strip():
                text_parts.append(para.text)
        return clean_extracted_text("\n".join(text_parts))
    except Exception as e:
        raise ValueError(f"Ошибка чтения DOCX: {e}")


def _extract_text(contents: bytes) -> str:
    # BOM must win over heuristic decoding. Without this, UTF-16 files are
    # decoded as CP1251 because CP1251 accepts every byte sequence.
    if contents.startswith((b"\xff\xfe", b"\xfe\xff", b"\xff\xfe\x00\x00", b"\x00\x00\xfe\xff")):
        return clean_extracted_text(contents.decode("utf-16" if not contents.startswith((b"\xff\xfe\x00\x00", b"\x00\x00\xfe\xff")) else "utf-32"))
    if contents.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"):
        return clean_extracted_text(contents.decode("utf-8-sig"))

    # UTF-16 without a BOM has a high NUL-byte ratio. Detect it before the
    # single-byte fallbacks so it cannot become readable-looking gibberish.
    sample = contents[:4096]
    if sample and sample.count(b"\x00") / len(sample) > 0.20:
        for encoding in ("utf-16-le", "utf-16-be"):
            try:
                return clean_extracted_text(contents.decode(encoding))
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                pass

    try:
        return clean_extracted_text(contents.decode("utf-8"))
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        pass

    candidates = []
    for encoding in ("cp1251", "cp866", "latin-1"):
        try:
            decoded = contents.decode(encoding)
            cleaned = clean_extracted_text(decoded)
            if _looks_like_text(cleaned):
                candidates.append((_legacy_decode_score(cleaned), cleaned))
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue
    if candidates:
        return max(candidates, key=lambda item: item[0])[1]
    return clean_extracted_text(contents.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))


def clean_extracted_text(text: str) -> str:
    """Remove transport/control noise while preserving normal Unicode text."""
    text = text.replace("\ufeff", "")
    text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
    text = text.replace("\x00", "")
    text = re.sub(r"[\u0001-\u0008\u000b\u000c\u000e-\u001f\u007f]", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[ \t]+\n", "\n", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", text)
    return text.strip()


def _looks_like_text(text: str) -> bool:
    if not text:
        return False
    replacement_count = text.count("\ufffd")
    if replacement_count > max(2, len(text) // 200):
        return False
    printable = sum(char.isprintable() or char in "\n\t" for char in text)
    return printable / len(text) >= 0.85


def _legacy_decode_score(text: str) -> float:
    """Prefer ordinary Russian text over printable legacy-codec mojibake."""
    if not text:
        return float("-inf")

    normal_cyrillic = sum("А" <= char <= "я" or char in "Ёё" for char in text)
    extended_cyrillic = sum("\u0400" <= char <= "\u052f" for char in text) - normal_cyrillic
    latin_letters = sum(char.isascii() and char.isalpha() for char in text)
    suspicious = sum(
        char in "\u00ad\ufffd" or (char.isprintable() and not char.isspace() and ord(char) < 32)
        for char in text
    )
    common_pairs = sum(
        text.lower().count(pair)
        for pair in ("ст", "но", "ен", "ов", "ни", "ра", "во", "ко", "пр", "то")
    )
    return normal_cyrillic * 3 + common_pairs * 2 + latin_letters - extended_cyrillic * 4 - suspicious * 8


def _extract_html(contents: bytes) -> str:
    try:
        from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
        html_str = _extract_text(contents)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html_str, "html.parser")
        
        # Remove script and style elements
        for script in soup(["script", "style", "header", "footer", "nav"]):
            script.decompose()
            
        # Get text
        text = soup.get_text(separator="\n")
        
        # Clean up spacing and empty lines
        lines = (line.strip() for line in text.splitlines())
        chunks = (phrase.strip() for line in lines for phrase in line.split("  "))
        text = "\n".join(chunk for chunk in chunks if chunk)
        
        return clean_extracted_text(text)
    except Exception as e:
        raise ValueError(f"Ошибка чтения HTML: {e}")

<file path="backend/push_router.py">
import os
import json
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Dict, Any
from pywebpush import webpush, WebPushException

router = APIRouter()

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY = os.getenv("VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY", "").strip()
VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY = os.getenv("VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY", "BEdVrUuTGrqZWpxNBc3tfNP0N4CtLzEAlH3U64D4WMKkfps-96rEJj6ntl2_2MnFzRNupEWQ1uzl4kBAcjrtRiQ")
VAPID_CLAIMS = {"sub": os.getenv("VAPID_CLAIMS_SUB", "mailto:admin@studyforge.local")}

SUBSCRIPTIONS_FILE = "subscriptions.json"

class PushSubscription(BaseModel):
    user_id: str
    subscription: Dict[str, Any]

def load_subscriptions():
    if os.path.exists(SUBSCRIPTIONS_FILE):
        with open(SUBSCRIPTIONS_FILE, "r") as f:
            try:
                return json.load(f)
            except:
                pass
    return {}

def save_subscriptions(subs):
    with open(SUBSCRIPTIONS_FILE, "w") as f:
        json.dump(subs, f)

def _authenticated_user_id(request: Request) -> str:
    user = getattr(request.state, "user", None) or {}
    user_id = user.get("id")
    if not user_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Требуется войти в аккаунт")
    return user_id


@router.post("/subscribe")
async def subscribe(request: Request, sub: PushSubscription):
    user_id = _authenticated_user_id(request)
    subs = load_subscriptions()
    subs[user_id] = sub.subscription
    save_subscriptions(subs)
    return {"status": "ok"}

@router.post("/send")
async def send_notification(request: Request):
    if not VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="Push-уведомления не настроены")
    data = await request.json()
    user_id = _authenticated_user_id(request)
    message = data.get("message", "Время повторить материалы!")
    
    subs = load_subscriptions()
    if user_id not in subs:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Subscription not found")
        
    sub_info = subs[user_id]
    
    try:
        webpush(
            subscription_info=sub_info,
            data=json.dumps({"title": "Meldy", "body": message, "url": "/review"}),
            vapid_private_key=VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY,
            vapid_claims=VAPID_CLAIMS
        )
        return {"status": "sent"}
    except WebPushException as ex:
        print("WebPushException:", ex)
        if ex.response and ex.response.status_code == 410:
            del subs[user_id]
            save_subscriptions(subs)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(ex))
