<file path="frontend/src/components/LearningDashboard.tsx">
import React from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { 
  ResponsiveContainer, AreaChart, Area, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, CartesianGrid 
} from 'recharts';
import { 
  Trophy, Flame, Zap, Briefcase, Calendar, TrendingUp, HelpCircle 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { CareerProfile, getLevelFromXP } from '../api/career';

interface LearningDashboardProps {
  profile: CareerProfile;
}

export default function LearningDashboard({ profile }: LearningDashboardProps) {
  const currentXP = profile.xp ?? 0;
  const completedModules = profile.course?.modules.filter(m => m.completed).length ?? 0;
  const totalModules = profile.course?.modules.length ?? 0;
  const streakDays = profile.streak_days ?? 0;

  // 1. Calculate Activity Heatmap for the last 30 days
  const get30DaysActivity = () => {
    const days = [];
    const today = new Date();
    
    // Map existing activity log
    const activityMap: Record<string, number> = {};
    if (profile.activity_log) {
      profile.activity_log.forEach(act => {
        activityMap[act.date] = (activityMap[act.date] ?? 0) + act.xp;
      });
    }

    for (let i = 29; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date(today);
      d.setDate(today.getDate() - i);
      const dateStr = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      const xp = activityMap[dateStr] ?? 0;
      
      // Calculate color level (0-4)
      let level = 0;
      if (xp > 0 && xp <= 30) level = 1;
      else if (xp > 30 && xp <= 70) level = 2;
      else if (xp > 70 && xp <= 120) level = 3;
      else if (xp > 120) level = 4;

      days.push({
        date: dateStr,
        dayLabel: d.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' }),
        xp,
        level
      });
    }
    return days;
  };

  const heatmapDays = get30DaysActivity();

  // 2. Prepare Grades Progress Chart (completed modules)
  const getChartData = () => {
    const data = (profile.course?.modules ?? [])
      .filter(m => m.completed && m.score !== undefined)
      .map((m, idx) => ({
        index: idx + 1,
        title: m.title,
        score: m.score ?? 0
      }));

    // If no completed modules, return empty indicator
    if (data.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }
    return data;
  };

  const chartData = getChartData();

  // 3. Velocity estimation
  const getLearningVelocity = () => {
    if (completedModules === 0) return 0;
    const activeDays = streakDays || 1;
    // ratio: modules per week
    const velocityRatio = completedModules / (activeDays / 7 || 1);
    // average calculation: 1.5 modules per week is average
    const pctDiff = Math.round((velocityRatio / 1.5 - 1) * 100);
    return Math.min(150, Math.max(-80, pctDiff));
  };

  const velocityDiff = getLearningVelocity();

  // 4. Job Readiness Index Calculation
  const getJobReadiness = () => {
    const progressRatio = totalModules > 0 ? completedModules / totalModules : 0;
    
    const completedWithScore = (profile.course?.modules ?? []).filter(m => m.completed && m.score !== undefined);
    const avgScore = completedWithScore.length > 0
      ? completedWithScore.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (m.score ?? 0), 0) / completedWithScore.length
      : 0;

    const xpFactor = Math.min(currentXP / 2000, 1);
    const streakFactor = Math.min(streakDays / 15, 1);

    const readiness = (progressRatio * 35) + ((avgScore / 100) * 35) + (xpFactor * 20) + (streakFactor * 10);
    return Math.min(100, Math.round(readiness));
  };

  const jobReadiness = getJobReadiness();

  const getEmploymentForecast = () => {
    if (completedModules === totalModules && totalModules > 0) {
      return 'Готов к офферу! 🚀';
    }
    if (completedModules === 0) {
      return 'Начните практику';
    }
    const daysPerModule = 3;
    const remainingDays = (totalModules - completedModules) * daysPerModule;
    const forecastDate = new Date();
    forecastDate.setDate(forecastDate.getDate() + remainingDays);
    return forecastDate.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
  };

  const employmentForecast = getEmploymentForecast();

  const getHeatmapColor = (level: number) => {
    switch (level) {
      case 1: return 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400';
      case 2: return 'bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-900 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-700 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-200';
      case 3: return 'bg-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-600 border border-indigo-400 dark:border-indigo-500 text-white';
      case 4: return 'bg-violet-500 border border-violet-400 text-white shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(139,92,246,0.15)] animate-pulse';
      default: return 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-900 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-700';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Top dashboard row cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {/* Job readiness Index */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Индекс трудоустройства</span>
            <Briefcase className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="my-3 flex items-baseline gap-2">
            <span className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{jobReadiness}%</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold">готовность</span>
          </div>
          <div className="h-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 rounded-full overflow-hidden w-full">
            <motion.div 
              className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-indigo-400 rounded-full"
              initial={{ width: 0 }}
              animate={{ width: `${jobReadiness}%` }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.8 }}
            />
          </div>
          <p className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-2 font-bold leading-relaxed">
            {jobReadiness >= 80 ? '🔥 Превосходные шансы на оффер! Пора откликаться.' : 
             jobReadiness >= 50 ? '🛡️ Хорошие базовые знания. Дожмите курс!' : 
             '📚 Решайте задачи песочницы для роста индекса.'}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Forecast card */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Оффер прогнозируется</span>
            <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="my-3">
            <p className="text-lg font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 capitalize">{employmentForecast}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold">
            <span>Профессия:</span>
            <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 truncate max-w-[120px]">{profile.course?.profession ?? 'IT специалист'}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Velocity card */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Темп обучения (Velocity)</span>
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="my-3 flex items-baseline gap-1">
            <span className={`text-2xl font-black ${velocityDiff >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400'}`}>
              {velocityDiff >= 0 ? `+${velocityDiff}%` : `${velocityDiff}%`}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold">к среднему</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-500 leading-relaxed font-bold">
            {velocityDiff >= 20 ? '🏃‍♂️ Вы учитесь быстрее большинства студентов!' : 
             velocityDiff >= 0 ? '🚶‍♂️ Отличный стабильный темп прохождения модулей.' : 
             '🐌 Советуем проходить практику регулярнее.'}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Streak card */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Активный стрик</span>
            <Flame className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-500 dark:text-orange-400" />
          </div>
          <div className="my-3 flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
            <span className="text-3xl font-black text-orange-500 dark:text-orange-400">{streakDays}</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-black uppercase">дней подряд</span>
          </div>
          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold">
            <span>Рекорд:</span>
            <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-black">{Math.max(streakDays, 7)} дн.</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Graphs split */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Recharts scores over time */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-6 lg:col-span-2 space-y-4 shadow-sm">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Динамика успеваемости</span>
            <h4 className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Оценки за практические аттестации ИИ-методиста</h4>
          </div>
          
          <div className="h-64 w-full text-xs">
            {completedModules === 0 ? (
              <div className="h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-6 border border-dashed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl">
                <HelpCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 mb-2" />
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">Здесь появится график ваших оценок</p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-0.5 max-w-xs">Пройдите практику вашего первого учебного модуля и отправьте ее на ревью.</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <AreaChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: -25, bottom: 0 }}>
                  <defs>
                    <linearGradient id="scoreColor" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                      <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#6366f1" stopOpacity={0.2}/>
                      <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#6366f1" stopOpacity={0}/>
                    </linearGradient>
                  </defs>
                  <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.08)" />
                  <XAxis dataKey="index" stroke="#94a3b8" fontSize={9} fontWeight="bold" />
                  <YAxis stroke="#94a3b8" fontSize={9} fontWeight="bold" domain={[0, 100]} />
                  <Tooltip 
                    contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--tooltip-bg, #0f172a)', border: '1px solid var(--tooltip-border, #1e293b)', borderRadius: '12px', color: 'var(--tooltip-text, #fff)' }}
                    labelStyle={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '9px', fontWeight: 'bold' }}
                    itemStyle={{ color: 'var(--tooltip-text, #fff)', fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: '800' }}
                    formatter={(value: any, name: any, props: any) => [
                      `${value}% (${props.payload.title})`, 'Балл ИИ'
                    ]}
                  />
                  <Area type="monotone" dataKey="score" stroke="#6366f1" strokeWidth={2.5} fillOpacity={1} fill="url(#scoreColor)" />
                </AreaChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* GitHub-style Heatmap widget */}
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 flex flex-col justify-between shadow-sm">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Тепловая карта активности</span>
            <h4 className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Набранный XP за последние 30 дней</h4>
          </div>

          {/* Grid render */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-6 gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 my-6 w-full max-w-[280px] mx-auto">
            {heatmapDays.map((day, idx) => (
              <div
                key={idx}
                title={`${day.dayLabel}: +${day.xp} XP`}
                className={`w-7 h-7 sm:w-8 sm:h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-[8px] font-black cursor-pointer transition-all hover:scale-105 hover:brightness-105 ${getHeatmapColor(day.level)}`}
              >
                {day.xp > 0 ? day.xp : ''}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Legend */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[8px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pt-3">
            <span>Меньше</span>
            <div className="flex gap-1">
              <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-900" />
              <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/40" />
              <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-900 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-700" />
              <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded bg-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-600 border border-indigo-400 dark:border-indigo-500" />
              <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded bg-violet-500 border border-violet-400" />
            </div>
            <span>Больше</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/components/MockInterviewModal.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { X, Send, Award, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, MessageSquare, Loader2, Sparkles, Trophy, Mic, MicOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  startMockInterview, respondMockInterview, evaluateMockInterview, 
  MockInterviewEvaluation, saveXPToProfile, CareerProfile 
} from '../api/career';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface MockInterviewModalProps {
  userId: string;
  profile: CareerProfile;
  profession: string;
  vacancyTitle: string;
  vacancyCompany: string;
  vacancyRequirements: string;
  completedModulesTitles: string[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onComplete: (score: number) => void;
}

export default function MockInterviewModal({
  userId,
  profile,
  profession,
  vacancyTitle,
  vacancyCompany,
  vacancyRequirements,
  completedModulesTitles,
  onClose,
  onComplete,
}: MockInterviewModalProps) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState<{ role: 'assistant' | 'user'; content: string }[]>([]);
  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [finished, setFinished] = useState(false);
  const [evaluation, setEvaluation] = useState<MockInterviewEvaluation | null>(null);
  const [evaluating, setEvaluating] = useState(false);
  const [isListening, setIsListening] = useState(false);
  const [recognition, setRecognition] = useState<any>(null);
  
  const chatEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    initInterview();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const SpeechRecognition = (window as any).SpeechRecognition || (window as any).webkitSpeechRecognition;
    if (SpeechRecognition) {
      const rec = new SpeechRecognition();
      rec.continuous = false;
      rec.interimResults = false;
      rec.lang = 'ru-RU';

      rec.onstart = () => {
        setIsListening(true);
      };

      rec.onend = () => {
        setIsListening(false);
      };

      rec.onerror = (event: any) => {
        console.error('Speech recognition error:', event.error);
        setIsListening(false);
        if (event.error === 'not-allowed') {
          toast.error('Пожалуйста, разрешите доступ к микрофону в настройках браузера.');
        } else {
          toast.error('Ошибка распознавания голоса.');
        }
      };

      rec.onresult = (event: any) => {
        const text = event.results[0][0].transcript;
        if (text) {
          setInput(prev => {
            const trimmed = prev.trim();
            return trimmed ? `${trimmed} ${text}` : text;
          });
          toast.success('Голос успешно распознан!');
        }
      };

      setRecognition(rec);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (recognition) {
        recognition.stop();
      }
    };
  }, [recognition]);

  const toggleListening = () => {
    if (!recognition) {
      toast.error('Распознавание речи не поддерживается вашим браузером. Используйте Google Chrome.');
      return;
    }

    if (isListening) {
      recognition.stop();
    } else {
      try {
        recognition.start();
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
      }
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    chatEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [chatMessages]);

  const initInterview = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await startMockInterview(
        profession,
        vacancyTitle,
        vacancyCompany,
        vacancyRequirements,
        completedModulesTitles
      );
      setChatMessages([
        { role: 'assistant', content: data.initial_question }
      ]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      toast.error('Не удалось начать собеседование. Попробуйте позже.');
      onClose();
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (!input.trim() || sending || finished) return;

    const userText = input;
    setInput('');
    const nextMsgs = [...chatMessages, { role: 'user' as const, content: userText }];
    setChatMessages(nextMsgs);
    setSending(true);

    try {
      const data = await respondMockInterview(
        profession,
        vacancyTitle,
        vacancyCompany,
        nextMsgs,
        userText
      );

      setChatMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: 'assistant' as const, content: data.next_question }]);
      if (data.is_finished) {
        setFinished(true);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      toast.error('Ошибка отправки ответа.');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEvaluate = async () => {
    setEvaluating(true);
    try {
      const result = await evaluateMockInterview(
        profession,
        vacancyTitle,
        vacancyCompany,
        chatMessages
      );
      setEvaluation(result);

      // Award XP for completing interview
      const xpReward = result.score >= 80 ? 100 : 50;
      
      // Save results to user profile
      const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
      const newInterviews = [...(profile.mock_interviews ?? [])];
      newInterviews.push({
        date: today,
        vacancy: `${vacancyTitle} в ${vacancyCompany}`,
        score: result.score,
        grade: result.grade,
        verdict: result.verdict,
      });

      const updatedProfile = {
        ...profile,
        mock_interviews: newInterviews,
      };

      await saveXPToProfile(userId, updatedProfile, xpReward, 'roleplay');
      
      toast.success(`🎉 Собеседование завершено! Получено +${xpReward} XP!`);
      
      if (result.score >= 80) {
        confetti({ particleCount: 160, spread: 80 });
      }
      onComplete(result.score);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      toast.error('Ошибка анализа собеседования.');
    } finally {
      setEvaluating(false);
    }
  };

  const getQuestionNumber = () => {
    const userTurns = chatMessages.filter(m => m.role === 'user').length;
    return Math.min(5, userTurns + 1);
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-2 sm:p-4 bg-slate-950/80 dark:bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96, y: 15 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-4xl h-[92vh] sm:h-[88vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50 dark:bg-gradient-to-r dark:from-indigo-950/40 dark:to-slate-900">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-indigo-600/10 dark:bg-indigo-600/20 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center border border-indigo-500/20">
                <Award className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <span className="text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-widest block">ИИ-Мок-Собеседование</span>
                <h3 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 truncate pr-4">{vacancyTitle} в {vacancyCompany}</h3>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-full transition text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200">
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Main content split */}
          <div className="flex-1 flex overflow-hidden min-h-0">
            {/* Left chat panel */}
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 min-w-0">
              {loading ? (
                <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Связываемся с рекрутером компании {vacancyCompany}...</p>
                </div>
              ) : evaluation ? (
                /* Report Screen */
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-8 space-y-6">
                  <motion.div 
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    className="flex flex-col items-center text-center max-w-2xl mx-auto gap-4"
                  >
                    <div className="relative">
                      <div className={`w-20 h-20 sm:w-24 sm:h-24 rounded-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center font-black text-xl sm:text-2xl border-4
                        ${evaluation.score >= 80 
                          ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/40 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.1)]' 
                          : 'bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border-indigo-500/40'}`}>
                        {evaluation.score}
                        <span className="text-[8px] sm:text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold opacity-60">из 100</span>
                      </div>
                      {evaluation.score >= 80 && (
                        <div className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 p-1.5 rounded-full border-2 border-white dark:border-slate-900 animate-bounce">
                          <Trophy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">Грейд: {evaluation.grade}</h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-extrabold uppercase mt-0.5">
                        {evaluation.interview_ready ? '🔥 Рекомендован к найму!' : '📚 Требуется подготовка'}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/40 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/80 rounded-2xl text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed text-left w-full shadow-sm">
                      <span className="font-extrabold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 block mb-1">💬 Вердикт HR-комиссии:</span>
                      {evaluation.verdict}
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 w-full text-left mt-2">
                      <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/15 border border-emerald-100 dark:border-emerald-500/20 rounded-2xl space-y-2">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Сильные стороны
                        </span>
                        <ul className="space-y-1.5">
                          {evaluation.strengths.map((s, idx) => (
                            <li key={idx} className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">• {s}</li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      </div>
                      <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/15 border border-rose-100 dark:border-rose-500/20 rounded-2xl space-y-2">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Что нужно подтянуть
                        </span>
                        <ul className="space-y-1.5">
                          {evaluation.weaknesses.map((w, idx) => (
                            <li key={idx} className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">• {w}</li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={onClose}
                      className="mt-4 sm:mt-6 px-8 py-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-indigo-500 text-white font-extrabold text-xs rounded-2xl transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-indigo-500/20 hover:scale-[1.02] w-full sm:w-auto"
                    >
                      Завершить и закрыть
                    </button>
                  </motion.div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                /* Chat view */
                <>
                  <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
                    {chatMessages.map((msg, idx) => (
                      <motion.div
                        key={idx}
                        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                        className={`flex gap-3 max-w-[85%] sm:max-w-[80%] ${msg.role === 'user' ? 'ml-auto flex-row-reverse' : ''}`}
                      >
                        {msg.role === 'assistant' && (
                          <div className="w-7 h-7 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-500/20 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                            <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                          </div>
                        )}
                        <div className={`p-3 sm:p-4 rounded-2xl text-xs leading-relaxed border ${
                          msg.role === 'user'
                            ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-500 text-white rounded-tr-none'
                            : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-tl-none shadow-sm'
                        }`}>
                          {msg.content}
                        </div>
                      </motion.div>
                    ))}
                    {sending && (
                      <div className="flex gap-3 max-w-[80%]">
                        <div className="w-7 h-7 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-500/20 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                          <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/50 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none flex items-center gap-2 shadow-sm">
                          <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                          <span className="text-[10px]">Рекрутер формулирует ответ...</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {finished && !evaluating && !evaluation && (
                      <motion.div 
                        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 5 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                        className="p-4 sm:p-5 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/20 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-500/20 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center gap-3 text-center max-w-md mx-auto"
                      >
                        <Sparkles className="w-6 h-6 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">Все вопросы успешно пройдены!</p>
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Рекрутер готов подвести итоги и дать развернутую техническую оценку.</p>
                        </div>
                        <button
                          onClick={handleEvaluate}
                          className="w-full py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-extrabold rounded-xl transition"
                        >
                          Получить результаты
                        </button>
                      </motion.div>
                    )}
                    {evaluating && (
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-10 gap-3">
                        <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">Собираем отчет комиссии...</p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">ИИ анализирует ваши технические и коммуникационные навыки.</p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div ref={chatEndRef} />
                  </div>

                  {/* Input form */}
                  {!finished && (
                    <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/80 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/30 flex gap-2 items-center">
                      <div className="text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-black text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase px-1 sm:px-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                        Вопрос {getQuestionNumber()}/5
                      </div>
                      <button
                        onClick={toggleListening}
                        disabled={sending}
                        className={`p-2 sm:p-2.5 rounded-xl transition flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border duration-200 ${
                          isListening 
                            ? 'bg-rose-500/10 border-rose-500 text-rose-500 animate-pulse' 
                            : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 text-slate-500 hover:text-indigo-500 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-indigo-400'
                        }`}
                        title={isListening ? "Остановить запись" : "Ответить голосом"}
                      >
                        {isListening ? <MicOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Mic className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                      </button>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        disabled={sending}
                        value={input}
                        onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
                        onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSend(); }}
                        placeholder={isListening ? "Слушаю вас..." : "Напишите или продиктуйте ваш ответ..."}
                        className="flex-1 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-850 rounded-xl px-3 sm:px-4 py-2 sm:py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500/50"
                      />
                      <button
                        onClick={handleSend}
                        disabled={!input.trim() || sending}
                        className="p-2 sm:p-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl transition flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-sm"
                      >
                        <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Right details panel */}
            {!evaluation && (
              <div className="w-72 border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/20 p-6 hidden lg:block space-y-5 overflow-y-auto">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest">Вакансия</span>
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 mt-0.5">{vacancyTitle}</h4>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{vacancyCompany}</p>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/60 space-y-2">
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest block">Проверяемый стек</span>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                    {completedModulesTitles.map((t, i) => (
                      <span key={i} className="text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-950 rounded">
                        {t}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/60">
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1">Требования вакансии</span>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed line-clamp-[12]">
                    {vacancyRequirements}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

<file path="frontend/src/components/ReviewTestModal.tsx">
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { X, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Clock, Zap, RotateCcw, Trophy } from 'lucide-react';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import type { ReviewQuestion } from '../api/career';
import { generateReviewTest, updateModuleReview } from '../api/career';

interface ReviewTestModalProps {
  moduleId: string;
  moduleTitle: string;
  moduleTheory: string;
  practiceType: string;
  courseProfession: string;
  token: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onComplete: (score: number) => void;
  numQuestions?: number;
}

const TIMER_SECONDS = 90; // 90 sec per question

export default function ReviewTestModal({
  moduleId, moduleTitle, moduleTheory, practiceType,
  courseProfession, token, onClose, onComplete, numQuestions = 3,
}: ReviewTestModalProps) {
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<ReviewQuestion[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [currentIdx, setCurrentIdx] = useState(0);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [answered, setAnswered] = useState(false);
  const [scores, setScores] = useState<boolean[]>([]);
  const [timer, setTimer] = useState(TIMER_SECONDS);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [finalScore, setFinalScore] = useState(0);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadTest();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading && !done && !answered) {
      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setTimer(t => {
          if (t <= 1) {
            clearInterval(timerRef.current!);
            handleAnswer(null); // time out = wrong
            return 0;
          }
          return t - 1;
        });
      }, 1000);
    }
    return () => { if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current); };
  }, [loading, done, answered, currentIdx]);

  async function loadTest() {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await generateReviewTest(moduleId, moduleTitle, moduleTheory, practiceType, numQuestions);
      setQuestions(data.questions || []);
    } catch {
      // fallback empty
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }

  function handleAnswer(choice: string | null) {
    if (answered) return;
    clearInterval(timerRef.current!);
    setSelected(choice);
    setAnswered(true);
    const q = questions[currentIdx];
    const isCorrect = choice !== null && choice.startsWith(q.correct);
    setScores(s => [...s, isCorrect]);
  }

  async function handleNext() {
    if (currentIdx < questions.length - 1) {
      setCurrentIdx(i => i + 1);
      setSelected(null);
      setAnswered(false);
      setTimer(TIMER_SECONDS);
    } else {
      // finish
      const correct = [...scores, selected !== null && selected.startsWith(questions[currentIdx].correct)].filter(Boolean).length;
      const total = questions.length;
      const pct = Math.round((correct / total) * 100);
      setFinalScore(pct);
      setDone(true);
      setSaving(true);
      try {
        await updateModuleReview(moduleId, courseProfession, pct, token);
      } catch { /* silent */ }
      setSaving(false);
      onComplete(pct);
    }
  }

  const q = questions[currentIdx];
  const timerPct = (timer / TIMER_SECONDS) * 100;
  const timerColor = timer > 45 ? '#22c55e' : timer > 20 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444';

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.94 }}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-lg overflow-hidden"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 bg-indigo-600/10 dark:bg-indigo-600/30 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center">
                <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-wider">🔁 Spaced Repetition</p>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-850 dark:text-slate-100 truncate max-w-[260px]">{moduleTitle}</h3>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-full transition">
              <X className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-400" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="p-6">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-48 gap-3">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Генерируем вопросы...</p>
              </div>
            ) : done ? (
              /* Results screen */
              <motion.div
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                className="flex flex-col items-center gap-5 py-4"
              >
                <div className={`w-20 h-20 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-3xl font-black
                  ${finalScore >= 70 ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border-2 border-emerald-500/40' : 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border-2 border-rose-500/40'}`}>
                  {finalScore}%
                </div>
                <div className="text-center">
                  <p className="text-base font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                    {finalScore >= 70 ? '🎉 Отлично! Материал усвоен!' : '📚 Нужно ещё поработать'}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
                    {finalScore >= 70
                      ? `Следующее повторение запланировано автоматически`
                      : 'Рекомендуем перечитать теорию и повторить через 1 день'}
                  </p>
                </div>
                {saving && <p className="text-xs text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 animate-pulse">Сохраняем прогресс...</p>}
                <div className="flex gap-3 w-full mt-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={onClose}
                    className="flex-1 py-3 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-650 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold transition"
                  >
                    Закрыть
                  </button>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            ) : (
              <>
                {/* Progress & Timer */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                    {questions.map((_, i) => (
                      <div
                        key={i}
                        className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all ${
                          i < currentIdx
                            ? (scores[i] ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-rose-500')
                            : i === currentIdx ? 'bg-indigo-500 w-4' : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700'
                        } ${questions.length > 10 ? 'w-2.5' : 'w-5'}`}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" style={{ color: timerColor }} />
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold tabular-nums" style={{ color: timerColor }}>{timer}с</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Timer bar */}
                <div className="h-1 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full mb-5 overflow-hidden">
                  <motion.div
                    className="h-full rounded-full"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: timerColor }}
                    animate={{ width: `${timerPct}%` }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Question */}
                <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
                  <motion.div
                    key={currentIdx}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 30 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -30 }}
                    className="space-y-4"
                  >
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 leading-relaxed">
                      <span className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-black">Q{currentIdx + 1}.</span> {q?.question}
                    </p>

                    {/* Options */}
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {q?.options.map((opt, oi) => {
                        const letter = opt.split(')')[0].trim();
                        const isCorrect = q.correct === letter;
                        const isSelected = selected?.startsWith(letter);
                        let bg = 'bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-600 dark:hover:border-indigo-500 hover:bg-indigo-50/20 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/30';
                        if (answered) {
                          if (isCorrect) bg = 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-500 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300';
                          else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) bg = 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-500 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300';
                          else bg = 'bg-slate-100/40 dark:bg-slate-800/40 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 opacity-50 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-400';
                        }
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={oi}
                            disabled={answered}
                            onClick={() => handleAnswer(opt)}
                            className={`w-full text-left p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${bg}`}
                          >
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              {answered && isCorrect && <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />}
                              {answered && isSelected && !isCorrect && <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400 shrink-0" />}
                              <span className="text-slate-855 dark:text-slate-200">{opt}</span>
                            </span>
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>

                    {/* Explanation */}
                    {answered && (
                      <motion.div
                        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                        className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed"
                      >
                        <span className="font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">Объяснение: </span>
                        <ReactMarkdown>{q?.explanation}</ReactMarkdown>
                      </motion.div>
                    )}

                    {answered && (
                      <motion.button
                        initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                        onClick={handleNext}
                        className="w-full py-3 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                      >
                        {currentIdx < questions.length - 1 ? 'Следующий вопрос →' : (
                          <><Trophy className="w-4 h-4" /> Завершить тест</>
                        )}
                      </motion.button>
                    )}
                  </motion.div>
                </AnimatePresence>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

<file path="frontend/src/components/SettingsPanel.tsx">
import { AnalysisSettings } from '../types';
import { FileText, Layers, HelpCircle, Zap, Headphones, Gamepad2, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface Props {
  settings: AnalysisSettings;
  onChange: (s: AnalysisSettings) => void;
}

const detailLabels: Record<string, string> = { brief: 'Краткий', medium: 'Средний', detailed: 'Подробный' };
const diffLabels: Record<string, string> = { easy: 'Лёгкий', medium: 'Средний', hard: 'Сложный', mixed: 'Смешанный' };
const typeLabels: Record<string, string> = { multiple: 'Выбор ответа', truefalse: 'Верно / Неверно' };

function SegmentedControl({ options, value, onChange }: { options: { key: string; label: string }[]; value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900/50 rounded-lg p-1 gap-1">
      {options.map(o => (
        <button key={o.key} onClick={() => onChange(o.key)}
          className={'flex-1 min-w-[80px] sm:min-w-0 px-2 sm:px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm transition ' + (value === o.key ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-medium shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200')}>
          {o.label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function SettingsPanel({ settings, onChange }: Props) {
  const set = (patch: Partial<AnalysisSettings>) => onChange({ ...settings, ...patch });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div>
        <label className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-3.5 block">Модули для генерации</label>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3.5 mb-6">
          {[
            { id: 'summarizer', label: 'Конспект', desc: 'Структурированные тезисы, темы и словарь терминов', icon: FileText, color: 'indigo' },
            { id: 'flashcards', label: 'Карточки', desc: 'Флеш-карточки для быстрого интервального повторения', icon: Layers, color: 'amber' },
            { id: 'quiz', label: 'Тест', desc: 'Интерактивный тест с подробным разбором ошибок', icon: HelpCircle, color: 'emerald' },
            { id: 'cheatsheet', label: 'Шпаргалка', desc: 'Самая главная выжимка лекции для быстрой проверки', icon: Zap, color: 'orange' },
            { id: 'podcast', label: 'Подкаст', desc: 'Увлекательный аудио-подкаст между двумя ведущими', icon: Headphones, color: 'purple' },
            { id: 'missions', label: 'Миссии', desc: 'Сюжетный текстовый квест-игра на основе лекции', icon: Gamepad2, color: 'rose' }
          ].map(agent => {
            const isChecked = (settings.enabledAgents || []).includes(agent.id);
            const Icon = agent.icon;
            
            // Theme mapping for high fidelity colors
            const themeClasses = {
              indigo: isChecked 
                ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50/20 dark:bg-indigo-950/15' 
                : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900',
              amber: isChecked 
                ? 'border-amber-500 bg-amber-50/20 dark:bg-amber-950/15' 
                : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900',
              emerald: isChecked 
                ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50/20 dark:bg-emerald-950/15' 
                : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900',
              orange: isChecked 
                ? 'border-orange-500 bg-orange-50/20 dark:bg-orange-950/15' 
                : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900',
              purple: isChecked 
                ? 'border-purple-500 bg-purple-50/20 dark:bg-purple-950/15' 
                : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900',
              rose: isChecked 
                ? 'border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/20 dark:bg-rose-950/15' 
                : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900',
            }[agent.color as 'indigo' | 'amber' | 'emerald' | 'orange' | 'purple' | 'rose'];

            const iconColors = {
              indigo: 'text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-100/70 dark:bg-indigo-950/40',
              amber: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-100/70 dark:bg-amber-950/40',
              emerald: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-100/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/40',
              orange: 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400 bg-orange-100/70 dark:bg-orange-950/40',
              purple: 'text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 bg-purple-100/70 dark:bg-purple-950/40',
              rose: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 bg-rose-100/70 dark:bg-rose-950/40',
            }[agent.color as 'indigo' | 'amber' | 'emerald' | 'orange' | 'purple' | 'rose'];

            return (
              <div
                key={agent.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  const current = settings.enabledAgents || [];
                  const next = isChecked 
                    ? current.filter(id => id !== agent.id)
                    : [...current, agent.id];
                  if (next.length > 0) {
                    set({ enabledAgents: next });
                  }
                }}
                className={`relative flex flex-col items-start p-4 rounded-xl border cursor-pointer select-none transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-[1.02] hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:scale-[0.99] group shadow-sm hover:shadow-md ${themeClasses} ${!isChecked ? 'opacity-60 hover:opacity-100' : ''}`}
              >
                {/* Header info */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full mb-2">
                  <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition shrink-0 ${iconColors}`}>
                    <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </div>
                  
                  {/* Custom checkbox badge */}
                  <div className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-full border flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300 ${isChecked ? 'bg-indigo-650 dark:bg-indigo-500 border-indigo-650 dark:border-indigo-500 scale-100 shadow-sm shadow-indigo-500/10' : 'border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-transparent scale-90'}`}>
                    {isChecked && <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white" />}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Text Content */}
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-850 dark:text-slate-100 mb-0.5">{agent.label}</span>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium leading-normal text-slate-450 dark:text-slate-500">{agent.desc}</span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Детализация конспекта */}
      {settings.enabledAgents?.includes('summarizer') && (
        <div>
          <label className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-2 block">Детализация конспекта</label>
          <SegmentedControl
            options={Object.entries(detailLabels).map(([k, v]) => ({ key: k, label: v }))}
            value={settings.summaryDetail}
            onChange={v => set({ summaryDetail: v as any })}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Количество карточек */}
      {settings.enabledAgents?.includes('flashcards') && (
        <div>
          <label className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-2 block">Количество карточек: {settings.flashcardCount}</label>
          <input type="range" min={3} max={12} value={settings.flashcardCount}
            onChange={e => set({ flashcardCount: +e.target.value })}
            className="w-full accent-brand-600" />
          <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1"><span>3</span><span>12</span></div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Параметры проверочного теста */}
      {settings.enabledAgents?.includes('quiz') && (
        <>
          <div>
            <label className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-2 block">Количество вопросов: {settings.quizCount}</label>
            <input type="range" min={3} max={10} value={settings.quizCount}
              onChange={e => set({ quizCount: +e.target.value })}
              className="w-full accent-brand-600" />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1"><span>3</span><span>10</span></div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-2 block">Сложность теста</label>
            <SegmentedControl
              options={Object.entries(diffLabels).map(([k, v]) => ({ key: k, label: v }))}
              value={settings.quizDifficulty}
              onChange={v => set({ quizDifficulty: v as any })}
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-2 block">Тип вопросов</label>
            <SegmentedControl
              options={Object.entries(typeLabels).map(([k, v]) => ({ key: k, label: v }))}
              value={settings.quizType}
              onChange={v => set({ quizType: v as any })}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="frontend/src/components/SkillsRadarChart.tsx">
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

interface SkillsRadarChartProps {
  data: Record<string, number>; // axis -> value 0-100
  size?: number;
  className?: string;
}

const DEFAULT_AXES = ['Algorithms', 'SQL/Data', 'Web Dev', 'Soft Skills', 'Architecture', 'Business Logic'];
const COLORS = {
  fill: 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25)',
  stroke: 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.85)',
  grid: 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.2)',
  label: '#94a3b8',
  dot: '#6366f1',
};

function polarToCartesian(cx: number, cy: number, r: number, angleRad: number) {
  return {
    x: cx + r * Math.cos(angleRad - Math.PI / 2),
    y: cy + r * Math.sin(angleRad - Math.PI / 2),
  };
}

export default function SkillsRadarChart({ data, size = 220, className = '' }: SkillsRadarChartProps) {
  // Determine axes: prefer axes from data (up to 6), fill with defaults
  const axes = Object.keys(data).length > 0
    ? Object.keys(data).slice(0, 6)
    : DEFAULT_AXES;

  const n = axes.length;
  const cx = size / 2;
  const cy = size / 2;
  const maxR = size / 2 - 30; // balanced radius with padded viewBox
  const levels = 4;
  const padX = 70; // large horizontal padding to accommodate long labels (e.g. Code Quality)
  const padY = 30; // vertical padding for labels

  // Compute angle for each axis
  const angle = (i: number) => (2 * Math.PI * i) / n;

  // Grid polygon points for each level
  const gridPolygon = (level: number) => {
    const r = (maxR * level) / levels;
    return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => {
      const pt = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, r, angle(i));
      return `${pt.x},${pt.y}`;
    }).join(' ');
  };

  // Data polygon
  const dataPolygon = axes.map((axis, i) => {
    const val = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, data[axis] ?? 0));
    const r = (maxR * val) / 100;
    const pt = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, r, angle(i));
    return `${pt.x},${pt.y}`;
  }).join(' ');

  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-col items-center gap-3 px-4 ${className}`}>
      <svg
        style={{ width: '100%', height: 'auto', maxWidth: `${size + 2 * padX}px`, overflow: 'visible' }}
        viewBox={`-${padX} -${padY} ${size + 2 * padX} ${size + 2 * padY}`}
        overflow="visible"
      >
        {/* Grid levels */}
        {Array.from({ length: levels }, (_, lv) => (
          <polygon
            key={lv}
            points={gridPolygon(lv + 1)}
            fill="none"
            stroke={COLORS.grid}
            strokeWidth={1}
          />
        ))}

        {/* Axis lines */}
        {axes.map((_, i) => {
          const outer = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, maxR, angle(i));
          return (
            <line
              key={i}
              x1={cx} y1={cy}
              x2={outer.x} y2={outer.y}
              stroke={COLORS.grid}
              strokeWidth={1}
            />
          );
        })}

        {/* Data polygon */}
        <motion.polygon
          points={dataPolygon}
          fill={COLORS.fill}
          stroke={COLORS.stroke}
          strokeWidth={2}
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.5 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeOut' }}
          style={{ transformOrigin: `${cx}px ${cy}px` }}
        />

        {/* Data dots */}
        {axes.map((axis, i) => {
          const val = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, data[axis] ?? 0));
          const r = (maxR * val) / 100;
          const pt = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, r, angle(i));
          return (
            <motion.circle
              key={i}
              cx={pt.x} cy={pt.y} r={4}
              fill={COLORS.dot}
              stroke="#1e1b4b"
              strokeWidth={1.5}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
              transition={{ delay: 0.4 + i * 0.05 }}
            />
          );
        })}

        {/* Axis labels */}
        {axes.map((axis, i) => {
          const labelR = maxR + 14;
          const pt = polarToCartesian(cx, cy, labelR, angle(i));
          const textAnchor =
            pt.x < cx - 8 ? 'end' : pt.x > cx + 8 ? 'start' : 'middle';
          // Split long labels into 2 lines
          const words = axis.split(/\s+/);
          const line1 = words.slice(0, Math.ceil(words.length / 2)).join(' ');
          const line2 = words.length > 1 ? words.slice(Math.ceil(words.length / 2)).join(' ') : null;
          return (
            <text
              key={i}
              x={pt.x}
              y={line2 ? pt.y : pt.y + 4}
              textAnchor={textAnchor}
              fontSize={9}
              fill={COLORS.label}
              fontWeight="600"
              fontFamily="Inter, system-ui, sans-serif"
            >
              <tspan x={pt.x} dy="0">{line1}</tspan>
              {line2 && <tspan x={pt.x} dy="11">{line2}</tspan>}
            </text>
          );
        })}
      </svg>

      {/* Legend chips */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-1.5 px-2">
        {axes.map(axis => (
          <div key={axis} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-semibold">
            <div
              className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full"
              style={{ backgroundColor: `hsl(${239 - (data[axis] ?? 0) * 0.5}, 80%, 60%)` }}
            />
            {axis}: <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">{data[axis] ?? 0}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { format, subDays } from 'date-fns';
import { ru } from 'date-fns/locale';
import { Bar, BarChart, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis } from 'recharts';
import { ArrowRight, BarChart3, BookOpen, CalendarDays, CheckCircle2, FileText, Flame, Plus, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { getMaterials } from '../api/materials';
import { getDueCards } from '../api/flashcards';
import type { StudySession } from '../types';

export default function Dashboard() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [dueCards, setDueCards] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [subjects, setSubjects] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<StudySession[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    Promise.all([
      getMaterials(user.id),
      getDueCards(user.id),
      supabase.from('subjects').select('*').eq('user_id', user.id),
      supabase.from('study_sessions').select('*').eq('user_id', user.id).order('date', { ascending: false }).limit(30),
    ])
      .then(([materialsData, cardsData, subjectsResult, sessionsResult]) => {
        setMaterials(materialsData);
        setDueCards(cardsData);
        setSubjects(subjectsResult.data || []);
        setSessions(sessionsResult.data || []);
      })
      .catch(console.error)
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [user?.id]);

  const streak = useMemo(() => {
    const dates = new Set(sessions.map(session => session.date));
    let count = 0;
    let cursor = new Date();
    while (dates.has(format(cursor, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) {
      count += 1;
      cursor = subDays(cursor, 1);
    }
    return count;
  }, [sessions]);

  const chartData = useMemo(() => {
    const reviewedByDate: Record<string, number> = {};
    sessions.forEach(session => {
      reviewedByDate[session.date] = session.cards_reviewed || 0;
    });
    return Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, index) => {
      const date = subDays(new Date(), 13 - index);
      const key = format(date, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
      return { day: format(date, 'dd.MM'), reviewed: reviewedByDate[key] || 0 };
    });
  }, [sessions]);

  const nextExam = useMemo(() => {
    const today = format(new Date(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
    return subjects
      .filter(subject => subject.exam_date && subject.exam_date >= today)
      .sort((a, b) => a.exam_date.localeCompare(b.exam_date))[0] || null;
  }, [subjects]);

  const reviewedToday = sessions.find(session => session.date === format(new Date(), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))?.cards_reviewed || 0;
  const name = user?.user_metadata?.full_name?.split(' ')[0] || 'Студент';
  const primaryAction = materials.length === 0
    ? {
        eyebrow: 'Первый шаг',
        title: 'Добавьте учебный материал',
        description: 'Загрузите лекцию, конспект или запись. Meldy подготовит конспект, карточки и тест.',
        label: 'Добавить материал',
        route: '/analyze',
        icon: Plus,
      }
    : dueCards.length > 0
      ? {
          eyebrow: 'На сегодня',
          title: `Повторить ${dueCards.length} ${pluralizeCards(dueCards.length)}`,
          description: 'Начните с карточек, срок которых уже наступил. Это займёт несколько минут.',
          label: 'Начать повторение',
          route: '/review',
          icon: RotateCcw,
        }
      : {
          eyebrow: 'На сегодня всё',
          title: 'Карточки повторены',
          description: 'Можно открыть последний материал или добавить новую лекцию.',
          label: 'Открыть библиотеку',
          route: '/library',
          icon: CheckCircle2,
        };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-[60vh] items-center justify-center" role="status" aria-label="Загрузка">
        <div className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-cyan-300 border-t-transparent" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const PrimaryIcon = primaryAction.icon;
  return (
    <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 md:py-10">
      <header className="flex flex-col gap-5 border-b border-slate-200 pb-7 dark:border-slate-800 md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between">
        <div>
          <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--sf-accent)]">Сегодня</p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-950 dark:text-slate-50 md:text-4xl">{name}, что повторим?</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm capitalize text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{format(new Date(), 'EEEE, d MMMM', { locale: ru })}</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => navigate('/analyze')} className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-cyan-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-950 transition-colors hover:bg-cyan-200 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-cyan-300">
          <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> Добавить материал
        </button>
      </header>

      <section className="grid gap-8 py-8 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.45fr)_minmax(280px,.75fr)]">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => navigate(primaryAction.route)} className="group relative min-h-64 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-[var(--sf-line)] bg-[var(--sf-surface)] p-6 text-left text-[var(--sf-ink)] transition-colors hover:border-[var(--sf-accent)] focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[var(--sf-accent)] sm:p-8">
          <div className="relative flex h-full min-h-48 flex-col justify-between gap-8">
            <div>
              <div className="mb-6 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-[var(--sf-line)] bg-[var(--sf-accent-soft)]"><PrimaryIcon className="h-5 w-5 text-[var(--sf-accent)]" /></div>
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[var(--sf-accent)]">{primaryAction.eyebrow}</p>
              <h2 className="mt-2 max-w-xl text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-3xl">{primaryAction.title}</h2>
              <p className="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-6 text-[var(--sf-muted)] sm:text-base">{primaryAction.description}</p>
            </div>
            <span className="inline-flex min-h-11 w-fit items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[var(--sf-accent)] px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-[0_3px_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--sf-accent)_72%,#111)] transition group-hover:-translate-y-px group-hover:bg-[var(--sf-accent-hover)] group-active:translate-y-px group-active:shadow-none">{primaryAction.label}<ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" /></span>
          </div>
        </button>

        <div className="divide-y divide-slate-200 border-y border-slate-200 dark:divide-slate-800 dark:border-slate-800">
          <Metric label="Карточек на сегодня" value={dueCards.length} icon={RotateCcw} />
          <Metric label="Повторено сегодня" value={reviewedToday} icon={CheckCircle2} />
          <Metric label="Дней подряд" value={streak} icon={Flame} />
          <Metric label="Материалов" value={materials.length} icon={BookOpen} />
        </div>
      </section>

      {nextExam && (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => navigate('/courses')} className="mb-8 flex w-full items-center gap-4 border-y border-amber-300/40 bg-amber-50/60 px-1 py-4 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-amber-50 dark:border-amber-800/40 dark:bg-amber-950/15 dark:hover:bg-amber-950/25">
          <CalendarDays className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">Ближайший экзамен</p>
            <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">{nextExam.name}</p>
          </div>
          <span className="shrink-0 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{format(new Date(nextExam.exam_date), 'd MMMM', { locale: ru })}</span>
          <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-slate-400" />

            <div><p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">Библиотека</p><h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950 dark:text-slate-50">Последние материалы</h2></div>

                  <span className="shrink-0 text-xs tabular-nums text-slate-400">{format(new Date(material.created_at), 'dd.MM.yy')}</span>

              ))}

          )}

        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-end justify-between gap-4">

            <button type="button" onClick={() => navigate('/analytics')} aria-label="Открыть прогресс" className="text-slate-400 hover:text-cyan-600 dark:hover:text-cyan-300"><BarChart3 className="h-5 w-5" /></button>

function Metric({ label, value, icon: Icon }: { label: string; value: number; icon: React.ElementType }) {
  return <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-4 first:pt-0 last:pb-0 lg:first:pt-4 lg:last:pb-4"><Icon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-300" /><span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{label}</span><strong className="text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-950 dark:text-slate-50">{value}</strong></div>;
}

function pluralizeCards(count: number) {
  const mod10 = count % 10;
  const mod100 = count % 100;
  if (mod10 === 1 && mod100 !== 11) return 'карточку';
  if (mod10 >= 2 && mod10 <= 4 && (mod100 < 12 || mod100 > 14)) return 'карточки';
  return 'карточек';
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Check, Loader2, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';

export default function Pricing() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const userId = user?.id;
  const [isPro, setIsPro] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isCurrent = true;

    if (!userId) {
      setIsPro(false);
      setLoadError(false);
      setLoading(false);
      return () => { isCurrent = false; };
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setLoadError(false);

    void (async () => {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('is_pro')
          .eq('id', userId)
          .single();

        if (error) throw error;
        if (!data) throw new Error('Profile is missing');
        if (isCurrent) setIsPro(Boolean(data.is_pro));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Не удалось проверить тариф:', error);
        if (isCurrent) setLoadError(true);
      } finally {
        if (isCurrent) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();

    return () => { isCurrent = false; };
  }, [userId]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-[50vh] flex items-center justify-center" role="status" aria-label="Проверяем тариф">
        <Loader2 className="w-7 h-7 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-300 animate-spin" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loadError) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-12">
        <p className="rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-4 text-rose-800 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/30 dark:text-rose-200" role="alert">
          Не удалось проверить тариф. Обновите страницу и попробуйте снова.

        <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-950 dark:text-white mb-3">
          Тарифы
        </h1>
        <p className="text-base md:text-lg text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
          Основные функции доступны бесплатно. Оплата тарифа PRO пока не подключена.
        </p>
      </header>

      <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-5 md:gap-6">
        <section className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl p-6 md:p-7 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex flex-col">
          <div className="mb-7">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950 dark:text-white mb-1">Студент</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 mb-5">Базовый набор для учёбы</p>
            <p className="text-3xl font-semibold text-slate-950 dark:text-white">0 ₽</p>
          </div>

          <ul className="space-y-4 mb-7 flex-1">
            <li className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
              <Check className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300 shrink-0" />
              <span>Анализ учебных материалов</span>
            </li>
            <li className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
              <Check className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300 shrink-0" />
              <span>Создание карточек и тестов</span>
            </li>
            <li className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
              <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300 shrink-0" />
              <span>До 100 единиц ИИ-лимита в день</span>
            </li>
