export default function FlashcardsView({ data, sources = [] }: { data: FlashcardsInfo; sources?: { id: string; text: string }[] }) {
  const cards = data?.flashcards;

  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});
  const [studyMode, setStudyMode] = useState(false);
  const [studyIdx, setStudyIdx] = useState(0);
  const [studyRevealed, setStudyRevealed] = useState(false);
  const [studyResults, setStudyResults] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});
  const [studyDone, setStudyDone] = useState(false);
  const [copiedIdx, setCopiedIdx] = useState(-1);

  const toggle = (i: number) => setRevealed({ ...revealed, [i]: !revealed[i] });
  
  const revealAll = () => {
    if (!cards || !Array.isArray(cards)) return;
    const r: Record<number, boolean> = {};
    cards.forEach((_: Flashcard, i: number) => { r[i] = true; });
    setRevealed(r);
  };
  
  const hideAll = () => setRevealed({});

  const startStudy = () => {
    setStudyMode(true);
    setStudyIdx(0);
    setStudyRevealed(false);
    setStudyResults({});
    setStudyDone(false);
  };

  const exitStudy = () => setStudyMode(false);

  const markCard = (known: boolean) => {
    if (!cards) return;
    const next = { ...studyResults, [studyIdx]: known };
    if (studyIdx + 1 < cards.length) {
      setStudyResults(next);
      setStudyIdx(studyIdx + 1);
      setStudyRevealed(false);
    } else {
      setStudyResults(next);
      setStudyDone(true);
    }
  };

  if (!cards || !Array.isArray(cards)) return <p className="text-slate-400">Нет данных</p>;

  // Study mode
  if (studyMode) {
    const knownCount = Object.values(studyResults).filter(Boolean).length;

    if (studyDone) {
      return (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          className="card p-8 text-center">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4 border border-emerald-100 dark:border-emerald-900/30">
            <GraduationCap className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-500 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2">
            Результат: {knownCount} из {cards.length}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-6">
            {knownCount === cards.length ? 'Отлично! Вы знаете все карточки!' :
             knownCount >= cards.length / 2 ? 'Неплохо, но есть что подтянуть.' :
             'Стоит повторить материал ещё раз.'}
          </p>
          <div className="flex justify-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={startStudy}
              className="px-5 py-2 bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-700 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition">
              Пройти снова
            </button>
            <button onClick={exitStudy}
              className="px-5 py-2 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition">
              К списку
            </button>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-2">
          <span>Карточка {studyIdx + 1} из {cards.length}</span>
          <button onClick={exitStudy} className="hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-slate-200 transition">Выйти</button>
        </div>

        <motion.div key={studyIdx} initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} className="card p-8 min-h-[300px] flex flex-col justify-center items-center text-center">
          <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-8">{cards[studyIdx].question}</p>
          
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
            {!studyRevealed ? (
              <motion.button 
                key="reveal" 
                initial={{ opacity: 0 }} 
                animate={{ opacity: 1 }} 
                exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                onClick={() => setStudyRevealed(true)}
                className="mx-auto px-6 py-2.5 bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-700 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition"
              >
                Показать ответ
              </motion.button>
            ) : (
              <motion.div 
                key="answer" 
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} 
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} 
                exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                className="w-full mt-4 pt-6 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-left markdown-content"
              >
                <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>
                  {cards[studyIdx].answer}
                </ReactMarkdown>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </motion.div>

        {studyRevealed && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} className="flex gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => markCard(true)}
              className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/30 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/40 transition">
              <Check className="w-5 h-5" />Знаю
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => markCard(false)}
              className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/20 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/30 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 font-medium hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition">
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />Ещё раз
            </button>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  // Normal mode
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-4 w-full">
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button onClick={revealAll} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
            <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />Показать все
          </button>
          <button onClick={hideAll} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
            <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />Скрыть все
          </button>
        </div>
        <button onClick={startStudy}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold text-white bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 transition shadow-sm shrink-0">
          <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4" />Начать обучение
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-3">
        {cards.map((c: Flashcard, i: number) => (
          <motion.div key={i} initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.05 }}
            className="card p-4 cursor-pointer hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700 transition group"
            onClick={() => toggle(i)}>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-2">Q{i+1}: {c.question}</p>
                <AnimatePresence>
                  {revealed[i] && (
                    <motion.div 
                      initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }} 
                      animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }} 
                      exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                      className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-850 pt-3 mt-2 markdown-content text-left"
                    >
                      <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkMath]} rehypePlugins={[rehypeKatex]}>
                        {c.answer}
                      </ReactMarkdown>
                    </motion.div>
                  )}
                </AnimatePresence>
                <SourceReferences ids={c.source_ids} sources={sources} compact />
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={(e) => { 
                  e.stopPropagation(); 
                  navigator.clipboard.writeText(`Q: ${c.question}\nA: ${c.answer}`); 
                  setCopiedIdx(i); 
                  setTimeout(() => setCopiedIdx(-1), 1500); 
                }} 
                className="shrink-0 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition p-1 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-500 dark:hover:text-slate-400"
              >
                {copiedIdx === i ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              </button>
            </div>
            {!revealed[i] && (
              <p className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-[13px] border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 pt-2 italic">Нажмите, чтобы увидеть ответ</p>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

export default function ForgeyAssistant() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<any>(null);
  const [selectedFaq, setSelectedFaq] = useState<FAQItem | null>(null);
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem('forgey_assistant_hidden') !== 'true';
  });

  const [isSocraticOpen, setIsSocraticOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleToggle = () => {
      setIsVisible(localStorage.getItem('forgey_assistant_hidden') !== 'true');
    };
    const handleSocraticOpen = () => { setIsSocraticOpen(true); setIsOpen(false); };
    const handleSocraticClose = () => setIsSocraticOpen(false);
    window.addEventListener('forgey_assistant_toggle', handleToggle);
    window.addEventListener('socratic_chat_open', handleSocraticOpen);
    window.addEventListener('socratic_chat_close', handleSocraticClose);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('forgey_assistant_toggle', handleToggle);
      window.removeEventListener('socratic_chat_open', handleSocraticOpen);
      window.removeEventListener('socratic_chat_close', handleSocraticClose);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    getProfile(user.id).then(setProfile);
  }, [user?.id, location.pathname]);

  // Закрываем панель при переходе на страницу чата
  useEffect(() => {
    if (location.pathname.startsWith('/chat')) {
      setIsOpen(false);
    }
    setSelectedFaq(null);
  }, [location.pathname]);

  const getPageAdvice = () => {
    const path = location.pathname;
    const isTeacher = profile?.role === 'teacher';

    if (path.startsWith('/dashboard')) {
      return {
        title: 'Твоя панель управления',
        text: `Привет, ${profile?.full_name || 'друг'}! Здесь видны ежедневные квесты, ближайшие экзамены и рекомендации. ${
          isTeacher
            ? 'Как преподаватель, переключайся на управление группами через «Сообщество».'
            : 'Карточки на повторение — твой главный инструмент: начни с них!'
        }`
      };
    }
    if (path.startsWith('/library')) return { title: 'Твоя библиотека', text: 'Все загруженные материалы. Кликни на лекцию — откроется конспект, карточки и тест.' };
    if (path.startsWith('/analyze')) return { title: 'Загрузка материалов', text: 'Перетащи PDF, конспект или аудио. ИИ создаст краткое изложение, карточки и тест за минуту.' };
    if (path.startsWith('/teacher')) return { title: isTeacher ? 'Управление классами' : 'Мой учебный класс', text: isTeacher ? 'Создайте класс, отправьте код студентам, назначайте материалы и следите за успеваемостью в лидерборде.' : 'Здесь задания и дедлайны от преподавателя. Выполняй их — зарабатывай XP!' };
    if (path.startsWith('/courses')) return { title: 'Учебные курсы', text: 'Объединяй материалы в структурированные курсы. ИИ разобьёт лекции по разделам от простого к сложному.' };
    if (path.startsWith('/exam')) return { title: 'Устный экзамен с ИИ', text: 'Симуляция настоящего экзамена. Отвечай голосом или текстом — Профессор оценит полноту ответа.' };
    if (path.startsWith('/analytics')) return { title: 'Аналитика успеваемости', text: 'Тепловая карта знаний: зеленые темы — отличные знания, красные — нужно срочно повторить.' };
    if (path.startsWith('/review')) return { title: 'Умные карточки', text: 'Интервальное повторение: алгоритм сам рассчитывает, когда показать карточку, чтобы ты не забыл.' };
    if (path.startsWith('/mistakes')) return { title: 'Дневник ошибок', text: 'Сюда попадают все неверные ответы из тестов. Повторяй их регулярно — ИИ учтёт это на экзамене.' };
    if (path.startsWith('/knowledge-map')) return { title: 'Карта знаний', text: 'Визуальный граф всех твоих лекций и понятий. Видишь связи между темами? Это и есть настоящее понимание.' };
    if (path.startsWith('/quick-prep')) return { title: 'Быстрый повтор', text: 'Экспресс-шпаргалка + блиц-опрос по материалу. Идеально за 5 минут до занятия.' };

    return { title: 'Помощник Meldy', text: 'Я помогу разобраться с учёбой. Выбери вопрос ниже.' };
  };

  const currentAdvice = getPageAdvice();

  // На странице чата на мобильных — полностью скрываем кнопку
  const isChatPage = location.pathname.startsWith('/chat');
  const isMessagesPage = location.pathname.startsWith('/messages');

  if (!isVisible) return (
    <div className={`fixed z-[9999] ${isChatPage || isMessagesPage ? 'hidden' : 'bottom-[80px] right-4 md:bottom-6 md:right-6'}`}>
      <motion.button
        onClick={() => { setIsVisible(true); localStorage.removeItem('forgey_assistant_hidden'); }}
        whileHover={{ scale: 1.1 }}
        whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
        title="Показать помощника"
        className="w-10 h-10 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900/50 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-md border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-500 transition"
      >
        <Bot className="w-5 h-5" />
      </motion.button>
    </div>
  );

  // На странице чата/сообщений или когда Socratic открыт — скрываем
  if (isChatPage || isMessagesPage || isSocraticOpen) return null;

  return (
    <>
      {/* FLOATING BUTTON */}
      <div className="fixed bottom-[80px] right-4 md:bottom-6 md:right-6 z-[9999]">
        <motion.button
          onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
          whileHover={{ scale: 1.08 }}
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
          className="relative w-13 h-13 w-[52px] h-[52px] bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-600 to-indigo-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-xl shadow-indigo-600/30 border border-indigo-400/20 text-white cursor-pointer"
          aria-label="Открыть помощника"
        >
          <span className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/20 animate-ping opacity-75" />
          <Bot className="w-6 h-6" />
          <span className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-3 h-3 bg-emerald-500 border-2 border-white rounded-full" />
        </motion.button>
      </div>

      {/* ASSISTANT PANEL */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isOpen && (
          <>
            {/* Backdrop on mobile */}
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
              className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-[2px] z-[9997] md:hidden"
              onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
            />

            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30, scale: 0.95 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 20, scale: 0.95 }}
              // На мобилке — снизу по центру экрана, не перекрывает навбар
              // На десктопе — справа внизу рядом с кнопкой
              className="fixed z-[9998] flex flex-col overflow-hidden
                inset-x-3 bottom-[148px] max-h-[60vh]
                md:inset-x-auto md:bottom-24 md:right-6 md:w-[340px] md:max-h-[500px]
                bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-2xl"
            >
              {/* HEADER */}
              <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900 text-white flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow-md">
                    <Bot className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-extrabold text-sm tracking-tight">Помощник Meldy</h3>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                      <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                      Онлайн · AI наставник
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                  className="p-1.5 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition"
                  aria-label="Закрыть"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* BODY */}
              <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 custom-scrollbar text-xs">
                <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
                  {!selectedFaq ? (
                    <motion.div key="advice" initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 10 }} className="space-y-4">
                      {/* Context balloon */}
                      <div className="bg-indigo-50/80 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/50 rounded-2xl p-3.5">
                        <h4 className="font-black text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-200 mb-1 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                          {currentAdvice.title}
                        </h4>
                        <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed font-medium">{currentAdvice.text}</p>
                      </div>

                      {/* FAQ */}
                      <div>
                        <h5 className="font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest text-[9px] mb-2 px-1">Частые вопросы</h5>
                        <div className="space-y-1.5">
                          {FAQ_DATABASE.map((item, idx) => (
                            <button
                              key={idx}
                              onClick={() => setSelectedFaq(item)}
                              className="w-full text-left p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 hover:text-indigo-700 dark:hover:text-indigo-300 rounded-xl transition font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60 hover:border-indigo-100 dark:hover:border-indigo-800/50 group"
                            >
                              <span className="truncate pr-2">{item.q}</span>
                              <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 group-hover:text-indigo-400 transition shrink-0">→</span>
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </motion.div>
                  ) : (
                    <motion.div key="faq-detail" initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -10 }} className="space-y-4">
                      <button onClick={() => setSelectedFaq(null)} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700 font-bold px-1">
                        <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> Назад
                      </button>
                      <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-2">
                        <h4 className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm leading-tight">{selectedFaq.q}</h4>
                        <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed font-medium">{selectedFaq.a}</p>
                      </div>
                      {selectedFaq.category === 'groups' && (
                        <button onClick={() => { setIsOpen(false); navigate('/messages'); }} className="w-full py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-center transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                          <Users className="w-4 h-4" /> Перейти к Сообществу
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {selectedFaq.category === 'library' && (
                        <button onClick={() => { setIsOpen(false); navigate('/library'); }} className="w-full py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-center transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                          <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4" /> Открыть Библиотеку
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </motion.div>
                  )}
                </AnimatePresence>
              </div>

              {/* FOOTER */}
              <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 shrink-0">
                <button
                  onClick={() => { setIsOpen(false); setIsVisible(false); localStorage.setItem('forgey_assistant_hidden', 'true'); }}
                  className="hover:text-rose-500 dark:hover:text-rose-400 transition"
                >
                  Скрыть помощника
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (user) {
                      localStorage.removeItem('forgey_assistant_hidden');
                      supabase.from('profiles').update({ onboarding_status: {} }).eq('id', user.id).then(() => {
                        setIsOpen(false);
                        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('profile_updated'));
                        navigate('/dashboard');
                      });
                    }
                  }}
                  className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-800 transition flex items-center gap-1"
                >
                  <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Начать тур заново
                </button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/components/QuizView.tsx">
import { QuizQuestion, QuizInfo } from '../types';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { CheckCircle2, XCircle, RotateCcw, Maximize2, Minimize2 } from 'lucide-react';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import SourceReferences from './SourceReferences';

export default function QuizView({ data, onComplete, sources = [] }: { data: any, onComplete?: (scorePct: number) => void, sources?: { id: string; text: string }[] }) {
  const quiz = data?.quiz;

  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);

  // Fullscreen mode state (separate from normal)
  const [fsOpen, setFsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [fsIdx, setFsIdx] = useState(0);
  const [fsAnswers, setFsAnswers] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [fsSubmitted, setFsSubmitted] = useState(false);

  const handleSelect = (qi: number, option: string) => {
    if (submitted) return;
    setAnswers({ ...answers, [qi]: option });
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    setSubmitted(true);
    const score = quiz.filter((q: QuizQuestion, i: number) => answers[i]?.startsWith(q.correct)).length;
    const pct = Math.round((score / quiz.length) * 100);
    
    if (score === quiz.length) {
      confetti({ particleCount: 120, spread: 80, origin: { y: 0.6 }, colors: ['#4F46E5', '#10b981', '#f59e0b'] });
    }
    
    if (onComplete) {
      onComplete(pct);
    }
  };
  const handleRetry = () => { setAnswers({}); setSubmitted(false); };

  if (!quiz || !Array.isArray(quiz)) {
    return (
      <div className="card p-6 bg-slate-50 border-slate-200">
        <p className="text-slate-500 mb-2 font-medium">Тест не удалось сгенерировать корректно</p>
        {data?.error && <p className="text-rose-500 text-xs mb-3">Ошибка: {data.error}</p>}
        {data?.raw && (
          <details className="text-xs">
            <summary className="text-indigo-600 cursor-pointer hover:underline mb-2">Показать технические данные</summary>
            <pre className="p-3 bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 rounded overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap max-h-64">
              {data.raw}
            </pre>
          </details>
        )}
        {!data?.raw && !data?.error && <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm">Нет данных для отображения</p>}
      </div>
    );
  }

  const correct = quiz.filter((q: QuizQuestion, i: number) => answers[i]?.startsWith(q.correct)).length;
  const total = quiz.length;
  const pct = Math.round((correct / total) * 100);

  const gradeInfo = pct >= 90 ? { label: 'Отлично', color: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', bg: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/30' }
    : pct >= 70 ? { label: 'Хорошо', color: 'text-brand-600 dark:text-indigo-400', bg: 'bg-brand-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/20 border-brand-200 dark:border-indigo-900/30' }
    : pct >= 50 ? { label: 'Удовлетворительно', color: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', bg: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/20 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/30' }
    : { label: 'Нужно подтянуть', color: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400', bg: 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/20 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/30' };

  // Fullscreen mode
  if (fsOpen && quiz) {
    const fsQ = quiz[fsIdx];
    const fsTotal = quiz.length;
    const fsCorrect = quiz.filter((q: QuizQuestion, i: number) => fsAnswers[i]?.startsWith(q.correct)).length;

    const fsSelect = (opt: string) => {
      if (fsSubmitted) return;
      setFsAnswers({ ...fsAnswers, [fsIdx]: opt });
    };

    const fsNext = () => {
      if (fsIdx + 1 < fsTotal) setFsIdx(fsIdx + 1);
      else setFsSubmitted(true);
    };

    const fsExit = () => { setFsOpen(false); setFsIdx(0); setFsAnswers({}); setFsSubmitted(false); };

    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-950 via-slate-900 to-indigo-950 text-slate-100 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-8 py-5 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800/80">
          <span className="text-indigo-400 font-extrabold text-base tracking-widest uppercase flex items-center gap-2">
            Meldy
            <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-normal">| Режим презентации</span>
          </span>
          <button
            onClick={fsExit}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800/50 hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white text-slate-300 transition duration-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-black border border-slate-700/50 cursor-pointer shadow-sm"
          >
            <Minimize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Выйти</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {!fsSubmitted ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center flex-1 px-8 py-12">
            <div className="w-full max-w-4xl text-center mb-10 bg-slate-900/40 p-8 sm:p-10 rounded-3xl border border-slate-800/60 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden">
              <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-indigo-500/5 rounded-full blur-2xl pointer-events-none" />
              <p className="text-indigo-400 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-3">Вопрос {fsIdx + 1} из {fsTotal}</p>
              <h2 className="text-white text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold leading-snug">{fsQ.question}</h2>
            </div>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 max-w-4xl w-full mx-auto">
              {fsQ.options?.map((opt: string, j: number) => {
                const selected = fsAnswers[fsIdx] === opt;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={j}
                    onClick={() => fsSelect(opt)}
                    className={`rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 text-base sm:text-lg font-bold cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 border flex items-center justify-between select-none ${
                      selected
                        ? 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/10'
                        : 'bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-850 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800/60 hover:text-white hover:border-slate-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="pr-4 leading-normal">{opt.replace(/^[A-D]\)\s*/, '')}</span>
                    <span className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black shrink-0 ${
                      selected
                        ? 'bg-white text-indigo-600 shadow'
                        : 'bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-slate-400'
                    }`}>
                      {['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'][j]}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {fsAnswers[fsIdx] && (
              <motion.button
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                onClick={fsNext}
                className="mt-10 px-8 py-4 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-2xl text-base font-black transition shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/20 duration-150 active:scale-[0.98] cursor-pointer"
              >
                {fsIdx + 1 < fsTotal ? 'Следующий вопрос →' : 'Завершить тест'}
              </motion.button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center flex-1 px-8 py-12">
            <div className="w-full max-w-2xl text-center bg-slate-900/40 p-8 sm:p-10 rounded-3xl border border-slate-800/60 shadow-xl mb-8 relative overflow-hidden">
              <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-emerald-500/5 rounded-full blur-2xl pointer-events-none" />
              <p className="text-5xl font-black text-white mb-2 tabular-nums">{fsCorrect} из {fsTotal}</p>
              <p className="text-indigo-400 font-extrabold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider mb-4">Верных ответов</p>
              
              <div className="w-full bg-slate-800 h-2.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden mb-6 p-[2px]">
                <div
                  className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-500 to-teal-400 rounded-full"
                  style={{ width: `${Math.round((fsCorrect / fsTotal) * 100)}%` }}
                />
              </div>
              <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm font-medium">Тест завершён. Правильных ответов: {Math.round((fsCorrect / fsTotal) * 100)}%.</p>
            </div>

            <div className="max-w-2xl w-full mx-auto space-y-4 pr-1">
              {quiz.map((q: QuizQuestion, i: number) => {
                const isCorrect = fsAnswers[i]?.startsWith(q.correct);
                return (
                  <div key={i} className={`rounded-2xl p-5 border flex items-start gap-4 transition-all ${
                    isCorrect 
                      ? 'bg-emerald-950/20 border-emerald-900/60 text-slate-200' 
                      : 'bg-rose-950/15 border-rose-900/60 text-slate-200'
                  }`}>
                    <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black shrink-0 ${
                      isCorrect ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-rose-600 text-white'
                    }`}>
                      {i + 1}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="font-semibold text-white mb-1.5 leading-snug break-words">{q.question}</p>
                      <p className={`text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 ${isCorrect ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-400'}`}>
                        {isCorrect
                          ? '✓ Верно'
                          : `✗ Правильный ответ: ${q.correct}) ${q.options?.find((o: string) => o.startsWith(q.correct))?.replace(/^[A-D]\)\s*/, '') || q.correct}`
                        }
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={fsExit}
              className="mt-8 px-8 py-3.5 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 rounded-2xl font-black text-sm active:scale-[0.98] transition shadow-md cursor-pointer"
            >
              Закрыть презентацию
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80">
        <div>
          <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">Проверочное тестирование</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">Ответьте на {total} вопросов для проверки знаний по материалу</p>
        </div>
        {!submitted && (
          <button
            onClick={() => setFsOpen(true)}
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100/70 dark:bg-indigo-950/30 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900/40 border border-indigo-250 dark:border-indigo-850/40 shadow-sm transition active:scale-[0.98] duration-150 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
          >
            <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Режим презентации для аудитории</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {submitted && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className={'card p-5 mb-6 flex items-center justify-between border ' + gradeInfo.bg}>
          <div>
            <p className={'font-bold text-lg ' + gradeInfo.color}>{correct} из {total} — {gradeInfo.label}</p>
            <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm">{pct}% правильных ответов</p>
          </div>
          <button onClick={handleRetry}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />Пройти снова
          </button>
        </motion.div>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-4">
        {quiz.map((q: QuizQuestion, i: number) => {
          const selected = answers[i];
          const isCorrect = selected?.startsWith(q.correct);
          const isWrong = submitted && selected && !isCorrect;

          return (
            <motion.div key={i} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.05 }}
              className="card p-5">
              <p className="font-medium text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-3">{i+1}. {q.question}</p>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {q.options?.map((opt: string, j: number) => {
                  const isSelected = selected === opt;
                  const isCorrectOpt = submitted && opt.startsWith(q.correct);
                  const isWrongOpt = submitted && isSelected && !isCorrect;

                  let cls = 'p-3 rounded-lg text-sm cursor-pointer transition border ';
                  if (!submitted) {
                    cls += isSelected ? 'bg-brand-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/30 border-brand-300 dark:border-indigo-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-indigo-200' : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700';
                  } else if (isCorrectOpt) {
                    cls += 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300';
                  } else if (isWrongOpt) {
                    cls += 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-900/50 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 line-through';
                  } else {
                    cls += 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/60 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500';
                  }

                  return (
                    <div key={j} className={'flex items-center gap-2 ' + cls}
                      onClick={() => handleSelect(i, opt)}>
                      {isCorrectOpt && <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />}
                      {isWrongOpt && <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-500 shrink-0" />}
                      <span>{opt}</span>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
              {submitted && q.explanation && (
                <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 pt-3"><span className="font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">Пояснение:</span> {q.explanation}</p>
              )}
              <SourceReferences ids={q.source_ids} sources={sources} compact />
            </motion.div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {!submitted && (
        <div className="mt-6 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400 mb-2">
            Отвечено {Object.keys(answers).length} из {total} вопросов
          </p>
          {Object.keys(answers).length === total && (
            <button onClick={handleSubmit}
              className="px-8 py-2.5 bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-700 text-white rounded-lg font-medium transition">
              Проверить ответы
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="frontend/src/components/SocraticTutor.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { X, Send, HelpCircle, Loader2, BookOpen, MessageCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { sendSocraticChat } from '../api/career';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface SocraticTutorProps {
  paragraphText: string;
  profession: string;
  isBeginnerLevel?: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function SocraticTutor({
  paragraphText,
  profession,
  isBeginnerLevel = false,
  onClose,
}: SocraticTutorProps) {
  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState<{ role: 'assistant' | 'user'; content: string }[]>([]);
  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [loadingExplanation, setLoadingExplanation] = useState(true);
  const [turnsLeft, setTurnsLeft] = useState(7);
  const chatEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Notify ForgeyAssistant to hide when we open
  useEffect(() => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('socratic_chat_open'));
    return () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('socratic_chat_close'));
    };
  }, []);

  // Load initial explanation on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoadingExplanation(true);
    setChatMessages([]);

    sendSocraticChat(paragraphText, profession, '', [], 'explain', isBeginnerLevel)
      .then((reply) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setChatMessages([{ role: 'assistant', content: reply }]);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setChatMessages([{
          role: 'assistant',
          content: `📖 **Тема: ${profession}**\n\nЯ загрузил этот фрагмент теории и готов разобрать его вместе с тобой!\n\nЗадавай любые вопросы — объясню простыми словами, с примерами и аналогиями.`,
        }]);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoadingExplanation(false);
      });

    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [paragraphText, profession, isBeginnerLevel]);

  useEffect(() => {
    chatEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [chatMessages, loadingExplanation]);

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (!input.trim() || sending || turnsLeft <= 0 || loadingExplanation) return;

    const userText = input;
    setInput('');
    const nextMsgs = [...chatMessages, { role: 'user' as const, content: userText }];
    setChatMessages(nextMsgs);
    setSending(true);
    setTurnsLeft(t => t - 1);

    try {
      const reply = await sendSocraticChat(
        paragraphText,
        profession,
        userText,
        nextMsgs,
        'socratic',
        isBeginnerLevel
      );
      setChatMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: 'assistant' as const, content: reply }]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      toast.error('Ошибка связи с наставником.');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('socratic_chat_close'));
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ x: '100%' }}
      animate={{ x: 0 }}
      exit={{ x: '100%' }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 200 }}
      className="fixed right-0 top-0 bottom-0 z-50 w-full max-w-md bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden"
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/20 shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="w-9 h-9 bg-violet-600/10 dark:bg-violet-600/20 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center border border-violet-500/20">
            <HelpCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[9px] font-black text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400 uppercase tracking-widest block">
              {isBeginnerLevel ? 'ИИ-Наставник для новичков' : 'Socratic Micro-Tutor'}
            </span>
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
              {isBeginnerLevel ? 'Персональный объяснятор' : 'Диалог с наставником'}
            </h3>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={handleClose}
          className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-full transition text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200"
        >
          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Paragraph context */}
      <div className="px-4 py-3 bg-violet-50/60 dark:bg-violet-950/20 border-b border-violet-100 dark:border-violet-900/30 text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 italic leading-relaxed max-h-20 overflow-y-auto shrink-0">
        <span className="font-bold text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-300 not-italic">📖 Разбираемый фрагмент: </span>
        "{paragraphText}"
      </div>

      {/* Chat pane */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 space-y-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900">

        {/* Loading initial explanation */}
        {loadingExplanation && (
          <div className="flex gap-2.5 max-w-[90%]">
            <div className="w-7 h-7 bg-violet-50 dark:bg-violet-950/50 border border-violet-100 dark:border-violet-500/20 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-sm">
              📖
            </div>
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/40 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-2 flex-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400 font-semibold">
                <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                Наставник изучает тему и готовит объяснение...
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="h-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full animate-pulse w-full" />
                <div className="h-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full animate-pulse w-4/5" />
                <div className="h-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full animate-pulse w-3/4" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Chat messages */}
        {chatMessages.map((msg, idx) => (
          <motion.div
            key={idx}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            className={`flex gap-2.5 ${msg.role === 'user' ? 'ml-auto flex-row-reverse max-w-[85%]' : 'max-w-[92%]'}`}
          >
            {msg.role === 'assistant' && (
              <div className="w-7 h-7 bg-violet-50 dark:bg-violet-950/50 border border-violet-100 dark:border-violet-500/20 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-sm mt-0.5">
                {isBeginnerLevel ? '🎓' : '🏛️'}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl text-[11px] leading-relaxed border shadow-sm ${
              msg.role === 'user'
                ? 'bg-violet-600 border-violet-500 text-white rounded-tr-none'
                : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/40 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-tl-none prose prose-[11px] dark:prose-invert max-w-none prose-p:my-1 prose-ul:my-1 prose-li:my-0.5 prose-strong:text-slate-900 dark:prose-strong:text-white'
            }`}>
              {msg.role === 'user'
                ? msg.content
                : <ReactMarkdown>{msg.content}</ReactMarkdown>
              }
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        ))}

        {sending && (
          <div className="flex gap-2.5 max-w-[85%]">
            <div className="w-7 h-7 bg-violet-50 dark:bg-violet-950/50 border border-violet-100 dark:border-violet-500/20 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-sm">
              {isBeginnerLevel ? '🎓' : '🏛️'}
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/40 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm">
              <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400" />
              <span className="text-[9px]">
                {isBeginnerLevel ? 'Наставник подбирает простое объяснение...' : 'Сократ подбирает аналогию...'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div ref={chatEndRef} />
      </div>

      {/* Footer input */}
      <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/80 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/20 shrink-0">
        {turnsLeft <= 0 ? (
          <p className="text-center text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic py-2">
            {isBeginnerLevel
              ? '🎓 Отличная работа! Ты задал много вопросов. Возвращайся к теории и продолжай!'
              : '🏛️ «Мудрость начинается с удивления». Наш диалог завершён. Пора продолжить курс!'}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center px-1 text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-semibold">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <MessageCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                {isBeginnerLevel ? 'Задай любой вопрос по теме' : 'Сократовский метод ведения мысли'}
              </span>
              <span>Реплик: {turnsLeft}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                disabled={sending || loadingExplanation}
                value={input}
                onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSend(); }}
                placeholder={loadingExplanation
                  ? 'Подождите, загружается объяснение...'
                  : isBeginnerLevel
                    ? 'Что непонятно? Задавай любой вопрос...'
                    : 'Задайте вопрос или изложите сомнение...'}
                className="flex-1 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-violet-500/60 transition disabled:opacity-60"
              />
              <button
                onClick={handleSend}
                disabled={!input.trim() || sending || loadingExplanation}
                className="p-2 bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-700 text-white rounded-xl transition flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-sm disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/components/UploadZone.tsx">
import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { Upload, FileText, X, Zap, Youtube, Video, FileAudio, Layers, CheckCircle2, FileVideo, Music, Camera, Loader2, Link } from 'lucide-react';
import SettingsPanel from './SettingsPanel';
import { AnalysisSettings } from '../types';
import { hasBadWords } from '../utils/moderation';
import { compressImage } from '../lib/imageCompression';

interface Props {
  settings: AnalysisSettings;
  onSettingsChange: (s: AnalysisSettings) => void;
  onUpload: (f: File | null, url?: string) => void;
  onDemo: () => void;
}

export default function UploadZone({ settings, onSettingsChange, onUpload, onDemo }: Props) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'docs' | 'media' | 'url'>('docs');
  const [dragOver, setDragOver] = useState(false);
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [url, setUrl] = useState('');
  const [sizeError, setSizeError] = useState('');
  const [isCompressing, setIsCompressing] = useState(false);

  const MAX_SIZE = 15 * 1024 * 1024;

  const validateAndSet = async (f: File) => {
    let finalFile = f;
    if (!f.name.includes('.') && f.size > 0 && f.type.startsWith('image/')) {
      finalFile = new File([f], f.name + '.jpg', { type: f.type });
    }

    if (finalFile.type.startsWith('image/')) {
      setIsCompressing(true);
      try {
        finalFile = await compressImage(finalFile);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Ошибка сжатия:', e);
      }
      setIsCompressing(false);
    }

    if (finalFile.size > MAX_SIZE) {
      setSizeError(`Файл занимает ${(finalFile.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} МБ. Максимальный размер — 15 МБ.`);
      setFile(null);
    } else if (hasBadWords(finalFile.name)) {
      setSizeError('Название файла содержит недопустимые слова. Пожалуйста, переименуйте файл.');
      setFile(null);
    } else {
      setSizeError('');
      setFile(finalFile);
    }
  };

  const handleDrop = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); setDragOver(false);
    const d = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
    if (d) validateAndSet(d);
  }, []);

  const handleStart = () => { 
    if (tab === 'url') {
      if (url.trim()) onUpload(null, url.trim());
    } else {
      if (file) onUpload(file); 
    }
  };

  const isReady = tab === 'url' ? (!!url.trim() && url.includes('.')) : !!file;

  return (
    <div className="py-10 space-y-8">
      {/* Hero */}
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="text-center">
        <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-3 leading-tight">
          Один материал — полный цикл подготовки
        </h1>
        <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-lg mb-8">
          Загрузите источник. Meldy подготовит конспект, карточки и тест со ссылками на исходный текст.
        </p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
            <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-500" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">Структурированный конспект</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
            <Layers className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">Карточки для запоминания</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">Проверочный тест</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.05 }}>
         <div className="flex bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900/50 p-1.5 rounded-2xl max-w-lg mx-auto">
            <button
              onClick={() => { setTab('docs'); setFile(null); }}
              className={`flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold transition whitespace-nowrap ${tab === 'docs' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200'}`}
            >
              <FileText className="inline-block w-4 h-4 mr-2" aria-hidden="true" />Документы
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => { setTab('media'); setFile(null); }}
              className={`flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold transition whitespace-nowrap ${tab === 'media' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200'}`}
            >
              <Video className="inline-block w-4 h-4 mr-2" aria-hidden="true" />Видео и аудио
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => { setTab('url'); setFile(null); }}
              className={`flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold transition whitespace-nowrap ${tab === 'url' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400 shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200'}`}
            >
              <Link className="inline-block w-4 h-4 mr-2" aria-hidden="true" />Ссылка
            </button>
         </div>
      </motion.div>

      {/* Шаг 1: Загрузка файла */}
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.1 }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
          <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-brand-600 dark:bg-brand-500 text-white text-sm flex items-center justify-center font-bold">1</span>
          <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
            {tab === 'docs' ? 'Выберите файл' : tab === 'media' ? 'Загрузите файл' : 'Укажите веб-ссылку'}
          </span>
        </div>

        {tab === 'url' ? (
          <div className="card p-8 md:p-12 text-center transition border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-brand-300 dark:hover:border-brand-500 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 shadow-lg rounded-2xl relative overflow-hidden">
            {/* Ambient Background Glow */}
            <div className="absolute top-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-64 h-64 bg-brand-500/10 dark:bg-brand-400/5 blur-3xl rounded-full pointer-events-none" />

            <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-brand-50 dark:bg-brand-900/30 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6 relative">
              <Link className="w-7 h-7 text-brand-500 dark:text-brand-400 animate-pulse" />
            </div>

            <h3 className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold text-xl mb-2">
              Анализ веб-страницы по ссылке
            </h3>
            <p className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-sm max-w-md mx-auto mb-6">
              Вставьте публичную ссылку на статью или учебный материал. Мы извлечём основной текст без меню и рекламы.
            </p>

            <div className="max-w-lg mx-auto relative group">
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-cyan-400 rounded-xl blur opacity-15 group-focus-within:opacity-25 transition duration-300 pointer-events-none" />
              <div className="relative flex items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 group-focus-within:border-brand-500 shadow-sm">
                <input
                  type="url"
                  name="source-url"
                  autoComplete="url"
                  aria-label="Ссылка на учебный материал"
                  placeholder="https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/..."
                  value={url}
                  onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3.5 bg-transparent text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none text-sm md:text-base font-medium"
                />
                {url && (
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => setUrl('')}
                    className="p-1.5 mr-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300 transition"
                  >
                    <X className="w-4 h-4" />

              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Presets */}
            <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap justify-center items-center gap-3">

              <button

                className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-brand-600 dark:hover:text-brand-400 hover:border-brand-300 dark:hover:border-brand-500 transition font-medium"
              >
                Ньютон (Вики)

              >

            >
              <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-brand-50 dark:bg-brand-900/30 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">

              <p className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">или нажмите для выбора</p>
              <p className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-660 text-sm mt-3">
                {tab === 'docs' ? 'PDF, DOCX, HTML, TXT, MD, JPG и PNG — до 15 МБ' : 'MP4, MP3, WAV, MPEG и M4A — до 15 МБ'}
              </p>
            </div>
            
            {tab === 'docs' && (
              <div className="mt-3 flex justify-center sm:hidden">

                  onClick={() => document.getElementById('camera-input')?.click()}

                >
                  <Camera className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-300" /> Сфотографировать конспект
                </button>
                <input id="camera-input" type="file" accept="image/*" capture="environment" className="hidden" onChange={e => { if (e.target.files?.[0]) { validateAndSet(e.target.files[0]); e.target.value = ''; } }} />
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        ) : file ? (
          <div className="card p-5 flex items-center gap-4">
            {tab === 'docs' ? <FileText className="w-10 h-10 text-brand-500 shrink-0" /> : <FileAudio className="w-10 h-10 text-brand-500 shrink-0" />}
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <p className="text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-medium truncate text-lg">{file.name}</p>
              <p className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-sm">{(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB</p>
            </div>
            <button onClick={() => setFile(null)}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300 transition">
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : null}

        <input id="fi" type="file" className="hidden" 
          accept={tab === 'docs' ? ".pdf,.docx,.txt,.md,.doc,.html,.htm,.jpg,.jpeg,.png" : ".mp4,.mp3,.wav,.mpeg,.m4a"}
          onChange={e => { if (e.target.files?.[0]) { validateAndSet(e.target.files[0]); e.target.value = ''; } }} />
        
        {sizeError && (
          <p className="mt-3 text-center text-sm text-rose-600">{sizeError}</p>
        )}
        
        {tab === 'docs' && (
          <div className="mt-3 text-center">
            <button onClick={onDemo}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-600 transition font-medium">
              ▶ Демо без файла
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </motion.div>

      {/* Шаг 2: Настройки */}
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.2 }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
          <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-brand-600 dark:bg-brand-500 text-white text-sm flex items-center justify-center font-bold">2</span>
          <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">Настройте параметры</span>
        </div>
        <div className="card p-6">
          <SettingsPanel settings={settings} onChange={onSettingsChange} />
        </div>
      </motion.div>

      {/* Кнопка запуска */}
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} transition={{ delay: 0.3 }}>
        <button
          onClick={handleStart}
          disabled={!isReady}
          className={'w-full h-14 rounded-xl font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition text-base ' +
            (isReady
              ? 'bg-brand-600 hover:bg-brand-700 text-white cursor-pointer shadow-sm hover:shadow-md active:scale-[1.01]'
              : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 cursor-not-allowed')}
        >
          <Zap className="w-5 h-5" />
          {isReady ? 'Запустить анализ' : tab === 'url' ? 'Введите ссылку на страницу' : 'Сначала выберите файл'}
        </button>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
import { useAuth } from '../hooks/useAuth';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { GraduationCap, Mail, Lock, ArrowRight, Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { validateEmail } from '../utils/validators';

export default function Login() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [emailError, setEmailError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (user) navigate('/dashboard');
  }, [user?.id, navigate]);

  const handleGoogleLogin = async () => {
    await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
      provider: 'google',
      options: {
        redirectTo: window.location.origin + '/auth/callback',
      },
    });
  };

  const handleLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    
    const ee = validateEmail(email);
    if (ee) {
      setEmailError(ee);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
    if (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('Invalid login credentials')) {
        setError('Неверный email или пароль');
      } else {
        setError('Произошла ошибка при входе. Проверьте данные.');
      }
    } else navigate('/dashboard');
    setLoading(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="auth-page min-h-screen flex text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
      {/* Left Column: Form */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-start sm:justify-center px-6 sm:px-12 lg:px-24 xl:px-32 relative pt-28 pb-12 sm:py-12">
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/')} className="absolute top-8 left-6 sm:left-12 flex items-center gap-2 group">
          <div className="app-logo-mark w-8 h-8 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center">
            <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-lg tracking-tight group-hover:text-[var(--sf-accent)] transition-colors">Meldy</span>
        </button>

        <motion.div 
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
          className="w-full max-w-sm mx-auto"
        >
          <div className="mb-8">
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 tracking-tight mb-2">Продолжить подготовку</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Ваши материалы, карточки и результаты сохранены в одном месте.</p>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} className="bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-600 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium mb-6">
              {error}
            </motion.div>
          )}

          <form onSubmit={handleLogin} className="space-y-5">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="login-email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">Email</label>
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                  <Mail className="h-5 w-5 text-slate-400" />
                </div>
                <input
                  id="login-email"
                  name="email"
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={e => {
                    setEmail(e.target.value);
                    setEmailError(validateEmail(e.target.value));
                  }}
                  aria-invalid={Boolean(emailError)}
                  aria-describedby={emailError ? 'login-email-error' : undefined}
                  className={`block w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border ${emailError ? 'border-rose-300 focus:border-rose-500 focus:ring-rose-500' : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 focus:ring-[var(--sf-accent)] focus:border-[var(--sf-accent)]'} rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm focus:ring-2 outline-none transition-colors`}
                  placeholder="you@example.com"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              {emailError && <p id="login-email-error" role="alert" className="text-rose-500 text-xs font-medium mt-1.5">{emailError}</p>}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="login-password" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">Пароль</label>
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                  <Lock className="h-5 w-5 text-slate-400" />
                </div>
                <input
                  id="login-password"
                  name="password"
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  className="block w-full pl-11 pr-11 py-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--sf-accent)] focus:border-[var(--sf-accent)] outline-none transition-colors"
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  required
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                  className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 px-3.5 flex items-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:text-[var(--sf-accent)] transition-colors"
                  aria-label={showPassword ? 'Скрыть пароль' : 'Показать пароль'}
                >
                  {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="w-5 h-5" /> : <Eye className="w-5 h-5" />}
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end mt-2">
                <button 
                  type="button" 
                  onClick={() => navigate('/forgot-password')} 
                  className="text-xs font-medium text-[var(--sf-accent)] hover:underline transition-colors"
                >
                  Забыли пароль?
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="group relative w-full flex justify-center py-3.5 px-4 border border-transparent rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-slate-950 bg-cyan-300 hover:bg-cyan-200 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-cyan-400 transition-colors disabled:opacity-70"
            >
              {loading ? (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">Входим… <div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-slate-950/20 border-t-slate-950 rounded-full animate-spin" /></span>
              ) : (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">Войти <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" /></span>
              )}
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="relative my-6">
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center">
              <div className="w-full border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800" />
            </div>
            <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs">
              <span className="auth-divider-label px-3 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">или</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleGoogleLogin}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:border-cyan-300 dark:hover:border-cyan-700 transition-colors"
          >
            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <path d="M17.64 9.20455C17.64 8.56636 17.5827 7.95273 17.4764 7.36364H9V10.845H13.8436C13.635 11.97 13.0009 12.9232 12.0477 13.5614V15.8195H14.9564C16.6582 14.2527 17.64 11.9455 17.64 9.20455Z" fill="#4285F4"/>
              <path d="M9 18C11.43 18 13.4673 17.1941 14.9564 15.8195L12.0477 13.5614C11.2418 14.1014 10.2109 14.4205 9 14.4205C6.65591 14.4205 4.67182 12.8373 3.96409 10.71H0.957275V13.0418C2.43818 15.9832 5.48182 18 9 18Z" fill="#34A853"/>
              <path d="M3.96409 10.71C3.78409 10.17 3.68182 9.59318 3.68182 9C3.68182 8.40682 3.78409 7.83 3.96409 7.29V4.95818H0.957275C0.347727 6.17318 0 7.54773 0 9C0 10.4523 0.347727 11.8268 0.957275 13.0418L3.96409 10.71Z" fill="#FBBC05"/>
              <path d="M9 3.57955C10.3214 3.57955 11.5077 4.03364 12.4405 4.92545L15.0218 2.34409C13.4632 0.891818 11.4259 0 9 0C5.48182 0 2.43818 2.01682 0.957275 4.95818L3.96409 7.29C4.67182 5.16273 6.65591 3.57955 9 3.57955Z" fill="#EA4335"/>
            </svg>
            Войти через Google
          </button>

          <p className="mt-8 text-center text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">
            Нет аккаунта?{' '}
            <button onClick={() => navigate('/register')} className="font-semibold text-[var(--sf-accent)] hover:underline transition-colors">
              Зарегистрироваться
            </button>
          </p>
        </motion.div>
      </div>

      {/* Right Column: Branded Visual (Hidden on mobile) */}
      <div className="auth-showcase hidden lg:flex flex-1 relative overflow-hidden items-center justify-center p-12 border-l">
        <motion.div 
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
          className="relative w-full max-w-lg"
        >
          <p className="auth-showcase-eyebrow text-xs font-medium mb-5">Как работает Meldy</p>
          <h2 className="auth-showcase-title text-4xl font-semibold leading-[1.08] tracking-tight mb-8">От источника до уверенного ответа.</h2>
          <div className="auth-showcase-list border-y divide-y">
            {[
              ['Загрузите материал', 'PDF, DOCX, текст, изображение или запись лекции.'],
              ['Разберите главное', 'Получите конспект со ссылками на исходные фрагменты.'],
              ['Проверьте себя', 'Закрепите тему карточками и коротким тестом.'],
            ].map(([title, description]) => (
              <div key={title} className="py-5">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 mb-1">{title}</h3>
                  <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">{description}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
